method.name: IBMCM_SetSearchOnlyFolderItems
method.qi: Prepares the IBMCM_SearchItem action whether to limit the searches to only folder items.

p.name: strParam
p.qi: True or False

method.ap:
A string or smart parameter value "True" or "False" whether the subsequent IBMCM_SearchItem actions
will limit the result to folder items. Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
If "True", the subsequent IBMCM_SearchItem actions will only search for folder items.
If "False", the subsequent IBMCM_SearchItem actions will search for all items that match the search criteria.
If this action is not called or the parameter is not "True" or "False", the default value of "True" will be used, and IBMCM_SearchItem actions will only return folder items. This action should be called before IBMCM_SearchItem.
IBMCM_SetSearchOnlyFolderItems("False")
IBMCM_SearchItem("", "A1001001A17E08B00210C00000")
This example will search for an item with item ID A1001001A17E08B00210C00000.
If an item is found, regardless of whether it is a folder item or not,
the current item will be set to it.
Otherwise if the item is not found,
the current item will be set to NULL.
IBMCM_SetSearchOnlyFolderItems("True")
IBMCM_SearchItem("", "@P.PageName")
This example will search only for a folder item.
If a folder item is found, the current item will be set to it.
Otherwise if the item is not found or the item is not a folder item,
the current item will be set to NULL.
This example also demonstrates the use of the predefined smart parameter @PageName.
The VScan.Scan action populates @P.PageName to be the filename of the image file without the file extension.
For example, the image file A1001001A17E08B00210C00000.tif will have a PageName of "A1001001A17E08B00210C00000". This smart parameter can be used to identify the CM8 item ID if the image file name conforms to the convention.

method.name: IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria
method.qi: Sets the search criteria for IBMCM_SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: itemType
p.qi: Name of the item type

p.name: attributeName
p.qi: Name of the attribute

p.name: comparisonOperator
p.qi: Comparison operator

p.name: attributeValue
p.qi: Comparison value of the attribute

p.name: dataType
p.qi: Data type of the attribute

method.ap:
Item type name
is mandatory. The search will be limited to the specified item type.
The rest of the parameters are optional. If they are not provided,
then the search will return all items from the specified item type.
If the
attribute name
is specified, the item attribute must exist in the IBM Content Manager repository schema.
If the
comparison operator
is not specified, but the attribute name and value are specified,
then the comparisonOperator defaults to the equal operator, "=". Supported comparison operators are:
"="," < "," < ="," > "," > =","!=","LIKE","NOT LIKE","IS NULL","IS NOT NULL","IN","NOT IN".
The
comparison value of the attribute
is mandatory if the
attribute name
is specified.
For "IS NULL" and "IS NOT NULL" operations, the attribute value and the data type are ignored.
For "LIKE" and "NOT LIKE" operations, the attribute value should include the wildcard character "%".
For "IN" and "NOT IN" operations, the attribute value should be enclosed in parentheses "()" and delimited by commas. See examples below.
The
data type of the attribute
is optional. Supported data types are: "STRING", "DATE", "NUMBER".
The default is "STRING".
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
method.ret:
False,
if parameters are not strings or parameter validations failed. Otherwise,
True.
Some parameter validations are done in this action, others are done in the IBMCM_SearchAndDownload() action.
method.h:
The parameters will be used in IBMCM_SearchAndDownload action to construct the IBM Content Manager query.
If this action is not called and the search criteria has not been set before IBMCM_SearchAndDownload(),
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload() will return False. This action should be called before IBMCM_SearchAndDownload.
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT",,,,)
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadMaximum("100")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadDirectory("C:\datacap\APT\images\input")
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
This example will search and download up to 100 APT CM items' content to the directory, C:\datacap\APT\images\input, with no sorting.
The CM query syntax is "/APT [ICMPARTS]". Each item content will have the item ID as the file name.
For example, A1001001A17E08B00210C00000.tif
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT", "APT_Flag","=","NA",)
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadDirectory("@APPPATH(vscanimagedir)")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadSort("False",,)
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
This example will search and download up to the default maximum number of APT CM items'
content that have not been processed by Datacap into the Smart Parameter VScan image directory.
The CM query syntax is "/APT[ICMPARTS AND @APT_Flag="NA"]". Each item content will have the item ID as the file name.
The file extension will be the same as the file extension of the original file.
For example, A1001001A17E08B00210C00000.jpg
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT", "Quantity",">","5", "NUMBER")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT", "DCStatus","IS NULL",,)
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT", "DCStatus","LIKE","start%",)
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT", "DCStatus","IN","("started","stopped")",)
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT", "Date",">","2017-01-01","DATE")
These are usage examples of the supported data type and comparison operators.

method.name: IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadDirectory
method.qi: Sets the download directory for SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: path
p.qi: The directory where the downloaded files will reside

method.ap:
The parameter will be used as the download directory in
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload
action.
The output directory is mandatory. You must verify that the directory is valid and has write permissions.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.ret:
True,
if parameter is a string. Otherwise,
False.
The directory will not be verified until the
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload
attempts to write to the directory.
method.h:
If this action is not called and the download directory has not been set before IBMCM_SearchAndDownload(),
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload() will return False. This action must be called before IBMCM_SearchAndDownload to set the output directory.
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT",,,)
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadMaximum("100")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadDirectory("C:\datacap\APT\images\input")
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
This example will search and download up to 100 APT CM items' content to the directory, C:\datacap\APT\images\input.
The CM query syntax is "/APT [ICMPARTS] SORTBY(@ITEMID ASCENDING)". Each item content will have the item ID as the file name.
For example, A1001001A17E08B00210C00000.tif
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT", "APT_Flag","=","NA")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadDirectory("@APPPATH(vscanimagedir)")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadSort("True","Date","ASCENDING")
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
This example will search and download up to the default maximum number of APT CM items'
content that have not been processed by Datacap into the Smart Parameter VScan image directory.
The CM query syntax is "/APT[ICMPARTS AND @APT_Flag="NA"] SORTBY(@Date ASCENDING)". Each item content will have the item ID as the file name. The file extension will be the same as the file extension of the original file.
For example, A1001001A17E08B00210C00000.jpg

method.name: IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadMaximum
method.qi: Sets the maximum number of downloads for SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: strParm
p.qi: The maximum number of downloads

method.ap:
The strParm sets the maximum number of downloads in the
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload
action.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
If this action is not called and the download maximum has not been set before IBMCM_SearchAndDownload(),
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload() will use the default maximum, which is 1000. Specify a number less than 1 to have no maximum, and IBMCM_SearchAndDownload() will return all matching items.
This action should be called before IBMCM_SearchAndDownload to change the maximum download.
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT",,,)
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadMaximum("100")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadDirectory("C:\datacap\APT\images\input")
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
This example will search and download up to 100 APT CM items' content to the directory, C:\datacap\APT\images\input.
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
Since this action was not called, the default maximum will be used. This example will search and download up to 1000 of content matching the IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria parameters.
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadMaximum("0")
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
Since the maximum is zero, there will not be a limit to the search. This example will search and download all
content matching the IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria parameters.

method.name: IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadSort
method.qi: Sets the sortby and sort order for SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: doSort
p.qi: True or False to sort

p.name: sortBy
p.qi: Item attribute name to sort by

p.name: sortOrder
p.qi: Sort order ASCENDING or DESCENDING

method.ap:
The
doSort
parameter takes "True" or "False" and determines whether to sort the search results
during the
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload
action.
The
sortBy
parameter is the name of the item attribute to sort by. The item attribute must exist in the CM8 repository schema.
The
sortOrder
parameter takes "ASCENDING" or "DESCENDING" and determines the sort order of the sort by attribute.
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
method.h:
If this action is not called and the sort information has not been set before IBMCM_SearchAndDownload(),
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload() will not sort the returned results.
This action should be called before IBMCM_SearchAndDownload to change the sort information.
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT","Date","IS NULL",)
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadMaximum("100")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadDirectory("C:\datacap\APT\images\input")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadSort("True","Date","ASCENDING")
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
This example will search and download up to 100 APT CM items' content to the directory, C:\datacap\APT\images\input, sorted by the "Date" attribute in ascending order.
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
Since this action was not called, no sorting will be done. This example will search and download
content matching the IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria parameters.

method.name: IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadStatusAttribute
method.qi: Sets the status attribute to update after a successful SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: checkStatus
p.qi: True or False whehter to add checking for download status

p.name: attributeName
p.qi: The Datacap download status attribute name

method.ap:
The
checkStatus
parameter takes "True" or "False" and determines whether to check the download status
of an item during the
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload
action.
The
attribute
must exist and must be defined for the SearchAndDownload item type as a short integer,
with no default. The attribute name is case-sensitive and must be the same as defined in the CM8 System Administration Client.
The default behavior is
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadStatusAttribute("False",).
Setting a status attribute is not required for the
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload
action.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.ret:
True,
if parameters are string. Otherwise,
False.
The attribute will not be verified until the
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload
attempts to update the status attribute value.
method.h:
The status attribute will be used two times during the
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload
action.
First, the search criteria will be appended to search for the attribute being 0 or NULL.
Second, when an item has been downloaded, the attribute will be updated to 1. Note that
if the document item type has enabled versioning to 'always create new version',
then a new version will be create with the changes.
Having a status attribute for the download is beneficial to avoid downloading duplicates with the
same search criteria between batches.
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT",,,,)
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadMaximum("100")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadDirectory("C:\datacap\APT\images\input")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadStatusAttribute("True", "DCStatus")
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
In this example, the CM query syntax is "/APT [ICMPARTS AND (@DCStatus IS NULL OR @DCStatus=0)] ".
During each bach, 100 items will be downloaded and their attributes changed to @DCStatus=1.
Subsequent batches using the
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload
action will not return any items that have already been downloaded, since
the DCStatus is no longer null.
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT","Date"," < ","2017-01-01","DATE")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadStatusAttribute("True","DCStatus")
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
In this example, the CM query syntax is "/APT [ICMPARTS AND @Date < "2017-01-01" AND (@DCStatus IS NULL OR @DCStatus=0)] ".
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadCriteria("APT","APT_Date"," < ","2017-01-01","DATE")
IBMCM_SetSearchAndDownloadStatusAttribute("False",)
IBMCM_SearchAndDownload()
In this example, the CM query syntax is "/APT [ICMPARTS AND @APT_Date < "2017-01-01"] ".
No checking is done whether the item has been downloaded by Datacap before. Unless you do want to be able to download items
that have been downloaded by Datacap before, we recommend that the application
call
IBMCM_SetAttributeValue()
to update the @APT_Date value to prevent the item from matching the criteria
next time.

com.qi: : Uploads and downloads documents from an IBM FileNet P8 repository.
com.h:
The IBMFileNetP8 actions facilitate the uploading and downloading of files between a Datacap application and an IBM® FileNet® P8 repository.
All the systems executing rules that utilize this action library must have both the IBM FileNet Content Engine .NET API
and the Web Services Enhancements (WSE) 3.0 for Microsoft .NET packages installed. The system hosting the Rulerunner service executes
rules and requires the necessary software to be installed. Additionally, rules can also be executed from other clients,
such as Datacap Desktop or web services machines, which must have the appropriate supporting files available.
The actions P8Login and P8SetTargetObjectID must be set prior to calling an action that interacts with
the FileNet P8 server. When the login action is performed, the login is valid for the current task profile.
When FileNet P8 actions are used across multiple task profiles, a separate login is required for each profile.

method.name: P8AddRedactionsToP8Document
method.qi: : Adds redactions to a P8 document
method.ap: None. The page property "PageName" is used.
method.h:
Adds redactions to an existing FileNet P8 document. This action requires one or more fields to first be redacted using
the RedactFields action in the Redact action library.
This action requires that documents were previously downloaded by P8SearchAndDownload action, or files that have
filenames beginning with the P8 object ID and the same ID exists on the FileNet server.
The MVScan action Scan copies files from an input directory and
adds them to the current batch. The MVscan Scan action also saves the base filename to a
page-level variable named "PageName". The P8AddRedactionsToP8Document action uses the "PageName" variable as the object ID
to find the FileNet P8 document to be updated. This page name must start with a valid FileNet document ID.
Example filename: "{3054025F-0000-CE12-B41A-7B2661D28802}.APT008.tif"
.......
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("@STRING(C:/mylocaldir)")
P8SetSearchWhereClause("DocumentTitle LIKE '2017-Invoices%'")
P8SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
.......
RedactFields("CCPattern1", "Redact_CreditCard", "4,4,4,4", True)
P8AddRedactionsToP8Document()
The example configures search criteria then downloads documents. The documents are
added to the batch with the Scan action. Application specific processing is performed until
there is a rule that adds redactions to the document. The P8AddRedactionsToP8Document action
then updates the existing document on the FileNet server with the redaction information.

method.name: P8CreateFolder
method.qi: : Creates a folder on the P8 repository.

p.name: FolderPath
p.qi: The name of the folder to create on the P8 system. Do not include the folder path, only specify the folder name.

method.ap: Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Creates a subfolder on a previously specified destination folder. The newly created
folder is set as the new destination folder for uploaded files.
The new folder is created within the folder set by the P8SetDestinationFolder action.
If the destination folder has not been set, then the folder is created on the root of the FileNet repository.
This action must be preceded by the P8Login and P8SetTargetObjectID actions.
P8SetDestinationFolder("@STRING(\1040EZ\Export\)")
P8CreateFolder("@BATCHID")
This example creates a subfolder under the \1040EZ\Export\ folder on the FileNet system and changes
the destination folder to the newly created folder. For example:
"\1040EZ\Export\20261009.000019".
If the folder is created successfully, the action adds a DCO variable, “Folder_ID”,
to the current DCO with the unique folder ID returned from FileNet Web Service.
P8Login("FileNetURL", "P8User", "@APPVAR(values/adv/P8Login)")
P8SetTargetClassID("ObjectStore")
P8SetTargetObjectID("p8os1")
P8SetDestinationFolder("@STRING(\DatacapFolder\)")
P8CreateFolder("@BATCHID")
This example demonstrates the logon actions on the same rule, typically a batch rule.
It creates a subfolder, whose name is based on the current batch ID,
under \DatacapFolder folder on the FileNet system and changes the destination folder to the newly created folder.
For example: "\DatacapFolder\20251023.000000". If the folder is created successfully,
the action adds a DCO variable, “Folder_ID”, to the current DCO with the unique folder ID returned from FileNet Web Service.
method.ret:
False,
if the parameter is invalid, the set up information is invalid,
or the folder cannot be created. Otherwise,
True.
Note: If the action returns False, the task is set to a status of “Aborted”.

method.name: P8Login
method.qi: : Provide the URL and login credentials for the P8 repository.

p.name: FileNetURL
p.qi: The URL for the FileNet P8 repository server.

p.name: LoginName
p.qi: The user ID the application uses for the FileNet P8 connection.

p.name: Password
p.qi: The password for the specified login name.

method.ap:
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters. To encrypt the password, it is recommended that
the password is placed into
the Datacap Application Manager's "Advanced Values" section.
The encrypted password location is specified in the parameter using smart parameter syntax.
method.h:
Creates the connection to the IBM FileNet P8 system. Subsequent FileNet actions use
the connection for uploading and downloading files.
P8Login("FileNetURL", "P8User", "@APPVAR(values/adv/FilenetPassword)")
P8SetTargetObjectID("AP_ObjectStore")
P8SetTargetObjectID("p8os1")
The example shows that the password is stored in the application manager in a variable called "FilenetPassword".
This usage encrypts the password within the application manager and the password is obtained from the stored location at runtime.
P8Login("FileNetURL", "P8User", "P8Password")
P8SetTargetObjectID("ObjectStore")
P8SetTargetObjectID("p8os1")
The example shows that the password is hard coded within the action rules.
Instructions on Installing SSL Certificates for the Content Platform Engine
To ensure secure communication with the Content Platform Engine application server, install your SSL certificate into the appropriate certificate store:
Standard SSL Certificate: Install the certificate into the "Trusted People" certificate store.
Chained SSL Certificate: Install the root certificate into the "Trusted Root Certification Authorities" certificate store.
For example, if your FileNet URL is "https://˂ipaddress˃:9443/acce", open this link in a browser and
download the SSL certificate from the site. Then, import the certificate into the relevant store as described above.
method.lvl: All, but generally at the Batch level.
method.ret:
False,
the FileNet P8 client software is not installed, if the login credentials are incorrect,
or an error occurs. Otherwise,
True.
method.see:
Refer to the top-level hop of this action library for information about this action library, including required
FileNetP8 connectivity software.

method.name: P8SearchAndDownload
method.qi: : Locates documents on the FileNet repository and downloads them to the batch or a directory.
method.ap:
None. The action uses the parameters set in the P8SetSearch* actions for executing the search against FileNet P8 repository.
First call the P8SetSearch* actions to configure the search then call P8SearchAndDownload to perform the search operation.
method.h:
Executes a search for documents in FileNet P8 and downloads the content of the documents returned by the search.
If the documents are being downloaded for processing by a Datacap application,
the downloaded documents can be ingested into the batch using the MVScan action library.
By default, the maximum number of search results are limited to 1000 documents. Use the action
P8SetSearchMaximumItems
to set a different maximum.
The user ID or process running the rules must have write permissions to the target directory. If a file already exists in the directory
with the same name as the content being downloaded, the existing file is overwritten.
After P8SearchAndDownload has downloaded the FileNet P8 content files, Scan() action can be called to read the files from the same directory,
bringing them into the currently running batch.
Important:
to prevent downloading duplicate item content, the task that calls P8SearchAndDownload action should not be run in a
multiple Rulerunner configuration.
Instead, use a single Rulerunner configured to run the vscan tasks that downloads from FileNet P8 and adds the files to the batch.
For information about configuring threads in Rulerunner, see the Knowledge Center
section: "Configuring Rulerunner to Run Tasks".
The following actions are
required
to be called prior to calling
P8SearchAndDownload
. See the help for these actions for more details.
P8SetURL
P8Login
P8SetTargetObjectID
P8SetSearchClass
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory
The following actions can optionally be called prior to calling
P8SearchAndDownload
.
Use the actions below, as needed, to filter which documents are downloaded by the P8SearchAndDownload action.
See the help for these actions for more details.
P8SetSearchWhereClause
P8SetSearchFolderRestriction
P8SetSearchOrderBy
P8SetSearchMaximumItems
P8SetSearchCurrentVersionOnly
P8SetSearchIncludeDocsWithoutContent
P8SetSearchIncludeSubclasses
P8SetSearchAndDownloadStatusProperty
P8SetURL("http://myp8server:9080/wsi/FNCEWS40MTOM/")
P8Login("User1,Password1")
P8SetTargetObjectID("AP_ObjectStore")
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("@APPPATH(vscanimagedir)")
P8SetSearchWhereClause("DocumentTitle LIKE '2017-Invoices%'")
P8SetSearchMaximumItems(“100”)
P8SetSearchOrderBy("InvoiceDate ASC“)
P8SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
This example searches for documents of "Invoice" class which have property "DocumentTitle" matching the
wildcard string '2017-Invoice%', sort the results in ascending order based on the InvoiceDate property,
take the top 100 results and download the contents of those documents to the directory specified in the Smart Parameter
for the MVScan image directory.
The output file name is a concatenation of the FileNet P8 item ID and the original upload file name of
the content (if it exists). If the original upload file name does not exist, then the default file extension
".tif" is used when the mime type of the content is "image/tiff".
Example: {3054025F-0000-CE12-B41A-7B2661D28802}.0.Flight1.tif.
When the Scan() action runs, it ingests the files from the populated directory into the the batch,
allowing the files to be processed by subsequent application rules.
P8SetURL("http://myp8server:9080/wsi/FNCEWS40MTOM/")
P8Login("User1,Password1")
P8SetTargetObjectID("AP_ObjectStore")
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("@APPPATH(vscanimagedir)")
P8SetSearchWhereClause("DocumentTitle LIKE '2017-Invoices%'")
P8SetSearchMaximumItems(“100”)
P8SetSearchAndDownloadStatusProperty("myStatusProp")
P8SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
This example is similar to earlier one. The main differences:
1. For each document downloaded, the property "myStatusProp" of the document is set to value of 1.
2. When searching for documents, any documents which have "myStatusProp=1" are excluded from the search.

method.name: P8SetDefineSecurityParentage
method.qi: : Configures how a file's security is determined.

p.name: Inherit
p.qi: Inherit parent security: True/False.

method.ap:
True:
Specifies that security is to be inherited from the parent folder.
False:
Specifies that security is not inherited from the parent folder.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Configures the document upload to inherit the security properties from the parent folder.
If this action is not called or if the parameter is not "True" or "False", the default value of "False" is used,
and the security is not inherited from the parent folder.
P8SetDestinationFolder("@APPVAR(values/gen/P8Folder)")
P8SetDefineSecurityParentage("True")
P8Upload()

method.name: P8SetDestinationFolder
method.qi: : Sets the destination folder for the documents being uploaded.

p.name: Destination
p.qi: An existing folder on the FileNet server.

method.ap:
The path to the destination FileNet P8 folder in the selected Object Store where documents are uploaded. For example: /MyApplication.
Note: The trailing slash is optional. Folders that are children of the root folder are not required to have a slash
after the name. In some cases a main folder of the object store requires a trailing '\', if the 'object store' is configured for it.
Providing the destination folder "Unfiled Documents" (case insensitive), sets the upload folder as FileNet's special "Unfiled Documents" folder.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Sets the destination folder for the documents being uploaded.
If this action is not called, the default value is the root folder of the specified target object.
Note: The action P8CreateFolder also updates the destination folder.
P8SetDestinationFolder("@STRING(\DatacapFolder\)")
In this example, DatacapFolder refers to an existing folder located under the Root Folder.
The path is enclosed within the @STRING smart parameter to ensure that the backslashes (\) are treated as literal characters,
rather than being interpreted as smart parameter delimiters.

method.name: P8SetDocumentClassAndTitle

p.name: ClassID
p.qi: The P8 Document Class ID.

p.name: Title
p.qi: The document title.

method.ap: Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Sets the Document Class and Title to be used in FileNet P8 for the documents being uploaded in subsequent actions.
P8SetDocumentClassAndTitle("CarRental", "@BATCHID+-+@ID")
This action would typically be run on a document or page DCO node.
The example sets the ClassID to 'CarRental' and the Title is '20251023.000001-TM000001',
which is current batch ID and current object ID,
separated by a "-". These values are applied to the documents uploaded to FileNet P8.

method.name: P8SetFileType
method.qi: : Identifies the type of files to upload to P8

p.name: FileExtension
p.qi: The file type to upload to P8.

method.ap:
Valid types are "tif", "jpeg", "jpg", "jpe", "gif", "pdf", "xls", "doc", "msg", "docx", "xlsx","zip","mpp","vsd","ppt".
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
This action sets the file type, and optionally, the MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions) type, or content type,
for uploaded documents with matching file extensions.
If the mime type is specified, it overrides the default mime type mapping and can specify the mime type
for files that do not have a default mime type.
The list below are default mime types for various file types:
The following file type extensions have default MIME type mappings:
ai : application/illustrator
avi : video/x-msvideo
bmp : image/bmp
doc : application/msword
docx : application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
dwg : image/vnd.dwg
dxf : image/vnd.dxf
gif : image/gif
htm : text/html
html : text/html
ico : image/x-icon
jpe : image/jpeg
jpeg : image/jpeg
jpg : image/jpeg
jpgv : video/jpeg
m4v : video/x-m4v
mov : video/quicktime
mp4 : video/mp4
mpeg : video/mpeg
mpg : video/mpeg
mpp : application/vnd.ms-project
mpv : video/mpv
msg : application/msoutlook
ogg : application/ogg
pcx : image/x-pcx
pdf : application/pdf
pic : image/x-pict
png : image/png
ppt : application/vnd.ms-powerpoint
pptx : application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation
qt : video/quicktime
rgb : image/x-rgb
rtf : text/richtext
tif : image/tiff
tiff : image/tiff
txt : text/plain
vsd : application/vnd.visio
wmd : application/x-ms-wmd
wmv : video/x-ms-wmv
wmx : video/x-ms-wmx
xls : application/vnd.ms-excel
xlsx : application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
xml : text/xml
Other file types are mapped to the generic
'application/octet-stream' MIME type.
P8SetFileType(".tif")
method.ret:
Always returns
True.

method.name: P8SetKeyProperty
method.qi: : Configures the value of the search property used by the P8UpdateProperties action.

p.name: PropertyName
p.qi: The property name (symbolic name) of a document in FileNet P8 repository.

p.name: PropertyValue
p.qi: The corresponding value of the property.

method.ap:
There should be 1 document in the destination P8 Object Store which has matching property with the corresponding value.
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
method.h:
Sets the key that is used by the P8UpdateProperties action. The key is a FileNet document property name and
its corresponding value. The P8UpdateProperties action uses the key to search for an existing FileNet P8 document.
If the document is found, the properties on the document is updated with the values specified in the P8SetProperty
actions.
Important: The P8UpdateProperties action only updates the first document returned which matches the criteria
specified by the parameters of this action.
P8SetTargetObjectID("os1")
P8SetKeyProperty("DCKey", "@X.DCKey")
P8SetProperty("FNProperty", "@X.SomeValue")
P8UpdateProperties()
This example uses the parameters of P8SetKeyProperty("DCKey", "@X.DCKey") to search for a
FileNet P8 document in an object store, with the property name "DCKey" and the property value
of the variable "DCKey".
If the DCO variable DCKey had the value of "123", then the P8UpdateProperties action searches
for a document that has the P8 property "DCKey" with the value "123".
If the FileNet document is found, it is assigned the
values specified in the SetProperty action where the property "FNProperty" is
updated with the value of the DCO variable "SomeValue", when the UpdateProperties action is called.
The P8UpdateProperties action only updates on the first document that is returned from the P8SetKeyProperty
action.
If more than one document matches the criteria specified in the P8SetKeyProperty action,
only the first document is updated.
The P8Login action must be called in a previous ruleset within the current task.
P8SetTargetObjectID("os1")
P8SetKeyProperty("ID", "{7E2A4DB7-17D2-CFF2-8A95-96D458200000}")
P8SetProperty("PickupLocation", "Lot 1")
P8UpdateProperties()
This second example is similar to the previous example.
Here the example has explicit parameters to illustrate how a document could be found
using the document ID, updated properties are set, then P8UpdateProperties
performs the update operation.

method.name: P8SetLocale
method.qi: : Configures the locale for the P8 server.

p.name: LocaleID
p.qi: Locale value accepted by the FileNet P8 Web Service.

method.ap:
Locales are represented by 2-letter ISO 639 Language Codes and 2-letter ISO 3166 Country Codes
separated by a _ character. For example: en_US or de_DE.
Please consult the ISO documents to determine your locale value.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Sets the Locale (the language and language conventions such as date format) used on the P8 server.
This action is only required if the P8 repository uses a locale other than US English.
If this action is not called, the value defaults to "en_US".
P8SetLocale("en_US")
method.lvl: All, but generally at the Batch level.
method.ret:
False,
an error occurs. Otherwise,
True.
This action does not validate that the provided locale is valid or accepted by the P8 server.
Refer to the FileNet P8 documentation for information about supported locales.

method.name: P8SetMultiplePageDocuments
method.qi: : Instructs the P8Upload action to create a single or multiple page P8 document.

p.name: Enabled
p.qi: Enable multiple page documents when uploading: True/False.

method.ap:
True:
Enable multiple page documents for upload.
False:
Disable multiple page documents for upload. This is the default value.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Indicates whether the upload actions should create one P8 document per page or not.
P8SetMultiplePageDocuments("True")
P8Upload()
Setting P8SetMultiplePageDococuments("True") instructs the P8Upload or P8UploadDirectory actions to create one P8 document that contains multiple pages.
If P8SetMultiplePageDocuments
is set to "True" then the P8Upload or P8UploadDirectory actions place all the pages listed the DCO into one, single, P8 document.
The default behavior is for the P8Upload and P8UploadDirectory actions to create a P8 document for each individual page list in the document DCO object.
P8SetMultiplePageDocuments("True")
P8UploadDir()

method.name: P8SetMultipleValueProperty
method.qi: : Sets a P8 multiple value property.

p.name: PropertyID
p.qi: The P8 identifier that supports multiple values.

p.name: PropertyValue
p.qi: A value enclosed within single quotes are treated as string literal.

p.name: PropertyType
p.qi: Optional property type, defaults to string.

method.ap: Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
method.h:
This action sets the value of a FileNet P8 multi-value property. The action allows multiple
values separated by a configurable separator or the action can be called multiple times for the same property.
The property delimiter is obtained from the application service location: "values/gen/p8delimiter".
If a custom delimiter is not configured, a pipe '|' is used as the default delimiter.
If the property value contains a '|' then choose a separator character that is unique for the property value.
The property type is optional. If this parameter is not provided, the default value is a "String".
Refer to the FileNet P8 documentation for a list of Property Types.
P8SetDocumentClassAndTitle("MyFilenetClass", "MyFilenetClass Documents")
P8SetProperty("CustomerName", "@D.CustomerName", "")
P8SetMultipleValueProperty("PurchaseDates", "03/14/2025|04/14/2025|05/14/2025", "")
P8SetProperty("ScanStation", "@STATION", "")
P8SetProperty("ScanOperator", "@OPERATOR", "")
P8SetFileType("pdf")
P8Upload()
This example shows multiple values are passed in a single call to P8SetMultipleValueProperty.
P8SetDocumentClassAndTitle("MyFilenetClass", "MyFilenetClass Documents")
P8SetProperty("CustomerName", "@D.CustomerName", "")
P8SetMultipleValueProperty("PurchaseDates", "03/14/2025", "")
P8SetMultipleValueProperty("PurchaseDates", "04/14/2025", "")
P8SetMultipleValueProperty("PurchaseDates", "05/14/2025", "")
P8SetProperty("ScanStation", "@STATION", "")
P8SetProperty("ScanOperator", "@OPERATOR", "")
P8SetFileType("pdf")
P8Upload()
This example shows P8SetMultipleValueProperty called multiple times, each time a different value is added to a property.
The example shows all of the calls being made in the same function and DCO object. The action can be called from
different DCO objects, such as Field1, Field2, etc., as long as all of the objects are processed
before the upload is performed.
method.ret:
False,
if the ID or Value parameters are missing or if the specified property
is not a multi-value property. Otherwise
True.

method.name: P8SetOverrideCheckoutOnUpdateContent
method.qi: : Controls the behavior of the P8UpdateContent action.

p.name: Override
p.qi: Checkout document for content update: True/False.

method.ap:
True:
Indicates to checkout P8 documents when the P8UpdateContent action is called.
False:
Instructs the P8UpdateContent action to not checkout documents.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
This action is optional. If used, it must be called prior to the action P8UpdateContent.
Set to “True” to tell
P8UpdateContent
to try to check-in a P8 document, if it is already checked out.
Set to “False” to tell
P8UpdateContent
to not update the content and to return false, if a P8 document is already checked out.
If this action is not called, the default value is "False".
......
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchWhereClause("DocumentTitle LIKE '2017-Invoices%'")
P8SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
......
P8SetOverrideCheckoutOnUpdateContent("True")
P8UpdateContent()
This example updates contents of the P8 document even if the document is already checked out.
The credentials used for the FileNet login action must have permission on the FileNet system to check out documents.
method.ret:
True,
if valid value ("True" or "False") is passed.
False,
if invalid value is passed or if an error occurs.

method.name: P8SetProperty
method.qi: : Sets the specified P8 property ID to a value with an optional type.

p.name: PropertyID
p.qi: The name of an existing document property in the FileNet library (equivalent to a document index field).

p.name: PropertyValue
p.qi: The value to assign to the associated Property ID. A value enclosed within single quotes are treated as string literal.

p.name: PropertyType
p.qi: Optional property type, defaults to string.

method.ap:
Supported property types are: Binary, Boolean, DateTime, Float, ID, Integer, Object and String.
Smart Parameters are supported for parameters.
method.h:
Sets the designated FileNet property to a specified value.
This is equivalent to setting an index value for a document in document management systems.
Only document properties can be set. Other properties, such as folder properties, cannot be set.
Note: Any ruleset that calls the P8SetProperty action more than once, using the same Property ID as the opening parameter the
property value does not create a multi-value property, it replaces the existing property value that was set by any previous ruleset.
P8SetProperty("DocumentTitle, @ID")
P8Upload()
method.ret:
False,
if either parameter is blank or if the value parameter is invalid. Otherwise
True.
Note: If the action returns False, the action sets the task to finish
with a status of “Abort”. Invalid property settings may not be detected or reported until P8Upload is run.

method.name: P8SetRetry
method.qi: : Sets the number of automatic upload retries for the P8Upload action.

p.name: NumberOfRetries
p.qi: Number of attempts to upload files.

method.ap: Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Use this action to set the amount of retries for the FileNet P8 upload actions. If the upload to FileNet fails, the
upload action retries the number of times specified by the P8SetRetry action.
If this action is not called prior to a FileNet upload action, the default amount of retries is 0.
P8SetRetry("3")
P8Upload()
The example configures the P8Upload action to retry 3 times, if the upload to FileNet fails.
method.ret:
False,
if a non-numeric parameter specified or if an error occurs. Otherwise
True.

method.name: P8SetSearchAndDownloadStatusProperty
method.qi: : Indicates if a document has already been downloaded.

p.name: Status
p.qi: FileNet property to use for download status tracking.

method.ap:
A name (symbolic name) of an existing integer property of the FileNet P8 document class specified by the action "P8SetSearchClass".
The name of the property is not validated until the P8SearchAndDownload action is executed.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Configures the P8 property on the document that is updated by P8SearchAndDownload, and set to 1, to indicate that the document has been downloaded.
Documents that have the property with a value of 1 are not downloaded again the next time P8SearchAndDownload is run.
The specified property must exist on the document and must be an integer type.
This action is optional. If used, this action must be called prior to the action P8SearchAndDownload.
If this action is not called, the default behavior is that no properties on the P8 document are updated by the "P8SearchAndDownload" action
when a P8 document is downloaded, and no status property are checked when searching for documents to download.
Set the parameter to an empty string "" to clear a previously set status property.
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchAndDownloadStatusProperty("myStatusProp")
P8SearchAndDownload()
In this example, P8SearchAndDownload() downloads P8 documents of class "Invoice" and set the property "myStatusProp"
to value of 1 for each document that is downloaded. When P8SearchAndDownload performs its search, any documents
with the property myStatusProp with a value of 1 are excluded from the search and are not downloaded.
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchAndDownloadStatusProperty("")
P8SearchAndDownload()
In this example, P8SetSearchAndDownloadStatusProperty("") clears any previously set value for the download status
property name. "P8SearchAndDownload" downloads P8 documents of class "Invoice", but does
not
set a status
property on documents that have been downloaded. When "P8SearchAndDownload" actions performs its search, there is no
check of a status property, so P8 documents that may have been previously been downloaded are included.
method.ret:
False,
if an error occurs. Otherwise,
True.
The existence of the property on the document class is not verified until
the action P8SearchAndDownload is called.

method.name: P8SetSearchClass
method.qi: : Configures the document class for the P8SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: ClassName
p.qi: The name (symbolic FileNet P8 name) of the class of document to search for in FileNet P8.

method.ap: Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Sets the P8 name of the document class used by a subsequent call to P8SearchAndDownload.
This action is required prior to calling action P8SearchAndDownload.
The name of the class is not validated until the P8SearchAndDownload action is executed.
By default, subclasses of the specified class are included in the search results.
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
method.see:
P8SetSearchIncludeSubClasses
to control whether or not subclasses are included.

method.name: P8SetSearchCurrentVersionOnly
method.qi: : Limits the P8SearchAndDownload action to the current document version only.

p.name: CurrentVersionOnly
p.qi: Only include current document versions when searching: True/False.

method.ap:
True:
Limit the search results to only the current version of documents.
False:
Allow search results to include any version of documents.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
The use of this action is optional prior to calling action
P8SearchAndDownload
.
If not set, the default value is "True".
If an invalid value is given for the parameter, i.e. not "True" or "False", then the action has no effect on the setting and the setting stays the
same value as it was prior to the action.
When set to "True", the search criteria used by the action "P8SearchAndDownload" includes the condition "IsCurrentVersion=True".
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("@STRING(C:/mylocaldir)")
P8SetSearchCurrentVersionOnly("False")
P8SearchAndDownload()

method.name: P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory
method.qi: : Sets the directory where files downloaded from P8 are placed by the P8SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: DirectoryPath
p.qi: The full directory path indicating where to place the files downloaded from P8.

method.ap: Smart parameters are supported.

h.p:
Files downloaded from P8 are placed in the specified directory. These files can be subsequently
placed into a Datacap batch using the MVscan action library. This action is required prior to calling action
P8SearchAndDownload
as it configures the destination location for the download.

The user or process running the P8SearchAndDownload action must have write permission to the directory specified by this action.
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory does not validate that the directory exists or that the process has permissions to write to this directory.
h.e:
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("@APPPATH(vscanimagedir)")
P8SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
This example downloads the content of the search documents to the directory specified by the Smart Parameter for the VScan image directory.

P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("@STRING(C:\mylocaldir"))
P8SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
This example downloads the content of the search documents to the directory "C:\mylocaldir".

method.name: P8SetSearchFolderRestriction
method.qi: : Restricts the P8 folder used in a subsequent P8SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: P8SearchFolderPath
p.qi: The path of the P8 folder where the search is performed by P8SearchAndDownload.

method.ap: Smart parameters are supported.

h.p:
Narrows the search area of the P8SearchAndDownload action to a specific folder on the FileNet server.
If this action is used to set a folder path, the action P8SearchAndDownload uses the folder restriction when searching the FileNet repository.
The folder path is not validated until the P8SearchAndDownload action is performed. If the path does not
start with a forward or reverse slash, P8SearchAndDownload generates an error.
If the path is syntactically valid but does not exist on the P8 server, or if the search criteria is not matched,
P8SearchAndDownload does not generate an error, it simply does not return any results.

Sets a FileNet P8 folder path to restrict the search results. The search results do
not
include subfolders of the folder. Set to empty an string
to unset a previously set value.
This action is optional and, if used, must be called prior to calling action
P8SearchAndDownload
.

NOTE: Setting the folder restriction may result in only document versions with version state value of "Released" being included in search result. Refer to FileNet P8
documentation to confirm the expected behavior.

method.ret:
False,
if an error occurs. Otherwise,
True.
The folder path is not validated by this action.

method.name: P8SetSearchIncludeDocumentsWithoutContent
method.qi: : Indicates if documents without content are to be included in search results.

p.name: Include
p.qi: Include empty documents in search results: True/False.

method.ap:
True:
documents without content are included in the search results.
False:
documents without content are not included in the search results. If the parameter is invalid, it is treated as False.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Configures the P8SearchAndDownload action to include empty documents.
This action is optional. If used, it must be called prior to calling the action P8SearchAndDownload.
If this action is not called, the default value used by P8SearchAndDownload is False.
In general, it should not be necessary to change the default setting which filters out content-less documents from the search results since there
should be no content to download for those documents. This action is only provided in case there is any unexpected behavior with the search clause used to
filter out content-less documents, and there is a need to turn off the filtering.
When this setting is "False", the search criteria used by P8SearchAndDownload includes the condition "ContentSize > 0".
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchIncludeDocumentsWithoutContent("True")
P8SearchAndDownload()

method.name: P8SetSearchIncludeSubClasses
method.qi: : Configures if subclasses should be included in search results.

p.name: IncludeSubclasses
p.qi: Include subclasses in the document search: True/False.

method.ap:
True:
Include documents of the class specified by the action P8SetSearchClass and all the subclasses of the
search class in search results.
False:
Include documents only of the class specified by the action P8SetSearchClass in search results.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
The value of this setting is used by the action "P8SearchAndDownload" to set the search behavior using the FileNet P8 API method "SQLSearch.SetFromClauseInitialValue".
This action is optional prior to calling action
P8SearchAndDownload.
If not set, the default is True.
If an invalid value is given for the parameter (i.e. not "True" or "False"), then the action has no effect on the setting and the setting stays the
same value as it was prior to the action.
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchIncludeSubClasses("False")
P8SearchAndDownload()
method.ret:
Always
True.

method.name: P8SetSearchMaximumItems
method.qi: : Configures the maximum results returned from P8SearchAndDownload.

p.name: MaximumSearchResults
p.qi: Maximum number of documents to download.

method.ap:
An integer specifying the maximum number of items to return in search results.
A value of "0" indicates no limit.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
The parameter limits the amount of results from the P8SearchAndDownload action.
This action is optional. If used, it must be called prior to the action P8SearchAndDownload.
If this action is not called, the default maximum is 1000.
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDir("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchMaximumItems(“100”)
P8SearchAndDownload()

method.name: P8SetSearchOrderBy
method.qi: : Configures the results order for the P8SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: OrderBy
p.qi: Orders the search results, ASC/DESC.

method.ap:
Configures the ORDERBY clause for sorting search results.
The parameter must have the P8 property name followed by a space with
the word "ASC", for an ascending order or the word "DESC", for a descending order.
Parameter format: PROPERTY_NAME ASC|DESC.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
This action changes the order of results returned by the action P8SearchAndDownload.
This action is optional. If it is used, it must be called prior to P8SearchAndDownload
but within the same task profile.
Set to empty string to clear a previously set value.
The parameter is not validated until the SearchAndDownload action is performed.
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDir("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchOrderBy("DocumentTitle ASC“)
P8SearchAndDownload()
In this example, the results are sorted by DocumentTitle in ascending order.
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDir("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchOrderBy("DocumentTitle DESC“)
P8SearchAndDownload()
In this example, the results are sorted by DocumentTitle in descending order.

method.name: P8SetSearchWhereClause
method.qi: : Sets the SQL where clause for the P8SearchAndDownload action.

p.name: WhereClause
p.qi: The clause used in the search query by P8SearchAndDownload.

method.ap:
The SQL search criteria (i.e. the WHERE clause). The criteria should follow the standard used
by FileNet P8 query, which generally conforms to the SQL-92 standard. Please reference the FileNet P8
Knowledge Center for a complete description.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
This action sets the SQL search criteria (i.e. the WHERE clause).
Set to empty string "" to clear a previously set WHERE clause.
Note that only parametric search is supported, not content-based (full-text) search.
This action is optional prior to calling action P8SearchAndDownload.
The syntax of the WHERE clause is not validated until the FNP8_SearchAndDownload action is executed.
The SQL search criteria must follow the IBM FileNet standard, which generally conforms to SQL-92,
with extensions for IBM FileNet specific constructs. For a complete description, see the
IBM Knowledge Center for IBM FileNet P8 Platform.
The clause is not validated until the P8SearchAndDownload action is executed.
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchWhereClause("DocumentTitle LIKE '2017-Invoices%'")
P8SearchAndDownload()

method.name: P8SetTargetClassID
method.qi: : Configures a target class of ObjectStore or FileStore.

p.name: ObjectID
p.qi: Repository type: ObjectStore/FileStore.

method.ap:
The valid values are "ObjectStore" and "FileStore".
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Sets the top level repository type.
If this action is not called, the default value of "ObjectStore" is used.
FileStore is an alternative repository type.
P8SetTargetClassID("ObjectStore")

method.name: P8SetTargetObjectID
method.qi: : Configures the P8 object ID for the P8Upload action.

p.name: ObjectID
p.qi: The P8 Object Store name to use for uploads and downloads.

method.ap: Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Configures the name of the Object Store on the FileNet server which is used
for searches and uploads. This action must be called after login and prior to any action that
interacts with the FileNet server.
P8Login("TheURL", "User1", "@APPVAR(values/adv/FilenetPassword)")
P8SetTargetClassID("ObjectStore")
P8SetTargetObjectID("AP_ObjectStore")
method.lvl: All, but generally at the Batch level.

method.name: P8SetTimeout
method.qi: : Configures the timeout for the P8Upload action.

p.name: Timeout
p.qi: Upload timeout in milliseconds.

method.ap:
A single parameter identifying the timeout in milliseconds for the FileNet P8 Web Service.
The default timeout is 600000 milliseconds (600 seconds).
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
This action sets the timeout in milliseconds for the FileNet P8 Web Service.
To take effect, this action must be called before the P8Upload action.
P8SetTimeout("90000")
P8Upload()
method.lvl: All, but generally at the Batch level.
method.ret:
False,
if the parameter is not valid or if an error occurs.
Otherwise,
True.

method.name: P8SetUploadFileNameVariable
method.qi: : Changes the P8Upload action to look for filenames in a specific variable instead of the associated page file.

p.name: DCOVariable
p.qi: Name of DCO variable containing the upload file name.

method.ap:
The name of the variable on the page object that contains the name of the file to upload.
Smart parameters are supported. If you supply a smart parameter, it must resolve to the name
of the DCO variable that exists on the page object that contains the name of the file. It must not
resolve to the file name itself.
method.h:
Identifies the DCO variable used by P8Upload to identify the files to upload to a FileNet P8 repository.
The name of the specified variable must exist on a page level object.
If the complete file path is specified in the variable, the full path is used as-is.
If the path is incomplete, the current batch directory is automatically added to the filename.
If the variable does not exist on the page, or if the variable is blank, then the page is skipped.
If this action is not called, the value defaults to blank and the upload action uses the standard file
that is associated with each page as specified in the IMAGENAME variable.
Refer to the P8Upload action help for an explanation of the upload steps.
P8SetUploadFileNameVariable("P8File")
P8Upload()
This example instructs the P8Upload action to obtain the name of the file to upload by looking
in the variable called "P8File" on the page object. This variable must have been set earlier in the application rules.
If the variable contains a file name with a full path specification, such as "C:\Upload\MyFile1.tif", then the specified file is uploaded
instead of the page file associated with the page. If the variable contains a file name without a path, such as
"MyFile1.tif", then the upload action assumes the file is within the current batch directory.
method.ret:
Always
True.

method.name: P8UpdateContent
method.qi: : Updates the content of a document in a FileNet P8 repository as a new version.
method.ap: None. The FileNet ID contained page DCO variable "PageName" is used to identify the file to update.
method.h:
Checks in a file as a new version of an existing FileNet document.
If any fields have been redacted, this action also adds redactions to the existing FileNet P8 document.
To only add redactions without updating content, use the action P8AddRedactionsToP8Document.
The functionality is in contrast to P8Upload, where the P8Upload action creates a new document in the FileNet repository and
P8UpdateContent versions an existing document.
Important:
This action can only be used for documents that were downloaded by P8SearchAndDownload action, or that have
filenames beginning with the P8 object ID.
Example filename: "{3054025F-0000-CE12-B41A-7B2661D28802}.0.APT008.tif"
The PageName variable is used to identify the Object ID of the FileNet document to update.
The DCO level determines the location of the PageName variable.
If run at page-level, the action uses the "PageName" variable on the current page.
If run at document-level, the action uses the "PageName" variable on the first page of the current document.
The PageName variable must be properly set prior to using the P8UpdateContent action. The PageName variable
is created by the Scan action in the MVscan action library. If the PageName variable does not exist, or if the
value is not correct for the document to upload, then the PageName variable must be set prior to calling P8UpdateContent.
Important: Handling of P8 documents with multiple content elements
A document in FileNet P8 can have one or more content elements. In order to update P8 documents with multiple content elements, the
P8UpdateContent action must be run at the Document-level and the content elements must correspond to pages of the
same document in the Datacap document hierarchy. In addition, the action P8MultiPageDocuments("True") must be called prior to
P8UpdateContent. Do not use the P8UpdateContent action at Page-level for P8 documents with
multiple content elements.
Versioning
If the FileNet P8 document class has
versioning-enabled
, then the new content is checked in as a new major version,
superseding the previous version.
If the FileNetP8 document class has
versioning-disabled
, then the action returns false to indicate the document
content cannot be updated. (FileNet P8 does not allow the document content to be updated for documents with
versioning-disabled.) See IBM FileNet P8 Knowledge Center for information about enabling/disabling versioning for
document classes.
Handling of P8 documents that are already checked out
By default, or if the Datacap action FNP8SetOverrideCheckoutOnUpdateContent("False") is called prior to
P8UpdateContent, then the action returns false if called for a P8 document that is already checked out.
If the action P8SetOverrideCheckoutOnUpdateContent("True") is called prior to P8UpdateContent and the P8 document
is already checked out, then the action skips the checkout process and attempts to check-in the document with the new content.
The P8 user must have permission to perform the check-in.
When used with P8UpdateProperties
If this action is used in the same application as the action P8UpdateProperties, it is recommended that P8UpdateProperties
is run before P8UpdateContent. For example, if FNP8_UpdateProperties is run on page-level on "Open", then FNP8_UpdateContent
should be run on "Close" for page-level or document-level. Doing this ensures that the property changes made by P8UpdateProperties are
included in the current version of the document which is created by P8UpdateContent.
......
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDirectory("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchWhereClause("DocumentTitle LIKE '2017-Invoices%'")
P8SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
...... run the actions below on the Document level ....
RecognizeToPDFOCR_A()
rrSet("@D.ID+.pdf", "@D.PDFFileName")
P8SetFileType("pdf")
P8SetUploadMode("PDFFileName")
P8sUpdateContent()
This example downloads Invoice documents from the P8 repository and ingests the documents into Datacap. It then converts the images to searchable PDF format files,
and updates the content of the P8 documents with the new PDF files.
......
P8SetSearchClass("Invoice")
P8SetSearchDownloadDir("C:/mylocaldir")
P8SetSearchWhereClause("DocumentTitle LIKE '2017-Invoices%'")
P8SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
...... run the actions below on the Document level ....
TifMerge_SetFileName("@BATCHID+@ID+@DATE(dd.mm.yyyy)")
TifMerge_SetFilePath("@APPVAR(values/gen/MergeFileTempDir)")
TifMerge_MergeImages("Rental_Agreement,Optional_Insurance")
P8MultiPageDocuments("True")
FNP8_UpdateContent()
This example downloads Invoice documents from the P8 repository and ingests the documents into Datacap. It then merges the images (from the same document)
into a multi-image Tiff file and updates the content of the P8 documents with the new TIFF file.
method.lvl: Document and Page level. To ensure proper handling of P8 documents with multiple content elements, this action must be run at Document level and with FNP8_MultiPageDocs("True").
method.ret:
False,
if an error occurs, or if the action is run on any level that is not document or page level. Otherwise,
True.
If successful, the DCO variable "Doc_ID" is created on each uploaded page with the value of the FileNet object identifier for the new version
of the document.

method.name: P8UpdateProperties
method.qi: : Updates an existing FileNet P8 document's properties values using the data passed into the SetProperty action.
method.ap: None.
method.h:
Use this action to update an existing FileNet P8 document's properties.
The UpdateProperties action only updates properties for an existing document.
If a new document is created, use the Upload action.
Uses the key specified in the P8SetKeyProperty action to search for an existing document
within a FileNet P8 Content Manager Object Store and updates the P8 document’s properties as specified by the P8SetProperty action.
P8SetKeyProperty("DCKey", "@X.DCKey)
P8SetProperty("AGIncome", "@P\AGIncomeField")
P8SetProperty("TaxYear", "@P\TaxYearField")
P8UpdateProperties()
The example first sets the key document property name "DCKey" and value to search
for a document. The search value is obtained from the DCO variable called "DCKey" on the current object.
There is no requirement for the DCO variable name, @X.DCKey, to match the property name being updated, it is shown
here for clarity within the application.
The next two actions identify the properties and values to update on the found FileNet P8 document.
P8UpdateProperties performs the transaction to the FileNet repository using the previously set values.
If more than one document matches the criteria specified in the SetKeyProperty action, only the first document is updated.
The example assumes that the actions are running on a page object.
method.ret:
Action returns
True
if the update is successfully; False if the action is unable to update the document.

method.name: P8Upload
method.qi: : Uploads images to P8 based on the previous configuration actions.
method.ap: None.
method.h:
Creates new FileNet P8 documents in the specified destination folder with the image files from the Datacap batch.
The upload steps can vary based on the actions P8SetMultiplePageDocuments, which enables the upload of multi-page documents,
and P8SetUploadFileNameVariable, which changes how upload finds files to upload. The combinations of these actions
alter the FileNet upload steps.
It is important that any required properties are set before calling P8Upload, such as P8SetDocumentClassAndTitle,
otherwise an upload error may occur.
⟸ Uploading in single-file / single-page mode ⟹
The default upload mode is the single-file mode. Each file uploaded becomes a unique file in the FileNet repository.
The following steps illustrate how single-file upload is performed.
Single-file Page Level Operation
If the batch contains a file named after the parent document object, i.e. documentid.type,
that file is uploaded and the operation completes.
If the batch contains a file named after the parent batch object, i.e. batchid.type,
that file is uploaded and the operation completes.
The file associated with the page is uploaded.
Single-file Document Level Operation
If the batch contains a file named after the document object, i.e. documentid.type,
that file is uploaded and the operation completes.
If the batch contains a file named after the parent batch object, i.e. batchid.type,
that file is uploaded and the operation completes.
If a file has not been uploaded, then each child page is processed as stated in "Single-File Page Level Operation".
Single-file Batch Level Operation
If the batch contains a file named after the batch object, i.e. batchid.type,
that file is uploaded and the operation completes.
If a file has not been uploaded, then each child document is processed as stated in "Single-File Document Level Operation".
⟸ Uploading in single-file / single-page mode with P8SetUploadFileNameVariable specified ⟹
The following describes the upload when a file name variable is specified. Each file uploaded becomes a unique file in the FileNet repository.
Single-file Page Level Operation with Variable
If the file name variable contains a file name, it is uploaded.
If the file name variable does not exist, or is blank, no file is uploaded for the page.
Single-file Document Level Operation with Variable
Each of the document object's child pages is processed according to the "Single-file Page Level Operation with Variable" steps.
Single-file Batch Level Operation with Variable
Each of the batch object's child document objects is processed according to the "Single-file Document Level Operation with Variable" steps.
⟸ Uploading in multiple-file / multiple-page mode ⟹
When uploading in multiple mode, first the current object is checked to see if the DCO variable MergedTiffFileName is set.
If it is set, the file specified
is added to the upload. The operation then continues as described below based on the current DCO level.
Multiple-file Page Level Operation
If the batch contains a file named after the parent document object, i.e. documentid.type,
that file is added to the upload and the operation completes for this page.
If the batch contains a file named after the parent batch object, i.e. batchid.type,
that file is uploaded and the operation completes for this page.
If a batch or document file has not been added, the associated page file is added to the upload.
Multiple-file Document Level Operation
If the batch contains a file named after the parent document object, i.e. documentid.type,
that file is added to the upload and the operation completes for this page.
If the batch contains a file named after the parent batch object, i.e. batchid.type,
that file is uploaded and the operation completes for this page.
If no batch or document file is found, then each child page is processed as stated in "Multiple-file Page Level Operation".
Multiple-file Batch Level Operation
If the batch contains a file named after the parent batch object, i.e. batchid.type,
that file is uploaded and the operation completes for this page.
If no batch file is found, then each child document is processed as stated in "Multiple-file Document Level Operation".
⟸ Uploading in multiple-file / multiple-page mode with P8SetUploadFileNameVariable specified ⟹
When uploading in multiple mode, first the current object is checked to see if the DCO variable MergedTiffFileName is set.
If it is set, the file specified
is added to the upload. The operation then continues as described below based on the current DCO level.
Multiple-file Page Level Operation with Variable
If the file name variable contains a file name, it is added to the upload.
If the file name variable does not exist, or is blank, no file is added for the page.
Multiple-file Document Level Operation with Variable
Each of the document object's child pages is processed according to the "Multiple-file Page Level Operation with Variable" steps.
Multiple-file Batch Level Operation with Variable
Each of the batch object's child document objects is processed according to the "Multiple-file Document Level Operation with Variable" steps.
P8Login("http://server:port//wsi/FNCEWS40MTOM/", "user", "password")
P8SetLocale("en-us")
P8SetTargetObjectID("MyObjectStore")
P8SetDestinationFolder("/MyTargetFolder")
P8SetDocumentClassAndTitle("MyFilenetDocClass", "@D.ID")
P8SetProperty("CustomerName", "@D.CustomerName")
P8SetMultipleValueProperty("InvoiceList", "@D.InvoiceList")
P8SetProperty("ScanStation", "@STATION")
P8SetProperty("ScanOperator", "@OPERATOR")
P8SetFileType("pdf")
P8Upload()
The example shows the actions required to perform an upload, all within a single function.
There are use cases where all of the actions are called on a single DCO node is appropriate.
In some instances, some of the actions may be called on different objects.
For example, the actions that would be called once, such as P8Login, may be called
at the batch level and then document specific actions, such as P8SetProperty or P8Upload
may be called on the a document or page object, depending on the needs of the specific application.
method.ret:
False,
if the upload is not successful, or the action was applied to the
Field level. Otherwise,
True.
If successful, the DCO variable "Doc_ID" is created on each page uploaded and set
to the FileNet document identifier.
Note: If the action returns False, the task to set to the status of “Aborted”.

method.name: P8UploadDirectory
method.qi: : Uploads files that are external to the batch.

p.name: SourceFolder
p.qi: The full path of the source folder that contains the images to be uploaded to FileNet.

p.name: DeleteAfterUpload
p.qi: Delete files from disk after upload: True/False.

method.ap:
DeleteAfterUpload:
False: The files are not deleted from the source folder after they are uploaded and instead are moved to the "Uploaded" directory.
True: The files are deleted from the source folder after they are uploaded.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Uploads all files in the folder configured by the action P8SetDestinationFolder.
This action is an alternative to P8Upload, allowing the upload of images
that are not within a Datacap batch.
P8UploadDirectory("C:\images", "False")
This example leaves the files in the source folder after they are uploaded and
the files are moved to the "Uploaded" directory.
FNP8_UploadDir("C:\images", "True")
This example deletes the images in the source folder after they are uploaded.
method.ret:
False,
if the upload is not successful. Otherwise,
True.
Note: If the action returns False, the action directs the Rulerunner task to finish
with a status of “Aborted”.
