af.name: SetProblemValue
af.g:
'Uses the decimal value you supply as a parameter to set a minimum Matching Tolerance Rating."
'A decimal value from 0.00 (Lowest Tolerance) to 0.99 (Highest Tolerance).</ap>
' <lvl>All, but generally at the Page level.</lvl>
Dim slocale
SetProblemValue = False
If InitAutoDocGlobalObjects=False then Exit Function
'Adding support for smart parmater
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
'filter and add leading zero
strparam=trim(strparam)
if len(strparam)<=2 then strparam = "0" & strparam
'normalize number
slocale = DetermineLocale ' in rrunner
StrParam=DCGlobalCurrency.NormalizeNumber(strparam,slocale)
If StrParam = "" Or Not IsNumeric(StrParam) Then WriteLog("SetProblemValue: Parameter isn't a numeric"): Exit Function
oFingerprint.m_ProblemValue = Cdbl(StrParam)
SetProblemValue = True

f.name: SetFingerprintSearchArea
f.g:
'Controls the portion of the current page that will be used to find a matching fingerprint." ' Two parameters:

' ' 1. A decimal value from 0.01 (1%) to 1.00 (all) to indicate how much of the page is to be matched. If only ' one parameter is used, the range for fingerprint matching will be 0 to x, where x is the parameter. ' For example, 0.5 indicates that fingerprint matching will be limited to the first half of the page (0 to 50%). '

' ' ' 2. Optional: A decimal value from 0.01 (1%) to 1.0 (all) to indicate the end point on the page to be ' used for fingerprint matching. For example: if the first parameter is 0.6, and the second parameter is 1.0, ' the last 40% of the page will be used for fingerprint matching (60-100%).
'
' Note. In both cases, you can replace a decimal value with a percentage or metric measurement. ' To indicate the value is a "Percentage" the action can use a number followed by "p" - 50p, for example - to represent 50%.
' Alternatively, a value can be expressed in millimeters, if the number is immediately followed by a lower ' case "m": 20m, for example.
' When using the percentage or metric values, the number must be a whole number, ' and cannot contain a decimal point. ' ' SetSearchArea was replaced by SetFingerprintSearchArea so we could use the "f" tag with unique parameters. Dim strTop Dim strBottom Dim slocale SetFingerprintSearchArea = False If InitAutoDocGlobalObjects=False then Exit Function 'Added support for smart parameters. matchStart=MetaWord(matchStart) writelog("Param: matchStart '" & matchStart & "'") matchEnd=MetaWord(matchEnd) writelog("Param: matchEnd '" & matchEnd & "'") matchStart = Trim(matchStart) matchEnd = Trim(matchEnd) If ( Len(matchStart) = 0 ) Then WriteLog("SetFingerprintSearchArea: Parameter matchStart must be specified."): Exit Function End If if (Len(matchEnd) = 0) then ' Only one parameter was passed in. Use it as the amount to match starting from the top. strTop = 0 strBottom = matchStart else ' Two parameters were passed. Use them as start and end. strTop = matchStart strBottom = matchEnd end if 'look for percentage or millimeter flags strTop=CStr(SetFingerprintSearchArea_utility(strTop)) strBottom=CStr(SetFingerprintSearchArea_utility(strBottom)) 'normalize number - pass as string slocale = DetermineLocale ' in rrunner strTop=DCGlobalCurrency.NormalizeNumber(strTop,slocale) strBottom=DCGlobalCurrency.NormalizeNumber(strBottom,slocale) 'Convert string to double oFingerprint.m_SearchAreaTop = Cdbl(strTop) oFingerprint.m_SearchAreaBottom = Cdbl(strBottom) WriteLog("SetFingerprintSearchArea: Top: '" & cstr(oFingerprint.m_SearchAreaTop) & "' Bottom: '" & cstr(oFingerprint.m_SearchAreaBottom) & "'.") m_SearchArea = 1 SetFingerprintSearchArea = True

af.name: SetSearchArea
af.g:
' This action has been replaced by SetFingerprintSearchArea." ' Two comma-separated parameters. See SetFingerprintSearchArea for details.

Dim result SetSearchArea = False 'Adding support for smart parameters StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam) writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'") aStrParam = Split(StrParam, ",", -1, 1) If (UBound(aStrParam) > 1) Then WriteLog("SetSearchArea: Parameter is invalid.") : Exit Function strTop = 0 strBottom = Trim(aStrParam(0)) If (UBound(aStrParam) = 1) Then strTop = Trim(aStrParam(0)) : strBottom = Trim(aStrParam(1)) ' Call the function that has replaced SetSearchArea SetSearchArea = SetFingerprintSearchArea(strTop, strBottom)

af.name: SetFingerprintDir
af.g:
' Sets the Fingerprint directory of your application." ' A String value specifying the directory's name and its path. Smart parameters are supported.

Dim sSmartParam If InitAutoDocGlobalObjects=False then Exit Function 'Added support for Smart Parameters(1) sSmartParam=MetaWord(StrParam) If sSmartParam<>"" Then StrParam=sSmartParam Else Writelog("No result from Smart Parameter(1) parsing. Using original parameter '" & StrParam & "'") End if If Right(StrParam,1) <> "\" Then StrParam = StrParam & "\" oFingerprint.SetFingerprintDir StrParam SetFingerprintDir = True

af.name: FindBlackFingerprint
af.g:
' Attempts to match black forms to fingerprints in the fingerprints directory of an application. ' If a match does not occur, the action will respond according to the parameter(s) you enter." ' ' Two comma-separated values (the second is optional)

' 1. True or False.
' True If a fingerprint match is not found, a new fingerprint is created and the two fingerprint files ' (.tif and .cco) are placed in the fingerprint directory.
' False if the task is to proceed without creating a new fingerprint.
'
' 2. Optional.
' The Page Type that is to be assigned to the newly created fingerprint if the first parameter ' is True. If you do not include this parameter, the action will assign the Page ' Type of the current page.
' Smart parameters are supported. ' FindBlackFingerprint = False If InitAutoDocGlobalObjects=False then Exit Function If (CurrentObj.ObjectType<>2) Then Exit Function 'must be a page If Not(FileMgr.FileExists(CurrentObj.ImageName)) Then WriteLog("FindBlackFingerprint skipping. " & CurrentObj.ImageName & " doesn't exist") Exit Function End If StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam) writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'") aStrParam = Split(StrParam, ",", -1, 1) If (UBound(aStrParam) > 1) Then WriteLog("FindFingerprint: Parameter is invalid.") : Exit Function strPageType = CurrentObj.Type strFingerprintCreation = Trim(aStrParam(0)) If (UBound(aStrParam) = 1) Then strPageType = Trim(aStrParam(1)) oFingerprint.m_bFingerprintCreation = False If (LCase(strFingerprintCreation)="false") Then oFingerprint.m_bFingerprintCreation = False If (LCase(strFingerprintCreation)="true") Then oFingerprint.m_bFingerprintCreation = True WriteLog("----- FindBlackFingerprint of: "&CurrentObj.ImageName&" -----") 'RTC 179132 - Logic added to get the extension of a file and then calculate the length of extension to get the corresponding cco file name. Dim aPath Dim realExt aPath =Split(CurrentObj.ImageName,".") Dim l l=UBound(aPath) 'Get the last item of an array which will be the real extenstion of an image. realExt = aPath(l) WriteLog("extension for current object image name is: " + realExt) 'Initially it was hardcoded to 3 considering image extension to be always 3 characters. 'Modified it with realExt which will work for any number of characters in extension. Dim strCCOFile strCCOFile = Left(CurrentObj.ImageName, Len(CurrentObj.ImageName)-Len(realExt))&"cco" WriteLog("strCCOFile :" +strCCOFile) If Not(FileMgr.FileExists(strCCOFile)) Then WriteLog("FindBlackFingerprint skipping. CCO file doesn't exist") Exit Function End If Dim oCCO Set oCCO = CCOCreator.Load(strCCOFile ) oFingerprint.UpdateSearchArea oFingerprint.m_bBlackFingerprint = True oFingerprint.Process oCCO, CurrentObj, oFingerprint.m_ProblemValue, strPageType If oFingerprint.m_bFailRule = True Then FindBlackFingerprint = False Else FindBlackFingerprint = True End If WriteLog("FindBlackFingerprint returns " & FindBlackFingerprint)

af.name: SetMaxOffset

' Sets the Maximum Offset value while matching source pages to fingerprints. The actual shift is four times the maximum offset value in pixels (4 * MaxOffset)."
' Integer value between 1 and 255.</ap>

Using original parameter.") End if SetTemplateDir = SetFingerprintDir(bInter, bDeBug, StrParam)

af.g: '"Provides the Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that is a link to a pre-established Fingerprint Service." ' String value specifying the URL that is the link to the Fingerprint Web Service. Accepts a Smart Parameter. af.g: '"Sets the standard Offset value to be used when matching source pages to fingerprints." ' Integer value between 1 and 255. CalculateOffset = False If InitAutoDocGlobalObjects=False then Exit Function If (CurrentObj.ObjectType<>2) Then WriteLog("CalculateOffset: this action works on a page level only.") : Exit Function 'must be a page CalculateOffset = oFingerprint.CalculateOffset(CurrentObj)

af.name: MergeCCOs_ByType
af.g:
' "Merges the Fingerprint files (.cco) associated with Page objects of the Document Hierarchy."
' Comma-separated String values indicating the Page Types of the Document Hierarchy objects to be merged.</ap>
Dim sMultFile
Dim nDCOchildren, i, j
Dim oChild, nCount
Dim oPrimaryPg
Dim sPPD
Dim sFileExtn
Dim sFilePath
Dim sFileName
Dim oParent
Dim pCounter
Dim bRes
Dim dcImageTemp,Wx,Hx,Bx
Dim nCounter
Set dcImageTemp = CreateObject("DCIMAGE.DCImageCtrl.1")
'This Action should run from the DCO Page to which all additional pages are to be appended.
'Will use first page of specified type as root page if called from document object.
'Appended Page will be first page of a valid Type in document by default.
'StrParam is a CSV of all the valid PageTypes to Append.
On Error Resume Next
MergeCCOs_ByType = False
sMultFile=""
nCounter=CInt(0)
'check for smart parameter
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
'Find Parent Document
Set oParent = Currentobj
If oParent.ObjectType>1 Then
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
End If
For i = 1 To oParent.NumOfChildren
Set oChild = CurrentObj.GetChild(i - 1)
If Not(oChild Is Nothing) Then
If oChild.ObjectType = 2 And InStr(Ucase(StrParam),Ucase(oChild.Type))>0 Then
WriteLog ("Processing '" & oChild.ID & "' ")
'Create MultiCCO file
If sMultFile = "" Then
sOrigFile = oChild.ImageName
sFileExtn = Ucase(FileMgr.GetExtensionName(sOrigFile))
If (sFileExtn = "TIF" Or sFileExtn = "TIFF") And FileMgr.FileExists(sOrigFile) Then
'Log the image height
sFilePath = FileMgr.GetParentFolderName(sOrigFile)
dcImageTemp.FileName = sOrigfile
Call dcImageTemp.GetImageInfo(Wx,Hx,Bx)
Writelog("Image " & sOrigFile & " Height:" & Hx)
dcImageTemp.FileName = ""
'Set CCO filename to 1st Page ID
sMultFile = Left(sOrigFile,Len(sOrigFile)-Len(sFileExtn)) & "CCO"
If Not FileMgr.FileExists(sMultFile) Then
WriteLog("----- Analysis of: " & sOrigFile & " -----")
Set oCCO = CCOCreator.Analyze(sOrigFile)
bSaved = oCCO.Save(sMultFile)
If bSaved=False Then
Writelog("ERROR saving File. Exiting Action.")
Exit Function
End If
Set oCCO = Nothing
End If
'Setup Primary Page Ref
Set oPrimaryPg = oChild
pCounter = 1
oPrimaryPg.Variable("CCOBlock")=Trim(sMultFile)
oPrimaryPg.Variable(Trim(FileMgr.GetFileName(sMultFile)) & "_" & CStr(pCounter))=FileMgr.GetFileName(oChild.ImageName)
oPrimaryPg.Variable(Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oChild.ImageName)))=nCounter
nCounter=CInt(Hx)
WriteLog ("MultiPage CCO file name : '" & sMultFile & "' ")
Else
Writelog("Unexpected File Name Extension: '" & sFileExtn & "' ")
End If
Else
sAppendFile = oChild.ImageName
sExt = Ucase(FileMgr.GetExtensionName(sAppendFile))
If (sExt = "TIF" Or sExt = "TIFF") Then
'Log the image height
dcImageTemp.FileName = sAppendFile
Call dcImageTemp.GetImageInfo(Wx,Hx,Bx)
Writelog("Image " & sAppendFile & " Height:" & Hx)
dcImageTemp.FileName = ""
sAppendCCO = Left(sAppendFile,Len(sAppendFile)-Len(sExt)) & "CCO"
If Not FileMgr.FileExists(sAppendCCO) Then
WriteLog("----- Analysis of: " & sAppendFile & " -----")
Set oCCO = CCOCreator.Analyze(sAppendFile)
bSaved = oCCO.Save(sAppendCCO)
If bSaved=False Then
Writelog("Error: Could not save file: '" & sAppendCCO & "'. Exiting Action.")
Exit Function
End If
Set oCCO = Nothing
End If
bRes=CCOCreator.Merge(sMultFile, sAppendCCO)
Writelog("Merging CCO : '" & sAppendCCO & "' to the end of '" & sMultFile & "' returns " & bRes)
If bRes = False Then
If Not FileMgr.FileExists(sMultFile) Then Writelog("Error: File Not Found:" & sMultFile)
If Not FileMgr.FileExists(sAppendCCO) Then Writelog("Error: File Not Found:" & sAppendCCO)
Writelog("Error: MergeCCO failed for file:" & sMultFile)
Exit Function
Else
pCounter = pCounter + 1
oPrimaryPg.Variable(Trim(FileMgr.GetFileName(sMultFile)) & "_" & CStr(pCounter))=FileMgr.GetFileName(oChild.ImageName)
oPrimaryPg.Variable(Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oChild.ImageName)))=nCounter
nCounter = nCounter + CInt(Hx)
End If
'oChild.Type = "Attachment"
Else
Writelog("Unexpected File Name Extension: '" & sExt & "' ")
End If
End If
End If
End If
Next 'i
Set oParent=Nothing
Set oPrimaryPg = Nothing
Set dcImageTemp = Nothing
If Not Err Then MergeCCOs_ByType = True

f.name: MergeLayoutByType
f.g:
' This action requires that a document structure exists.
On Error Resume Next
MergeLayoutByType = false
PageTypesToMerge = MetaWord(PageTypesToMerge)
if IsAlive(g_DLayout) Then
WriteLog("Creating VPB")
g_DLayout.DatacapRRCurrentDCO = CurrentObj
MergeLayoutByType = g_DLayout.MergeLayout(PageTypesToMerge, Pilot.BatchDir)
Else
WriteLog("Error: Cannot merge. The layout object was not loaded. Returning false.")
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function MergeLayoutByType")

af.name: BlankPagesIDBySize
af.g:
' "Uses the Image file's size to determine if the file represents a 'blank' page." ' A three-part, comma-separated value consisting of:
' 1. Numeric value indicating the maximum size in bytes that qualifies a page as a blank page.
' 2. String value representing the Page Type of a blank page.
' 3.Numeric value (0, 1 or 2) to designate which pages in a multi-page Image file are to be evaluated.
'
' The third parameter is optional.
' 0 = both sides of a two-page Image file.
' 1 = odd pages only.
' 2 = even images only. Dim aStrParam Dim iMinSize Dim sPageType Dim iSide BlankPagesIDBySize = False StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam) writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'") aStrParam = Split(StrParam & ",,",",") iMinSize = Trim(aStrParam(0)) sPageType = CStr(aStrParam(1)) iSide = Trim(aStrParam(2)) If IsNumeric(iMinSize) Then iMinSize = CLng(iMinSize) Else Writelog("Minimum size paramater must be numeric.") Exit Function End If If Len(sPageType)=0 Then Writelog("sPageType paramater must contain a value.") Exit Function End If If Len(iSide)=0 Then iSide = CInt(0) End If If IsNumeric(iSide) Then iSide = CInt(iSide) Else Writelog("iSide paramater must be numeric {0,1,2} or blank.") Exit Function End If BlankPagesIDBySize = BlankPageID(CurrentObj, iMinsize, sPageType, iSide)

af.name: SetApplicationID
af.g:
' String parameter that represents unique Application ID. Smart parameters are supported.
' This value used to retrieve correct list of fingerprints loaded to the server.
Dim sSmartParam 'Added support for Smart Parameters(1) sSmartParam=MetaWord(StrParam) If sSmartParam<>"" Then StrParam=sSmartParam Else Writelog("No result from Smart Parameter(1) parsing. Using original parameter '" & StrParam & "'") End if If (oFingerprint.m_bCCO_WS) Then oFingerprint.m_AppID = StrParam On Error Resume Next oFingerprint.m_oCCO_WSClient.SetApplicationID(oFingerprint.m_AppID) Err.Clear On Error Goto 0 Else SetApplicationID = false End If

af.name: SetFingerprintFailureThreshold
af.g:
' Int parameter that represents percent threshold of fingerprint upload failures to ignore. Smart parameters are supported.
' The batch aborts if the percentage of fingerprints that are failed to load exceeds this value.
Dim sSmartParam Dim m_nThreshold SetFingerprintFailureThreshold = true 'Added support for Smart Parameters(1) sSmartParam=MetaWord(StrParam) If sSmartParam<>"" Then StrParam=sSmartParam Else Writelog("No result from Smart Parameter(1) parsing. Using original parameter '" & StrParam & "'") End if If ((Cint(StrParam)<0) OR (Cint(StrParam)>100)) Then Writelog("Error. Value has to be between values 0 and 100 original parameter value:'" & StrParam & "' . Aborting batch") nTaskStatus=retAbort SetFingerprintFailureThreshold = false End If If InitAutoDocGlobalObjects=False then Exit Function If (oFingerprint.m_bCCO_WS) Then m_nThreshold = CInt(StrParam) DIM xml Dim oXmlDoc, oNodeList, name Dim oLoaded, oFailed Dim Loaded, Failed xml = oFingerprint.m_oCCO_WSClient.GetFingerprintStatistics Set oXmlDoc = CreateObject("Msxml2.DOMDocument") oXmlDoc.loadXML(xml) Set oNodeList = oXmlDoc.getElementsByTagName("application") If oNodeList.length > 0 then For each x in oNodeList name=x.getAttribute("name") if (name=oFingerprint.m_AppID)Then 'WriteLog("FPSvc node " & x.xml) set oLoaded = x.selectSingleNode("./fploaded") set oFailed = x.selectSingleNode("./fpfailed") Loaded = CInt(oLoaded.text) Failed = CInt(oFailed.text) 'WriteLog("Loaded: " & oLoaded.text) 'WriteLog("Failed: " & oFailed.text) End If Next Else Writelog ("No fingerprints selected to load. Application:'"&oFingerprint.m_AppID&"'") End If if((Loaded+Failed)>0) Then if (Loaded<1) Then nTaskStatus=retAbort SetFingerprintFailureThreshold = false Writelog ("Aborting the batch. None of the fingerprints loaded successfully. Failed to load: '"&Failed&"' fingerprints. Application:'"&oFingerprint.m_AppID&"'") Else Dim percent percent = (Failed*100/(Loaded+Failed)) If (percent>m_nThreshold) Then nTaskStatus=retAbort SetFingerprintFailureThreshold = false Writelog ("Aborting the batch. Threshold is set to:'" & m_nThreshold &"%' and '"&percent&"%' of fingerprints failed to load. Application:'"&oFingerprint.m_AppID&"'") End if end if Else Writelog ("Using fingerprint service, but no Fingerprints are loaded or failed. Application:'"&oFingerprint.m_AppID&"'") End if Else Writelog ("Fingerprints service is not used. Input value ignored. Application:'"&oFingerprint.m_AppID&"'") SetFingerprintFailureThreshold = false End If

af.name: UpdateFingerprintStats
af.g:
Dim oCmd
Dim oParam1
Dim oParam2
Dim DateHit
Dim oRS
Dim sParam
UpdateFingerprintStats = false
If InitAutoDocGlobalObjects=False then Exit Function
if Not(IsObject(oFingerprint.m_oAdoCnn)) then
Writelog("Connection to the fingerprint database was not created.")
Exit Function
End if
if oFingerprint.m_oAdoCnn.State = 0 then
Writelog("Connection to the fingerprint database was not found.")
Exit Function
End if
if CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 2 then
Writelog("This action was designed to operate on a page level object only.")
Exit Function
End if
Set oCmd = CreateObject("ADODB.Command")
sSQL = "UPDATE Template SET tp_HitCount = tp_HitCOunt + 1, tp_LastHit = ? WHERE tp_TemplateID = ?"
oCmd.CommandText = sSQL
oCmd.CommandType = 1
oCmd.ActiveConnection = oFingerprint.m_oAdoCnn
Writelog("Connection set")
Writelog("TemplateID = " & CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID"))
If (IsDBOracle(oFingerprint.m_oAdoCnn) or DCO.Variable("OracleFP") = "1") then
'ORACLE VERSION:
FormattedDateStamp = Year(Now) & "/" & Right("00" & Month(Now),2) & "/" & Right("00" & Day(Now),2)
Writelog("Oracle datestamp: " & FormattedDateStamp)
sParam = "to_date('" & FormattedDateStamp & "','YYYY/MM/DD')"
Writelog("Oracle date param: " & "to_date('" & FormattedDateStamp & "','YYYY/MM/DD')")
oCmd.CommandText = "UPDATE Template SET tp_HitCount=tp_HitCount+1, tp_LastHit=" & sParam & " WHERE tp_TemplateID=" & CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID")
else
Set oParam1 = oCmd.CreateParameter("P1",200,1,50)
Set oParam2 = oCmd.CreateParameter("P1",200,1,50)
oCmd.Parameters.Append oParam1
oCmd.Parameters.Append oParam2
Writelog("Parameters set")
if (IsDBSQL(oFingerprint.m_oAdoCnn) or IsDBDB2(oFingerprint.m_oAdoCnn)) then
'SQL Server VERSION:
FormattedDateStamp = Year(Now) & "-" & Right("00" & Month(Now),2) & "-" & Right("00" & Day(Now),2) & " " & "00:00:00" ' yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss
oCmd(0).Value = FormattedDateStamp
' Writelog("MSSQL & DB2 datestamp: " & FormattedDateStamp)
else
'Access VERSION:
FormattedDateStamp = Date()
oCmd(0).Value = FormattedDateStamp
' WAS: oCmd(0).Value = Date() ' will not work for Oracle
'Writelog("Access datestamp: " & FormattedDateStamp)
end if
oCmd(1).Value = CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID")
if oCmd(1).Value = "" then
Writelog("No TemplateID found. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
End If
WriteLog(oCmd.CommandText)
oRS = oCmd.Execute
Set oCmd = Nothing
Set oParam1 = Nothing
Set oParam2 = Nothing
Set oRS = Nothing
UpdateFingerprintStats = TRUE

Two comma-separated values (the second is optional):
1.A True / False value:
True if a task is to create a new fingerprint and add it to the fingerprint directory when a match does not occur;
False if the task is to proceed without creating a new fingerprint.
2.Optional:
The Page Type that is to be assigned to the newly-created fingerprint. If omitted, the current Page Type of the current page will be used.
Smart parameters are supported.
Page level only.
This action has been replaced by the action FindFingerprint in the AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting action library. It is recommended that this action is no longer used because it will be removed in a future release.
This action attempts to match the current sourcepage to a fingerprint, and creates a new fingerprint if a match does not occur.
Include this action after a rule's SetSearchArea, SetProblemValue and SetFingerprintDir actions. AnalyzeImage()
RotateImage()
RecognizePageOCR_S()
SetSearchArea("0.5")
SetProblemValue("0.7")
SetFingerprintDir("\ParentDirectory\Application\Fingerprint")
FindFingerprint("True,Invoice_Page")
In this sequence, the FindFingerprint action will only use the top 50% of the current page to search for a match. However, it will accept a match of 0.7 or higher. If no match is found, the sequence will create a new fingerprint and store it in the location specified by the SetFingerprintDir action. If the parameter has been set to False, a new fingerprint will not be created in case there is no match.
False if the action is not applied at the Page level, or if the parameter is False and a fingerprint match does not occur. Otherwise, True. If a new Fingerprint cannot be added, the action still returns True.
None. Page level only.
False if the rule with this action is not bound to a Page object of the Document Hierarchy; if the current page does not have an Image file; or if the fingerprint's two files cannot be created. Otherwise, True.
This action has been replaced by the action AddFingerprint in the AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting action library. It is recommended that this action is no longer used because it will be removed in a future release.
Creates a fingerprint for the current source page.
The resulting fingerprint will consist of two files: the page's Image file (.tif) and its Processing file (.cco).
Alert! A SetFingerprintDir action must precede this action.
SetFingerprintDir("C:\ParentDirectory\Application\fingerprint")
CreateFingerprint()
SetFingerprintDir, DeleteFingerprint
None. Page level only.
Always returns True. Under certain conditions the action will be unable to delete the fingerprint but will still return True. For example if the action is not applied at the Page level or if the fingerprint's Image file cannot be found. Please review the log file if DeleteFingerprint does not perform as expected.
This action has been replaced by the action DeleteFingerprint in the AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting action library. It is recommended that this action is no longer used because it will be removed in a future release.
Deletes the Image file (.tif) And Processing file (.cco) of the current page's fingerprint from the application's fingerprint directory, and its record from the Fingerprint database.
Alert! A SetFingerprintDir action must precede this action.

A two-part, comma-separated value consisting of:
1.The Fingerprint Class value. Smart parameters are supported. Alternatively, the name of the Field on this page that specifies the Fingerprint Class.
2.(optional) The Fingerprint ID value. Smart parameters are supported. Alternatively, the name of the Field on this page that specifies the Fingerprint ID.
Smart parameters are supported.
Page level only. False if either parameter is invalid. Otherwise, True.
This action has been replaced by the action SetFingerprint in the AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting action library. It is recommended that this action is no longer used because it will be removed in a future release.
Sets a newly created fingerprint's Fingerprint Class and Fingerprint Class ID values.
After the mandatory Fingerprint Class value and optional Fingerprint Class ID have been manually assigned by a fingerprint creation task, this action places these values into the Host table of the application's Fingerprint database - as RefName and RefID values.
SetFingerprint("@P\VendorName,@P\VendorID")
In this example, runtime values of the VendorName and VendorID Field objects will populate the Host table of the application's Fingerprint Database. Alternative method: SetFingerprint("@VendorName,@VendorID")
A decimal value from 0.00 (Lowest Tolerance) to 0.99 (Highest Tolerance). The decimal separator must be appropriate for the locale. Smart parameters are supported. All, but generally at the Page level. False if the parameter is missing or the parameter is not numeric. Otherwise, True.
This action has been replaced by the action SetMinimumMatchingTolerance in the AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting action library. It is recommended that this action is no longer used because it will be removed in a future release.
Uses the decimal value you supply as a parameter to set a minimum Matching Tolerance Rating.
Important! A lower rating results in lower tolerance and a greater chance for a match, but also a greater chance for a False match.
This setting will remain in affect for the length of the current task profile. If Autodoc actions are used in subsequent task profiles, this setting will have to be performed again before using actions that utilize this setting.
AnalyzeImage()
CreateFields()
RotateImage()
RecognizePageOCR-S()
SetSearchArea("0.5")
SetProblemValue("0.70")
SetFingerprintDir("\ParentDirectory\Application\Fingerprint")
FindFingerprint("True")
In this sequence, the FindFingerprint action assigns a Matching Tolerance Rating that is neither overly restrictive nor unrealistically accepting.
If the rule's conditions do not result in a match, and True is used as the parameter for the FindFingerprint action, a new fingerprint will be added to the library.
Two parameters:
1. A decimal value from 0.01 (1%) to 1.00 (all) to indicate how much of the page is to be matched. If the second parameter is empty the first parameter represents the bottom of the area for matching, starting from the top of the page. If the second parameter is not empty, the first parameter is the top or start of the area for matching. For example, a single parameter of 0.5 indicates that fingerprint matching will be limited to the first half of the page (0 to 50%). Decimal separators must be appropriate for the current locale. In applications which might be used in locales with different decimal separators, use percentage notation.
2. Optional: A decimal value from 0.01 (1%) to 1.0 (all) to indicate the end point on the page to be used for fingerprint matching. If this parameter is supplied, the fist parameter is the starting point. For example: if the first parameter is 0.6, and the second parameter is 1.0, the last 40% of the page will be used for fingerprint matching (60-100%).
Note. In both cases, you can replace a decimal value with a percentage. To indicate the value is a "Percentage" the action can use a number followed by "p" - 50p, for example - to represent 50%.
When using the percentage values, the number must be a whole number, and cannot contain a decimal separator.
Decimal separators must be appropriate for the current locale. In applications which might be used in locales with different decimal separators, use percentage notation.
Smart parameters are supported.
This action has been replaced by the action SetFingerprintSearchArea in the AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting action library. It is recommended that this action is no longer used because it will be removed in a future release.
This action uses the numeric value(s) you supply to determine the portion of the current page that will be used to find a matching fingerprint.
This setting will remain in affect for the length of the current task profile. If Autodoc actions are used in subsequent task profiles, this setting will have to be performed again before using actions that utilize this setting.
SetFingerprintSearchArea("0.5","")
The example above compares lines and words in the upper 50% of the current page to the lines and words in the same portion of each fingerprint. Notice the second parameter has been left blank.
SetFingerprintSearchArea("0.5","1.0")
This example compares lines and words in the lower 50% of the current page to the lines and words in the same portion of each fingerprint. Remember: you can replace a parameter's decimal value with a percentage(p) or metric(m) number.
All levels, but generally at the Page level.
False if the first parameter is missing or is not numeric. Also returns False if the second parameter is not numeric. Otherwise, True.
SetProblemValue
The String value of the Fingerprint ID.
Smart parameters are supported.
This action has been replaced by the action SetPageFingerprintID in the AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting action library. It is recommended that this action is no longer used because it will be removed in a future release.
Assigns a value to the FingerprintID property of the selected Page object of the Document Hierarchy. This links a specific fingerprint template ID with the page. The fingerprint template identifies the zone locations for each field within the page, associating an area of the image to the location of the text represented by the field.
Typically fingerprint templates are automatically assigned with the action FindFingerprint which will automatically identify the fingerprint template that matches the document. However, there are times when alternate techniques can be used to match a page to a specific fingerprint template. This action assigns a specific fingerprint template ID to the page.
A common use for this action is to first determine what it is about that page that determines which fingerprint should be associated with the page. One typical mechanism is determining the fingerprint by some unique text on the page. Other methods are possible such as the name of the source file or other attributes that can be detected about the page.
Once the use case is understood, then rules can be written to determine which fingerprint template ID should be assigned. Once determined by the rules, then this action can be used to assign a specific fingerprint template ID to the page. Once assigned, then the zones can be loaded to assign the position locations to the page's fields.
The SetPageFingerprintID action will create a fingerprint ID property/variable "TemplateID" of the current Page object if it does not already exist.
This action is functionally equivalent to the following generic action:
rrSet("1010","@X.TemplateID")
However, using SetPageFingerprintID can add additional context to the intention of setting the fingerprint.
RecognizePageOCR_A()
WordFind("MQSW")
SetPageFingerprintID("1010")
In this sequence, the page is recognized then the recognized text is searched to see if it contains "MQSQ", which is an example of some kind of unique text that identifies the page. If the WordFind action locates "MQSW" on the current page, the SetPageFingerprintID action assigns "1010" as the page's Fingerprint ID. This links the page to a fingerprint with a Fingerprint ID of "1010" as was settup in the Zones tab of Datacap Studio.
Page level.
True if the rule is applied at the Page level. Otherwise, False.
FindFingerprint, ReadZones, ReadZonesFPX

Sets the Maximum Offset value while matching source pages to fingerprints. This action has no effect when used with the Fingerprint Service
The actual shift is four times the maximum offset value in pixels (4 * MaxOffset). Increasing this value improves but slows the matching process.
The default value is 6: 4 * 6 = 24 pixels.
This setting will remain in affect for the length of the current task profile. If Autodoc actions are used in subsequent task profiles, this setting will have to be performed again before using actions that utilize this setting.

af.name: GetAllBarcodesBP
af.g:
GetAllBarcodesBP = True
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2 Then
Writelog "This action is required to run the Page or Field level. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
strParam = MetaWord(strParam)
If Trim(strParam) = "" Then strParam = ","
writelog("Param: '" & strParam & "'")
l_bRet = GetBarcodeBP(true,true)
If l_bRet = False Then Exit Function
If CurrentObj.Variable("NumBarcodes") = "0" OR CurrentObj.Variable("NumBarcodes") = "" Then Exit Function
l_iBarcodes = CInt(CurrentObj.Variable("NumBarcodes"))
For l_iIndex = 0 to l_iBarcodes - 1
If CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex) <> "" Then
CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCodeList") = CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCodeList") & CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex) & strParam
End If
Next
If Right(CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCodeList"),1) = strParam Then
CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCodeList") = Left(CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCodeList"), Len(CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCodeList"))-1)
End If
GetAllBarcodesBP = true

af.name: GetBarcodeBP
af.g:
GetBarcodeBP = False
Dim barcodePos
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2 Then
Writelog "This action is required to run the Page or Field level. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
If fReadBarcodeBP(CurrentObj) Then
If 3 = CurrentObj.ObjectType Then 'If field, then store field value
CurrentObj.Text = CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode0")
'CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = CurrentObj.Variable("Position0")
barcodePos = CurrentObj.Variable("Position0")
if (NOT len(barcodePos)=0) Then
WriteLog("Updating field position: '" & barcodePos & "'")
CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = barcodePos
End If
End If
GetBarcodeBP = True
Else
GetBarcodeBP = False
End If

af.name: GetDataMatrixCodeBP
af.g:
GetDataMatrixCodeBP = False
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2 Then
Writelog "This action is required to run the Page or Field level. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
CurrentObj.Variable("bp_tp") = "4194304"
GetDataMatrixCodeBP = fReadBarcodeBP(CurrentObj)
CurrentObj.DeleteVariable("bp_tp")
GetDataMatrixCodeBP = True

af.name: Get2DCodeBP
af.g:
Get2DCodeBP = False
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2 Then
Writelog "This action is required to run the Page or Field level. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
CurrentObj.Variable("bp_tp") = "2097152"
Get2DCodeBP = fReadBarcodeBP(CurrentObj)
CurrentObj.DeleteVariable("bp_tp")

af.name: MatchBarcodeBP
af.g:
MatchBarcodeBP = False
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2 Then
Writelog "This action is required to run the Page or Field level. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
If Trim(strParam) = "" Then
Writelog "This action requires a parameter with the barcode text value to match. None has been specified, exiting."
Exit Function
End If
'l_bRet = GetBarcodeBP(true,true)
l_bRet = fReadBarcodeBP(CurrentObj)
If (l_bRet = False) Then
Writelog "Read barcode returned false"
Exit Function
End If
If (CurrentObj.Variable("NumBarcodes") = "0" OR CurrentObj.Variable("NumBarcodes") = "") Then
Writelog "No barcodes found"
Exit Function
End If
l_iBarcodes = CInt(CurrentObj.Variable("NumBarcodes"))
For l_iIndex = 0 to l_iBarcodes - 1
If strParam = CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex) Then
Writelog "'" & strParam & "' match found in '" & CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex) & "'"
CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode") = CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex)
If (3 = CurrentObj.ObjectType) Then 'If field, then store field value
CurrentObj.Text = CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex)
CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = CurrentObj.Variable("Position" & l_iIndex)
End If
MatchBarcodeBP = True
Exit For
End If
Next
If Not MatchBarcodeBP Then
Writelog "A barcode matching the text '" & strParam & "' was not found."
CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode") = ""
End If

af.name: MatchBarcodePrefixBP
af.g:
MatchBarcodePrefixBP = False
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2 Then
Writelog "This action is required to run the Page or Field level. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
If Trim(strParam) = "" Then
Writelog "This action requires a parameter with the barcode text value to match. None has been specified, exiting."
Exit Function
End If
'l_bRet = GetBarcodeBP(true,true)
l_bRet = fReadBarcodeBP(CurrentObj)
If (l_bRet = False) Then
Writelog "Read barcode returned false"
Exit Function
End If
If (CurrentObj.Variable("NumBarcodes") = "0" OR CurrentObj.Variable("NumBarcodes") = "") Then
Writelog "No barcodes found"
Exit Function
End If
l_iBarcodes = CInt(CurrentObj.Variable("NumBarcodes"))
strParam = Trim(strParam)
For l_iIndex = 0 to l_iBarcodes - 1
If strParam = Left(CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex), Len(strParam)) Then
Writelog "'" & strParam & "' match found in '" & CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex) & "'"
CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode") = CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex)
If (3 = CurrentObj.ObjectType) Then 'If field, then store field value
CurrentObj.Text = CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode" & l_iIndex)
CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = CurrentObj.Variable("Position" & l_iIndex)
End If
MatchBarcodePrefixBP = True
Exit For
End If
Next
If Not MatchBarcodePrefixBP Then
Writelog "A barcode starting with the prefix '" & strParam & "' was not found."
CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCode") = ""
End If
Exit Function

f.name: IdentifyByBarcodesBP
f.g:
Dim bRegEx
IdentifyByBarcodesBP = FALSE
If CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 2 Then
Writelog "This action is required to run at the Page level. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
barcodePageMappings = MetaWord(barcodePageMappings)
mappingsDelim = MetaWord(mappingsDelim)
keyValueSep = MetaWord(keyValueSep)
If DCO.Variable(IDENTIFY_REGEX) <> "" Then bRegEx = CBool(DCO.Variable(IDENTIFY_REGEX))
If mappingsDelim = "" Then mappingsDelim = ","
If keyValueSep = "" Then keyValueSep = "="
If caseSensitive = "" Then caseSensitive = "FALSE"
writelog("barcodePageMappings: '" & barcodePageMappings & "' mappingsDelim: '" & mappingsDelim & "' keyValueSep: '" & keyValueSep & "' caseSensitive: " & caseSensitive)
caseSensitive = CBool(caseSensitive)
Dim barcodePagePairs
barcodePagePairs = Split(barcodePageMappings, mappingsDelim)
If UBound(barcodePagePairs) < 0 Then
Writelog "Barcode-page type mappings not provided. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
Dim barcodesFoundList
If CInt(CurrentObj.FindVariable("GetBarCodeList")) < 0 Then Call GetAllBarcodesBP("bInter", "bDebug", mappingsDelim)
barcodesFoundList = TRIM(CurrentObj.Variable("GetBarCodeList"))
If barcodesFoundList = "" Then
Writelog "No barcodes found on page. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
If caseSensitive = FALSE Then barcodesFoundList = UCase(barcodesFoundList)
WriteLog "RegEx matching: " & bRegEx
For Each mapping In barcodePagePairs
Writelog "Evaluating barcode-page mapping: '" & mapping & "'"
If mapping <> "" Then
Dim matchBarcodeVal
matchBarcodeVal = LEFT(mapping, INSTRREV(mapping, keyValueSep)-1)
If caseSensitive = FALSE Then matchBarcodeVal = UCase(matchBarcodeVal)
Dim pageType
pageType = RIGHT(mapping, LEN(mapping)-INSTRREV(mapping, keyValueSep))
If matchBarcodeVal <> "" AND pageType <> "" Then
For Each barcodeFound in Split(barcodesFoundList, mappingsDelim)
Dim bFound
bFound = (Not bRegEx) AND (barcodeFound = matchBarcodeVal)
bcPageIDRegEx.Pattern = matchBarcodeVal
bFound = (bFound) OR (bRegEx AND bcPageIdRegEx.Test(barcodeFound))
If bFound Then
Writelog Space(3) & "Found match: '" & matchBarcodeVal &_
"' in value '" & barcodeFound & "'" &_
" setting page type to '" & pageType & "'"
CurrentObj.Type = pageType
IdentifyByBarcodesBP = TRUE
Exit Function
End If
Next
Else
Writelog Space(3) & "Skipped invalid mapping"
End If
Else
Writelog Space(3) & "Skipped invalid mapping"
End If
Next
Writelog "No match found"

af.name: ReadBarCodeBP
af.g:
ReadBarCodeBP = False
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2 Then
Writelog "This action is required to run the Page or Field level. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
If Trim(strParam) = "" Then
Writelog "This action requires a parameter with the barcode text value to match. None has bee specified, exiting."
Exit Function
End If
CurrentObj.Variable("bp_su") = "1"
ReadBarCodeBP = MatchBarcodeBP(true,true,strParam)
CurrentObj.DeleteVariable("bp_su")

af.name: SetMinimumConfidenceBP
af.g:
SetMinimumConfidenceBP = False
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2 Then
Writelog "This action is required to run the Page or Field level. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
'On error resume next
l_iConfidence = CInt(strParam)
If Err.Number <> 0 Then
Writelog "There was a problem setting the confidence: " & Err.Description
Exit Function
End If
If (1 > l_iConfidence OR l_iConfidence > 10 ) Then
Writelog "The valid values for confidence are in the range of 1-10"
Exit Function
Else
CurrentObj.Variable("ReqConf") = CStr(l_iConfidence)
Writelog "Minimum confidence set to " & CurrentObj.Variable("ReqConf")
SetMinimumConfidenceBP = True
End If

*** This Action Is Deprecated ***

If the engine does not detect any barcodes, then the variable GetBarCodeList is not populated nor created.
GetAllBarcodesBP(",")
Page and field level.

In addition the calling object's value and variable "GetBarCode" will be filled with the bar code value. This action also stores barcode information such as confidence, coordinates, code name, and size. GetBarcodeBP contains detailed information regarding barcode detection settings.

True if the action is called at the page level or field level. Otherwise, False.
In addition the calling object's value and variable "GetBarCode" will be filled with the bar code value. This action also stores barcode information such as confidence, coordinates, code name, and size. If the object's barcode settings are set to read more than one barcode, and more than one barcode is found, barcodes are also stored in the variable "GetBarCodeX" where "X" is the index of the barcode found.
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release. It is recommended that you no longer use this action. Instead, use the GetBarcode action in the Barcode action library.
Use this action if your page has 1D or 2D barcodes. Any field must have a Position assigned when bar code reading is performed. For example the application would invoke the CreateFields action, and if the field has Position defined in the Document Hierarchy and the zones are loaded, it is ready for field level barcode reading. If anchors or fingerprint matching are used, ReadZones or other registration may be required to align the fields correctly to the fingerprint template zones.
Setting The Expected Barcode Type
By default, the barcode engine will consider the barcode type to be unknown and attempt to detect the barcode. The barcode type must be set when detecting PatchCode and PDF417 barcodes. For other barcode formats, it still may be necessary to set the expected barcode type for the engine to find and recognize the barcode. If a barcode is not being detected, set the proper barcode type to aid the barcode detection.
The expected barcode types can be easily set using the "BAR/P" tab property within the "Zones" tab of Datacap Studio. This property can be set by selecting the target DCO node page or field, locking the DCO and selecting the expected barcode types. This will automatically calculate the correct value based on all of the selected types and set the bp_tp variable for your application in the Setup DCO. For best results, keep the expected types to a minimum. When you use this property approach to setting the expected barcode type, it is not necessary to separately set the bp_tp variable.
Alternatively, the expected barcode type can be set at runtime on the target field/page being recognized by setting the variable bp_tp. If the "bp_tp" variable is empty or does not exist, the engine defaults to "Unknown" (please see notes for "Unknown" below).
The bp_tp variable sets the expected barcode type, or types, which will provide better recognition results. If multiple barcode types are expected, the value of this variable must be a combination of the barcode types shown below. Multiple types can be read by adding the values of their codes together. Always set the expected type to the minimum possible types. This variable can be set using rrSet prior to calling a barcode recognition action. For example: rrSet("256","@X.bp_tp") for reading a Code 39 barcode.
When the barcode type is set to Patch Code, the following string values may be returned by the engine (the string value depends on the type of Patch Code that is found):
Patch 1: 1100
Patch 2: 1001
Patch 3: 1010
Patch 4 / Toggle Patch: 0110
Patch 6: 0011
Patch T / Transfer patch: 0101
Important! When recognizing PatchCodes, the barcode type must be set explicitly to PatchCode. The default barcode type setting of "Unknown" will not detect PatchCodes.
Valid barcode types:
0 : Unknown. Detects all barcode types automatically, in the exception of PatchCode and PDF417. These have to be set explicitly to be detected.
1 : INDUSTRY 2 OF 5
2 : INTERLEAVED 2 OF 5
4 : IATA 2 OF 5
8 : DATALOGIC 2 OF 5
16 : INVERT 2 OF 5
32 : BCD MATRIX
64 : MATRIX 2 OF 5
128 : CODE 32
256 : CODE 39
512 : CODABAR 2
1024 : CODE 93
2048 : CODE 128
4096 : EAN-13
8192 : EAN-8
16384 : UPC-A
32768 : UPC-E
65536 : ADD 5
131072 : ADD 2
262144 : UCC128/EAN-128
524288 : Patch Code
1048576 : PostNet
2097152 : PDF417
4194304 : DataMatrix
8388608 : Code 39 Extended
16777216 : Code 93 Extended
33554432 : QRCode
67108864 : IntelligentMail
134217728 : Royal Mail (RM4SCC)
268435456 : Australian Post 4-State Code
536870912 : Aztec
1073741824: GS1DataBar
Variable Length Royal Mail Barcodes
The Royal Mail barcode is a fixed length barcode. Some countries use a variable a variable length variation of the Royal Mail barcode, such as the Postal Services of Portugal. To allow reading of a variable length Royal Mail barcode for Portuguese CTT, in addition to selecting the Royal Mail barcode type, the variable length setting must be enabled. Setting the DCO variable "RoyalMailVariableLength" to "1" will allow detection of variable length Royal Mail barcodes. It is allowed to enable variable length for fixed length Royal Mail barcodes, if the length restriction does not need to be enforced.
This example sets the barcode type to variable length Royal Mail:
rrSet("1", "@P.RoyalMailVariableLength")
rrSet("134217728", "@P.bp_tp")
GetBarcodeBP()
Minimum and Maximum Settings
Multiple barcodes can exist and be recognized on a single page. The DCO variable bp_su controls the maximum number of barcodes that will attempt to be read on a single page. If not specified, the default maximum is 10.
The minimum number of expected barcodes can be specified using the DCO variable bp_minExpected. This setting will control when image enhancement takes place. Unless specified, the minimum expected barcodes will default to the same value as the maximum number of barcodes setting.
Barcode Detection Steps
The barcode actions will detect using the following steps.
- Recognize barcodes on the page / field.
- Stop if minimum expected is detected.
- If minimum not reached and image enhancement is enabled then
- - Use each of the enabled image enhancement features and read the barcode.
- - Stop if minimum expected is detected.
- - Continue performing each enabled image enhancement feature to detect the minimum expected barcodes.
If the number of recognized barcodes is equal to or more than the specified minimum, image enhancement will be skipped. If the minimum number of barcodes has not been reached, and if image enhancement is enabled, then barcode recognition will be performed a second time using the configured type of image enhancement in an attempt to read the barcode.
For example, if the configured minimum barcodes is 1 and the maximum is 10, first barcode recognition will be performed without any image enhancement and attempt to read up to 10 barcodes. If at least 1 barcode is read, the action will complete. If 0 barcodes are read, the action will perform the specified image enhancement and attempt once more to recognize the barcodes on the page. If 0 barcodes are read and no image enhancement is configured, the action will complete without a second attempt at recognition.
Another example is if two barcodes are expected with the minimum set to 2. If 2 or more barcodes are read, then recognition will stop. If less than two are read and if image enhancement is enabled, the barcode action will perform the configured image enhancement type and attempt to read the barcode again. It will do this for each type of enabled image enhancement.
Image Enhancement
Image enhancement may be necessary in order to help read damaged or poorly scanned barcodes. Depending on the problem with the barcode, different types of enhancements may make the barcode readable. The barcode_p actions offer a way to enhance the image while reading the barcode. To enable this feature, set the variable bp_enhance to "1". When set to "1", the engine will first try to recognize the barcode without image enhancement.
If the minimum number of barcodes has not been read, then the action will try again using the specified image enhancement. If the minimum number of barcodes has been read, then the image enhancement will be skipped. If your barcode images are such that they will always require image enhancement, set bp_enhance to "2", which will skip the first recognition step that attempts to recognize without image enhancement.
Enabling image enhancement for barcodes will only alter the image during barcode recognition, the original image in the batch will be left unchanged.
The image enhancements are not cumulative, enable only one type of image enhancement that is needed.
Image Enhancement Types
Smooth Zoom: bp_zoom - Scales the image larger to help improve recognition for small barcodes.
Blur: bp_blur - Blurs the image which can help jagged lines.
Dilate: bp_dilate - Expands pixels making lines thicker.
Erode: bp_erode - Removes pixels along line edges.
Flip: bp_flip - It is usually not necessary to flip the image for an upside-down barcode to recognize.
Resize: bp_resize - Enlarges the image which could help small barcodes, similar to zoom.
Binarize: bp_binarize - Converts 24 and 8 bit images to 1 bit. A 1 bit image can improve recognition for barcodes where the contrast between the barcode lines and the background is low or when there is light shading preventing recognition.
Enabling Image Enhancement
To activate automatic image enhancement, set the DCO variable bp_enhance to "1" prior to calling a barcode action on the DCO page or field node that will be recognized.
For example: rrSet("1","@X.bp_enhance")
Each specific image enhancement can be enabled by setting the associated DCO variable to "1" or disabled by setting it to "0". By default, "Smooth Zoom" is always enabled and all other image enhancements are disabled.
For example, if "Smooth Zoom" is the desired enhancement, simply enabling image enhancement by setting bp_enhance to "1" will enable image enhancement for Smooth Zoom.
If only Binarize is required, then this sequence prior to calling a barcode action will enable only the Binarize feature. rrSet("1","@X.bp_enhance")
rrSet("0","@X.bp_zoom")
rrSet("1","@X.bp_binarize")
Enabling Multiple Enhancements
Multiple enhancements can be enabled if you find that you consistently receive documents that require different types of enhancements. For example, some documents always work the first time, other documents only detect if binarize is used and others work only if blur is used. If multiple enhancements are enabled, the action will attempt to recognize using each of the enabled enhancement types until the minimum expected have been read.
For example, to always use Binarize and Blur to recognize the barcode, set the following prior to recognizing the barcode:
rrSet("1","@X.bp_enhance")
rrSet("0","@X.bp_zoom")
rrSet("1","@X.bp_binarize")
rrSet("1","@X.bp_blur")
The action will then use the blur and binarize enhancements until the minimum number is read. If bp_enhance is set to "1" the action will always first try to recognize without any enhancements and only if the minimum is not reached, will it continue. Each additional enhancement type enabled will be attempted until the minimum are read or all enabled enhancements have been attempted.
For best performance, always set the minimum number of barcodes expected or the action may perform unnecessary enhancements.
The order in which the enhancements are attempted by the barcode action cannot be controlled.
Barcode Orientation
Barcode orientation defaults to both horizontal and vertical. Specifying the orientation may help in detection of barcodes. For example, if the barcodes will always be horizontal, then detection and recognition can be improved by setting the orientation to Horizontal only. If necessary, the orientation can be configured by setting the DCO variable bp_or.
0 = Horizontal and Vertical.
1 = Horizontal.
2 = Vertical.
3 = Horizontal, Vertical and Diagonal.
Barcode Byte Mode:
Some specific barcode types, such as PDF-417, allow null characters within the data stream. If this occurs, the full length of the barcode can be truncated returning only the characters up to the first null character. This is typically observable by noting that the read barcode is shorter than expected. For example, if the barcode should be a 40 character ID but it returns truncated text.
To treat a barcode as byte data, set the DCO variable BarcodeUseByte to "1". This setting will treat the stream as bytes and also convert any null characters to spaces so the entire string can then be utilized in other parts of the application.
When in byte mode, the default replacement character of a space can be set to a different replacement character by setting the DCO variable BarcodeReplacementChar to the desired replacement character.
NOTE: Unicode characters are not supported when using byte mode.
rrSet("1", "@X.bp_minExpected")
rrSet("33554432", "@X.bp_tp")
GetBarcodeBP()
This example configures the reader to expect 1 barcode on the page and sets the barcode type in rules prior to calling the barcode action.
rrSet("1", "@X.bp_minExpected") rrSet("1","@X.bp_enhance")
rrSet("0","@X.bp_zoom")
rrSet("1","@X.bp_binarize")
GetBarcodeBP()
This example assumes the barcode type has previously been configured in Datacap Studio. It also enables the binarize image enhancement to run, if no barcodes are found on the page.

sPath=CurrentObj.Variable("IMAGEFILE")
ImageCtrl.FileName = sPath
ImageCtrl.GetRes xDPI, yDPI
CCOMaxHeightPixels = CCOMaxHeightTMM * yDPI / 254
WriteLog("MaxHt TMM = " & CCOMaxHeightTMM & " yDPI = " & CStr(yDPI) & " MaxHt PX = " & CCOMaxHeightPixels)
sOverlap=CurrentObj.Variable("LineHeightOverlapPercent")
if CStr(sOverlap) <> "" then
'WriteLog("Overlap '" & sOverlap & "'")
on error resume next
if CInt(sOverlap) > 0 and CInt(sOverlap) < 100 then
CCOLineHeightOverlapPercent = CInt(sOverlap)
WriteLog("Line Height Overlap Percent set to " & CCOLineHeightOverlapPercent)
End If
end if
on error goto 0
imageFileExtensionPeriod = instrRev(sPath,".")
sPath = Left(sPath,imageFileExtensionPeriod) & "cco"
Set pObj=Nothing
Set xDoc=CCO2XML(sPath, pObj) ' extract CCO to XML doc, get back pObj=CCO in memory
Call SortXML2(xDoc, wbottom) ' sort XML by text baseline
sXPath=Replace(sPath, ".cco", "sortv.xml")
'xDoc.Save(sXPath)
Split2LinesDiscret(xDoc) ' organize into lines
sXPath=Replace(sPath, ".cco", "split.xml")
'xDoc.Save(sXPath)
'Call SortXML2(xDoc, wleft) ' sort within line by left to right
Call SortXMLBiDi(xDoc) ' sort within line LTR or RTL depending on hr_bidi
sXPath=Replace(sPath, ".cco", "sorth.xml")
'xDoc.Save(sXPath)
' now build up the full structure of lines and words
Set xNodes=xDoc.selectNodes(".//W")
For Each oNode In xNodes
xDoc.documentElement.appendChild(oNode)
Next
Set xNodes=xDoc.selectNodes(".//L")
For Each oNode In xNodes
oNode.parentNode.removeChild(oNode)
Next
' sXPath=Replace(sPath, ".cco", "NodeLRemoved.xml")
' xDoc.Save(sXPath) ' Debug only
' now join together "phrases" that were previously split but belong together in a line
Call ReJoin(xDoc, pObj)
' sXPath=Replace(sPath, ".cco", "Rejoin.xml") ' Debug only
' xDoc.Save(sXPath) ' debug only
Call RecreateCCO(xDoc, sPath, pObj)
sXPath=Replace(sPath, ".cco", "c.xml")
xDoc.Save(sXPath)
Set xDoc=Nothing
NormalizeCCO=True

rrx.help:
'**************************************************** ' Cco2cco.rrx - a description of the library
' Licensed Materials - Property of IBM ' “Restricted Materials of IBM” ' 5725-C15 5725-C69 ' ' © Copyright IBM Corp. 1994, 2020 All Rights Reserved ' ' US Government Users Restricted Rights - Use, duplication or ' disclosure restricted by GSA ADP Schedule Contract with ' IBM Corp.
'****************************************************
Page. Always True.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended that this action is no longer used. Instead, use the replacement action NormalizeCCO in the SharedRecognitionTools action library.
This action sorts the words and lines in a Fingerprint file (.cco) created by a recognition engine, for use by navigation and pattern match actions. The action is called by full-page recognition actions for ICR/C, OCR/S, and OCR/A. This action should always be called before using Locateactions or the pat_RecogMatch_IDaction to find recognized text on a page.
In this context, the fingerprint is calculated for a particular image in a batch, as opposed to the Fingerprint database, which contains fingerprints for various page types and layout variations that have been defined for a particular application.
There are two types of Fingerprint files. One type is based on the image geometry. The second type is based on recognized text. The AnalyzeImageaction creates a geometric fingerprint containing lines and "words" based only on the black pixels in the image. Full-page recognition actions (RecognizePageOCR_S, RecognizePageICR_C, RecognizePageOCR_A etc.) create a fingerprint based on the results of recognition, i.e. both geometry and text of the recognized characters, words and lines.
In Recognition-based fingerprints, the order of lines and words may appear to be arbitrary, especially if the page contains images, tables, stamps, or blocks of text with varying font sizes. This can cause unpredictable results from Locateactions that navigate geometrically. The word-matching and phrase-matching action pat_RecogMatch_IDalso requires well-ordered text to work reliably.
The NormalizeCCO action re-orders the words of text in a Recognition-based fingerprint into lines and words in "standard" reading order, from top to bottom and left to right.
LineHeightOverlapPercent parameter is percentage of a line that two words must be offset to be considered as separate lines. By default LineHeightOverlapPercent is set to 50 percent. This variable can be used if the offset between two word in different lines, seems to be less than the default value which is 50.
rrSet (35,@P.LineHeightOverlapPercent)
In the example, if two words are vertically offset by more than 35% of the height of the words, then they are considered to be on separate lines. Lower values are more likely to split words into separate lines. Higher values are more likely to merge words into a single line.
LineHeightOverlapPercent variable should be set before NormalizeCCO().
rrSet (35,@P.LineHeightOverlapPercent)
RecognizePageOCR_A
IMPORTANT NOTE: NormalizeCCO discards any "words" or blocks containing characters taller than 1/4 inch, or the height set by SetMaxCharacterHeightTMM().
NOTE: If the AnalyzeImage action is called before full-page recognition, the recognized text is placed into the geometry created by AnalyzeImage.This hybrid Fingerprint file is not always suitable for cco2cco. To force creation of a pure recognition-based fingerprint, call SetFingerprintRecogPriority(True) before full-page recognition. This guarantees that any existing geometric fingerprint will be ignored, and it applies to OCR_Sand ICR_Conly.
NOTE: The full page recognition actions,RecognizePageXXX from the ICR_C, OCR_A, and OCR_S libraries call NormalizeCCO() automatically unless the action CCONormalization_OFF (from the Recog_Shared library) is called prior to recognition. The full page recognition from the OCR_SR library, however, requires that NormalizeCCO() to be called manually post recognition.
If using the OCR/A or OCR/SR action Recognize, then use the action CreateCcoFromLayout to load the CCO after recognition has been performed.
SetFingerprintRecogPriority(True)
RecognizePageOCR_S()
NormalizeCCO()
pat_RecogMatch_ID()
Integer maximum height of characters to permit in the CCO, in 1/10 mm units. Default is 64, or approx 1/4 inch (50 pixels at 200 DPI).
Page. Always True.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended that this action is no longer used. Instead, use the replacement action SetMaxCharacterHeightTMM in the SharedRecognitionTools action library.
SetMaxCharacterHeightTMM(75)
NormalizeCCO()
One or two digit Integer value sets the percent maximum height of characters over the average to permit in the CCO.
Off by default. Parameter of zero (0) or less turns off this functionality.
Page. Always True.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended that this action is no longer used. Instead, use the replacement action SetMaxCharacterHeightAVG in the SharedRecognitionTools action library.

net.h:
The ClassifyLayout actions classify document pages based on page layout features such as title, page number, average font size, and the presence and locations of tables and graphics.
The application must recognize the document using an OCR action that produces a layout XML file before invoking any ClassifyLayout actions.
Actions that produce a layout XML file include OCR_SR.Recognize and OCR_A.Recognize.
The Identify action creates a variable that your application rules can use to set the page Type.
ClassifyLayout actions store classification knowledge (page types and features associated with each type) in tables in the Fingerprint database.

method.name: Identify
method.h:
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release.
It is recommended that you no longer use this action.
There is no replacement.
The Identify action analyzes the layout file for the current page and tries to find a similar page type that was previously learned by the Feedback action.
This action stores the best matching page type in the page variable acidType.
It also creates variables acidPageNo (like 1/3 for first page of 3, or 0/0 if no page # found) and acidTitle (if title is detected) to be used for further processing.
Recognize()
Identify()
method.ret:
True,
if the action completes without errors, regardless of whether classification is successful or not. If the action is called on an object other than a page, or if it encounters an internal error, it returns
False.

method.name: Feedback
method.h:
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release.
It is recommended that you no longer use this action.
There is no replacement.
You can use the Feedback action to teach the ClassifyLayout action how to properly classify pages.
The Feedback action is usually called at export time. The Idenfity action must have run previously,
and the page type should be manually verified or corrected before calling this action.
This action compares the acidType variable created by Idenfity to the verified page TYPE.
If those are different, this page and its features are added to the knowledge base to be used by Identify in the future.
Feedback()
method.ret:
True,
if the action is called on a page, and is able to complete. If called on a non-page object, or if the action encounters an error, it returns
False.

method.name: CMISLogin
method.qi: Supply login credentials and connect to the CMIS server.
method.ap:
atomPubURL :
The AtomPub URL for your CMIS compatible repository.
userID :
The logon user ID.
password :
The password.
repositoryID :
Optionally specify the CMIS repository ID.
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
method.h:
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release.
It is recommended that you no longer use this action.
This action connects to a CMIS compatible repository using a AtomPub URL. If the repository ID is blank,
the connection will be made to the first repository returned from the CMIS connection.
This action must be called before using any of the other CMIS actions.
CMISLogin("http://localhost:8080/alfresco/service/api/cmis","MyUserID","@APPVAR(values/adv/cmispassword)")
The password is obtained from the application service and is set using the application manager.
CMISLogin("http://localhost:8080/alfresco/service/api/cmis","MyUserID","@APPVAR(values/adv/cmispassword)","MyRepositoryID")
This example passes the optional repository ID.
method.ret: Returns True if the login was successful, otherwise it returns False.

method.name: CMISUploadPage
method.qi: Upload the current DCO page to the CMIS server.
method.ap:
cmisUploadedName :
The desired final name of the file in the repository.
cmisUploadDirectory :
The full path for the folder within the repository where the file will be stored.
mimeType :
The mime type of the uploaded file.
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
method.h:
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release.
It is recommended that you no longer use this action.
This action uploads the current DCO page to the configured repository.
Note that objects created on the CMIS server may not be immediately accessible.
For example, the indexing service on your CMIS server may run on a configured interval,
so your new object may not be available until the indexing service completes.
If you are having trouble accessing newly created objects, check the settings and documentation
of your CMIS server to determine when objects should become available.
A record of uploaded files will be placed in the file UploadRecord.xml in the batch directory.
CMISSetDocUploadType("cmisbook:poem")
CMISSetDocUploadProperty("cmisbook:author", "Edgar Allan Poe", "string", False)
CMISSetDocUploadProperty("cmisbook:Title", "The Raven", "string", False)
CMISUploadPage("MyFile.txt", "/MyCMISDir", "text/plain")
This set of actions sets property values of the page that will be uploaded, then uploads the page.
The current page will be placed into the \MyCMISDir folder and be given the mime type of text/plain.
method.ret:
Returns
True,
if the file is successfully uploaded. Otherwise, it returns
False.

method.name: CMISSetDocUploadType
method.qi: Sets the type of the file that will be uploaded.
method.ap:
cmisDocType :
The document type of the uploaded file. Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release.
It is recommended that you no longer use this action.
This action sets the CMIS document type for the file that will be subsequently uploaded in a following upload action.
Use of this action is optional. If it is not called, the value of cmis:document will be used.
To set the document type, this action must be called before CMISUploadFile or CMISUploadPage.
Standard CMIS properties are of the form "CMIS:xxx". By convention, custom CMIS properties should not use the "CMIS:" prefix.
Calling this action with an empty string, will reset the value back to the default cmis:document type.
Once the upload is complete, the document type is reset to the default value
and this action will need to be called again to set a custom value for another upload.
If the specified upload type is invalid or not defined on your CMIS server, an error will occur in the upload action.
CMISSetDocUploadType("cmisbook:poem")
CMISSetDocUploadProperty("cmisbook:author", "Edgar Allan Poe", "string", False)
CMISSetDocUploadProperty("cmisbook:Title", "The Raven", "string", False)
CMISUploadPage("MyFile.txt", "/MyCMISDir", "text/plain")
This uses a predefined custom document type and then sets the custom author and title properties of the uploaded file.
method.ret: Always returns True.

method.name: CMISSetDocUploadProperty
method.qi: Sets the value of a property belonging to the file that will be uploaded.
method.ap:
cmisDocProperyName :
The name of the CMIS property to set.
cmisDocProperyValue :
The value of the specified property.
valueType :
The CMIS type of the value. Must be "string", "integer", "datetime" or "boolean".
isMulti :
True if the CMIS type is a multi value type. False if the CMIS type is single.
Smart parameters are supported for cmisDocProperyName, cmisDocProperyValue and valueType.
method.h:
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release.
It is recommended that you no longer use this action.
This action sets a value to the specified property for files or pages that will be uploaded
to the CMIS repository. Use of this action is optional.
Standard CMIS properties are of the form "CMIS:xxx". By convention, custom CMIS properties should not use the "CMIS:" prefix.
This action must be called before CMISUploadFile or CMISUploadPage. If multiple properties
need to be set for a document upload, call this action multiple times to set
multiple properties. The property must be defined for the document type within the CMIS repository.
If the property or value is not valid for the document type, the error will not be
reported until the upload action is called. Once the upload is complete, the property settings set with this action
are discarded and this action will need to be called again to set any custom properties for another upload.
For a boolean property type, the value must be either "true" or "false".
The datetime type accepts an input string specifying just the date or the date and time.
The application will attempt to parse the input date format based on the current locale.
The action will use the locale set in the Application Service / hr_locale variable.
If that is not set, the current OS locale will be used to interpret the date/time. The action attempts to ignore
unrecognized data, if possible. If the month, day or year is missing, it will attempt to use the values
from the current date. If a time is not specified, then then time is set to 12:00 midnight.
It is recommended to provide the full short date in the correct format that is correct for the current
locale, and a full 4 digit year, to reduce the chance of the action guessing values incorrectly.
Only Gregorian short date formats are supported.
Example input datetime strings in the en-US locale.
05/01/2009 14:57:32.8 becomes 5/1/2009 2:57:32 PM
2009-05-01 14:57:32.8 becomes 5/1/2009 2:57:32 PM
2009-05-01T14:57:32.8375298-04:00 becomes 5/1/2009 11:57:32 AM
5/01/2008 14:57:32.80 -07:00 becomes 5/1/2008 2:57:32 PM.
CMISSetDocUploadType("cmisbook:poem")
CMISSetDocUploadProperty("cmisbook:author", "Edgar Allan Poe", "string", False)
CMISSetDocUploadProperty("cmisbook:Title", "The Raven", "string", False)
CMISUploadPage("MyFile.txt", "/MyCMISDir", "text/plain")
This uses a predefine custom document type and then sets the author and title properties of the uploaded file.
method.ret: Returns False, if the property could not be set or the datetime parameter could not be processed. Otherwise True is returned.

method.h:
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release.

This action uploads a file to the configured repository. You can optionally set properties of the uploaded file using the

Note that objects created on the CMIS server may not be immediately accessible by the client.
For example, the indexing service on your CMIS server may run on a configured interval,

If you are having trouble accessing newly created objects, check the settings and documentation
of your CMIS server to determine when objects should become available.
A record of uploaded files will be placed in the file UploadRecord.xml in the batch directory.
CMISSetDocUploadType("cmisbook:poem")
