af.name: FNP8_SetURL
af.qi: Sets the URL for the FileNet P8 Web Service.

af.name: FNP8_Login
af.qi: Sets the UserID and Password for login to the IBM FileNet P8 system.

af.name: FNP8_SetLocale
af.qi: Identifies the locale on the target P8 system.

af.name: FNP8_SetTargetClassID
af.qi: Sets the F8 Document Class for uploaded documents.

af.name: FNP8_SetTargetObjectID
af.qi: Sets the name of the Object Store in which documents will be stored.

af.name: FNP8_SetDestinationFolder
af.qi: Sets the destination folder for the documents being uploaded.

af.name: FNP8_CreateFolder
af.qi: Creates a subfolder on a specified target class and object.

af.name: FNP8_SetDocClassId
af.qi: Sets the P8 Document Class for the uploaded files.

af.name: FNP8_SetDefineSecurityParentage
af.qi: Sets the security parentage for the uploaded files.

af.name: FNP8_SetDocTitle
af.qi: Sets the Document Title for documents being uploaded.

af.name: FNP8_SetFileMimeType
af.qi: Specifies a custom MIME type to be used by a file extension.

af.name: FNP8_SetProperty
af.qi: Sets the designated FileNet property to a specified value.

af.name: FNP8_SetPropertyEx
af.qi: Sets the designated FileNet property to a specified value.

af.name: FNP8_SetMultiValueProperty
af.qi: Sets the values in a multi-value property.

af.name: FNP8_SetTimeout
af.qi: Sets the timeout for the FileNet P8 Web Service in milliseconds.

af.name: FNP8_Upload
af.qi: Uploads the Batch images to the FileNet P8 repository.

af.name: FNP8_UploadDir
af.qi: Uploads all images from a specific source folder.

af.name: FNP8_SetFileType
af.qi: Assigns the file type for the files that are uploaded.

af.name: FNP8_SetUploadMode
af.qi: Set the upload mode.

af.name: FNP8_MultiPageDocs
af.qi: Set the upload mode.

af.name: FNP8_SetRetry
af.qi: Sets the number of automatic upload retries.

af.name: FNP8_SetKeyProperty
af.qi: Sets the update properties key to a FileNet document property and its corresponding property value.

af.name: FNP8_UpdateProperties
af.qi: Updates an existing FileNet P8 document's properties values using the data passed into the SetProperty action.

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchClass
af.qi: Sets the document class to use for search.

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchDownloadDir
af.qi: Sets the full directory path for where the contents of the documents returned by search should be downloaded to.

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchWhereClause
af.qi: Sets the search criteria (WHERE clause).

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchAndDownloadStatusProperty
af.qi: Sets the name of an integer property which the FNP8_SearchAndDownload action will update for the documents which it downloads to flag that the document has been downloaded.

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchMaxItems
af.qi: Sets the maximum number of search results.

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchFolderRestriction
af.qi: Sets a folder path to restrict the search results.

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchOrderBy
af.qi: Sets the orderby clause for the search results.

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchIncludeDocsWithoutContent
af.qi: Set to true to include documents without content in search results, false otherwise. Default is false.

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchIncludeSubClasses
af.qi: Set to true to include the subclasses of the search class in search results, false otherwise. Default is true.

af.name: FNP8_SetSearchCurrentVersionOnly
af.qi: Set to true to include only the current version of documents in the search results, false otherwise. Default is true.

af.name: FNP8_SearchAndDownload
af.qi: Executes a search for documents in Filenet P8 and downloads the content of the documents.

af.name: FNP8_AddRedactionsToP8Document
af.qi: Updates an existing P8 document to add redactions, if any fields have been redacted

af.name: FNP8_SetOverrideCheckoutOnUpdateContent
af.qi: Set to True to override existing checkouts of documents being updated, False otherwise. Default is False.

af.name: FNP8_UpdateContent
af.qi: Update the content of a document in a FileNet P8 repository.

A single parameter identifying the URL for the IBM FileNet P8 Server . The IP port is typically :9080 (IBM WebSphere) and the URL typically ends in /WSDL. Smart parameters are supported.
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release. It is recommended that you no longer use this action. Instead, use the P8Login action in the IBMFileNetP8 action library.
This action sets the URL for the FileNet P8 Content Manager Server. This action should be called before any other P8 upload actions.
FNP8_SetURL("http://myp8server:9080/wsi/FNCEWS40MTOM/")
IMPORTANT: The address may be case sensitive and the trailing forward-slash “/” must be present. To confirm that the address reaches a working IBM FileNet P8 Server, browse to the address after adding “wsdl” to the end, e.g. http://myp8server:9080/wsi/FNCEWS40MTOM/wsdl
All, but generally at the Batch level.
False, if DC_P8_Server.dll was not successfully installed on this computer, or if the parameter is not formatted as a valid URL. Otherwise, True.
Note: This action returns True whether or not the URL is actually an operating IBM FileNet P8 Server or not. If not, an error will be reported when the Upload or UploadDir action runs. You can check that the URL is correct and operating by displaying it in any web browser.
Two comma-separated smart parameter supported string values:
1. Login Name.
2. Password.
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release. It is recommended that you no longer use this action. Instead, use the P8Login action in the IBMFileNetP8 action library.
This action provides the User ID and Password to use when logging in to IBM FileNet P8. FNP8_Login("User1,Password1")All, but generally at the Batch level.False, if DC_P8_Server.dll was not successfully installed on this computer, or either parameter value is missing or not a string. Otherwise, True.
Locale value accepted by the FileNet P8 Web Service. The default value is “en_US”.
Locales are represented by 2-letter ISO 639 Language Codes and 2-letter ISO 3166 Country Codes separated by a _ character. For example: en_US or de_DE
Please consult these ISO documents to determine your locale value.
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release. It is recommended that you no longer use this action. Instead, use the P8SetLocale action in the IBMFileNetP8 action library.
Sets the Locale (the language and language conventions such as date format) used on the P8 server. This action is only required if the P8 repository uses a locale other than US English. FNP8_SetLocale("en_US")All, but generally at the Batch level.False, if DC_P8_Server.dll was not successfully installed on this computer, or either parameter value is missing or not a string. Otherwise, True.
Specifies the repository type. The valid values are "ObjectStore" and "FileStore".
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release. It is recommended that you no longer use this action. Instead, use the P8SetTargetClassUD action in the IBMFileNetP8 action library.
Sets the top level repository type. If this action is not called, the default value of "ObjectStore"will be used. FileStore is an alternative repository type. FNP8_SetTargetClassID("ObjectStore")All levels.False if DC_P8_Server.dll was not successfully installed on this computer, or either parameter value is missing or not a string. Otherwise, True.
String value of the Object Store name. Smart parameters are supported.
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release. It is recommended that you no longer use this action. Instead, use the P8SetTargetObjectID action in the IBMFileNetP8 action library.
Provides the name of the Object Store that you wish to store your documents in. FNP8_SetTargetObjectID("AP_ObjectStore") All, but generally at the Batch level. False, if DC_P8_Server.dll was not successfully installed on this computer, or either parameter value is missing or not a string. Otherwise, True.
The path to the destination FileNet P8 folder in the selected Object Store where documents should be uploaded. For example: \1040EZ\ The default value is the root folder of the specified target object. Smart parameters are supported.
Note: The trailing '\' is optional, folders that are children of the root folder do not have to have a '\' after the name. In some cases a main folder of the object store will require a trailing '\', if the 'object store' configured for it.
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release. It is recommended that you no longer use this action. Instead, use the P8SetDestinationFolder action in the IBMFileNetP8 action library.
Sets the destination folder for the documents being uploaded. See also FNP8_CreateFolder.
Note: This setting can be changed by a subsequent FNP8_CreateFolder action. Note: If you call it with the foldername "Unfiled Documents" (case insensitive) it will upload to FileNet's special "Unfiled Documents" folder. FNP8_SetDestinationFolder("\1040EZ\")All levels.False if DC_P8_Server.dll was not successfully installed on this computer, or either parameter value is missing or not a string. Otherwise, True.
A string value or a predefined Smart Parameter variable which specifies the name of the folder to create.
Smart parameters are supported such as: @BATCHID, @ID, @STATUS, @TYPE, @VALUE, @JOBID, @JOBNAME, @OPERATOR, @STATION, @TASKID and @TASKNAME. Please refer to the smart parameter documentation for more information.
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release. It is recommended that you no longer use this action. Instead, use the P8CreateFolder action in the IBMFileNetP8 action library.
This action creates a subfolder on a specified target class and object. Like the Upload actions, this action must be preceded by SetURL, Login and SetTargetClassID actions.
FNP8_SetDestinationFolder("\1040EZ\Export\")
FNP8_CreateFolder("@BATCHID")
This example will create a subfolder under the \1040EZ\Export\ folder and change the destination folder to the newly created folder. If the folder is created successfully, the action adds a variable “Folder_ID” to the current DCO with the folder ID returned from FileNet Web Service. All levels.False if the parameter cannot be parsed, the set up information is invalid, or the folder cannot be created. Otherwise, True.
Note: If the action returns False, the action directs the Rulerunner task to finish with a status of “Aborted”.
String value of the Document Class ID.

A string or smart parameter value "True" or "False" whether the file security is to be inherited from the parent folder. Smart parameters are supported.
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***
This action has been deprecated and is scheduled to be removed in a future release. It is recommended that you no longer use this action. Instead, use the P8SetDefineSecurityParentage action in the IBMFileNetP8 action library.
If "True", specifies that security is to be inherited from the parent folder, equivalent to setting the filenet.api.constant.DefineSecurityParentage to DEFINE_SECURITY_PARENTAGE. If "False", specifies that security is not inherited from the parent folder, equivalent to setting the filenet.api.constant.DefineSecurityParentage to DO_NOT_DEFINE_SECURITY_PARENTAGE.
If this action is not called or the parameter is not "True" or "False", the default value of "False" will be used, and the security will not inherit from the parent folder.
FNP8_SetDestinationFolder("@APPVAR(values/gen/P8Folder)")
FNP8_SetDefineSecurityParentage("True")
FNP8_Upload()
All levels.
True
String value of a Document Title or a predefined Smart Parameter variable. “Title”, without the quotation marks, is an acceptable default parameter.
Smart parameters are supported.

or

This action sets the MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions) type, or content type, for the uploaded documents.

Two comma-separated values. The first value specifies the file extension and the second specifies the new MIME type for the file extension.
*** This Action Is Deprecated ***

This action sets the MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions) type, or content type, for uploaded documents with matching file extensions. This action overrides the library’s default mapping of the file extension to a MIME type. To override and use the custom MIME type, provide the file extension and the new MIME type to associate with the file extension.
The following file type extensions have default MIME type mappings:
ai : application/illustrator
avi : video/x-msvideo
bmp : image/bmp
doc : application/msword
docx : application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
dwg : image/vnd.dwg
dxf : image/vnd.dxf
gif : image/gif
htm : text/html
html : text/html
ico : image/x-icon
jpe : image/jpeg
jpeg : image/jpeg
jpg : image/jpeg
jpgv : video/jpeg
m4v : video/x-m4v
mov : video/quicktime
mp4 : video/mp4
mpeg : video/mpeg
mpg : video/mpeg
mpp : application/vnd.ms-project
mpv : video/mpv
msg : application/msoutlook
ogg : application/ogg
pcx : image/x-pcx
pdf : application/pdf
pic : image/x-pict
png : image/png
ppt : application/vnd.ms-powerpoint
pptx : application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation
qt : video/quicktime
rgb : image/x-rgb
rtf : text/richtext
tif : image/tiff

txt : text/plain
vsd : application/vnd.visio
wmd : application/x-ms-wmd
wmv : video/x-ms-wmv
wmx : video/x-ms-wmx
xls : application/vnd.ms-excel
xlsx : application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
xml : text/xml
Other file types are mapped to the generic 'application/octet-stream' MIME type.
FNP8_SetFileMimeType(".rar,application/x-rar-compressed")
All levels. Always returns True.
The following comma-separated string values:
1. Property ID: the name of an existing document property in the FileNet library (equivalent to a document index field).
2. Property Value: the value to assign to the associated Property ID. A value enclosed within single quotes are treated as string literal.
3. Optional property type. If this parameter is not specified, the property type will default to a 'string'. Supported types are: Binary, Boolean, DateTime, Float, ID, Integer, Object and String.
Smart Parameters are supported for values.

If a ruleset calls the FNP8_SetProperty action more than once, using the same Property ID as the opening parameter, FileNet P8 assumes that the second parameter is multi-value and assigns that value to the property.

This action is similar to FNP8_Upload, except that FNP8_UpdateContent checks in the file as a new version of an existing FileNet P8 document. (In contrast, FNP8_Upload creates a new FileNet P8 document.)
Note: This action will also add redactions to the existing FileNet P8 document (if any fields have been redacted). If you only want to add redactions, without updating content, then use the action: FNP8_AddRedactionsToP8Document
IMPORTANT: This action can only be used for documents that were downloaded by FNP8_SearchAndDownload action, or that have filenames beginning with the P8 object ID. The action Scan parses the first part of the filename and saves it as a page-level variable named "PageName". The FNP8_UpdateContent action uses the "PageName" variable as the object ID to find the FileNet P8 document to be updated.
Example filename: "{3054025F-0000-CE12-B41A-7B2661D28802}.0.APT008.tif"
How the action finds the object ID for the FileNet P8 document depends on the level at which this action is run:
If run at page-level, the action uses the "PageName" variable on the current page.
If run at document-level, the action uses the "PageName" variable on the first page of the current document.
IMPORTANT: Handling of P8 documents with multiple content elements
A document in FileNet P8 can have one or more content elements. In order to update P8 documents with multiple content elements, the FNP8_UpdateContent action must be run at the Document-level and the content elements must correspond to pages of the same document in the Datacap document hierarchy. In addition, the FNP8_MultiPageDocs("True") should be run prior to running FNP8_UpdateContent. Do NOT use the FNP8_UpdateContent action at Page-level for P8 documents with multiple content elements.
Versioning
If the FileNet P8 document class has versioning-enabled, then the new content will be checked in as a new major version (the prior version will be superceded).
If the FileNetP8 document class has versioning-disabled, then the action will return false to indicate the document content cannot be updated. (FileNet P8 does not allow the document content to be updated for documents with versioning-disabled.) See IBM FileNet P8 Knowledge Center for information about enabling/disabling versioning for document classes.
Handling of P8 documents that are already checked out
By default, or if the Datacap action FNP8_SetOverrideCheckoutOnUpdateContent("False") is called prior to FNP8_UpdateContent, then the action will return false if called for a P8 document that is already checked out.
If the action FNP8_SetOverrideCheckoutOnUpdateContent("True") is called prior to FNP8_UpdateContent and the P8 document is already checked out, then the action will skip the checkout process and attempt to checkin the document with the new content. This will work if the P8 user has permission to perform the checkin.
When used with FNP8_UpdateProperties
If this action is used in the same application as the action FNP8_UpdateProperties, it is recommended that FNP8_UpdateProperties should be run before FNP8_UpdateContent. For example, if FNP8_UpdateProperties is run on page-level on "Open", then FNP8_UpdateContent should be run on "Close" for page-level or document-level. This is ensure that the property changes made by FNP8_UpdateProperties are included in the current version of the document which is created by FNP8_UpdateContent.
......
FNP8_SetSearchClass("Invoice")
FNP8_SetSearchDownloadDir("C:/mylocaldir")
FNP8_SetSearchWhereClause("DocumentTitle LIKE '2017-Invoices%'")
FNP8_SearchAndDownload()
Scan()
...... run the actions below on the Document level ....
dcpdf_SetTitle("CarRental")
dcpdf_MakePDFDoc("true")
rrSet("@D.ID+.pdf", "@D.PDFFileName")
FNP8_SetFileType("pdf")
FNP8_SetUploadMode("PDFFileName")
FNP8_UpdateContent()
This example downloads Invoice documents from the P8 repository and ingests the documents into Datacap. It then converts the images to searchable PDF format files, and updates the content of the P8 documents with the new PDF files.

LogMessage = "You must go into file " & P8ConfigFile & " and fill out this entry to export to P8."
Dim oDoc
Dim oPage
Dim oField
For i = 0 to DCO.NumOfChildren-1 'loop through docs
Set oDoc = DCO.GetChild(i)
Writelog("Checking document: " & oDoc.ID)
Set oPage = oDoc.GetChild(0)
Writelog("Main_Page ID: " & oPage.ID)
for j = 0 to oPage.NumOfChildren - 1 'loop through fields
Set oField = oPage.GetChild(j)
Writelog("Checking field: " & oField.ID)
If oField.Type = "DocType" then
CurrentDocType = oField.Text
Writelog("CurrentDocType: " & CurrentDocType)
retn = Pilot.GetProfileString(CurrentDocType,"P8DocClass","*",P8ConfigFile)
if retn = "*" then
Call Pilot.SetProfileString(CurrentDocType,"P8DocClass","",P8ConfigFIle)
Writelog("P8Config Error: Missing P8DocClass entry for [" & CurrentDocType & "]")
Writelog(LogMessage)
end if
end if
if oField.Type = "FlexField" then
retn = Pilot.GetProfileString(CurrentDocType,oField.ID,"*",P8ConfigFile)
if retn = "*" then
CheckP8Config = FALSE
Writelog("P8Config Error: Missing entry for document [" & CurrentDocType & "] property: " & oField.ID)
Writelog(LogMessage)
Call Pilot.SetProfileString(CurrentDocType,oField.ID,"",P8ConfigFile)
end if
if TRIM(retn) = "" then
Writelog("P8Config Error: Blank entry for document [" & CurrentDocType & "] property: " & oField.ID)
Writelog(LogMessage)
end if
end if
Next 'j
Next 'i

f.name: SetP8FlexProperties
f.g:
'Your VBScript code goes here.
SetP8FlexProperties = TRUE 'Actions must always return a TRUE or FALSE.
Dim oField
Dim PropAr
for i = 0 to CurrentObj.NumOfChildren - 1 'loop through fields
Set oField = CurrentObj.GetChild(i)
Writelog("Checking field: " & oField.ID)
If oField.Type = "DocType" then
CurrentDocType = oField.Text
Writelog("CurrentDocType: " & CurrentDocType)
retn = Pilot.GetProfileString(CurrentDocType,"P8DocClass","*",P8ConfigFile)
if retn = "*" then
Writelog("P8Config Error: Unable to find document class. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
Writelog("Setting P8 Document Class to: " & retn)
Call FNP8_SetDocClassID(false,false,retn)
end if
if oField.Type = "FlexField" then
retn = Pilot.GetProfileString(CurrentDocType,oField.ID,"*",P8ConfigFile)
if ((retn = "*") OR (Trim(retn) ="")) then
Writelog("P8Config Error: Missing or blank entry for document [" & CurrentDocType & "] property: " & oField.ID)
Exit Function
end if
PropAr = SPLIT(retn,",")
PropName = PropAr(0)
Writelog("Setting P8 property type to: " & PropName)
if uBound(PropAr) > 0 then
DataType = PropAr(1)
Writelog("Setting P8 DataType to: " & DataType)
end if
Writelog("Setting P8 property type to: " & PropName)
if DataType = "" then
Writelog("Using: " & PropName & "," & oField.Text)
Call FNP8_SetProperty(false,false,PropName & "," & oField.Text)
else
Writelog("Using: " & PropName & "," & oField.Text & "," & DataType)
Call FNP8_SetProperty(false,false,PropName & "," & oField.Text & "," & DataType)
End if
'Call FNP8_SetProperty(false,false,PropName & "," & DataType)
end if
Next 'i

Call ZoneBottom_ImageBottom(false,false)
Call GetBarcodeBP(false,false)

af.name: ReadZonesFPX
af.g:
Dim sName
Dim PosName
Dim sOffSet
Dim aOffSet
Dim nXoffset
Dim nYoffset
Dim oCurPage
Dim bPos
Dim bPM
ReadZonesFPX = False
sFingerprintDir = m_sFingerprintDir
If Trim(sFingerprintDir) = "" Then
Writelog "The fingerprint directory has not been set. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
If Right(FingerprintDir,1) <> "\" Then
FingerprintDir = FingerprintDir & "\"
End If
sOffSet = ""
Set oCurPage = CurrentObj
sOffSet=oCurPage.Variable("Image_Offset")
While oCurPage.ObjectType<>2 AND oCurPage.ObjectType>1
Set oCurPage = oCurPage.Parent()
If len(sOffSet)=0 then sOffSet=oCurPage.Variable("Image_Offset")
Wend
sName=oCurPage.Variable("TemplateID")
PosName = "Pos" & sName
Writelog("ReadZones for " & PosName)
If Not FPXMLWrapper.OpenFingerprint(sFingerprintDir, sName, False) Then
Writelog "Could not open the fingerprint information: " & FPXMLWrapper.LastError
Exit Function
End If
aOffSet = Split(sOffSet & ",0" , ",")
If sOffSet <> "" Then
nXoffset = (-1*aOffSet(0))
nYoffset = (-1*aOffSet(1))
End If
If Not(Isnumeric(nXoffSet)) or len(trim(nXoffSet))=0 then
nXoffset = 0
writelog("X offset value was not numeric or empty. Setting value to Zero.")
end if
If Not(Isnumeric(nYoffSet)) or len(trim(nYoffSet))=0 then
nYoffset = 0
writelog("Y offset value was not numeric or empty. Setting value to Zero.")
end if
Writelog("Offsets : " & nXoffset & "," & nYoffset)
oSet = 0
xAdj = clng(nXoffSet)
Yadj = clng(nYoffSet)
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 4 then
sZonePos = FPXMLWrapper.GetFieldInfo(CurrentObj.ID)
writelog("DCO pos:" & sZonePos)
bPM = Not(CurrentObj.Variable("PatternMatch")="1")
bPos = CurrentObj.Variable("Position")="0,0,0,0" or CurrentObj.Variable("Position")=""
If sZonePos <> "" and sZonePos <> "0,0,0,0" and bPM and bPos then
arZonePos=split(sZonePos,",")
If UBound(arZonePos)=3 Then
arZonePos(0)=arZonePos(0)+Xadj
arZonePos(1)=arZonePos(1)+Yadj
arZonePos(2)=arZonePos(2)+Xadj
arZonePos(3)=arZonePos(3)+Yadj
CurrentObj.Variable("Position")=CStr(arZonePos(0)) & "," & CStr(arZonePos(1)) & "," & CStr(arZonePos(2)) & "," & CStr(arZonePos(3))
writelog("new pos:" & CurrentObj.Variable("Position"))
End if
End if
Set oSetupNode = CurrentObj.SetupNode()
If Not(oSetupNode is Nothing) then
If oSetupNode.variable("RecogType")="4" then
writelog(space(oSet+2) & "OMR recogtype found.")
For nChar = 1 to oSetupNode.NumOfRules
Set oSubRule = oSetupNode.GetRule(nChar-1)
Set oSubChar = CurrentObj.GetChild(nChar-1)
If Not(oSubRule is Nothing) then
If oSubChar is Nothing then
Set oSubChar = CurrentObj.AddChild(4, "", -1)
End if
sZonePos = FPXMLWrapper.GetFieldInfo(oSubRule.Name)
writelog(space(oSet+2) & "Found ZonePos: " & sZonePos)
if sZonePos <> "" and sZonePos <> "0,0,0,0" then
arZonePos=split(sZonePos,",")
If UBound(arZonePos)=3 Then
arZonePos(0)=arZonePos(0)+Xadj
arZonePos(1)=arZonePos(1)+Yadj
arZonePos(2)=arZonePos(2)+Xadj
arZonePos(3)=arZonePos(3)+Yadj
bRes = oSubChar.SetPosition(clng(arZonePos(0)) ,clng(arZonePos(1)),clng(arZonePos(2)),clng(arZonePos(3)))
bRes = oSubChar.GetPosition(clng(arZonePos(0)) ,clng(arZonePos(1)),clng(arZonePos(2)),clng(arZonePos(3)))
'writelog("Saved X Y (" & CStr(arZonePos(2)- arZonePos(0)) & "," & CStr(arZonePos(3)-arZonePos(1)) & ") " & vbcrlf)
end if
end if
End If
Next 'nChar
End If
End If
Set oSetupNode = Nothing
Call ZoneChildrenFPX(CurrentObj, PosName, oSet, Xadj, Yadj)
End if
ReadZonesFPX = True

af.name: WriteZonesFPX
af.g:
Dim ParamAr
Dim oPage
Dim sFingerprint
Dim sFingerprintDir
Dim sHostName
Dim sHostID
Dim oFS
Dim FPXMLFile
Dim i
Dim oField
sHostName = ""
sHostID = ""
WriteZonesFPX = False
if CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 2 then
Writelog("Action belongs on a page level only. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
ParamAr = Split(StrParam,",")
sFingerprintDir = m_sFingerprintDir
if Right(sFingerprintDir,1) <> "\" then
sFingerprintDir = sFingerprintDir & "\"
end if
If Trim(sFingerprintDir) = "" Then
Writelog "The fingerprint directory has not been set. Exiting."
Exit Function
End If
If uBound(ParamAr) >= 0 Then sHostName = MetaWord(ParamAr(0))
If uBound(ParamAr) >= 1 then sHostID = MetaWord(ParamAr(1))
Set oPage = CurrentObj
sFingerprint = oPage.Variable("TemplateID")
If uBound(ParamAr) >= 2 then
sPageType = MetaWord(ParamAr(2))
Else
sPageType = oPage.Type
End if
writelog("Fingerprint ID " & sFingerprint)
Set oFS = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
If Not oFS.FolderExists(sFingerprintDir) then
Writelog("Could not find: " & sFingerprintDir)
oFS.CreateFolder(sFingerprintDir)
Writelog("Created: " & sFingerprintDir)
End If
If sHostID = "" Then
sHostID = ""
End If
If sHostName = "" then
sHostName = ""
End If
Writelog "Fingerprint directory : " & sFingerprintDir
If Not FPXMLWrapper.OpenFingerprint(sFingerprintDir, sFingerprint, true) Then
Writelog "Could not open the fingerprint information: " & FPXMLWrapper.LastError
Exit Function
End If
Writelog "Fingerprint page type set to " & sPageType
Writelog "Fingerprint host name set to " & sHostName
Writelog "Fingerprint host id set to " & sHostID
FPXMLWrapper.UpdateFPrint sPageType,sHostName ,sHostID
Writelog "Saving zones..."
For i = 0 to oPage.NumOfChildren - 1
Set oField = oPage.GetChild(i)
If Not oField Is Nothing Then
If oField.ObjectType = 3 Then
If oField.Type = m_sDetailType Then
Call WriteDetailFieldFPX(oField)
Else
If Trim(oField.Variable("Position")) <> "" AND Trim(oField.Variable("Position")) <> "0,0,0,0" Then
FPXMLWrapper.AddFieldInfo oField.ID,oField.Variable("Position")
Writelog "Writing zones for field " & oField.ID
End If
If oField.NumOfChildren <> 0 Then
Call WriteChildrenZonesFPX(oField)
End If
End If
End If
End If
Next 'i
If FPXMLWrapper.Save Then
Writelog "Finished saving zones."
WriteZonesFPX = True
Else
Writelog "The page zones could not be written to the fingerprint XML file :" & FPXMLWrapper.LastError
WriteZonesFPX = False
End If

rrx.help:
'**************************************************** ' fpxml.rrx - a description of the library
' Licensed Materials - Property of IBM ' “Restricted Materials of IBM” ' 5725-C15 5725-C69 ' ' © Copyright IBM Corp. 1994, 2025 All Rights Reserved ' ' US Government Users Restricted Rights - Use, duplication or ' disclosure restricted by GSA ADP Schedule Contract with ' IBM Corp.
'****************************************************
None.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended to use the action XMLReadZones in AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting instead of this action.
This action reads the field zone information from the fingerprint XML file associated with the fingerprint for the current page object. This action is similar to the ReadZones action in the Zones library. The primary difference is that ReadZones reads the zone information stored in the setup DCO and ReadZonesFPX reads the zone information from the associated fingerprint XML file. Typically this action will be called after the CreateFields action but before field recognition.
ReadZonesFPX loads position information for each node in the calling object and it's children. Pre-adjusts these values based on offset information stored in the 'Image_Offset' variable at any node level. The offset value is applied to all child objects of a node where an 'Image_Offset' variable is found; unless overwritten by a child node also having an Image_Offset value to apply.
Position information is based on the Fingerprint XML position for the parent page's fingerprint ID.
If 'Enable FPXML' setting is checked in the application settings 'Main' tab within the Taskmaster Application Manager, Datacap Studio will place field zone information into a fingerprint XML file instead of placing the zone information into the applications setup DCO. One FPXML file is created per fingerprint. Depending on application needs, using fingerprint XML files may have advantages. Refer to Taskmaster documentation for more information about using fingerprint XML files. If the application is using FPXML files, then use this action to load the zones.
SetDirectoryFPX("@APPPATH(*/fingerprint)")
ReadZonesFPX()
Page or Field level.
False, if the fingeprint xml cannot be loaded or if SetDirectoryFPX has not been called to set the location of the fingerprint XML files. Otherwise, True.
Two comma separated parameters:
Detail field type: type of the field that is the parent to the line item field, often called "Details".
LineItem field type: type of the line item field which is the parent of the fields to be captured, often called "Lineitem".
Smart parameters are supported.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended to use the action XMLSetDetailsAndLineitemPair in AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting instead of this action.
Use this action if your page contains Details and Lineitems fields, as is common with an invoice page. The action sets the type of the special Details and Lineitem fields. These fields, unlike other field types, are handled by the ReadZonesFPX and WriteZonesFPX actions in a special way that is compatible with the Locate actions framework.
If your page has Details and Lineitems, then this action is required to identify the types so the position information will be properly saved. Using SetDetailsAndLineitemPairFPX prior to calling WriteZonesFPX will cause WriteZonesFPX to save line item field positions to the fingerprint file. The second parameter is the type of the line item field which is the parent of the fields to be captured and is often called "Lineitem".
If your page contains Detail and Lineitem fields, this action also needs to be used prior to calling ReadZonesFPX.
Details are the parent object of the line item fields. Details are a collection of lineitems and each line item has a collection of fields. For example, in a typical invoice application a single lineitem can contain the fields: quantity, item number, description, unit price, and total.
SetDetailsAndLineitemPairFPX("Details,Lineitem")
ReadZonesFPX()
In this example, the details field is called "Details" and the line items are called "Lineitem".
An example DCO hierarchy may look something like this:
- Details
--- Lineitem
------- Qty
------- ItemID
------- ItemDesc
------- Price
------- LineTotal
Any level.
False if one parameter is missing. Otherwise True
A string identifying the Fingerprint directory. This is the directory that contains the FPXML files. Smart parameters are supported.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended to use the action SetFingerprintDirectory in AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting instead of this action.
This action sets the directory from which fingerprint XML files will be written or read. This action must be called to identify the FPXML directory before calling ReadZonesFPX or WriteZonesFPX.
SetDirectoryFPX("@APPPATH(*/fingerprint)")
ReadZonesFPX()
This example uses the @APPPATH smart parameter to obtain the directory from the application service.
SetDirectoryFPX("C:\Datacap\APT\fingerprint")
ReadZonesFPX()
This example hard codes the directory, which is fine but could make the application less portable.
Any level.
False if the parameter is missing. Otherwise True
Three comma separated parameters:
Fingerprint host name: This is the fingerprint class name and can be seen in the zones tab of Datacap Studio. It is used to group or classify fingerprints. If this value is not provided, then a blank class name will be used.
Fingerprint host id: This is an internal numeric value that is associated with the fingerprint class name. If a value is not provided, a blank value will be used.
Fingerprint page type: This is the page type that corresponds to the fingerprint for the page. If this value is not provided, it uses the page type of the current page.
Smart parameters are supported. All parameters are optional. If you provide only the second or third parameter, you must supply an empty value for the previous parameters.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended to use the action XMLWriteZones in AutomaticDocumentFingerprinting instead of this action.
This action will write out all of the field positions for the current page to the fingerprint XML file. Typically this action is used for applications that are using fingerprint XML files and new pages are dynamically zoned at runtime. After the zoning of the page has been completed, then this action is used to write out the zone information to the FPXML file, allowing subsequent pages of this type to be processed using the saved zone information.
If the fingerprint directory that had been previously specified using SetDirectoryFPX does not exist, it will be created, providing that the parent directory already exists.
Fields with empty positions are not written to the fingerprint XML file.
SetDirectoryFPX("@APPPATH(*/fingerprint)")
WriteZonesFPX("MyFPClass,,MyPageType")
This example writes out the zones for the current page and sets the fingerprint class to "MyFPClass" and the page type to "MyPageType".
SetDirectoryFPX("@APPPATH(*/fingerprint)")
WriteZonesFPX("MyFPClass,,@P.MyType")
This example writes out the zones for the current page and sets the fingerprint class to "MyFPClass" and the page type to the value contained by the page variable "MyType".
Page level only.
False, if there is a problem saving to fingerprint XML file or if not called at the page level, if the page does not have a fingerprint assigned, or a fingerprint directory has not been set. Otherwise True.

af.g:
LoadSettings_FingerprintID = False
Dim sFingerPrintFolderPath
Dim sProjectFolderPath
Dim aLookup
Dim sFprintpath
Dim sSQL
On Error Resume Next
If CurrentObj.Variable("FingerprintDir") <> "" Then
sFingerPrintFolderPath = CurrentObj.Variable("FingerprintDir")
Else
If CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID")<>"" then
aLookup = GetDataArray("SELECT TP_CCOPATH FROM TEMPLATE WHERE TP_TEMPLATEID=" & CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID") & "; ")

sFingerPrintFolderPath=""

LoadSettings_FingerprintID = g_ScanFix.LoadSettings_FingerprintID (sFingerPrintFolderPath)
Else
Writelog "ScanFix object is not initialized."
End If

'**************************************************** ' ImageFix.rrx - a description of the library
' Licensed Materials - Property of IBM ' “Restricted Materials of IBM” ' 5725-C15 5725-C69 ' ' © Copyright IBM Corp. 1994, 2019 All Rights Reserved ' ' US Government Users Restricted Rights - Use, duplication or ' disclosure restricted by GSA ADP Schedule Contract with ' IBM Corp.
'****************************************************
The file extension that the action is to assign to the backup of the original Image file. For example: tio
The extension must be at least 1 character. If the leading period is provided, it must have at least one character following it. Long name file extensions are allowed.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended that this action is no longer used. Instead, use the replacement action ImageEnhance in the DCImageFix action library.
Initiates image processing to perform a preconfigured set of image enhancements.
Include this action after a LoadSettings or LoadSettings_FingerprintID action.
LoadSettings("C:\ParentDir\Invoice\Process\ImageFix.ini")
ImageEnhance("tio")
Keep in mind in this example that the ImageFix settings specified in ImageFix.ini will be applied to every page in the batch. An example of the copied file name: "TM000001.tio".
LoadSettings("C:\ParentDir\Invoice\Process\ImageFix.ini")
ImageEnhance("tio.tif")
This example uses a longer file extension, which preserves the original file type, making it easier to view the original file without renaming. An example of the copied file name: "TM000001.tio.tif".
Page or Field Level.
False if the parameter is too short. Otherwise, True.
Stringvalue of the name of the ImageFix Settings file (.ini). The action will search for a file of this name in the application's Processdirectory.
If this file is not located in the Process directory, you must provide the file's full path as well as its name.
Note, however, that the action can use Smart Parameter syntax, such as the '@PATH(string)' method to specify the path.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended that this action is no longer used. Instead, use the replacement action LoadSettings in the DCImageFix action library.
This action loads the settings that the ImageFixaction will use to process all images in the current batch. The action's parameter includes the file's name and complete path to its location in the application's Processdirectory. As an alternative, the parameter can use a smart parameter such as @Path to designate the value of the path to the same Processdirectory.
LoadSettings(C:\ParentDir\Invoice\Process\ImageFix.ini)
ImageEnhance(tio)
Loads the settings file using the path denoted by the "ScanFixSettings" key that is listed in the Paths.ini file. If the key pointed to a relative path, it would be converted to the appropriate full path and then use that path to find the settings:
LoadSettings(@PATH(ScanFixSettings))
ImageEnhance(tio)
All.
False if the ImageFix Settings file that you specify as a parameter is not found. Otherwise, True.
None.
This action will be removed in a future release. It is recommended that this action is no longer used. Instead, use the replacement action LoadSettings_FingerprintID in the DCImageFix action library.
Loads the specific ImageFix Settings file (.ini) that corresponds to the Fingerprint ID of the current page.
The action will search the application's fingerprint folder for a fingerprint-specific ImageFix Settings file. Settings for these files are assigned during the Image Enhancement phase of Fingerprint Definition, using tools of Rule Manager's Image Processing Setup dialog. (Chapter 3 of the Rule Manager Reference shows you how to define a fingerprint-specific ImageFix Settings file.)
Important! The name of a fingerprint-specific ImageFix Settings file is limited to the Fingerprint ID with the ".ini" extension: 1044.ini, for example.
LoadSettings_FingerprintID()
ImageEnhance(tio)
Page level only.
False if a fingerprint-specific Settings file does not exist. Otherwise, True.

af.name: iloc_AssignPageType
af.g:
On Error Resume Next
iloc_AssignPageType = False
If InitFPDB=False then
writeLog("No connection to FP Database.")
Exit Function
End If
If(IsNumeric(strParam)) Then
writeLog("param in iloc_AssignPageType is numeric: " & strParam)
Else
writeLog("param in iloc_AssignPageType is non-numeric: " & strParam)
sSQL = "select pt_PageTypeID,pt_PageType from PageType where pt_PageType='" & strParam & "'"
Dim oRecSet
Set oRecSet = Conn.Execute(sSQL)
If DBErrTrap(conn, "iloc_AssignPageType") Then
oRecSet.Close()
writeLog("iloc_AssignPageType Database error after: " & sSQL )
Set oRecSet=Nothing
Exit Function
End If
If oRecSet.state = 0 Then
writelog(Space(4) & "Unable to open recordset.")
Set oRecSet = Nothing
End If
If oRecSet.eof Or oRecSet.bof Then
writelog(Space(4) & "No records returned.")
writelog(Space(4) & "Insert as Page type into PageType page.")
sSQL1 = "insert into PageType(pt_PageType) values ('"& strParam &"')"
Conn.Execute(sSQL1)
If DBErrTrap(conn, "GetDataArray1") Then
writeLog("GetDataArray1 Database error after: " & sSQL1 )
Exit Function
End If
' reread again ? what is the purpose?
oRecSet.Close
Set oRecSet = Conn.Execute(sSQL)
If DBErrTrap(conn, "iloc_AssignPageType") Then
oRecSet.Close()
writeLog("iloc_AssignPageType Database error after: " & sSQL )
Set oRecSet=Nothing
Exit Function
End If
''' call ExecuteSQL(bInter, bDebug, sSQL1)
''' Set oRecSet = oConn.Execute(sSQL)
End If
nRowCount = 0
oRecSet.MoveFirst
writelog("Retrieved value from database: " & oRecSet.Fields.Item(0).Value)
Select Case oRecSet.Fields.Item(0).Type
Case 3 ' int
strParam = CInt(oRecSet.Fields.Item(0).Value)
writelog("Obtained new value: " & strParam)
Case Else
writelog("got nonnumeric value")
strParam = CStr(oRecSet.Fields.Item(0).Value)
writelog("Obtained new value: " & strParam)
End Select
Set oRecSet = Nothing
End If
nTemplateID = CInt(CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID"))
sSQL2 = "Update Template set tp_PageType=" & CInt(strParam) &_
" where tp_TemplateID="& nTemplateID
conn.Execute(sSQL2)
If DBErrTrap(conn, "iloc_AssignPageType") Then
writeLog("iloc_AssignPageType Database error after: " & sSQL2 )
Exit Function
else
writelog("Update successful for nTemplateID: " & nTemplateID)
End If
iloc_AssignPageType = True

af.name: SetDynamicDetailZones
af.g:
' The parameter is the Zone Bottom field. If more than one field is listed,
' Zone Bottom must be first field, and additional fields are ignored.
'
' This action takes the position of the line items and it builds the line coordinates from them
' and then it sets the details zones from that top line to the bottom of the CCO.
'
' LoadCCOFromField()
' SetDynamicDetailZones("Zone Bottom,Notes")
' ZoneBOTTOM_ImageBottom()
' ScanDetails()
'
' Page level.
'
' False if no children exist. Otherwise, True.
Dim oLineItem
Dim oSubField
Dim PosAr
Dim LineULHx
Dim LineULHy
Dim LineLRHx
Dim LineLRHy
Dim i
Dim FieldAr
Dim oZoneBottomField
Dim ZoneBottomY
LineULHx = 1000000
LineULHy = 1000000
LineLRHx = 0
LineLRHy = 0
Writelog("SetDynamicDetailZones active")
if CurrentObj.NumOfChildren > 0 then
Set oLineItem = CurrentObj.GetChild(0)
else
Writelog("No Children. Exiting")
SetDynamicDetailZones = False
Exit Function
End if
Writelog("LineItem: " & oLineItem.ID)
for i = 0 to oLineItem.NumOfChildren - 1
Set oSubField = oLineItem.GetChild(i)
Writelog("Evaluating " & oSubField.Type)
if (oSubField.Variable("Position") <> "") AND (InStr("," & StrParam & ",","," & oSubField.Type & ",") = 0) then
Writelog("Processing " & oSubField.Type)
CurrentObj.Variable("POS-" & oSubField.Type) = oSubField.Variable("Position")
PosAr = Split(oSubField.Variable("Position"),",")
if cLng(PosAr(0)) < cLng(LineULHx) AND cLng(PosAr(0)) > 0 then
LineULHx = PosAr(0)
End if
if cLng(PosAr(1)) < cLng(LineULHy) AND cLng(PosAr(0)) > 0 then
LineULHy = PosAr(1)
End if
if cLng(PosAr(2)) > cLng(LineLRHx) then
LineLRHx = PosAr(2)
End if
if cLng(PosAr(3)) > cLng(LineLRHy) then
LineLRHy = PosAr(3)
End if
end if
oSubField.Variable("TestPos") = LineULHx & "," & LineULHy & "," & LineLRHx & "," & LineLRHy
next 'i
'LineULHx = cLng(LineULHx) - 20
'LineULHy = cLng(LineULHy) - 1
'LineLRHx = cLng(LineLRHx) + 20
'LineLRHy = cLng(LineLRHy) + 0
CurrentObj.Variable("LineItemPos") = cStr(CCO.Left) & "," & LineULHy & "," & cStr(CCO.Right) & "," & LineLRHy
LineULHx = cLng(LineULHx) -10
LineULHy = cLng(LineULHy) - 1
LineLRHx = cLng(LineLRHx) + 10
'Handle ZoneBottom
FieldAr = Split(StrParam,",")
Writelog("FieldAr(0)=" & FieldAr(0))
Set oZoneBottomField = Nothing
Set oZoneBottomField = oLineItem.FindChild(FieldAr(0))
ZoneBottomY = cStr(CCO.Bottom)
CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = cStr(CCO.Left) & "," & LineULHy & "," & cStr(CCO.Right) & "," & ZoneBottomY
While CurrentObj.NumOfChildren > 0
CurrentObj.DeleteChild(0)
wend
'DCO.Write(Pilot.DCOFile)
SetDynamicDetailZones = TRUE

af.name: LoadCCOFromField
af.g:
' None.
'
' This action loads the DCO from a field object.
' The verify panels do not load the CCO into the scripting engine so this action acomplishes that task.
' This action is required for any invoice action that uses the CCO.
'
' LoadCCOFromField()
' SetDynamicDetailZones("Zone Bottom,Notes")
' ZoneBOTTOM_ImageBottom()
' ScanDetails()
'
'
' Field Level.
'
' False, if this action is not called on a field or if the CCO file does not exist. Otherwise, True.
LoadCCOFromField = False
if CurrentObj.Parent.ObjectType <> 2 then
Writelog("Action must be on a field that is a child of a page. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
Dim sFileName
sFileName = Left(CurrentObj.Parent.ImageName,len(CurrentObj.Parent.ImageName) - 3) & "cco"
writelog("Attempting to load: " & sFileName)
Dim lbCCOCreator
set lbCCOCreator = CreateObject("CCO._CCOCreator.1")
if FileMgr.FileExists(sFileName) then
set CCO = lbCCOCreator.load(sFileName)
Writelog("Loading CCO '" & sFileName & "' ")
LoadCCOFromField = True
Else
Writelog("CCO: " & sFileName & "' does not Exist.")
End if
Set lbCCOCreator = nothing
Set oField = CurrentObj

af.name: ScanLineItemDynamic
af.g:
' A comma separated list of any fields that should be ignored.
'
' This action scans the line items from the CCO that was loaded into the field. It is like
' ScanLineItem but uses the CCO loaded for the field and reads position variables from the line item level.
' It is required for Find Details functionality. It saves the positions of the line and of the feids at the detail
' level so all of the line items can be erased and recreated.
'
' FPXMLUsed()
' ScanLineItemDynamic("ZoneBottom,Notes")
'
' Field Level.
'
' Always True.
ScanLineItemDynamic=False
'Writelog(sName) sName doesn't appear anywhere else in this file.
CurrentObj.CreateFields()
nCount=CurrentObj.NumOfChildren()
For i=0 To nCount-1
Set oField=CurrentObj.GetChild(i)
Writelog(oField.ID)
If Not oField Is Nothing Then
if InStr("," & StrParam & ",","," & oField.Type & ",") = 0 then
oField.Variable("Position")= CurrentObj.Parent.variable("POS-" & oField.Type)
End if
set oField = Nothing
End If
Next
ScanLineItemDynamic=True

af.name: PopulateZNLineItemFieldDynamic
af.g: ' This action is like the PopulateZNLineItemField but it uses the CCO that was ' loaded into memory by LoadCCOFromField, instead of the global CCO. ' It populates the fingerprint’s Data file with the recognized value contained inside ' the zone of a child Field object of a LINEITEM parent field. This action should ' only be used with sub-fields of the LINEITEM field - ItemID, ItemDesc, ' Quantity, Price in the Invoices application. PopulateZNLineItemFieldDynamic=False sPos=CurrentObj.Variable("Position") If( sPos<>"" and sPos <> "0,0,0,0" ) Then If Not AdjustPosToParentDynamic(CurrentObj,1) Then Exit Function Writelog("Ready for DCOFieldFromCCO") PopulateZNLineItemFieldDynamic=DCOFieldFromCCO(CurrentObj, CCO) Else PopulateZNLineItemFieldDynamic=true End If

af.name: CalculateNotesZone
af.g:
' This action creates a zone between detail lines, so the text between lines can
' be recognized.
Dim oLineItem
Dim oNextLineItem
Dim i
Dim oNotesField
Dim NoteULHx
Dim NoteULHy
Dim NoteLRHx
Dim NoteLRHy
Dim PosAr1
Dim PosAr2
Dim PosAr3
CalculateNotesZone = TRUE
if CurrentObj.NumOfChildren = 0 then
Writelog("No children found. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
For i = 0 to CurrentObj.NumOfChildren - 1
Set oLineItem = CurrentObj.GetChild(i)
PosAr1 = Split(oLineItem.Variable("Position"),",")
NoteULHx = CCO.Left
NoteULHy = PosAr1(3)
Writelog("Set NoteULHx to: " & cStr(NoteULHx))
Writelog("Set NoteULHy to: " & cStr(NoteULHy))
if i = CurrentObj.NumOfChildren - 1 then
PosAr2 = Split(CurrentObj.Variable("Position"),",")
NoteLRHx = CCO.Right
NoteLRHy = PosAr2(3)
Writelog("Last Child - Set NoteLRHx to: " & cStr(NoteLRHx))
Writelog("Last Child - Set NoteLRHy to: " & cStr(NoteLRHy))
else
Set oNextLineItem = CurrentObj.GetChild(i+1)
PosAr3 = Split(oNextLineItem.Variable("Position"),",")
NoteLRHx = CCO.Right
NoteLRHy = PosAr3(1)
Writelog("Not Last Child - Set NoteLRHx to: " & cStr(NoteLRHx))
Writelog("Not Last Child - Set NoteLRHy to: " & cStr(NoteLRHy))
End if
oLineItem.FindChild("Notes").Variable("Position") = NoteULHx & "," & NoteULHy & "," & NoteLRHx & "," & NoteLRHy
Writelog("Set Notes positon to: " & oLineItem.FindChild("Notes").Variable("Position"))
Next 'i

af.name: IsFingerPrintClass
af.g:
' Two comma separated parameters:
' 1. The database connection string. Smart parameters are supported.
' 2. Fingerprint class.
' This action connects to the fingerprint database and verifies that the specified fingerprint
' class contains the fingerprint ID of the current page.
Dim oConn
Dim oRS
Dim oRS1
Dim sSQL
Dim RetnAr
Dim Retn
Dim ParamAr
Dim ConnectionString
Dim sTID
On Error Resume Next
IsFingerprintClass = FALSE
if CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 2 then
Writelog("Action must be on a page level. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
ParamAr= Split(StrParam,",")
if uBound(ParamAr) <> 1 then
Writelog("Wrong number of parameters. Expecting (DSN,FingerPrintClass)")
Exit Function
End if
Set oConn = CreateObject("ADODB.Connection")
ConnectionString = Trim(ParamAr(0))
' Added support for Smart Parameters
sSmartParam=MetaWord(ConnectionString)
If sSmartParam<>"" and ConnectionString<>sSmartParam Then
'attempt to decrypt value
bRes = [securecall]sSmartParam,ConnectionString[/securecall]
If bRes=False Then Writelog("Value not Decrypted.")
Else
Writelog("No result from Smart Parameter parsing. Using the original parameter string.")
End if
oConn.Open(FormatADOConn(ConnectionString))
If oConn.State <> 1 then
writelog("Unable to open Connection to DB. Exiting")
Exit Function
Else
Writelog("DB Connection Open.")
End if
sTID = trim(CurrentObj.variable("TemplateID"))
If len(sTID) = 0 then
Writelog("No TemplateID variable value. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
sSQL = "Select tp_HostID from Template where tp_TemplateID = " & sTID & ";"
sSQL = ModifySQLByDBType(oConn,sSQL)
Writelog("sSQL=" & sSQL)
Set oRS = oConn.Execute(sSQL)
If oRS.EOF Or oRS.BOF Then
IsFingerprintClass = False
writelog("RecordSet Returns EOF or BOF. Exiting Function.")
Exit Function
End If
Retn = oRS.GetString
Writelog ("Returned: " & Retn)
if Len(Retn) > 1 then
RetnAr=Split(Retn,chrW(13))
End if
Retn = RetnAr(uBound(RetnAr)-1)
Writelog("Retn: " & Retn)
if IsNumeric(Retn) then
HostID = Retn
else
Writelog("Did not get a valid HostID. Exiting")
Writelog(sSQL)
oConn.Close
set oRS = Nothing
Exit Function
end if
sSQL = "Select hs_RefName from Host where hs_HostID = " & Trim(cStr(HostID)) & ";"
sSQL = ModifySQLByDBType(oConn,sSQL)
Writelog("sSQL=" & sSQL)
Set oRS1 = oConn.Execute(sSQL)
if oRS1.BOF or oRS1.EOF then
Writelog("Nothing found.Exiting")
oConn.Close
set oRS = Nothing
set oRS1 = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
Retn = oRS1.GetString
Retn = Left(Retn,len(Retn)-1)
Writelog("Retn='" & Retn & "' Second Parameter='" & ParamAr(1) & "'")
if InStr("," & ParamAr(1) & "," , "," & Retn & ",") > 0 then
IsFingerPrintClass = TRUE
else
IsFingerPrintClass = FALSE
End if
oConn.Close
set oRS = Nothing
Set oRS1 = Nothing
Call ErrorHandler("Function IsFingerPrintClass")

af.name: iloc_SetDetailSimple
af.g:
' The detail Datacap Object (DCO) Type.
' This action fills the Setup DCO from Runtime Data file.
Dim i
Dim oPage
Dim sFPID
Dim oSetup
Dim oLineItem
Dim oDetail
Dim xOffset
Dim yOffset
Dim nLeft, nTop, nRight, nBottom
Dim nLineLeft, nLineTop, nLineRight, nLineBottom
Dim LinePosAr
Dim DetailPosAr
Dim oSetupNode_Detail
On Error Resume Next
iloc_SetDetailSimple = False
xOffset = clng(0)
yOffset = clng(0)
Set oPage = CurrentObj
If oPage Is Nothing Then
writelog("No Current DCO node found.")
Exit Function
End If
if oPage.ObjectType<>2 Then
Writelog("Current DCO must be Type Page.")
Exit Function
End if
'Find Template ID for oPage
sFPID = oPage.Variable("TemplateID")
If Len(sFPID)=0 Then
Writelog("No Template ID found.")
Set oPage = Nothing
Exit Function
Else
writelog("Template ID:'" & sFPID & "'")
End If
'Find the offset for oPage
sOffset = oPage.Variable("Image_Offset")
If len(sOffset)>0 Then
writelog("Image Offset is '" & sOffset & "'")
aOffset = Split(sOffset,",")
If IsNumeric(aOffset(0)) then xOffset=clng(aOffset(0))
If IsNumeric(aOffset(1)) then yOffset=clng(aOffset(1))
End if
Set oSetup = CurrentObj.SetupObject
If(oSetup Is Nothing) Then
writelog("SetupObject Not Found.")
Set oPage = Nothing
Exit Function
Else
writelog("Setup path:'" & oSetup.Path & "'")
End If
If oSetup.readlock(oSetup.path) Then
'Process The Detail
Set oDetail = oPage.FindChild(Trim(sDetailName))
If Not(oDetail is Nothing) then
Set oLineItem=oDetail.GetChild(0)
If oLineItem is Nothing then
Writelog("No First Child field found - Exiting.")
Set oPage = Nothing
Set oDetail = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
'Writelog("First Field Found:'" & oLineItem & "'.")
nLineLeft = "" 'clng(0)
nLineTop = "" 'clng(0)
nLineRight = "" 'clng(0)
nLineBottom = "" 'clng(0)
'Loop through LineItem Subfields
For i = 1 to (oLineItem.NumOfChildren-Len(oLineItem.Text))
Set oSubField = oLineItem.GetChild(i-1)
If Not(oSubField is Nothing) then
sPosition = Trim(oSubField.Variable("Position"))
Writelog(oSubField.Type & " has a DCO position of " & sPosition)
if Len(oDetail.Variable("POS-" & oSubField.ID)) > 7 then
sPosition = oDetail.Variable("POS-" & oSubField.ID)
Writelog(oSubField.Type & " has a captured position of " & sPosition)
end if
aPosition = Split(sPosition & "," ,",")
'check runtime field for position info
If sPosition<>"0,0,0,0" and len(sPosition)>0 and ubound(aPosition)=4 then
Set oSetupNode_SubField = oSetup.GetNodeByName(3,oSubField.Type)
If Not(oSetupNode_SubField is Nothing) then
'Adjust for Image_Offset & save to SetupNode
nLeft = clng(aPosition(0)) + xOffset
nTop = clng(aPosition(1)) + yOffset
nRight = clng(aPosition(2)) + xOffset
nBottom = clng(aPosition(3)) + yOffset
Writelog("Setting SubField Zone to:'" & CStr(nLeft) & "," & CStr(nTop) & "," & CStr(nRight) & "," & CStr(nBottom) & "'")
oSetupNode_SubField.Variable("Pos" & sFPID) = CStr(nLeft) & "," & CStr(nTop) & "," & CStr(nRight) & "," & CStr(nBottom)
'Adjust LineItem field
If nLineLeft = "" then nLineLeft = nLeft
If nLineTop = "" then nLineTop = nTop
If nLineRight = "" then nLineRight = nRight
If nLineBottom = "" then nLineBottom = nBottom
If nLineLeft>nLeft Then nLineLeft = nLeft
If nLineTop>nTop Then nLineTop = nTop
If nLineRight<nRight Then nLineRight = nRight
If nLineBottom<nBottom Then nLineBottom = nBottom
Else
Writelog("Setupnode is Nothing!")
End if
Set oSetupNode_SubField = Nothing
End if
End if
Next 'i
'if oLineItem.Variable("Position") <> "" then
' LinePosAr = Split(oLineItem.Variable("Position"),",")
' Writelog("Line item unadjusted positions" & oLineItem.Variable("Position"))
'end if
if oLineItem.Parent.Variable("LineItemPos") <> "" then
LinePosAr = Split(oLineItem.Parent.Variable("LineItemPos"),",")
Writelog("Line item unadjusted positions" & oLineItem.Variable("Position"))
end if
if uBound(LinePosAr) = 3 then
nLineLEft = cLng(LinePosAr(0)) + xOffset
nLineTop = cLng(LinePosAr(1)) + yOffset
nLineRight = cLng(LinePosAr(2)) + xOffset
nLineBottom = cLng(LinePosAr(3)) + yOffset
Set oSetupNode_LineItem = oSetup.GetNodeByName(3,oLineItem.Type)
If Not(oSetupNode_LineItem is Nothing) then
Writelog("Setting LineItem Zone to:'" & CStr(nLineLeft) & "," & CStr(nLineTop) & "," & CStr(nLineRight) & "," & CStr(nLineBottom) & "'")
oSetupNode_LineItem.Variable("Pos" & sFPID) = CStr(nLineLeft) & "," & CStr(nLineTop) & "," & CStr(nLineRight) & "," & CStr(nLineBottom)
End if
Set oSetupNode_LineItem = Nothing
else
Writelog("Line Postition was invalid")
end if
if oDetail.Variable("Position") <> "" then
DetailPosAr = Split(oDetail.Variable("Position"),",")
Writelog("Detail unadjusted positions" & oDetail.Variable("Position"))
end if
if uBound(DetailPosAr) = 3 then
nLineLEft = cLng(DetailPosAr(0)) + xOffset
nLineTop = cLng(DetailPosAr(1)) + yOffset
nLineRight = cLng(DetailPosAr(2)) + xOffset
nLineBottom = cLng(DetailPosAr(3)) + yOffset
Set oSetupNode_Detail = oSetup.GetNodeByName(3,oDetail.Type)
If Not(oSetupNode_Detail is Nothing) then
Writelog("Setting Detail Zone to:'" & CStr(nLineLeft) & "," & CStr(nLineTop) & "," & CStr(nLineRight) & "," & CStr(nLineBottom) & "'")
oSetupNode_Detail.Variable("Pos" & sFPID) = CStr(nLineLeft) & "," & CStr(nLineTop) & "," & CStr(nLineRight) & "," & CStr(nLineBottom)
End if
Set oSetupNode_Detail = Nothing
else
Writelog("Detail Postition was invalid")
end if
Else
Writelog("Detail Field not found.")
Exit Function
End if
If oSetup.WriteSetup(oSetup.path)=False Then
Writelog("Unable to save Setup DCO:'" & oSetup.path & "'")
Else
Writelog("Saved DCO Setup:'" & oSetup.path & "'")
iloc_SetDetailSimple = True
End If
oSetup.UnlockIt()
Else
writelog("unable to save DCO because it was locked")
writelog(oSetup.path)
End If 'readlock
Set oLineItem = Nothing
Set oDetail = Nothing
Set oPage = Nothing

af.name: IsMultipageDocument
af.g:
' This action is used to determine if the current object is a document with multiple pages attached.
Dim oDoc
IsMultipageDocument = False
if CurrentObj.ObjectType = 0 then
Writelog("Action cannot be on a batch object. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
Set oDoc = CurrentObj
While oDoc.ObjectType > 1
Set oDoc = oDoc.Parent
wend
if oDoc.ObjectType = 0 then
Writelog("Document object not found. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Writelog("Document has " & oDoc.NumOfChildren & " page(s).")
if oDoc.NumOfChildren > 1 then
IsMultipageDocument = True
end if

af.name: IsSinglePageDocument
af.g:
' This action is used to determine if the current object is a document with only 1 page attached.
Dim oDoc
IsSinglePageDocument = False
if CurrentObj.ObjectType = 0 then
Writelog("Action cannot be on a batch object. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
Set oDoc = CurrentObj
While oDoc.ObjectType > 1
Set oDoc = oDoc.Parent
wend
if oDoc.ObjectType = 0 then
Writelog("Document object not found. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Writelog("Document has " & oDoc.NumOfChildren & " page(s).")
if oDoc.NumOfChildren = 1 then
IsSinglePageDocument = True
end if

af.name: CreateFingerprint
af.g:
' This action will create a fingerprint for the current page.
' Forces the creation of a new fingerprint using the current image, even if there is an existing
' fingerprint. A typical scenario is when there is a very similar fingerprint that
' incorrectly matches the current image, such as two invoices
' that are very similar. When the new invoice is received in the future, it should
' now match on this new fingerprint.
CreateFingerprint = False
If (CurrentObj.ObjectType<>2) Then Exit Function 'must be a page
If Not(FileMgr.FileExists(CurrentObj.ImageName)) Then
WriteLog("CreateFingerprint skipping. Image file doesn't exist")
Exit Function
End If
WriteLog("----- CreateFingerprint for: "& CurrentObj.ImageName & " -----")
retn = oFingerprint.AddNewFingerprint(CurrentObj,CurrentObj.Type)
If bFailRule = True Then
CreateFingerprint = False
Else
CreateFingerprint = True
End If
WriteLog("CreateFingerprint returns " & CreateFingerprint)

af.name: SetPicChar
af.g:
' This action should not be used, as it is scheduled to be removed in future versions.
' It has been replaced by PIC_SetPictureCharacter in Picture.rrx.
Dim PicCharNum
SetPicChar = FALSE
PicCharNum = Left(StrParam,1)
if Len(StrParam) < 3 then
WriteLog("SetPicChar parameter must be a single digit numeric followed by a comma, followed by the allowable characters")
Exit Function
end if
if Not IsNumeric(PicCharNum) then 'first character must be a digit
WriteLog("SetPicChar parameter must be a single digit numeric followed by a comma, followed by the allowable characters")
Exit Function
end if
if mid(StrParam,2,1) <> "," then
WriteLog("SetPicChar parameter must be a single digit numeric followed by a comma, followed by the allowable characters")
Exit Function
end if
PicCharAr(PicCharNum) = Right(StrParam,Len(StrParam) - 2)
WriteLog("Picture Character " & cStr(PicCharNum) & " is set to: " & PicCharAr(PicCharNum))
SetPicChar = TRUE

af.name: WriteErrorMessage
af.g:
' Writes the message to field level variable message that appears in the status bar.
DCOMessage(StrParam)
WriteErrorMessage = FALSE

af.name: IsInList
af.g:
' A string that is a superset of the expected 'Text' value.
' This action validates that the value of a field is contained within a given string.
IsInList = FALSE
if CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 3 then
Writelog("Action must be on a field object. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
if InStr("," & StrParam & "," , "," & CurrentObj.Text & ",") > 0 then
IsInList = TRUE
CurrentObj.Text = CurrentObj.Text
end if

af.name: IsInINI
af.g:
' A comma separated string of:
' 1. The INI Filename.
' 2. The section within the INI file.
' 3. The keword to find in the section.
'
'
' Reads the value of the specified key in the INI file. It compares the value of the current
' field with the with the string in the INI file. The field must be a substring of the string in the
' INI file.
'
' IsInINI("C:\MyDir\settings.ini", "mysection", "mykey")
On Error Resume Next
Dim ParamAr
Dim oFS
Dim SearchList
Dim DCOValue
IsInINI = FALSE
ParamAr = Split(StrParam,",")
If uBound(ParamAr) <> 2 then
Writelog("Improper number of parameters. Parameters are a CSV value of the 1) INI Filename 2) Section & 3) Keyword.")
Exit Function
End if
Set oFS = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
If Not oFS.FileExists(ParamAr(0)) then
Writelog("Could not find the INI file specified: " & ParamAr(0) & ". Parameters are Filename,Section,Keyword ")
Exit Function
End if
WriteLog("Looking for section [" & ParamAr(1) & "] key '" & ParamAr(2) & "' in INI file:'" & ParamAr(0) & "'." )
SearchList = Pilot.GetProfileString(ParamAr(1), ParamAr(2),"",ParamAr(0))
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 3 then
Writelog("Calling DCO is not a field, using variable 'Text' as value source.")
DCOValue = CurrentObj.Variable("Text")
Else
DCOValue = CurrentObj.Text
End if
If SearchList = "" then
WriteLog("Unable to find section [" & ParamAr(1) & "] with key '" & ParamAr(2) & "'.")
Exit Function
Else
Writelog("Returned key value:'" & SearchList & "'. Checking if returned value is in calling DCO value of '" & DCOValue & "'.")
End if
If InStr("," & SearchList & "," , "," & DCOValue & ",") > 0 then
IsInINI = TRUE
Writelog("DCO value was found in the INI returned value.")
'Next call sets value to high confidence (Text=Text)
CurrentObj.Text = CurrentObj.Text
Else
Writelog("DCO value was NOT found in the INI returned value.")
End if

af.name: DetailFix
af.g:
' Calculates the quantity, price and line total for when one of them is blank within a detail field.
' This calculation is performed for all detail lines on the page.
Dim oQtyField
Dim oPriceField
Dim oLineTotalField
Dim i
DetailFix = TRUE
if CurrentObj.NumOfChildren = 0 then
Writelog("There were no children fields. Exiting")
Exit Function
Else
WriteLog("There are " & CurrentObj.NumOfChildren & " children")
End if
Set oQtyField = Nothing
Set oPriceField = Nothing
Set oLineTotalField = Nothing
Set oQtyField = CurrentObj.FindChild("Qty")
Set oPriceField = CurrentObj.FindChild("Price")
Set oLineTotalField = CurrentObj.FindChild("LineTotal")
WriteLog("The Qty is :" & oQtyField.Text & "'")
'WriteLog("The Price is :" & CurrentObj.FindChild("Price") & "'")
'WriteLog("The LineTotal is :" & CurrentObj.FindChild("LineTotal") & "'")
if oQtyField Is Nothing then
Writelog("Unable to find Qty field. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
if oPriceField Is Nothing then
Writelog("Unable to find Price field. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
if oLineTotalField Is Nothing then
Writelog("Unable to find LineTotal field. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
if Trim(oQtyField.Text) <> "" And Not IsNumeric(oQtyField.Text) then
Writelog("Non-numeric Qty found. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
if Trim(oPriceField.Text) <> "" And Not IsNumeric(oPriceField.Text) then
Writelog("Non-numeric Price found. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
if Trim(oLineTotalField.Text) <> "" And Not IsNumeric(oLineTotalField.Text) then
Writelog("Non-numeric Line total found. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
if (Trim(oQtyField.Text) = "" AND Trim(oPriceField.Text) = "") OR (Trim(oLineTotalField.Text) = "" AND Trim(oPriceField.Text) = "") OR (Trim(oQtyField.Text) = "" AND Trim(oLineTotalField.Text) = "") Then
Writelog("Missing too many values for calculation")
Exit Function
End if
if Trim(oQtyField.Text) = "" then
WriteLog("Qty was blank")
oQtyField.Text = cStr( cDbl(oLineTotalField.text) / cDbl(oPriceField.text))
'oQtyField.Text = cStr( oLineTotalField.text / oPriceField.text)
'Round to nearest whole number
'oQtyField.Text = cStr(cLng(cDbl(oQtyField.Text) + 0.5))
oQtyField.Variable("Calculated") = "YES"
CurrentObj.Variable("Calculated Field") = "Qty"
Writelog("Calculated QTY (" & oQtyField.Text & ") from Price (" & oPriceField.Text & ") and LineTotal(" & oLineTotalField.Text & ")")
End if
If Trim(oPriceField.Text) = "" then
WriteLog("Price was blank")
oPriceField.Text = cStr( cDbl(oLineTotalField.Text) / cDbl(oQtyField.Text))
oPriceField.Variable("Calculated") = "YES"
CurrentObj.Variable("Calculated Field") = "Price"
Writelog("Calculated Price (" & oPriceField.Text & ") from Qty (" & oQtyField.Text & ") and LineTotal(" & oLineTotalField.Text & ")")
oPriceField.Text = FormatCurrency(oPriceField.Text,2,-1)
end if
if Trim(oLineTotalField.Text) = "" then
WriteLog("LineTotal blank")
oLineTotalField.Text = cStr( cDbl(oPriceField.Text) * cDbl(oQtyField.Text))
oLineTotalField.Variable("Calculated") = "YES"
CurrentObj.Variable("Calculated Field") = "LineTotal"
Writelog("Calculated LineTotal (" & oLineTotalField.text & ") from Qty (" & oQtyField.Text & ") and Price(" & oPriceField.Text & ")")
oLineTotalField.Text = FormatCurrency(oLineTotalField.Text,2,-1)
end if

af.name: CheckForSticky
af.g:
' For new fingerprints this action checks to see if there another matching fingerprint
' within the same batch that has already been verified, where it can
' use it to obtain zone information. An example is when a batch contains two similar
' invoices, which have never been processed by the system before. Once the first
' invoice is zoned during verify, the same new fingerprint can be used
' on the second invoice. This is only needed on new matching fingerprints within the same batch
' because a fingerprints zones are saved at export time and are available for subsequent batches.
Dim i
Dim j
Dim k
Dim ThisFingerprintID
Dim oDoc
Dim oPage
Dim oSourceField
Dim oDestField
Dim PosAr
Dim OffSetAr
Dim oSourceLineItemField
Dim oDestLineItemField
Dim oDetails
Dim oLineItem
Dim oCopyVendor
CheckForSticky = True
ThisFingerprintID = CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID")
Writelog("Current page TemplateID = '" & ThisFingerprintID &"', DCO.NumOfChildren = '" & DCO.NumOfChildren & "'")
For i = 0 To DCO.NumOfChildren - 1
Set oDoc = DCO.GetChild(i)
Set oPage = oDoc.GetChild(0)
Writelog("Type = '" & oPage.Type & "', TemplateID = '" & oPage.Variable("TemplateID") & "', oPage.Status = '" & oPage.Status & "'")
If oPage.Type = "Main_Page" And oPage.Variable("TemplateID") = ThisFingerprintID And (oPage.Status = 0 OR oPage.Status = 73) Then
If Not oPage.FindChild("Vendor") Is Nothing Then
If Not CurrentObj.FindChild("Vendor") Is Nothing Then
Set oCopyVendor=CurrentObj.FindChild("Vendor")
oCopyVendor.Text=oPage.FindChild("Vendor").Text
else
Writelog("Destination Vendor field not available")
end if
else
Writelog("Source Vendor field not available")
end if
OffSetAr = Split(CurrentObj.Variable("Image_Offset"),",")
'Writelog("Vendor = '" & CurrentObj.FindChild("Vendor").Text & "', Image_Offset = '" & CurrentObj.Variable("Image_Offset") & "'")
For j = 0 To CurrentObj.NumOfChildren - 1
Set oSourceField = oPage.GetChild(j)
Writelog("oSourceField: " & oSourceField.ID)
Set oDestField = CurrentObj.GetChild(j)
oDestField.Text = ""
writelog ("Writing positions for " & oSourceField.Type)
If oSourceField.Variable("Position") <> "0,0,0,0" Then
PosAr = Split(oSourceField.Variable("Position"),",")
oDestField.Variable("Position") = cStr(clng(PosAr(0))- cLng(OffsetAr(0))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(1))-cLng(OffsetAr(1))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(2))-cLng(OffsetAr(0))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(3))-cLng(OffsetAr(1)))
'oDestField.Variable("Position") = cStr(clng(PosAr(0))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(1))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(2))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(3)))
End If
if (oSourceField.ID = "Vendor") Or (oSourceField.ID = "Vendor_Number") then
oDestField.Text = oSourceField.Text
end if
Next 'j
Set oSourceLineItemField = Nothing
Set oSourceLineItemField = oPage.FindChild("Details").GetChild(0)
If Not oSourceLineItemField Is Nothing Then
set oDetails = CurrentObj.FindChild("Details")
Writelog("Found Details Field")
oDetails.CreateFields()
Set oLineItem = oDetails.GetChild(0)
oLineItem.CreateFields()
Set oDestLineItemField = CurrentObj.FindChild("Details").GetChild(0)
PosAr = Split(oSourceLineItemField.Variable("Position"),",")
'msgbox(oSourceLineItemField.Variable("Position"))
oDestLineItemField.Variable("Position") = cStr(clng(PosAr(0))- cLng(OffsetAr(0))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(1))-cLng(OffsetAr(1))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(2))-cLng(OffsetAr(0))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(3))-cLng(OffsetAr(1)))
'msgbox(oDestLineItemField.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("NumOfChildren = '" & oDestLineItemField.NumOfChildren & "'")
For k = 0 To oDestLineItemField.NumOfChildren - 1
Set oSourceField = oSourceLineItemField.GetChild(k)
Set oDestField = oDestLineItemField.GetChild(k)
' msgbox ("Writing positions for " & oDestField.Type & " " &oDestField.Variable("Position") )
'Writelog("Writing positions for " & oDestField.Type & " " &oDestField.Variable("Position") )
If oSourceField.Variable("Position") <> "0,0,0,0" Then
PosAr = Split(oSourceField.Variable("Position"),",")
oDestField.Variable("Position") = cStr(clng(PosAr(0))- cLng(OffsetAr(0))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(1))-cLng(OffsetAr(1))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(2))-cLng(OffsetAr(0))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(3))-cLng(OffsetAr(1)))
'msgbox("Dest-" & oDestField.Variable("Position"))
oDestField.Variable("Position") = cStr(clng(PosAr(0))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(1))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(2))) & "," & cStr(cLng(PosAr(3)))
End If
Next 'k
End If
Writelog("Setting Sticky = Yes")
CurrentObj.Variable("Sticky") = "Yes"
Set oSourceLineItemField = Nothing
Exit Function
End If
Next 'i
Writelog("Setting Sticky = No")
CurrentObj.Variable("Sticky") = "No"

af.name: SetStickyNo
af.g:
' This action sets the 'Sticky' indicator to 'No', indicating that there are no sticky fingerprints.
' Sticky fingerprints are a way of identifying a page within a single verify session, when another
' form of the same type appears after a previous form had just been zoned.
CurrentObj.Variable("Sticky") = "No"
SetStickyNo = TRUE
