af.name: ExecuteSQLBind
af.g:
' This action should not be used, as it is scheduled to be removed in future versions.
Dim ParamAr
Dim oCmd
Dim oParam
Dim oRS
Dim i
ExecuteSQLBind = FALSE
If Not isobject(oConn) Or oConn is Nothing then
writelog("No DB Connection Object. Aborting Task.")
nTaskStatus = RetAbort
Exit Function
End if
If oConn.State =0 then
Writelog("DB Connection is Closed.")
Exit Function
End if
ParamAr = Split(StrParam,",")
Set oCmd = CreateObject("ADODB.Command")
Set oParam = oCmd.CreateParameter("HostID",200,1,50)
Writelog("Setting oCmd.CommandText to: " & ParamAr(0) )
oCmd.CommandText = ParamAr(0)
oCmd.CommandType = 1
oCmd.ActiveConnection = oConn
for i = 1 to uBound(ParamAr)
'oCmd.Parameters.Append oParam
Writelog("Setting parameter " & cStr(i-1) & " to " & ReturnNamedValue(ParamAr(i)) )
'oCmd(i-1).Value = ReturnNamedValue(ParamAr(i))
' oCmd(i-1).Value = "1083"
next 'i
'msgbox oCmd.CommandText
'msgbox oCmd(0).Value
Set oRS = oCmd.Execute
'msgbox "Here"
str = ""
oRS.movefirst
Do While NOT oRS.EOF
for i = 0 to oRS.fields.count - 1
str = str & " " & oRS.fields(i).value
next
writelog(str)
str = ""
oRS.movenext
Loop
ExecuteSQLBind = TRUE

af.name: ReadFPXMLZones
af.g:
' Comma separated parameters:
' 1. The fingerprint directory. Smart parameters are supported.
' 2. A comma separated list of the detail lines.
'
' This action reads the zones from the FPXML into the objects for the page and stores the specified
' fileds so that when it creates detail lines it knows the positions of the detail line's fields.
'
Dim oFS
Dim oField
Dim FingerprintDir
Dim sFPXML
Dim xFPXML
Dim xDoc
Dim oLineItemField
Dim oSubField
Dim ParamAr
ReadFPXMLZones = FALSE
Set oFS = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
ParamAr = Split(StrParam,",")
FingerprintDir = MetaWord(Trim(ParamAr(0)))
if Right(FingerprintDir,1) <> "\" then
FingerprintDir = FingerprintDir & "\"
End if
if CurrentObj.ObjectType = 2 then
Set oPage = CurrentObj
else
Writelog("Action must be on a page object. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
if oPage.Variable("TemplateID") = "" then
writelog("Setting to test")
oPage.Variable("TemplateID") = "1068"
end if
sFPXML = FingerprintDir & oPage.Variable("TemplateID") & ".xml"
writelog("Attempting to read: " & sFPXML)
if Not oFS.FileExists(sFPXML) then
Writelog("FPXML does not exist: " & sFPXML)
Exit Function
end if
Set xDoc=CreateObject("MSXML2.DOMDocument")
xDoc.async=False
xDoc.Load(sFPXML)
For i=0 To oPage.NumOfChildren - 1
Set oField=oPage.GetChild(i)
Writelog("Processing: " & oField.Type)
sType = oField.Type
sPos=xDoc.selectSingleNode(".//F[@type='" & sType & "']/V[@n='Position']").text
oField.Variable("Position")=sPos
Writelog(oField.Type & ".Variable(Position) was set to: " & sPos)
if oField.Type = ParamAr(1) then
sPos=xDoc.selectSingleNode(".//F[@type='" & ParamAr(2) & "']/V[@n='Position']").text
oField.Variable("LineItemPos") = sPos
Writelog(oField.Type & ".Variable(LineItemPos) was set to: " & sPos)
for j = 3 to uBound(ParamAr)
sPos=xDoc.selectSingleNode(".//F[@type='" & ParamAr(j) & "']/V[@n='Position']").text
oField.Variable("POS-" & ParamAr(j)) = sPos
Writelog(oField.Type & ".Variable(POS-" & ParamAr(j) & ") was set to " & sPos)
Writelog("Looping j")
next 'j
end if
Writelog("Looping i")
Next 'i
ReadFPXMLZones = TRUE

af.name: FPXMLUsed
af.g:
' This action indicates if FPXML format fingerprint files are being used. Call this action if you are
' using fingerprints from FPXML with Invoice.rrx.
Set oPage = CurrentObj
While oPage.ObjectType > 2
Set oPage = oPage.Parent
wend
if oPage.Variable("ZoneRead") = "FPXML" then
FPXMLUsed = TRUE
else
FPXMLUsed = FALSE
end if
set oPage = Nothing

af.name: SwitchMMDD
af.g:
'
' This action is intended to switch US Month and Day date values. It will swap the first two characters
' of the field value with the two characters following the separator.
'
Dim DateAr
Dim SepUsed
Dim SepCount
Dim i
Dim OldVal
Dim OldConf
OldVal = CurrentObj.Text
oldConf = CurrentObj.ConfidenceString
Writelog("Starting value: " & CurrentObj.Text)
SwitchMMDD = False
SepCount = 0
Call AllowOnlyChars(False,False,"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789" & StrParam)
'Remove Extra Spaces
While InStr(CurrentObj.Text," ") > 0
CurrentObj.Text = Replace(CurrentObj.Text," "," ")
wend
For i = 1 to Len(CurrentObj.Text)
if InStr(StrParam,mid(CurrentObj.Text,i,1)) > 0 then
SepCount = SepCount + 1
if SepUsed = "" then
SepUsed = mid(CurrentObj.Text,i,1)
end if
end if
next 'i
Writelog("SepCount: " & cStr(SepCount))
if SepCount = 2 then
DateAr = Split(CurrentObj.Text,SepUsed)
CurrentObj.Text = DateAr(1) & SepUsed & DateAr(0) & SepUsed & DateAr(uBound(DateAr))
SwitchMMDD = TRUE
end if
writelog(CurrentObj.Text)

af.name: ValidateVendor
af.g:
' ValidateVendor exists in Flex.rrx and invoice.rrx. This is to single source it.
ValidateVendor = ValidateVendorPrivate(StrParam)

af.name: FindExportImage
af.g:
' One of the following values:
' 1. Document Level TIFF.
' 2. Document Level PDF.
' 3. Page Level TIO.
' 4. Page Level TIF.
'
' This action searches the batch directory for a file that corresponds to the current page that contains the current
' field. The file extension must match the extension specified with the input parameter.
Dim oDoc
Dim oPage
Dim oFS
FindExportImage = False
Set oFS = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
if CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 3 then
Writelog("Action must be on a field object. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Set oPage = CurrentObj
While oPage.ObjectType > 2
Set oPage = oPage.Parent
wend
if oPage.ObjectType <> 2 then
Writelog("Unable to find page object. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Set oDoc = oPage
While oDoc.ObjectType > 1
Set oDoc = oDoc.parent
wend
if oDoc.ObjectType <> 1 then
Writelog("Unable to find document object. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
if InStr(",1,2,3,4,","," & StrParam & ",") < 1 then
Writelog("Invaid string parameter. Expecting 1, 2, 3, or 4. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
if Strparam = "1" then
if oFS.FileExists(Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oDoc.ID & ".tif") then
CurrentObj.Text = Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oDOc.ID & ".tif"
FindExportImage = TRUE
else
Writelog( Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oDoc.ID & ".tif was not found.")
Exit Function
End if
End if
if Strparam = "2" then
if oFS.FileExists(Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & Pilot.BatchID & oDoc.ID & ".pdf") then
CurrentObj.Text = Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & Pilot.BatchID & oDoc.ID & ".pdf"
FindExportImage = TRUE
else
Writelog( Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & Pilot.BatchID & oDoc.ID & ".pdf was not found." )
Exit Function
End if
End if
if Strparam = "3" then
if oFS.FileExists(Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oPage.ID & ".tio") then
CurrentObj.Text = Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oPage.ID & ".tio"
FindExportImage = TRUE
else
Writelog( Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oPage.ID & ".tio was not found." )
Exit Function
End if
End if
if Strparam = "4" then
if oFS.FileExists(Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oPage.ID & ".tif") then
CurrentObj.Text = Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oPage.ID & ".tif"
FindExportImage = TRUE
else
Writelog( Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oPage.ID & ".tif was not found." )
Exit Function
End if
End if

af.name: SwapImages
af.g:
' Two extensions:
' 1. The extension to be saved as TIF.
' 2. The extension that current tif is saved as.
'
' This action interchanges the TIF for the current page with another TIF that has the same file name but
' a different extension. One possible use is if you had a backup of the TIF and need to restore it.
' The current TIF will be named with the new extension while the other named TIF, is renamed to have a TIF extension.
Dim ParamAr
Dim oPage
Dim oFS
Dim CurrentTIFF
Dim ProcessedTIFF
Dim OriginalTIFF
On Error Resume Next
SwapImages = False
if CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2 then
Writelog("Action will not work from a document or batch level. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Set oPage = CurrentObj
While oPage.ObjectType = 3
Set oPage = oPage.Parent
wend
if oPage.ObjectType <> 2 then
Writelog("Field was not on a page. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
ParamAr = Split(StrParam,",")
if uBound(ParamAr) <> 1 then
Writelog("Invalid number of parameters. Expecting (ext1,ext2). Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
if Left(ParamAr(0),1) <> "." then
ParamAr(0) = "." & ParamAr(0)
Writelog("First extension changed to: " & ParamAr(0))
end if
if Left(ParamAr(1),1) <> "." then
ParamAr(1) = "." & ParamAr(1)
Writelog("Second extension changed to: " & ParamAr(1))
end if
Set oFS = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
CurrentTIFF = oPage.ImageName
ProcessedTIFF = Left(CurrentTIFF,InStrRev(CurrentTIFF,".") - 1) & ParamAr(1)
Writelog("Moving " & CurrentTIFF & " to " & ProcessedTiFF)
if oFS.FileExists(CurrentTIFF) then
Call oFS.CopyFile(CurrentTIFF,ProcessedTIFF)
Writelog("Moved Processed")
else
writelog("File not found. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
OriginalTIFF = Left(CurrentTIFF,InStrRev(CurrentTIFF,".") - 1) & ParamAr(0)
if oFS.FileExists(OriginalTIFF) then
Call oFS.CopyFile(OriginalTIFF,CurrentTIFF)
Writelog("Moved Original")
else
Writelog("Original File not found. Exiting")
Exit Function
end if
SwapImages = TRUE

af.name: AlterDatebyDay
af.g:
' The number of days to add.
'
' This action will add the specified number of days to the date contained in the current field. The original character
' confidence is not changed.
Dim OldConf
AlterDatebyDay = TRUE
if CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 3 then
Writelog("Action must be on a field object only. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
if Not IsNumeric(StrParam) then
Writelog("Expecting numeric parameter. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
OldConf = CurrentObj.ConfidenceString
CurrentObj.Text = DateAdd("d",cLng(StrParam),CurrentObj.Text)
CurrentObj.ConfidenceString = OldConf

af.name: CheckFreeDiskSpace
af.g:
' Two comma separated parameters:
' 1. The path to Settings.ini that contains the 'LowDiskSpaceThreshold' setting.
' 2. The letter drive of the drive to check.
'
' Reads the 'LowDiskSpaceThreshold' setting from the [Notifications] section of the Settings.ini file. If the
' available disk space is lower than the value specified in the INI file, then a notification will be created.
' If the 'LowDiskSpaceThreashold' is missing from the INI file, the default value of 3000 bytes will be used.
Dim oFS
Dim ParamAr
Dim Threshold
Dim oDrive
Dim DriveFreeSpace
CheckFreeDiskSpace = False
if CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 0 then
writelog("Action was designed to run from batch level only. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Set oFS = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
StrParam = MetaWord(Trim(StrParam))
ParamAr = SPlit(StrParam,",")
if uBound(ParamAr) <> 1 then
Writelog("Invalid number of parameters. Expecting SettingsFile,DriveLetter). Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
if Not oFS.FileExists(ParamAr(0)) then
Writelog("SettingsFile was not found. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
set oDrive = oFS.GetDrive(oFS.GetDriveName(ParamAr(1)))
DriveFreeSpace = FormatNumber(oDrive.FreeSpace/(1024 * 1024),0)
Writelog("Free Space: " & DriveFreeSpace)
Threshold = Pilot.GetProfileString("Notifications","LowDiskSpaceThreshold","3000",ParamAr(0))
Writelog("Current Threshold Setting: " & Threshold)
if cLng(DriveFreeSpace) >= cLng(Threshold) then
if Pilot.GetProfileString("Notifications","LowDiskNotificationSent","",ParamAr(0)) = "Yes" then
Call Pilot.SetProfileString("Notifications","LowDiskNotificationSent","No",ParamAr(0))
writelog("Cleared Notification")
end if
CheckFreeDiskSpace = TRUE
else
if Pilot.GetProfileString("Notifications","LowDiskNotificationSent","",ParamAr(0)) = "No" then
Call Pilot.SetProfileString("Notifications","LowDiskNotificationSent","Yes",ParamAr(0))
writelog("Marked Notification to Send")
CheckFreeDiskSpace = TRUE
end if
end if

af.name: CheckAndFixDecimal
af.g:
' Replaces the space or , with .
' This can be used to fix errors where the decimal is not recognized and leaves a blank in that area,
' also this can be used for conversion for European numbers that use a comma to separate dollars from cents
' so $100,00 becomes $100.00 or $100 00 becomes $100.00.
'
Dim oldCOnf
Dim NewText
CheckandFixDecimal = False
If CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 3 then
Writelog("Action must be on a field object")
Exit Function
End if
if Len(CurrentObj.Text) < 3 then
Writelog("Length is too short for currency. Exiting FALSE")
Exit Function
End if
Writelog("The Starting value is :" & CurrentObj.Text)
oldConf = CurrentObj.ConfidenceString
if Mid(CurrentObj.Text,len(CurrentObj.Text) - 2,1) = " " OR Mid(CurrentObj.Text,len(CurrentObj.Text) - 2,1) = "," then
NewText = Left(CurrentObj.Text,Len(CurrentObj.Text) - 3) & "." & Right(CurrentObj.Text,2)
Writelog("Converting " & CurrentObj.Text & " to " & NewText)
CurrentObj.Text = NewText
CurrentObj.ConfidenceString = oldCOnf
Else
WriteLog("The value of :" & CurrentObj.Text & " doesn't fall in the criteria of a space or comma followed by two digits")
End if
CheckAndFixDecimal = TRUE

af.name: AllMixedCase
af.g:
' This action will change the value of the current field to be Title case. The first letter of
' each word will be capitalized.
Dim i
Dim oldConf
Dim MixedString
AllMixedCase = True
If CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 3 then
Writelog("Action is designed for field object. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
writelog("Getting confidence")
oldConf = CurrentObj.ConfidenceString
for i = 1 to len(CurrentObj.Text)
if i = 1 then
MixedString = uCase(Left(CurrentObj.Text,1))
else
if mid(CurrentObj.Text,i-1,1) = " " then
MixedString = MixedString & uCase(mid(CurrentObj.Text,i,1))
else
MixedString = MixedString & lCase(mid(CurrentObj.Text,i,1))
end if
end if
Writelog(MixedString)
next 'i
CurrentObj.Text = MixedString
CurrentObj.ConfidenceString = oldConf

af.name: CaptureOpInfo
af.g:
' An optional prefix to the variable name.
' This action will capture the Operator, Station ID and current time and place them into variables. The variables will be
' named based on the provided variable prefix, like this: "prefix Operator", "prefix Station" and "prefix Time".
CapatureOpInfo = TRUE
If Trim(StrParam) = "" Then StrParam = Pilot.TaskID
CurrentObj.Variable(StrParam & " " & "Operator") = Pilot.Operator
CurrentObj.Variable(StrParam & " " & "Station") = Pilot.Station
CurrentObj.Variable(StrParam & " " & "Time") = Now()

af.name: GenerateDetails
af.g:
' This action sets up a field in APT and puts a detail subfield on every page. This extra detail subfield
' appears on all pages of a multi-page invoice, allowing every page to be viewed.
On Error Resume Next
Dim oPage
Dim oDoc
Dim NumPages
Dim oLineItem
Dim oField
GenerateDetails = False
if CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 3 then
Writelog("Action must be on a field object. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
if CurrentObj.Parent.ObjectType <> 2 then
Writelog("Action must be on a field that is a child of a page object. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
Set oPage = CurrentObj.Parent
if oPage.Parent.ObjectType <> 1 then
Writelog("Action must be on a field in a document structure. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
Set oDoc = oPage.Parent
Writelog("Proper structure found")
NumPages = oDoc.NumOfChildren
Writelog("Detected " & NumPages & " pages.")
For i = CurrentObj.NumOfChildren-1 To 0 Step -1
CurrentObj.DeleteChild(i)
Next
For i = 0 to NumPages - 1 'children indexes are 0 based
Writelog("Creating line for page " & cStr(i+1) )
Set oLineItem = CurrentObj.AddChild(3,"Page_No" & cStr(i+1) ,-1)
oLineItem.Type = "Page_No"
oLineItem.Status = 0
oLineItem.Variable("Position") = "90,90,210,210"
oLineItem.Variable("IMAGEFILE") = oDoc.GetChild(i).Variable("IMAGEFILE")
Set oField = oLineItem.AddChild(3,"TIFF",0)
oField.Variable("IMAGEFILE") = oDoc.GetChild(i).Variable("IMAGEFILE")
oField.Variable("Position") = "100,100,200,200"
oField.Status = 0
oField.Text = Right(oField.Variable("IMAGEFILE"),12)
oField.Type = "TIFF"
next 'i
GenerateDetails = TRUE
Call ErrorHandler("GenerateDetails")

af.name: IncrementBatchVar
af.g:
' The name of the variable to increment.
'
' This action increments a batch level variable by 1. If the variable does not already exist, it will be created.
' If the variable exists but the value is not numeric, the variable will be set to 1.
Dim CurrentValue
IncrementBatchVar = TRUE
CurrentValue = DCO.Variable(strParam)
if Not IsNumeric(CurrentValue) then
Writelog("Creating batch variable: " & strParam)
DCO.Variable(strParam) = "1"
Exit Function
End if
DCO.Variable(StrParam) = cStr(cLng(DCO.Variable(StrParam)) + 1)

af.name: SendOutlookNotification
af.g:
' The extension of the attachment. The attachment is expected to be named the same as the current document ID.
'
' This action uses outlook to send a notification to specified e-mail addresses. The message within the email
' is determined by previous calls to actions that have set notification, such as CheckFreeDiskSpace.
'
' Note that this action has some requirements such as Outlook installed on the machine and logged
' in with an ID that has appropriate permissions to send emails.
Dim oOutlook
Dim oMail
Dim oDoc
Dim MailTo
Dim StrMessage
Dim oFS
SendOutlookNotification = TRUE
On Error Resume Next
Set oDoc = CurrentObj
While oDoc.ObjectType > 1
Set oDoc = oDoc.Parent
Wend
if oDoc.ObjectType <> 1 then
Writelog("Document object not found. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Set oOutlook = Nothing
Set oOutlook = CreateObject("Outlook.Application")
if oOutlook Is Nothing then
Writelog("Could not create Outlook object. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Set oMail = oOutlook.CreateItem(0)
SettingsFile = Pilot.GetProfileString("Files","Settings","*",Pilot.ProjectPath)
If SettingsFile = "*" Then
writelog("Missing settings file " & Pilot.ProjectPath & ". Exiting.")
Exit Function
End If
Writelog("Settings file: " & SettingsFile)
MailTo = Pilot.GetProfileString("Notifications",CurrentObj.Text,"*",SettingsFile)
if MailTo = "*" then
Writelog("Could not find email address in settings.ini. Exiting - " & CurrentObj.Text)
Exit Function
End if
if Left(StrParam,1) <> "." then
StrParam = "." & StrParam
End if
oMail.To = MailTo
oMail.Subject = "Taskmaster Notification - " & oDoc.ID
Set oFS = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
if oFS.FileExists(Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oDoc.ID & StrParam) then
oMail.Attachments.Add(Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oDoc.ID & StrParam)
else
Writelog("Could not find attachment: " & Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & oDoc.ID & StrParam)
end if
strMessage = "Reason for notification: " & CurrentObj.Text & vbcrlf & vbcrlf
strMessage = strMessage & "Operator: " & CurrentObj.Parent.Variable("Verify Operator") & vbcrlf
strMessage = strMessage & "Station: " & CurrentObj.Parent.Variable("Verify Station") & vbcrlf
strMessage = strMessage & "Time: " & CurrentObj.Parent.Variable("Verify Time") & vbcrlf
strMessage = strMessage & "Comments: " & CurrentObj.Parent.Variable("comments") & vbcrlf
oMail.Body = strMessage
oMail.Send
Set oMail = Nothing
Set oOutlook = Nothing

af.name: UpdateFPStats
af.g:
' This action updates the fingerprint statistics in the fingerprint database.
' It keeps track of the last accessed fingerprint and the number of times a fingerprint is accessed.
Dim oCmd
Dim oParam1
Dim oParam2
Dim DateHit
Dim oRS
ON ERROR RESUME NEXT
UpdateFPStats = False
if oConn.State = 0 then
Writelog("Connection to the rules/fingerprint database was not found.Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
if CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 2 then
Writelog("This action was designed to operate on a page level object only. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Set oCmd = CreateObject("ADODB.Command")
Set oParam1 = oCmd.CreateParameter("P1",200,1,50)
Set oParam2 = oCmd.CreateParameter("P1",200,1,50)
sSQL = "UPDATE Template SET tp_HitCount = tp_HitCOunt + 1, tp_LastHit = ? WHERE tp_TemplateID = ?"
sSQL = ModifySQLByDBType(oCmd,sSQL)
oCmd.CommandText = sSQL
oCmd.CommandType = 1
oCmd.ActiveConnection = oConn
Writelog("Connection set")
oCmd.Parameters.Append oParam1
oCmd.Parameters.Append oParam2
Writelog("Parameters set")
Writelog("TemplateID = " & CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID"))
oCmd(0).Value = Date()
oCmd(1).Value = CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID")
if oCmd(1).Value = "" then
Writelog("No TemplateID found. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
Writelog("Ready to do oCmd.Execute")
oRS = oCmd.Execute
Writelog("SQL Executed")
Set oCmd = Nothing
Set oParam1 = Nothing
Set oParam2 = Nothing
Set oRS = Nothing
ERR.CLEAR
UpdateFPStats = TRUE

af.name: Overlay
af.g: 'Combines the current image with the image file specified by the SetBackgroundImage action into 'a new image replacing the current image. This action is used to reinstate a form background 'that was 'dropped out' during scanning. ' Note: The parameter of the preceding SetBackgroundImageaction can be a smart parameter that ' locates a paths.inifile in the same folder that contains the application's Document Hierarchy file. Dim sOverlay Dim X, Y, rtn On Error Resume Next Overlay = False If (CurrentObj.ObjectType<>2) Then 'CurrentObj must be a dco page Writelog("Overlay: object is not a page.") Exit Function End if 'Look for field 'Image_Offset' writelog("Looking for Image_Offset field.") Set fldImgOvr = CurrentObj.FindChild( "Image_Offset" ) 'If Image_Offset field is not found look for field 'IMAGEOVERLAYOFFSET' If (fldImgOvr Is Nothing) Then writelog("Looking for IMAGEOVERLAYOFFSET field.") Set fldImgOvr = CurrentObj.FindChild("IMAGEOVERLAYOFFSET") End if 'Check that one of the fields was returned If (fldImgOvr Is Nothing) Then WriteLog("Couldn't find the image offset field...") Exit Function End if Writelog("Image to Overlay:'" & CurrentObj.ImageName & "'") rtn = -1 'Get the value and filter for spaces and semi-colon (autofld.dll puts a semi-colon at the end of the field value) sOverlay = Trim(fldImgOvr.Text) If (sOverlay = "") or (sOverlay = ";") Then writelog("Looking for Image_Offset page variable") sOverlay = CurrentObj.Variable("Image_Offset") End if sOverlay = Trim(Replace(sOverlay,";","")) If (sOverlay <> "") Then Writelog("Overlay field value:" & sOverlay) aXY = Split(sOverlay, ",") X = CLng(aXY(0)) Y = CLng(aXY(1)) Writelog("X: " & X & "; Y: " & Y) On Error Resume Next rtn = g_oImageOverlay.Overlay(CurrentObj.ImageName, X, Y) CatchOverlayError("") else Writelog("no overlay offset info found.") End If If(rtn = 0) Then If X < 0 Then X = 0 If Y < 0 Then Y = 0 Call ov_ZoneChildren(CurrentObj, 0, X, Y) Overlay = True End If

sExtn = ".key"

'Add the '.key' extension for file i/o compatibility

af.name: WordFind
af.g:
' A word or phrase to find on the page.
'
' The current page be searched to find the word or phrase. The location of the first
' word or phrase that matches the parameter will be remembered so it can be
' utilized by subsequent actions. Word matching is case sensitive.
' To improve matching,
' this action automatically adjusts the search criteria to allow for
' common character substitutions. For example, if the list includes
' "will" and the recognition read "wi11", a match will still occur.
' Common substitutions include characters: B8, Z2, S5, oO0 and iItl1.
Dim L,R,T,B
Dim sPosition
Dim strKey
On Error Resume Next
WordFind=False
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
'Set Search Zone to Entire CCO
L = CCO.Left
T = CCO.Top
R = CCO.Right
B = CCO.Bottom
sPosition = cstr(L & "," & T & "," & R & "," & B)
'Set CCO Start Search Position
Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(0,0,0,0)
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
strKey = RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, StrParam)
WordFind = KeySearch(strKey, sPosition, 1)
Call ErrorHandler("Function WordFind")

f.name: GoSiblingBlockNext
f.g:
' Moves to the next sibling block. Because the current word cannot exist in the
' sibling block, the currently select word is changed to the first word in the sibling.
' For example, if the current block is a line, the next line becomes the current block
' and the current word becomes the first word block found within the line block.
On Error Resume Next
Dim sWordPosition
Dim sWordText
GoSiblingBlockNext = False
if (not LoadDocStructurePage) Then Exit Function
count = trim(MetaWord(count))
If Not IsNumeric(count) Then
Writelog("The parameter '" & count & "' is not numeric. Current block has not changed.")
exit function
end if
GoSiblingBlockNext = g_DLayout.GoSiblingBlockNext(CInt(count))
if (GoSiblingBlockNext = False) Then
Writelog("Could not go to next sibling block. Position not changed.")
exit function
End if
' The current word will have changed, need to update the DCO with that new word position.
sWordPosition = g_DLayout.GetCurrentWordPosition
sWordText = g_DLayout.GetCurrentWordText
Writelog("New selected word = " & sWordText & " pos = " & sWordPosition)
Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(0,0,0,0) 'Assume start of CCD and we will find the first word in the block.
bResult = KeySearch(sWordText, sWordPosition, 1)
if (bResult) Then
WriteLog("Positioned CCO word: " & sWordText)
else
Writelog("Could not find word: '" & sWordText & "' in pos: " & sWordPosition) ' if this happens then cco != document structure.
End If
GoSiblingBlockNext = bResult
Call ErrorHandler("Function GoSiblingBlockNext")

' sibling block, the currently select word is changed to the first word in the sibling.
' For example, if the current block is a line, the previous line becomes the current block

Dim sWordPosition
Dim sWordText
GoSiblingBlockPrevious = False
if (not LoadDocStructurePage) Then Exit Function
count = trim(MetaWord(count))

GoSiblingBlockPrevious = g_DLayout.GoSiblingBlockPrevious(CInt(count))
if (GoSiblingBlockPrevious = False) Then
Writelog("Could not go to previous sibling block. Position not changed.")
exit function
End if
' The current word will have changed, need to update the DCO with that new word position.
sWordPosition = g_DLayout.GetCurrentWordPosition
sWordText = g_DLayout.GetCurrentWordText
Writelog("New selected word = " & sWordText & " pos = " & sWordPosition)
Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(0,0,0,0) 'Assume start of CCD and we will find the first word in the block.

af.name: UpdateFieldWithBlock

' Updates the field zone coordinates with the coordinates of the currently selected block.

On Error Resume Next
If (CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 3) Then
Writelog("Action must be called at field level. Exiting")
Exit Function 'must be a page or a field

sEOL=Space(1)
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
sPosition = g_DLayout.GetCurrentBlockPosition()

v1_left = CLng(aSplit(0))
v1_top = CLng(aSplit(1))

v1_bottom = CLng(aSplit(3))

v1_top = v1_top-2

v1_bottom = v1_bottom+2
If v1_bottom>CCO.bottom then v1_right=CCO.bottom

af.name: RegExFindNext_InBlock
af.g:
' A word or phrase to find in the current field. The parameter is expected to be
' a Regular Expression.
' Starting from the location of a previously found word, this action locates the first
' occurrence of a word or phrase in the current field where the input search term
' is specified as a regular expression.
' The search is started from the location of a previously found word in the currently selected block "zone".
' Any field coordinates are ignored.
' The search is case sensitive.
Dim sPosition
Dim oParent
Dim strKey
On Error Resume Next
RegExFindNext_InBlock = False
' Check for Page or Field level. Not sure about Document level yet.
If ((CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 2) and (CurrentObj.ObjectType <> 3)) Then
Writelog("Action must be called at field level. Exiting")
Exit Function 'must be a page or a field
End if
if (not LoadDocStructurePage) Then Exit Function
sPosition = g_DLayout.GetCurrentBlockPosition() ' Put the boundries to the current block. Whole page if no block set.
Writelog("Position of current block = " & sPosition)
If sPosition="0,0,0,0" then sPosition=""
StrParam = g_SmartParameterValue(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
strKey = StrParam

af.name: WordFind_InZone
af.g:
'A word or phrase to find in the current zoned field.
' The current field will be searched to find the word or phrase. The location of the first
' word or phrase that matches the parameter will be remembered so it can be
' utilized by subsequent actions. Word matching is case sensitive.
'
' To improve matching,
' this action automatically adjusts the search criteria to allow for
' common character substitutions. For example, if the list includes
' "will" and the recognition read "wi11", a match will still occur.
' Common substitutions include characters: B8, Z2, S5, oO0 and iItl1.
Dim sPosition
Dim oParent
Dim strKey
On error Resume Next
WordFind_InZone=False
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
Set oParent=CurrentObj
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
While (sPosition="" Or sPosition="0,0,0,0") and oParent.objectType>1
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
Wend
If sPosition="0,0,0,0" then sPosition=""
Set oParent=Nothing
'Set CCO Start Search Position
Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(0,0,0,0)
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
strKey = RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, StrParam)
WordFind_InZone = KeySearch(strKey, sPosition, 1)
Call ErrorHandler("Function WordFind_InZone")

af.name: FindKeyList
af.g:
' The name of the Keyword text file. The file will contain a list of words or phrases,
' separated by new lines, that will be used for matching.
' The file name can be provided in one of two ways:
' 1. A full path name of the file, including the extension.
' 2. The file name only, with no extension specified. The application will look in
' the process directory and the file must have a ".key" extension.
' Opens the Keyword file you specify as a parameter, then checks the
' words on the current page against the keywords in the list to find a match. The location of the
' found word or phrase that matches an entry in the keyword file
' will be remembered so the result can be used by subsequent actions.
' Word matching is case sensitive.
' To improve matching,
' this action automatically adjusts the search criteria to allow for
' common character substitutions. For example, if the list includes
' "will" and the recognition read "wi11", a match will still occur.
' Common substitutions include characters: B8, Z2, S5, oO0 and iItl1.
Dim KeyList
Dim aKeys,strKey,Found,Kx
Dim sPosition
Dim bReturn
On Error Resume Next
FindKeyList = False
bReturn = False
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
'Set CCO Start Search Position
Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(0,0,0,0)
'Set Search Zone to Entire CCO
L = CCO.Left
T = CCO.Top
R = CCO.Right
B = CCO.Bottom
sPosition = cstr(L & "," & T & "," & R & "," & B)
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
KeyList = ReadKeyFile(StrParam)
If g_bAggregateListSearch=True then
If Aggregate_List_Search(KeyList,sPosition,1,True) then bReturn=True
Else
aKeys = Split(KeyList & vbCrLf, vbCrLf)
For Kx = 0 To UBound(aKeys)-1
strKey = Trim(aKeys(Kx))
If Len(strKey)>0 Then
strKey = RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, strKey)
If KeySearch(strKey, sPosition, 1) then
bReturn = True
Exit For
End if
End If
Next 'sKey
End if
FindKeyList = bReturn

Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(0,0,0,0)
Set oParent=CurrentObj
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
While (sPosition="" Or sPosition="0,0,0,0") and oParent.objectType>1
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
Wend
Set oParent = Nothing
If sPosition="0,0,0,0" then sPosition=""
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
KeyList = ReadKeyFile(StrParam)
If g_bAggregateListSearch=True then
If Aggregate_List_Search(KeyList,sPosition,-1,False) then bReturn=True
Else
aKeys = Split(KeyList & vbCrLf, vbCrLf)
For Kx = 0 To UBound(aKeys)-1
strKey = Trim(aKeys(Kx))
If Len(strKey)>0 Then
If KeySearch(strKey, sPosition, -1) then
bReturn = True
Exit For
End if
End If
Next 'sKey
End if
FindLastRegExList_InZone = bReturn

af.name: GoFirstWord
af.g:
' This action navigates to the first word on the current line. If the page's
' Fingerprint file (.cco) does not have a Line position, the action defaults
' to the first line of the current zone - or page, if a zone is not present.
Dim L1,L2,W1,W2
Dim oParent
Dim sPosition
Dim arData
Dim i
GoFirstWord = False
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
'Get Current Zone boundry
Set oParent=CurrentObj
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Start Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
While (sPosition="" Or sPosition="0,0,0,0") and oParent.objectType>1
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("New Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
Wend
Writelog("Final Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
If sPosition="" then sPosition="0,0,0,0"
arData=Split(sPosition, ",")
For i=0 To UBound(arData)
If trim(arData(i))="" then
arData(i)=clng(0)
else
arData(i)=CLng(arData(i))
End if
Next
Set oParent=Nothing
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(L1,W1,L2,W2)
Writelog("Start CCO Position lines:" & L1 & "-" & L2)
If CCO.Count>0 Then
'If no CCO position then default to 1st line in zone or page if no zone
If L1=0 then
Call CCO.LocateLines(arData(1),arData(3),L1,L2)
Writelog("Locate Lines " & L1 & "-" & L2)
If L1=0 then L1=1
End if
W1=1
Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(L1,W1,L1,W1)
Writelog("Position set to Line " & L1 & " Word " & W1)
GoFirstWord=True
End if
Call ErrorHandler("Function GoFirstWord")

af.name: UpdateField
af.g:
' Updates the appropriate field in the current page's Data file with the recognized
' (and possibly formatted!) value of the located word.
Dim L1,W1,L2,W2
Dim v_left,v_top,v_right,v_bottom
Dim v1_left,v1_top,v1_right,v1_bottom
Dim v2_left,v2_top,v2_right,v2_bottom
Dim sValue, sConfidence
Dim Wx,Lx,Cx
Dim Cleft ,Ctop ,Cright ,Cbottom
Dim sEOL,n
Dim Wxstart,Wxend
On Error Resume Next
UpdateField=False
sEOL=Space(1)
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(L1,W1,L2,W2)
Writelog("CCO Position:" & L1 & "," & W1 & "," & L2 & "," & W2)
If L1=0 and W1=0 then
writelog("No Position information found. Exiting Action")
Exit Function
End If
'First Word Positions
v1_left = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Left
v1_top = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Top
v1_right = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Right
v1_bottom = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Bottom
'Last Word Positions
v2_left = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Left
v2_top = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Top
v2_right = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Right
v2_bottom = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Bottom
'Merge Positions
If v2_left < v1_left then v1_left = v2_left
If v2_top < v1_top then v1_top = v2_top
If v2_right > v1_right then v1_right = v2_right
If v2_bottom > v1_bottom then v1_bottom = v2_bottom
Call CheckMCCOImageReference(CurrentObj,L1)
'Expand Zone for viewability - check image border boundries
v1_left = v1_left-2
If v1_left<0 then v1_left=0
v1_top = v1_top-2
If v1_top<0 then v1_top=0
v1_right = v1_right+2
If v1_right>CCO.Right then v1_right=CCO.Right
v1_bottom = v1_bottom+2
If v1_bottom>CCO.bottom then v1_right=CCO.bottom
CurrentObj.Text=""
Call CurrentObj.SetPosition(v1_left-2, v1_top-2, v1_right+2, v1_bottom+2)
If len(trim(L2))=0 then L2=L1
If len(trim(W2))=0 then W2=W1
For Lx = L1 to L2
Wxstart=1
Wxend=CCO.Item(Lx).Count
If Lx=L1 Then Wxstart=W1
If Lx=L2 Then Wxend=W2
For Wx = Wxstart to Wxend
For Cx = 1 to CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Count
sValue = ASCW(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Value)
sConfidence = CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).confidence
Set cObj = CurrentObj.AddChild(4,"",-1)
nChar = cObj.AddValue(CLng(sValue), CLng(sConfidence))
Cleft = Clng(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Left)
Ctop = Clng(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Top)
Cright = Clng(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Right)
Cbottom = Clng(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Bottom)
bRes = cObj.SetPosition(Cleft ,Ctop ,Cright ,Cbottom)
Next 'Cx
'Add Space to DCO Value Between Words
If Wx<Wxend then
Set cObj = CurrentObj.AddChild(4,"",-1)
nChar = cObj.AddValue(CLng(32), CLng(9))
bRes = cObj.SetPosition(Clng(0) ,Clng(0) ,Clng(0) ,Clng(0))
End if
Next 'Wx
'Add EOL character(s) to DCO Value between Lines
If Lx<L2 then
If IsAlive(g_SetEOL) Then sEOL = g_SetEOL
For n = 1 to len(sEOL)
Set cObj = CurrentObj.AddChild(4,"",-1)
nChar = cObj.AddValue(CLng(ASCW(Mid(sEOL,n,1))), CLng(9))
bRes = cObj.SetPosition(Clng(0) ,Clng(0) ,Clng(0) ,Clng(0))
Next 'n
End if
Next 'Lx
WriteLog(Space(3) & "UpdateField Value Found: '" & CurrentObj.Text & "' Confidence: '" & CurrentObj.ConfidenceString & "' ")
If IsObject(logwindow) Then
Call ShowCurrPosFromCCO()
ValueUP.Text = CurrentObj.Text
End If
UpdateField = True
Call ErrorHandler("Function UpdateField")

af.name: UpdateDCOField
af.g: ' String value of the target field's name, as a Field object of the Document Hierarchy. ' This action updates the size and position coordinates of the Fieldobject ' representing the field identified by the parameter. Typically, the action follows ' earlier actions and events which modify the field's width and height, or its ' precise placement on the current source page. Dim L1,W1,L2,W2 Dim v_left,v_top,v_right,v_bottom Dim v1_left,v1_top,v1_right,v1_bottom Dim v2_left,v2_top,v2_right,v2_bottom Dim sValue, sConfidence Dim Wx,Lx,Cx Dim Cleft ,Ctop ,Cright ,Cbottom Dim oField Dim sEOL,n Dim Wxstart,Wxend On Error Resume Next UpdateDCOField=False If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(L1,W1,L2,W2) Writelog("CCO Position:" & L1 & "," & W1 & "," & L2 & "," & W2) If L1=0 and W1=0 then writelog("No Position information found. Exiting Action") Exit Function End If 'First Word Positions v1_left = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Left v1_top = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Top v1_right = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Right v1_bottom = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Bottom 'Last Word Positions v2_left = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Left v2_top = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Top v2_right = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Right v2_bottom = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Bottom 'Merge Positions If v2_left < v1_left then v1_left = v2_left If v2_top < v1_top then v1_top = v2_top If v2_right > v1_right then v1_right = v2_right If v2_bottom > v1_bottom then v1_bottom = v2_bottom writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'") Set oField = DCONav(StrParam) If oField is Nothing then Writelog("Target DCO not found.") Exit Function End if Call CheckMCCOImageReference(oField,L1) oField.Text="" 'Expand Zone for viewability - check image border boundries v1_left = v1_left-2 If v1_left<0 then v1_left=0 v1_top = v1_top-2 If v1_top<0 then v1_top=0 v1_right = v1_right+2 If v1_right>CCO.Right then v1_right=CCO.Right v1_bottom = v1_bottom+2 If v1_bottom>CCO.bottom then v1_right=CCO.bottom Call oField.SetPosition(v1_left-2, v1_top-2, v1_right+2, v1_bottom+2) If len(trim(L2))=0 then L2=L1 If len(trim(W2))=0 then W2=W1 For Lx = L1 to L2 Wxstart=1 Wxend=CCO.Item(Lx).Count If Lx=L1 Then Wxstart=W1 If Lx=L2 Then Wxend=W2 For Wx = Wxstart to Wxend For Cx = 1 to CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Count sValue = ASCw(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Value) sConfidence = CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).confidence Set cObj = oField.AddChild(4,"",-1) nChar = cObj.AddValue(CLng(sValue), CLng(sConfidence)) Cleft = Clng(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Left) Ctop = Clng(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Top) Cright = Clng(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Right) Cbottom = Clng(CCO.Item(Lx).Item(Wx).Item(Cx).Bottom) bRes = cObj.SetPosition(Cleft ,Ctop ,Cright ,Cbottom) Next 'Cx 'Add Space to DCO Value Between Words If Wx

af.name: SetRect
af.g:
'Four coordinates designating the rectangle's size and location: X,Y,W,H.
Dim vals

vals = Split(strParam,",",4)

nW = CLng(Trim(vals(2)))

af.name: MergeNextWord
af.g:
' An Integer indicating the number of words to the right, starting from the previously
' found word, to be placed into a field.
' Places the located word with one or more words to the right, on the same line,
' into the current object field.
Dim L1,W1,L2,W2
Dim Wx
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
If Not IsNumeric(StrParam) Or IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = 1
StrParam = Abs(StrParam)
On error Resume Next
MergeNextWord=False
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(L1,W1,L2,W2)
If L1=0 then L1=1
If L2=0 then L2=1
If W1=0 then W1=1
If W2=0 then W2=1
For Wx = 1 To StrParam
'Check if there is a word to the right to merge with
If CCO.Item(L2).count < (W2 + Wx) Then
MergeNextWord = True
Exit Function
End if
Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(L1,W1,L2,W2 + Wx)
Next 'Wx
WriteLog("MergeNextWord New Value: " & GetCurrValue())
If IsObject(LogWindow) Then
ShowCurrPosFromCCO()
End If
MergeNextWord = True
Call ErrorHandler("Function MergeNextWord")

af.name: IsNumber
af.g:
' An Integer (0-100) indicating the minimum percentage of characters that must be numeric.
' If no parameter is specified, the value defaults to 100 percent; all characters must be numeric.
Dim Value, TrueCount, FalseCount, TFRatio
On Error Resume Next
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = 100
If Not IsNumeric(StrParam) Then
StrParam = 100
Writelog("Parameter is not Numeric. Setting to 100")
End If
If StrParam < 0 Then
StrParam = 0
Writelog("Parameter is negative value. Setting to Zero")
End If
If StrParam > 100 Then
StrParam = 100
Writelog("Parameter is Greater than 100. Setting to 100")
End If
IsNumber = False
TrueCount = 0
FalseCount = 0
Value = Trim(GetCurrValue)
Writelog("Checking Value of '" & Value & "'.")
ValueLen = len(Value)
' \p{N} or \p{Number}: any kind of numeric character in any script.
' \p{Nd} or \p{Decimal_Digit_Number}: a digit zero through nine in any script except ideographic scripts.
' \p{Nl} or \p{Letter_Number}: a number that looks like a letter, such as a Roman numeral.
' \p{No} or \p{Other_Number}: a superscript or subscript digit, or a number that is not a digit 0..9 (excluding numbers from ideographic scripts).
For Cx = 1 To Len(value)
sCharacter=Mid(value,Cx,1)
If DCGlobalStrings.RegExIsMatch(sCharacter,"\p{N}") Then
TrueCount = TrueCount + 1
Elseif DCGlobalStrings.RegExIsMatch(sCharacter,"\p{Mn}") Then
ValueLen = ValueLen - 1
Else
FalseCount = FalseCount + 1
End If
Next 'Cx
TFRatio = (StrParam/100)*ValueLen
If TrueCount >= TFRatio and ValueLen>0 Then IsNumber = True
If ValueLen <= 0 Then ValueLen = 1
WriteLog(Space(3) & "Value is " & (TrueCount/ValueLen)*100 & "% Numeric")
If IsNumber=False Then
Writelog("value contains less than " & StrParam & "% numeric characters.")
End If

af.name: IsAlpha
af.g:
' An Integer (0-100) indicating the minimum percentage of characters that need to be alphabetic.
' If no value is provided, the percentage defaults to 100; all characters must be alphabetic.
Dim Value, TrueCount, FalseCount, TFRatio, Ck
IsAlpha = False
' StrParam is a value between 0 and 100
' This action determines the percentage of numbers required to return True
' Defaults to 100%
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = 100
If Not IsNumeric(StrParam) Then
StrParam = 100
Writelog("Parameter is not Numeric. Setting to 100")
End If
If StrParam < 0 Then
StrParam = 0
Writelog("Parameter is negative value. Setting to Zero")
End If
If StrParam > 100 Then
StrParam = 100
Writelog("Parameter is Greater than 100. Setting to 100")
End If
TrueCount = 0
FalseCount = 0
Value = Trim(GetCurrValue)
ValueLen = len(Value)
' \p{L} or \p{Letter}: any kind of letter from any language.
' \p{Ll} or \p{Lowercase_Letter}: a lowercase letter that has an uppercase variant.
' \p{Lu} or \p{Uppercase_Letter}: an uppercase letter that has a lowercase variant.
' \p{Lt} or \p{Titlecase_Letter}: a letter that appears at the start of a word when only the first letter of the word is capitalized.
' \p{L&} or \p{Letter&}: a letter that exists in lowercase and uppercase variants (combination of Ll, Lu and Lt).
' \p{Lm} or \p{Modifier_Letter}: a special character that is used like a letter.
' \p{Lo} or \p{Other_Letter}: a letter or ideograph that does not have lowercase and uppercase variants.
' \p{Mn} : a non spacing mark - used with non composite character sets.
For Cx = 1 To Len(value)
sCharacter=Mid(value,Cx,1)
If DCGlobalStrings.RegExIsMatch(sCharacter,"\p{L}") Then
TrueCount = TrueCount + 1
Elseif DCGlobalStrings.RegExIsMatch(sCharacter,"\p{Mn}") Then
ValueLen = ValueLen - 1
Else
FalseCount = FalseCount + 1
End If
Next 'Cx
TFRatio = (StrParam/100)*ValueLen
If TrueCount >= TFRatio and ValueLen>0 Then IsAlpha = True
WriteLog(Space(3) & "Value is " & (TrueCount/ValueLen)*100 & "% Alphabetic")
If IsAlpha Then
Writelog("Value is at least " & StrParam & "% Alphabetic")
Else
Writelog("Value is not at least " & StrParam & "% Alphabetic")
End If

af.name: MergePreviousWord
af.g:
' An Integer indicating the number of words to the left of the previously found field,
' to be placed into the current object field.
' Merges the located word with one or more words to the left, on the same line.
' MergePreviousWord replaced the action MergeWordLF
Dim L1,W1,L2,W2
Dim Wx
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
If Not IsNumeric(StrParam) Or IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = 1
StrParam = Abs(StrParam)
On error Resume Next
MergePreviousWord=False
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(L1,W1,L2,W2)
If L1=0 then L1=1
If L2=0 then L2=1
If W1=0 then W1=1
If W2=0 then W2=1
Writelog("Starting from leading and trailing words:" & L1 & "," & W1 & ":" & L2 & "," & W2)
Writelog("Merging up to '" & strparam & "' words Left.")
For Wx = 1 To StrParam
'Check if there is a word to the left to merge with
If (W1 - Wx)<=0 Then
MergePreviousWord = True
Exit Function
End if
Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(L1,W1-Wx,L2,W2)
Next 'Wx
WriteLog("MergePreviousWord New Value: " & GetCurrValue())
If IsObject(LogWindow) Then
ShowCurrPosFromCCO()
End If
MergePreviousWord = True
Call ErrorHandler("Function MergePreviousWord")

af.name: IsDateValue
af.g:
' Determines if the recognized value of the located word has an acceptable Date format.
Dim Value
Dim slocale
On error Resume Next
IsDateValue=False
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
IsDateValue = True
Value = GetCurrValue()
writelog("Checking Value:'" & Value & "' ")
slocale = DetermineLocale
IsDateValue = DCGlobalDates.IsDate(Value,slocale)
writelog(DCGlobalDates.GetLog())

af.name: FilterIt
af.g: ' A String containing the character(s) to be removed. ' Alert! This action removes every instance of the character or characters. On Error Resume Next StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam) writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'") Writelog("FilterIt: Calling RemoveType...") FilterIt = RemoveType(bInteractive, bDebug, StrParam)

af.name: SelectSnippet
af.g: ' 1. The character that is to appear in the Snippet field if a value is not ' available. "~" is the default. ' 2. The magnification of the value's image. "1" = 100% and is the default. ' ' Used in conjunction with directional actions, this action will populate a Snippet ' field with the recognized value of the located word. Dim Lx, Wx Dim L1,W1,L2,W2 Dim v_left,v_top,v_right,v_bottom Dim v1_left,v1_top,v1_right,v1_bottom Dim v2_left,v2_top,v2_right,v2_bottom StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam) writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'") StrParam = StrParam & ", " If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = " ,1" aStrParam = Split(StrParam,",") If Not IsNumeric(aStrParam(1)) Then aStrParam(1) = "1" WriteLog("SelectSnippet: setting default area...") On error Resume Next SelectSnippet=False If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function On Error Resume Next Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(L1,W1,L2,W2) If L1=0 then L1=1 If L2=0 then L2=1 If W1=0 then W1=1 If W2=0 then W2=1 writelog("Showing CCO " & L1 & "," & W1 & " to " & L2 & "," & W2) 'First Word Positions v1_left = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Left v1_top = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Top v1_right = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Right v1_bottom = CCO.Item(L1).Item(W1).Bottom 'Last Word Positions v2_left = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Left v2_top = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Top v2_right = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Right v2_bottom = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Bottom 'Merge Positions If v2_left < v1_left then v1_left = v2_left If v2_top < v1_top then v1_top = v2_top If v2_right > v1_right then v1_right = v2_right If v2_bottom > v1_bottom then v1_bottom = v2_bottom v1_bottom = v1_bottom + ((v1_bottom - v1_top) * (2 * aStrParam(1))) v1_right = v1_right + ((v1_right - v1_left) * (.75 * aStrparam(1))) v1_left = v1_left - (15 * aStrParam(1)) v1_top = v1_top - (15 * aStrParam(1)) Call CurrentObj.SetPosition(v1_left, v1_top, v1_right, v1_bottom) CurrentObj.text = aStrParam(0) Call CheckMCCOImageReference(CurrentObj,L1) If IsObject(LogWindow) Then ValueUp.text = aStrParam(0) Call ShowRect (v1_left, v1_top, v1_right, v1_bottom) End If SelectSnippet = True Call ErrorHandler("Function SelectSnippet")

af.name: DefaultValue

StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam) writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'") If IsObject(LogWindow) Then Valuetxt.text = strParam CurrentObj.Text = StrParam If IsObject(LogWindow) Then ValueUp.text = StrParam DefaultValue = True

af.name: MaxLength
af.g:
'An Integer specifying the maximum number of characters the word can contain.

MaxLength = False

wCount = clng(LenT(GetCurrValue()))
If IsNumeric(StrParam) Then
If wCount <= CLng(StrParam) Then
MaxLength = True

Else

bOverride=False
msg = vbCr & "MaxLength returns FALSE."
End If
End If
Else
msg = "Parameter is not Numeric, MaxLength returns False."
writelog(msg)
End If
writelog("MaxLength: Set to " & StrParam & " Characters. Count is " & wCount & ". " & msg)

af.name: MinLength

If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = " "

af.name: IsCurrency
af.g:
' This CCO action determines if the value of the located word is 100% numeric and
' includes a two-digit decimal amount.
' The field must contain a two digit currency value. The decimal separator can be a period or
' comma. The action will ignore leading and trailing spaces. The field cannot contain
' a currency symbol.
IsCurrency = False
On error Resume Next
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
CurrentValue = GetCurrValue()
If Not DCGlobalStrings.RegExIsMatch(CurrentValue,"[^\p{N}\p{Sc}\.\,\'\s]") Then
If Len(Trim(CurrentValue))>=3 Then
If Left(Right(CurrentValue,3),1) = "." Or Left(Right(CurrentValue,3),1) = "," Then
IsCurrency = True
End If
End If
End If
Debuglog("IsCurrency returns " & IsCurrency)
Call ErrorHandler("Function IsCurrency")

af.name: ScanRT
af.g:
' Numeric value of the number of words to be evaluated to the right of the current word.
' ScanRT (scan right) looks for a word or words in positions that are slightly above or below the
' line on which the current word rests.
Dim Up_xL,Up_yB,Dn_xL,Dn_yT,CM,CR,DistUp,DistDN,l,w
On error Resume Next
ScanRT=False
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
'Check the parameter is numeric (default to 1 if not)
If Not IsNumeric(Strparam) Or Len(Trim(Strparam)) = 0 Then StrParam = "1"
'///Word Code Relationship Diagram -
'///WordCode: Ln LL Hn RR Rn Ln LS RS Rn HL RH HH
'///TargetWord-> ---- ---- -- ---- ---- : ---- ------ ------ ---- : ---- ---- : ------
'///CurrentCCO-> ------ --------- ---------- ------
ScanRT = True
If JumpToWordH(bInteractive, bDebug, CLng(strParam)) Then
'go right n words on same line
elseif CodeUP("R1",1) And NoCodeUP("L,S,H",1) And CodeDN("R1",1) And NoCodeDN("L,S,H",1) Then
writelog("find closest R1 word coordinates")
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(L1,W1,L2,W2)
If L1=0 then L1=1
If L2=0 then L2=1
If W1=0 then W1=1
If W2=0 then W2=1
Up_xL = CCO.Item(L2-1).Item( (InStr(LineMapUp(1),"R1")+2) /3).Left
Up_yB = CCO.Item(L2-1).Item( (InStr(LineMapUp(1),"R1")+2) /3).bottom
Dn_xL = CCO.Item(L2+1).Item( (InStr(LineMapDN(1),"R1")+2) /3).Left
Dn_yT = CCO.Item(L2+1).Item( (InStr(LineMapDN(1),"R1")+2) /3).Top
CM = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Bottom - CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Top
CR = CCO.Item(L2).Item(W2).Right
DistUp = ( (Up_xL-CR)^2 + (Up_yB-CM)^2 )
DistDN = ( (Dn_xL-CR)^2 + (Dn_yT-CM)^2 )
writelog(Space(4) & "DistUP: " & DistUp & " DistDN: " & DistDN)
If CLng(DistUP) > CLng(DistDN) Then
writelog(Space(6) & "UPto")
Call GoUpTo(bInteractive, bDebug,"R1,1")
Else
writelog(Space(6) & "DNto")
Call GoDnTo(bInteractive, bDebug,"R1,1")
End If
elseif CodeUP("R1",1) And NoCodeUP("L,S,H",1) And countUP(1)=1 Then
writelog(Space(4) & "CodeUP('R1',1) And NoCodeUP('L,S,H',1)")
If countUP(1) = 1 Then Call GoUpTo(bInteractive, bDebug,"R1,1")
elseif CodeDN("R1",1) And NoCodeDN("L,S,H",1) And countDN(1) = 1 Then
writelog(Space(4) & "CodeDN('R1',1) And NoCodeDN('L,S,H',1)")
If countDN(1) = 1 Then Call GoDnTo(bInteractive, bDebug,"R1,1")
elseif CodeUP("R1",1) And NoCodeUP("S,LL,H",1) Then
writelog(Space(4) & "CodeUP('R1',1) And NoCodeUP('S,LL,H',1)")
Call GoUpto(bInteractive, bDebug,"R1,1")
elseif CodeDN("R1",1) And NoCodeDN("S,LL,H",1) Then
writelog(Space(4) & "CodeUP('R1',1) And NoCodeUP('S,LL,H',1)")
Call GoDNto(bInteractive, bDebug,"R1,1")
Else
ScanRT = False
writelog(Space(4) & "ScanRT = False")
End If
Writelog("ScanRT returns " & ScanRT)
Call ErrorHandler("Function ScanRT")

af.name: GroupWords
af.g:
'Long value of the maximum character width separating words to the right and left of the current word.
'Groups any words to the left and right of a located word if the target words are
'themselves separated by a character width equal to or less than the character
'width you specify as a parameter.
nSpaces = MetaWord(nSpaces)
writelog("Param: '" & nSpaces & "'")
GroupWords = GroupCCOWords(nSpaces, "ALL")

af.name: GroupNextWords
af.g:
' Long value of the maximum character width separating words to the right of the current word.
' Groups words to the right of the located word if the target words are separated
' by a character width equal to or less than the character width you specify as a parameter.
nSpaces = MetaWord(nSpaces)
writelog("Param: '" & nSpaces & "'")
GroupNextWords = GroupCCOWords(nSpaces, "RIGHT")
Call ErrorHandler("Function GroupNextWords")

af.name: GroupPreviousWords
af.g:
'Long value of the maximum character width separating words to the left of the current word.
' Groups only words to the left of the located word if the target words are
' separated by a character width equal to or less than the character width you specify as a parameter.
' GroupWordsLEFT was changed to GroupPreviousWords so the functionality makes sense for LTR and RTL text.
nSpaces = MetaWord(nSpaces)
writelog("Param: '" & nSpaces & "'")
GroupPreviousWords = GroupCCOWords(nSpaces, "LEFT")
Call ErrorHandler("Function GroupPreviousWords")

af.name: IsValue
af.g:
' The value to be compared to the object's recognized value.
' Determines if the recognized value of a word of the current page is identical
' to the value you enter as a parameter.
' If you want to check only a subset of the field, use ValueInField.
Dim lenV, ValueUP, cntV
IsValue = False
On error Resume Next
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
strParam = MetaWord(strParam)
writelog("Param: '" & strParam & "'")
value = GetCurrValue()
value = Trim(value)
WriteLog(Space(2) & "Looking for '" & Strparam & "'. Current CCO value is '" & value & "'.")
If Ucase(strParam) = Ucase(value) Then IsValue = True
If IsObject(LogWindow) Then
Call ShowCurrPosFromCCO()
End If

af.name: IsValue_RegEx
af.g:
' A Regular Expression that will be used for comparison with the recognized value of the word.
' Determines if the recognized value of a word of the current page is identical
' to the value you enter as a parameter. The parameter will be evaluated as
' as regular expression when compared to the recognized text.
Dim sValue
Dim bFound
IsValue_RegEx = False
StrParam = g_SmartParameterValue(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
On error Resume Next
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
Writelog("Search Value:" & StrParam)
bFound = False
sValue= Replace(GetCurrValue,"~"," ")
WriteLog(Space(2) & "Looking for " & Strparam & ". Current CCO value is " & svalue)
IgnoreCase = True
bFound = g_ValueMatch(sValue, StrParam, IgnoreCase)
If bFound = True Then
IsValue_RegEx = True
Else
writelog("No Matches Found")
End If
If IsObject(LogWindow) Then
Call ShowCurrPosFromCCO()
End If

af.name: ValueInField
af.g: 'The value that is to be matched with a portion of the value in the current field. ' Checks if the parameter you enter is within the value of the current field represented ' by the bound Field object of the Document Hierarchy. Only a portion of the field's ' value needs to match the parameter. If the entire field must match, use IsValue. Dim modStrParam Dim sValue Dim Match Dim Matches Dim bFound On Error Resume Next ValueInField = False bFound = False sValue= Space(1) & Replace(GetFieldValue,"~"," ") Writelog("Look in string: " & sValue) StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam) writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'") 'Check for and protect against RegEx reserved characters StrParam = DCGlobalStrings.RegExEscape(StrParam) Writelog("Parameter after regex escape: " & StrParam) IgnoreCase = True bFound = g_ValueMatch(sValue, StrParam, IgnoreCase) If bFound = True Then ValueInField = True Else writelog("No Matches Found") End If

af.name: ValueInField_RegEx
af.g:
' The portion of the value to find in the field. The parameter is expected
' to be expressed as a regular expression.
' This action checks if the Regular Expression you specify as the parameter
' is equivalent to the value of the current field. Only a part of the field must match
' the parameter. To match the entire value of the field, use IsValueRegEx.
Dim sValue
Dim bFound
On Error Resume Next
ValueInField_RegEx = False
StrParam = g_SmartParameterValue(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
Writelog("Search Value:" & StrParam)
bFound = False
sValue= Space(1) & Replace(GetFieldValue,"~"," ")
Writelog("Look in string: " & sValue)
IgnoreCase = True
bFound = g_ValueMatch(sValue, StrParam, IgnoreCase)
If bFound = True Then
ValueInField_RegEx = True
Else
writelog("No Matches Found")
End If

af.name: ValueInField_Fuzzy
af.g:
'String value to be matched to the current field's value, using fuzzy matching procedures.
'Checks if there is a "fuzzy" match of the parameter's value with the value in the current field.
'Only a portion of the field's value needs to match.
'The match is performed by allowing for common substitutions that can occur during
'recognition. These substitutions include characters: B8, Z2, S5, oO0 and iItl1.
Dim modStrParam
Dim sValue
Dim Match
Dim Matches
Dim bFound
Dim oValue
On Error Resume Next
ValueInField_Fuzzy = False
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
Writelog("Original Value:" & StrParam)
modStrParam = RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, StrParam)
bFound = False
sValue= Space(1) & Replace(GetFieldValue,"~"," ")
Writelog("Look in string: " & sValue)
IgnoreCase = True
bFound = g_ValueMatch(sValue, modStrParam, IgnoreCase)
If bFound = True Then
ValueInField_Fuzzy = True
Else
writelog("No Matches Found")
End If

af.name: WordFind_Offset
af.g:
' 1. String value of a keyword that the action is to find on both the fingerprint and recognized image.
' 2. An optional parameter that specifies the offset threshold. If not specified, the default value is 100 pixels.
' This action locates a word or phrase on both the recognized page and on the fingerprint.
' The positioning of both locations are compared to determine an offset value. The calculated
' difference is stored in the DCO of the current page in the variable Image_Offset. This value
' will be used by subsequent actions, such as ReadZones, to compensate for
' the difference so the field data is properly located.
Dim oPage
Dim nThreshold
Dim aStrParam
Dim Temp_CCO
Dim L,W
Dim nLiveTop, nLiveLeft
Dim nFPIDTop, nFPIDLeft
Dim nFPID
Dim sFPIDFile
Dim sSQL, aResult
Dim nOffSetX, nOffSetY
On Error Resume Next
WordFind_Offset = TRUE
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
Set oPage = CurrentObj
While not(oPage.ObjectType<=2)
Set oPage = oPage.Parent()
Wend
'Check for page object
If oPage.ObjectType <>2 then
Writelog("Calling DCO must be of Type PAGE")
Set oPage = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
'Check if page has a fingerprint ID
nFPID = oPage.Variable("TemplateID")
If len(nFPID)=0 or Not(Isnumeric(nFPID)) Then
Writelog("FingerPrint ID not found on Run Time CCO. Exiting Action.")
Set oPage = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
'Split & Check Parameters
aStrParam = Split(StrParam & "," , ",")
sKeyWord = aStrparam(0)
nThreshold = Trim(aStrParam(1))
If len(nThreshold)=0 or Not(Isnumeric(nThreshold)) Then
nThreshold = cint(100)
Else
Writelog("Distance Threshold is set to '" & nThreshold & "' pixels.")
nThreshold = cint(nThreshold)
End if
'Find Word & Positions on Live CCO
If Not(WordFind(bInter, bDebug,sKeyWord)) Then
Writelog("Keyword not found on Run Time CCO. Exiting Action.")
Set oPage = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(L,W)
If L=0 then L=1
If W=0 then W=1
nLiveTop = CCO.Item(L).Item(W).Top
nLiveLeft = CCO.Item(L).Item(W).Left
Writelog("LiveX=" & nLiveLeft & ", LiveY=" & nLiveTop)
'Find & Load Fingerprint CCO file
sSQL = "SELECT tp_CCOPath FROM Template WHERE tp_TemplateID=" & nFPID & ";"
aResult = GetDataArray(sSQL)
If IsNull(aResult(0,0)) or aResult(0,0)="" then
Writelog("Null or Empty Value returned from DB FPID file lookup. Exiting Action.")
Set oPage = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
sFPIDFile = aResult(0,0)
If Not FileMgr.FileExists(sFPIDFile) then
Writelog("File:" & sFPIDFile & " not found. Exiting Action.")
Set oPage = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
Set Temp_CCO = CCO
Set CCO = CCOCreator.Load(sFPIDFile)
If CCO is Nothing Then
Writelog("FPID CCO could not be loaded. Exiting Action.")
Set CCO = Temp_CCO
Set oPage = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
'Find Word & Positions on FPID CCO
If Not(WordFind(bInter, bDebug,sKeyWord)) Then
Writelog("Keyword not found on FPID CCO. Exiting Action.")
Set CCO = Temp_CCO
Set Temp_CCO = Nothing
Set oPage = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(L,W)
If L=0 then L=1
If W=0 then W=1
nFPIDTop = CCO.Item(L).Item(W).Top
nFPIDLeft = CCO.Item(L).Item(W).Left
Writelog("FPIDX=" & nLiveLeft & ", FPIDY=" & nLiveTop)
'Switch Page CCO back
Set CCO = Temp_CCO
Set Temp_CCO = Nothing
'Compare Live vs. FPID and calculate Offset
nOffSetX = nFPIDLeft - nLiveLeft
nOffSetY = nFPIDTop - nLiveTop
If (abs(nOffSetX)<= nThreshold) and (abs(nOffSetX)<= nThreshold) then
oPage.Variable("Image_Offset") = cstr(nOffsetX) & "," & cstr(nOffSetY)
Writelog("New OffSet Calculated: (" & cstr(nOffsetX) & "," & cstr(nOffSetY) & ").")
Else
Writelog("OffSet (" & cstr(nOffsetX) & "," & cstr(nOffSetY) & ") was beyond the Set threshold. Exiting Action")
End if
WordFind_Offset = True
Set oPage = Nothing

f.name: AggregateKeyList
f.g:
' Toggles Key list searches to merge all words in the list into a single query.
On Error Resume Next
g_bAggregateListSearch=SearchAll
AggregateKeyList=True

f.name: SetVirtualPageStartPosition
f.g:
' This action identifies the current position of the locate cursor as the start of the VPB. Before calling this action,
' the user will use the standard locate actions to locate the starting position of the VPB. Internally this will
' simply setup a variable that remembers the current locate position.
On Error Resume Next
SetVirtualPageStartPosition = false
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
If (CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2) Then
Writelog("Only page or field level is supported.")
exit function
End If
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(g_Saved_VPBStart_L1,g_Saved_VPBStart_W1,g_Saved_VPBStart_L2,g_Saved_VPBStart_W2)
' do we care if a locate hasn't been performed? Probably not.
writelog("Saved current CCO Pos: " & g_Saved_VPBStart_L1 & "," & g_Saved_VPBStart_W1 & " to " & g_Saved_VPBStart_L2 & "," & g_Saved_VPBStart_W2)
SetDocumentStuctureWordToCCOWord
if IsAlive(g_DLayout) Then
WriteLog("Saving information for VPB Start.")
SetVirtualPageStartPosition = g_DLayout.VPBSaveStartPosition()
Else
WriteLog("Error: The layout object was not loaded. Returning false.")
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function SetVirtualPageStartPosition")

f.name: SetVirtualPageEndPosition
f.g:
' This action identifies the current position of the locate cursor as the end of the VPB.
' Before calling this action, the user will use the standard locate actions to find the end of the VPB.
' Internally this will set an internal variable to the ending position of the block.
On Error Resume Next
SetVirtualPageEndPosition = false
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
If (CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2) Then
Writelog("Only page or field level is supported.")
exit function
End If
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(g_Saved_VPBEnd_L1,g_Saved_VPBEnd_W1,g_Saved_VPBEnd_L2,g_Saved_VPBEnd_W2)
writelog("Saved current CCO Pos: " & g_Saved_VPBEnd_L1 & "," & g_Saved_VPBEnd_W1 & " to " & g_Saved_VPBEnd_L2 & "," & g_Saved_VPBEnd_W2)
SetDocumentStuctureWordToCCOWord
if IsAlive(g_DLayout) Then
WriteLog("Saving information for VPB End.")
SetVirtualPageEndPosition = g_DLayout.VPBSaveEndPosition()
Else
WriteLog("Error: The layout object was not loaded. Returning false.")
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function SetVirtualPageStartPosition")

f.name: CreateVirtualZone
f.g:
' This action requires that SetVirtualPageStartPosition and SetVirtualEndPosition have been called.
' This action then does the work to create the field and set the zone coordinates to the position,
' based on the virtual page coordinates.
On Error Resume Next
CreateVirtualZone = false
if (not LoadDocStructurePage) Then Exit Function
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
' This action must be called on page or field level.
sPageType = MetaWord(sPageType)
if IsAlive(g_DLayout) Then
WriteLog("Creating VPB")
g_DLayout.DatacapRRCurrentDCO = CurrentObj
g_DLayout.DatacapRRDCO = DCO
CreateVirtualZone = g_DLayout.VPBCreateVirtualZone(sFieldName)
Else
WriteLog("Error: The layout object was not loaded. Returning false.")
End If
If (CreateVirtualZone) Then
'Get the child field object
Set theField = CurrentObj.FindChild(sFieldName)
WriteLog("----- SnapCCO2DCO for: " & theField.ID & " -----")
goSnapper.SnapCCOtoDCO theField
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function CreateVirtualZone")

f.name: CreateVirtualZoneFullWidth
f.g:
' This action requires that SetVirtualPageStartPosition and SetVirtualEndPosition have been called.
' This action then does the work to create the field and set the zone coordinates to the position,
' based on the virtual page coordinates. It will expand the width of the zone to include all text within the top and bottom points
On Error Resume Next
CreateVirtualZone = false
if (not LoadDocStructurePage) Then Exit Function
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
' This action must be called on page or field level.
sPageType = MetaWord(sPageType)
if IsAlive(g_DLayout) Then
WriteLog("Creating VPB")
g_DLayout.DatacapRRCurrentDCO = CurrentObj
g_DLayout.DatacapRRDCO = DCO
CreateVirtualZone = g_DLayout.VPBCreateVirtualZoneFullWidth(sFieldName)
Else
WriteLog("Error: The layout object was not loaded. Returning false.")
End If
If (CreateVirtualZone) Then
'Get the child field object
Set theField = CurrentObj.FindChild(sFieldName)
WriteLog("----- SnapCCO2DCO for: " & theField.ID & " -----")
goSnapper.SnapCCOtoDCO theField
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function CreateVirtualZone")

f.name: CreateVirtualPage
f.g:
' This action requires that SetVirtualPageStartPosition and SetVirtualEndPosition have been called.
' This action then does the work to create the extracted portion of the text,
' creating the new page that contains only the designated block.
On Error Resume Next
CreateVirtualPage = false
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
' Because start and end must be previously called, this action can be run on any level.
sPageType = MetaWord(sPageType)
if IsAlive(g_DLayout) Then
WriteLog("Creating VPB")
g_DLayout.DatacapRRCurrentDCO = CurrentObj
g_DLayout.DatacapRRDCO = DCO
CreateVirtualPage = g_DLayout.VPBCreateVirualPage(Pilot.BatchDir, sPageType) '(DCO)
Else
WriteLog("Error: The layout object was not loaded. Returning false.")
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function CreateVirtualPage")

f.name: LocatePositionSave
f.g:
On Error Resume Next
LocatePositionSave = false
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
If (CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2) Then
Writelog("Only page or field level is supported.")
exit function
End If
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(g_Saved_L1,g_Saved_W1,g_Saved_L2,g_Saved_W2)
' do we care if a locate hasn't been performed? Probably not.
writelog("Saved current CCO Pos: " & g_Saved_L1 & "," & g_Saved_W1 & " to " & g_Saved_L2 & "," & g_Saved_W2)
if IsAlive(g_DLayout) Then
WriteLog("Saving current block information")
Call g_DLayout.BlockPositionSave()
End If
LocatePositionSave = true
Call ErrorHandler("Function LocatePositionSave")

f.name: LocatePositionRestore
f.g:
On Error Resume Next
LocatePositionRestore = false
If IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
If (CurrentObj.ObjectType < 2) Then
Writelog("Only page or field level is supported.")
exit function
End If
Call CCO.SetCurrentPosition(g_Saved_L1,g_Saved_W1,g_Saved_L2,g_Saved_W2)
writelog("Restored CCO Pos: " & g_Saved_L1 & "," & g_Saved_W1 & " to " & g_Saved_L2 & "," & g_Saved_W2)
if IsAlive(g_DLayout) Then
WriteLog("Saving current block information")
Call g_DLayout.BlockPositionRestore()
End If
LocatePositionRestore = true
Call ErrorHandler("Function LocatePositionRestore")

f.name: Find_IgnoreCase
f.g:
' Toggles regular expression searches character case default.
' By default searches are case sensitive.
On Error Resume Next
g_LocateIgnoreCase=IgnoreCase
Find_IgnoreCase=True

Opens the Keyword file you specify as a parameter, starting from the location of a previous find, this action checks the words or phrases on the current page against the keywords in the list to find a match. The entries in the keyword file are expected to be regular expressions.
To perform the action, the search first looks for the first word or phrase in the keyword file. Starting from the location of the last find, if the word is found, the search stops. If no match is found, the next line from the keyword file is read and again the search starts from the result of a previous find. This process continues until a match is found or all of the lines in the keyword file have been read. The location of the found word or phrase that matches an entry in the keyword file will be remembered so the result can be used by subsequent actions. Word matching is case sensitive.

Starting from a word or phrase found by a previous Locate action, the current location position is moved to the previous words on the current line by the number of words indicated by the input parameter. Subsequent Locate actions can then perform additional operations on this new located word position.
Regardless of being called at the page or field level, this action operates on the recognized text for the current page.
The internal location position is moved to the previous word based on the reading order of the text. The movement will be perceived as a left directional movement on left-to-right text. The movement will be perceived as a right directional movement on right-to-left text.
Note: If the action is added with an empty or non-numeric parameter, the action will default the argument to '1'.
This action is always called after a search action has been used.
WordFind("Total")
GoPreviousWord("1")
GoBelowWord("1")
UpdateField()
In this example, the locate action WordFind will search the entire page, from top to bottom, looking for the word "Total". Once found, the internal word pointer will move to the previous word, then to the word below the word. The field associated with this ruleset will have it's zone coordinates updated with the position of the current word.
Given this scenario where the page has a table with columns such as Tax and Total similar to this:
Tax Total
344.76 13,774.00
The actions above will locate the Tax amount 344.76 and set the field zone to that word.
Page or field level. True if a word is found. Otherwise, False.

ScanRT (scan right) looks for a word in positions that are slightly above or below the line on which the current word or phrase is located.
WordFind("Number")
ScanRT("1")
This sequence first finds "Number" on the current page, then moves one word to the right as it searches for a value.
To compensate for the possibility that this value may be printed slightly above or below the line on which "Number" was printed, the ScanRT action expands the area in which the target value can reside. When a page is recognized, skewing or data layout may cause alignment problems. Words that are thought of as being on the same line, may not have been recognized as being on the same line, but slightly above or below the current line. This action compensates for that anomaly when looking for words right of the current word location. It uses a calculation adjustment to determine which of the words to the right of the current word, should be considered to be on the same line. It will then remember the location of the word that best fits this criteria. This new remembered location can then be utilized by subsequent actions.

Note that this action is currently released as a preview. The action is supported however the functionality may change in the next release, which may require an update to your application.
This action utilizes the document block layout created by the Document Analytics actions. The currently selected block, which denotes an area on the page, is changed to the containing block. This will effectively make the new area of interest larger than the previous area.
For example, if the currently selected block is a word, when SelectParentBlock is called, the selected word remains the same, but the area of interest is changed to the parent block, which would be the entire line. Subsequent actions that act on the current block will now respect the line as the area of interest on the page.
Calling SelectParentBlock again would move the selected block to the parent of the line. The block selected will depend on the layout of the page. One typical scenario is that the selected block will now be a paragraph that contains multiple lines, including the word that was previously found. Any block actions, such as additional searches, will be performed within the boundaries of this newly selected paragraph block.
While the block nesting layout typically follows the same pattern, the layout of blocks will depend on the layout of text on the page. For predictable results, the application rules may need to work on expected layouts based on the page types supported by the application.
It is very important to be aware that the block logic is subject to the block structure identified by the recognition engine. For a given page, it is likely that the block structure identified by one recognition engine will be different from another recognition engine. If two similar looking pages are provided to the same recognition engine, it is possible for there to be significantly different block structures identified for the text on the page. It is also possible that when a specific engine is upgraded to a new version, the way in which it detects blocks on the page can change, requiring the application logic to change with the upgrade. When using the "block" oriented locate commands, perform sufficient testing confirm that the blocks structure is operating reliably enough for the needs of the application.
RegExFind_InBlock("Da.e")
SelectParentBlock()
SelectParentBlock()
UpdateFieldWithBlock()
RegExFind_InBlock will look for the first occurrence of a word or phrase that matches the regular expression. If a match is found, the next action will change the currently selected block from the found word to the entire line that contains the word. SelectParentBlock is then called again to change the selected block to the parent of the current line, then the current field zone is updated to contain the entire set of lines contained in the current block and the field value is set to all of the text within the current block.

If the currently selected block has multiple parent blocks of the same type, then the parent nearest to the current block would be selected.
If the current block is of the specified type, then the action will return true and the selected block will remain at the current block. When starting a new search after performing previous searches, it may be useful to call this action with type "Page" to reset the selected block to the page block so the entire page block area can be searched again using the "block" actions.
It is very important to be aware that the block logic is subject to the block structure identified by the recognition engine. For a given page, it is likely that the block structure identified by one recognition engine will be different from another recognition engine. If two similar looking pages are provided to the same recognition engine, it is possible for there to be significantly different block structures identified for the text on the page. It is also possible that when a specific engine is upgraded to a new version, the way in which it detects blocks on the page can change, requiring the application logic to change with the upgrade. When using the "block" oriented locate commands, perform sufficient testing confirm that the blocks structure is operating reliably enough for the needs of the application. The Locate actions that do not use blocks are more resilient to the detected formatting and do not use the block structure detected by the engine.

LocatePositionSave creates a restore point for the current word position of the locate pointer. After calling additional locate actions that change the word location of locate pointer, the previously saved position can be restored using the LocatePositionRestore action.
Using LocatePositionSave and LocatePositionRestore together provides an efficient way to reset the position to a located word, when the subsequent locate actions have moved the pointer to a located word. For example, when rules need to look for text in multiple directions based on a found word, these actions efficiently reset the internal locate pointer to a saved position instead of performing the original locate action a second time, which can require more processing time.
