f.name: CalculateDateDifference
f.g:
On error Resume Next
Dim locale
CalculateDateDifference=True
startDate = Trim(MetaWord(startDate))
endDate = Trim(MetaWord(endDate))
dateProperty = MetaWord(dateProperty)
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
Writelog("startDate = " & startDate & ". endDate = " & endDate & ". dateProperty = " & dateProperty & " Locale = " & locale & ".")
If Not DCGlobalDates.IsDate(startDate, locale) Then
CalculateDateDifference = False
sMessage = "The startDate value of '{1}' is not a valid date or recognised date format."
' sMessage = RRState.Loadstring("validations","IsFieldDate_01","The date value of '{1}' is not a valid date or recognised date format.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",startDate)
' DCOMessage(sMessage)
Writelog("Start date error: " & sMessage)
End if
If Not DCGlobalDates.IsDate(endDate, locale) Then
CalculateDateDifference = False
sMessage = "The endDate value of '{1}' is not a valid date or recognised date format."
' sMessage = RRState.Loadstring("validations","IsFieldDate_01","The date value of '{1}' is not a valid date or recognised date format.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",endDate)
' DCOMessage(sMessage)
Writelog("End date error: " & sMessage)
End if
dim result
result = DCGlobalDates.SubtractDates(startDate,endDate, dateProperty, locale)
Writelog(DCGlobalDates.GetLog())
Writelog("SubtractDates result: " & result)
If len(targetVariable) = 0 Then targetVariable = DCONavType()
targetVariable = Trim(targetVariable)
CalculateDateDifference = DCONavSetValue(targetVariable, result)

af.name: AssignFieldDefault
af.g:
' Assigns a default value to the current field.
On Error Resume Next
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
If Not(CurrentObj is Nothing) then
CurrentObj.Clear
AssignFieldDefault = u_ModifyText("","",1,StrParam)
Elseif not(isObject(LogWindow)) then
AssignFieldDefault = False
WriteLog("AssignFieldDefault returns " & AssignFieldDefault)
Exit Function
end If
WriteLog("AssignFieldDefault returns " & AssignFieldDefault)

af.name: IsFieldLengthMax
af.g:
' Checks that the character length of the current Field object's captured value is equal to
' or less than the value set as a parameter..
On Error Resume Next
Dim wCount, msg, locale
Dim Value
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = " "
IsFieldLengthMax = False
Value = GetFieldValue()
wCount = Len(DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(Value,"\p{Mn}",""))
If DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(StrParam, locale) Then
If wCount <= CInt(StrParam) Then
IsFieldLengthMax = True
End If
Else
msg = vbCr & "Parameter is not Numeric."
End If
WriteLog("IsFieldLengthMax is " & StrParam & " character(s). Character count is " & wCount & msg)
WriteLog("IsFieldLengthMax returns: " & IsFieldLengthMax)
If IsFieldLengthMax = False Then
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldLengthMax_01","Field '{0}' value of '{1}' is too long. The field has {3} characters and the maximum allowed length is {2}.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",GetFieldValue())
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{2}",StrParam)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{3}",wCount)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function IsFieldLengthMax")

af.name: IsFieldLengthMin
af.g:
' Checks the character length of the current Field object's captured value to see if its
' length is equal to or longer than a number <var>n</var>
On Error Resume Next
Dim wCount, msg, locale
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
IsFieldLengthMin = False
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
If IsNull(StrParam) Then WriteLog("IsFieldLengthMin: Invalid Parameter '" & strParam & "' . Function Failed")
wCount = Len(DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(GetFieldValue(),"\p{Mn}",""))
Debuglog("IsFieldLengthMin: Start Value = '" & GetFieldValue() & "' Length = " & wCount)
If DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(StrParam, locale) Then
If wCount >= CInt(StrParam) Then
IsFieldLengthMin = True
End If
Else
msg = vbCr & "Parameter is not Numeric."
End If
WriteLog("IsFieldLengthMin is " & StrParam & " character(s). Character count is " & wCount & msg)
WriteLog("IsFieldLengthMin returns: " & IsFieldLengthMin)
If IsFieldLengthMin = False Then
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldLengthMin_01","Field '{0}' value of '{1}' is too short. The field has {3} characters and the minium allowed length is {2}.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",GetFieldValue())
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{2}",StrParam)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{3}",wCount)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function IsFieldLengthMin")

af.name: InsertChars
af.g:
' 1. The characters or character string to be inserted; defaults to a space.
' 2. A number n indicating the target position within the captured value;
' defaults to the end of the value.
' 3. The number of insertions; defaults to 1.
'
' Inserts a character or string of characters into the captured value, one or more times.
On Error Resume Next
Dim l,w,c
Dim w_left,v_top,w_right,v_bottom
Dim aStrParam, PlaceAt, sInsert, addPos, Cx
Dim Tstring
Dim locale
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
StrParam = StrParam & ", , "
Value = GetFieldValue()
CurCount = Len(GetFieldValue())
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = " , ,1"
aStrParam = Split(StrParam &",," ,",")
If DCGlobalCurrency.isnumeric(aStrParam(1),locale) then
If aStrParam(1) < 1 Then Exit Function
End if
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(aStrParam(1),locale) Or aStrParam(1) = " " Then
aStrParam(1) = CurCount + 1
Else
PlaceAt = aStrParam(1)
End If
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(aStrParam(2),locale) Then aStrParam(2) = "1"
sInsert = aStrParam(0) 'string to insert
PlaceAt = aStrParam(1) 'position to insert
iNumber = aStrParam(2) 'times to insert
WriteLog("InsertChars Insert String '" & sInsert & "' starting at position# '" & PlaceAt & "' , '" & iNumber & "' times.")
Tstring = ""
If CInt(CurCount) < CInt(PlaceAt) Then PlaceAt = CurCount + 1
If Len(sInsert)= 0 Then sInsert = " "
For Cnt = 1 To CInt(iNumber)
Tstring = Tstring & sInsert
Next 'Cnt
Writelog("Inserting value:'" & Tstring & "'")
if CurrentObj is Nothing then exit Function
For xChar = 1 To Len(Tstring)
NewValue = Mid(Tstring,xChar,1)
Set oNewChar = CurrentObj.AddChild(4,"",PlaceAt-1)
Writelog("Adding character '" & NewValue & "' to position '" & PlaceAt)
nChar = oNewChar.AddValue(CLng(Ascw(NewValue)), CLng(9))
bRes = oNewChar.SetPosition(clng(0),clng(0),clng(0),clng(0))
Set oNewChar = Nothing
PlaceAt = PlaceAt + 1
Next 'xChar
WriteLog("Field value after InsertChars is '" & GetFieldValue() & "' ")
InsertChars = True

af.name: AddPaddingToEnd
af.g:
' A number <var>n</var> indicating the maximum permissible length of the value. If the
' action finds that a value's length is less than this number, it will insert spaces until
' the maximum length is reached.
'
' Pads the current Field object's captured value with spaces to the right.
Dim locale
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
On Error Resume Next
CurCount = Len(GetFieldValue())
strParam = MetaWord(strParam)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.isnumeric(strParam, locale) then
Writelog("Parameter must be numeric. '" & StrParam & "' is not a numeric value")
Exit function
end if
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = CurCount
ActionNum = Abs(CInt(strParam)) - CurCount
If cint(ActionNum)>cint(0) then
WriteLog("AddPaddingToEnd: add " & ActionNum & " space(s)")
AddPaddingToEnd = InsertChars(bInteractive, bDebug, Space(ActionNum) & "," & CurCount+1 & ",1")
Else
WriteLog("Field Value is greater or equal to parameter '" & StrParam & "' no padding will be performed.")
AddPaddingToEnd = True
End if

af.name: AddPaddingToStart
af.g:
' A number <var>n</var> indicating the maximum permissible length of the value. If the
' action finds that a value's length is less than this number, it will insert spaces
' until the maximum length is reached.
'
' Pads the current Field object's captured value with spaces to the left of the first character.
Dim locale
On Error Resume Next
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
strParam = MetaWord(strParam)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.isnumeric(strParam, locale) then
Writelog("Parameter must be numeric. '" & StrParam & "' is not a numeric value")
Exit function
End if
CurCount = Len(GetFieldValue())
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = CurCount
ActionNum = Abs(CInt(strParam)) - CurCount
If cint(ActionNum)>cint(0) then
WriteLog("AddPaddingToStart: add " & ActionNum & " space(s)")
AddPaddingToStart = InsertChars(bInteractive, bDebug,Space(ActionNum) & ",1,1")
Else
WriteLog("Field Value is greater or equal to parameter '" & StrParam & "' no padding will be performed.")
AddPaddingToStart = True
End if

af.name: TrimSpaces
af.g:
' Deletes extra spaces at the beginning and end of the current Field object's captured value.
Dim CurCount
Dim Value
Dim Tcnt
Dim nChilds
Dim bRes
On Error Resume Next
Value = GetFieldValue()
CurCount = Len(Value)
nChilds = CurrentObj.Numofchildren - CurCount
Tcnt = 0
Writelog("Start Value'" & Value & "'")
If not(CurrentObj is Nothing) then
CharValue = 0
If len(CurrentObj.Text) > 0 then CharValue = CurrentObj.Getchild(nChilds).CharValue(0)
While clng(CharValue)= clng(32)
bRes = CurrentObj.DeleteChild(nChilds)
CharValue = 0
If len(CurrentObj.Text) > 0 then CharValue = CurrentObj.Getchild(nChilds).CharValue(0)
Tcnt = Tcnt + 1
Wend
If len(CurrentObj.Text) > 0 then CharValue = CurrentObj.Getchild(CurrentObj.Numofchildren-1).CharValue(0)
While clng(CharValue)= clng(32)
bRes = CurrentObj.DeleteChild(CurrentObj.Numofchildren-1)
CharValue = 0
If len(CurrentObj.Text) > 0 then CharValue = CurrentObj.Getchild(CurrentObj.Numofchildren-1).CharValue(0)
Tcnt = Tcnt + 1
Wend
End if
TrimSpaces = True
WriteLog("TrimSpaces: " & Tcnt & " position(s) trimmed.")

af.name: TruncateFromStart
af.g:
' A number that is the value's maximum length.
'
' This action deletes characters from the start of the current object's captured
' value until the value's length equals the length specified by the parameter.
Dim locale
Dim value
Dim bRes
Dim nVLen
On Error Resume Next
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
Value = GetFieldValue()
TruncateFromStart = False
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.isnumeric(strParam,locale) then
Writelog("Parameter must be numeric. '" & StrParam & "' is not a numeric value")
Exit function
end if
'LenT counts text length not byte length.
nVLen = clng(LenT(Value))
If nVLen > Clng(StrParam) Then
Writelog("Start Field Value:'" & Value & "' ")
If not (CurrentObj is Nothing) then
Do While nVLen>clng(StrParam)
bRes = CurrentObj.DeleteChild(0)
Value = GetFieldValue()
nVLen = clng(LenT(Value))
loop
End if
Value = GetFieldValue()
Writelog("New Field Value:'" & Value & "' ")
End If
TruncateFromStart = True
WriteLog("TruncateFromStart returns " & TruncateFromStart)

af.name: TruncateFromEnd
af.g:
' A Number <var>n</var> that is the value's maximum length.
' This action deletes characters from the end of the current object's captured value until the value's length equals the length indicated by the parameter.
On Error Resume Next
Dim Value
Dim locale
Dim nVLen
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
Value = GetFieldValue()
TruncateFromEnd = False
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.isnumeric(StrParam, locale) then
Writelog("Parameter must be numeric. '" & StrParam & "' is not a numeric value")
Exit function
End if
nVLen = clng(LenT(Value))
If nVLen > clng(StrParam) Then
Writelog("Start Field Value:'" & Value & "' length:'" & cstr(nVLen) & "'.")
If not (CurrentObj is Nothing) then
Do While nVLen > clng(StrParam)
DeleteLastPos = Len(GetFieldValue)-1
If DeleteLastPos<0 then Exit Do
bRes = CurrentObj.DeleteChild(DeleteLastPos)
'Writelog("Deleting character at position:'" & DeleteLastPos & "'.")
Value = GetFieldValue()
nVLen = clng(LenT(Value))
Loop
End if
Value = GetFieldValue()
End If
Writelog("End Field Value:'" & Value & "' ")
TruncateFromEnd = True
WriteLog("TruncateFromEnd returns " & TruncateFromEnd)

af.name: AddLeadingZeros
af.g:
' A number <var>n</var> which is the value's maximum length.
' Adds zeros ("0") to the beginning of the current Field object's captured value until the value's total length reaches the maximum n you specify as the parameter.
Dim CurCount
Dim ActionNum
Dim locale
On Error Resume Next
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
AddLeadingZeros = True
strParam = MetaWord(strParam)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.isnumeric(strParam, locale) then
Writelog("Parameter must be numeric. '" & StrParam & "' is not a numeric value")
AddLeadingZeros = False
Exit function
End if
CurCount = LenT(GetFieldValue())
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = CurCount
ActionNum = Abs(clng(strParam)) - CurCount
WriteLog("Adding " & cstr(ActionNum) & " leading Zeros.")
If clng(ActionNum)>clng(0) then
AddLeadingZeros = InsertChars(bInteractive, bDebug,String(ActionNum,"0") & ",1,1")
End if

af.name: AddTrailingZeros
af.g:
' A number <var>n</var> which is the value's maximum length.
' Adds zeros ("0") to the end of the current Field's captured value until the value's length reaches the maximum <var>n</var> you enter as the parameter.
Dim CurCount
Dim ActionNum
Dim locale
On Error Resume Next
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
AddTrailingZeros = True
strParam = MetaWord(strParam)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.isnumeric(strParam, locale) then
Writelog("Parameter must be numeric. '" & StrParam & "' is not a numeric value")
AddTrailingZeros = False
Exit function
end if
CurCount = LenT(GetFieldValue())
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = CurCount
ActionNum = Abs(Clng(strParam)) - CurCount
WriteLog("Adding " & cstr(ActionNum) & " trailing zeros.")
If clng(ActionNum)>clng(0) then
AddTrailingZeros = InsertChars(bInteractive, bDebug, String(ActionNum,"0") & "," & CurCount+1 & ",1")
End If

af.name: DeleteSelectedChars
af.g:
' The character or string of characters to be deleted.
' A number indicating the starting index within the string to start deletion. If this parameter
' is blank or is not a number, the starting index value will default to 1, the first position in the string.
' The number of times the character or character string is to be deleted from the
' value. The default is "1" and "*" deletes all instances.
'
' Deletes specific characters from the current Field object's captured value.
On Error Resume Next
'Added support for smart parameters
'StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
StrParam = StrParam & ",,"
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = ",,1"
aStrParam = Split(StrParam,",")
delChars = MetaWord(aStrParam(0))
if IsEmpty(delChars) Then
delCars = aStrParam(0)
end if
WriteLog("Delete string = '" & delChars & "'")
DeleteSelectedChars = u_ModifyText(delChars, aStrParam(1), aStrParam(2),"")
WriteLog("DeleteSelectedChars end value: '" & GetFieldValue() & "' ")

af.name: DeleteAllAlpha
af.g:
On Error Resume next
Dim sResult
Dim sExpression
'Deletes all alphabetic characters from the current Field object's captured value.
' \p{L} or \p{Letter}: any kind of letter from any language.
' \p{Mn} : a non spacing mark - required for non composed characters.
'Expression to match all letters from any language
'sExpression = "\p{L}+"
'Expression to match all letters with and without upto two trailing non spacing mark characters.
sExpression = "(\p{L}\p{Mn}{0,2})+"
sResult = DCGlobalStrings.RemoveReplace(sExpression,cint(0),"",cint(0), CurrentObj)
DeleteAllAlpha=True
WriteLog("Alphabetic characters deleted")

af.name: DeleteAllNumeric
af.g:
On Error Resume next
Dim sResult
'Removes all Numeric characters from the current Field object's captured value.
' \p{N} or \p{Number}: any kind of numeric character in any script.
sResult = DCGlobalStrings.RemoveReplace("\p{N}+",cint(0),"",cint(0), CurrentObj)
DeleteAllNumeric=TRUE

af.name: DeleteAllPunct
af.g:
On Error Resume Next
Dim sResult
DeleteAllPunct=TRUE
' Removes all punctuation characters current Field object's captured value.
' \p{P} or \p{Punctuation}: any kind of punctuation character.
sResult = DCGlobalStrings.RemoveReplace("\p{P}+",cint(0),"",cint(0), CurrentObj)

af.name: DeleteAllMiscChars
af.g:
On Error Resume next
Dim sResult
'Removes all characters with ASCII values 123 through 191 from the current Field object's captured value.
' \p{S} or \p{Symbol}: math symbols, currency signs, dingbats, box-drawing characters, etc..
sResult = DCGlobalStrings.RemoveReplace("\p{S}+",cint(0),"",cint(0), CurrentObj)
DeleteAllMiscChars = True

af.name: DeleteAllSysChars
af.g:
On Error Resume next
Dim sResult
' The action removes all characters with ASCII values 0 through 31 from the current
' object's captured value.
' \p{C} or \p{Other}: invisible control characters and unused code points.
sResult=DCGlobalStrings.RemoveReplace("\p{C}+",cint(0),"",cint(0), CurrentObj)
DeleteAllSysChars = True
WriteLog("System characters deleted")

af.name: FilterFieldSelectedChars
af.g:
' A String containing the character(s) to be removed.
' Every instance of the character(s) will be removed from the captured value.
' Removes all instances of the character(s) you enter as the parameter from the current
' Field object's captured value.
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
StrParam = rr_EscapeRegExProtectedChars(StrParam)
FilterFieldSelectedChars = u_RemoveReplace("[" & Strparam &"]+",1,"","*")
WriteLog("'" & StrParam & "' character(s) removed from field value")

af.name: ReplaceChars
af.g:
' The character or string of characters to be replaced; defaults to a space. SmartParameter Enabled.
' The character(s) of the replacement String. SmartParameter Enabled.
' The number of times replacement is to occur. The default is "1" and "*" replaces all instances.
'
' Replaces a character or string of characters in the current Field object's captured value with a String you enter as one of the parameters.
Dim sFind, sPush, iIndex
Dim sFindMW, sPushMW
Dim locale
On Error Resume Next
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
ReplaceChars=False
StrParam = StrParam & ",,"
aStrParam = Split(StrParam,",")
If Len(aStrParam(0)) = 0 Then aStrParam(0) = " "
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(aStrParam(2), locale) And Not(Trim(aStrParam(2)) = "*") Then aStrParam(2) = 1
sFind = aStrParam(0)
sPush = aStrParam(1)
iIndex = aStrParam(2)
sFindMW = MetaWord(sFind)
sPushMW = MetaWord(sPush)
'Only use MetaWord result if it returns a value
If sFindMW<>"" Then sFind=sFindMW
If sPushMW<>"" Then sPush=sPushMW
If sFind="" Then
Writelog("String to replace (search string) is empty.")
Exit Function
End if
ReplaceChars = u_ModifyText(sFind,1,iIndex,sPush)
WriteLog("ReplaceChars new field value is '" & GetFieldValue & "'")

af.name: AllowOnlyChars
af.g:
' Two actions exist with the same name so single source the code by calling AllowOnlyCharacters
'WriteLog("Validations - AllowOnlyChars")
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
AllowOnlyChars = AllowOnlyCharacters(StrParam)

af.name: DateStampField
af.g:
'A Date format such as mm/dd/yy or dd/mm/yy. (* defaults to mm/dd/yyyy)
'Updates the current Field object with today's date.
Dim dd,ddd,mm,yyyy,yy,y,m,d,mmm
Dim sPattern, sReplace, bIgnoreCase
DateStampField = True
'Updates field with current Date value
'Strparam is the pattern to update the field with
'Value: '*' sets to default value
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
if strParam = "" then strParam = "*"
'Check Parameter for invalid chars
Dim sCheck
sCheck = Ucase(StrParam)
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"C","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ," ","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"/","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"-","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,".","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"&","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"DAY","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"MONTH","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"YEAR","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"JULIAN","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"Y","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"D","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"M","")
If (len(trim(sCheck))>0 AND (not "*" = trim(sCheck)))then
Writelog("Invalid characters in parameter:'" & sCheck & "' ")
end if
'End Check
If InStr(StrParam,"*")>0 Then StrParam = "mm/dd/yyyy"
StrParam = Trim(StrParam)
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"c","y")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam," "," & CHR(32) &")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"/"," & CHR(47) &")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"-"," & CHR(45) &")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"."," & CHR(46) &")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"& &","&")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"day","dd")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"month","mm")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"year","yyyy")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"julian","y")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"jjj","y")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"j","y")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"yd","y & d")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"ym","y & m")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"my","m & y")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"md","m & d")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"dy","d & y")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"dm","d & m")
sPattern = "& *&"
sReplace = "&"
bIgnoreCase = False
'RegExReplace(string value, string pattern, string replacewith, bool ignorecase = false)
StrParam = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(StrParam, sPattern, sReplace, bIgnoreCase)
WriteLog("Strparam after character substitution:'" & StrParam & "' ")
d = Day(Now)
dd = Right("0" & d,2)
yyyy = Year(Now)
yy = Right(yyyy,2)
m = Month(Now)
mm = Right("0" & m,2)
mmm = MonthName(Month(Now), True)
ccyy = yyyy
y = DatePart("y",Now)
CurrentObj.Text = Eval(Strparam)
WriteLog("DateStampField returns True. Date value: '" & CurrentObj.text & "'")
Call ErrorHandler("Function DateStampField")
Set RX = Nothing

af.name: TimeStampField
af.g:
' A time format (for example, HH:MM:SS, or HH:MM.)
' * defaults to HH:MM:SS
Dim mm,ss,hh,hhhh,m,s,h
TimeStampField = True
'Updates field with current Time value
'Strparam is the pattern to update the field with
'Value: '*' sets to default value
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
'Check Parameter for invalid chars
Dim sCheck
sCheck = Ucase(StrParam)
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"M","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"H","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"S","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,":","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ," ","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"/","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"&","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"MIN","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"MINUTE","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"SEC","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"SECOND","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"HR","")
sCheck = Replace(sCheck ,"HOUR","")
If len(trim(sCheck))>0 then
Writelog("Invalid characters in parameter:'" & sCheck & "' ")
End if
'End Check
If Trim(StrParam) = "*" Then StrParam = "HH:MM:SS"
StrParam = Trim(StrParam)
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"/"," & CHR(47) &")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam," "," & CHR(32) &")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,":"," & CHR(58) &")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"& &","&")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"min","mm")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"minute","mm")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"sec","ss")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"second","ss")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"hr","hh")
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"hour","hh")
WriteLog("Strparam after character substitution:'" & StrParam & "' ")
m = Minute(Now)
s = Second(Now)
h = Hour(Now)
hhhh = hh
mm = Right("0" & m,2)
ss = Right("0" & s,2)
hh = Right("0" & h,2)
CurrentObj.Text = Eval(StrParam)
WriteLog("TimeStampField returns True. Time value: " & CurrentObj.text)

af.name: SetIsOverrideable
af.g:
' Specifies that if the validation fails for the current object, If it is non-overrideable
' or overrideable by the user.
' This status may prevent an operator from overriding a field's validations
' and then continuing to subsequent pages.
' IMPORTANT! - THIS IS A DUPLICATE NAMED METHOD WHICH ALSO EXISTS IN RRUNNER. Which one is called is determined by the load order,
' It doesn't matter which one is called out in Datacap Studio. THIS IS A VB LIMITATION and why we should NEVER have duplicate named VB actions.
' BOTH THE Validation and rrunner versions MUST be kept identical.
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
Set oBatch = CurrentObj ' Find the batch node - Even though we are likely on a field, RuleRunnerLogic will check the batch node after at the end of the rules.
While oBatch.ObjectType > 0
Set oBatch = oBatch.Parent
Wend
WriteLog("SetIsOverrideable parameter is " & StrParam)
If Ucase(StrParam) = Ucase("True") Then
nDefaultRtn = nRtn_Over
oBatch.Variable("nDefaultRtn")="1" ' 1 = can override - This is for compatability with RuleRunnerLogic which needs to use the DCO variable.
WriteLog("Validation Setting Rule to Overrideable.")
Else
nDefaultRtn = nRtn_Fail
oBatch.Variable("nDefaultRtn")="2" ' 2 = cannot override - This is for compatability with RuleRunnerLogic which needs to use the DCO variable.
WriteLog("Validation Setting Rule to NON Overrideable.")
End If
SetIsOverrideable = True

af.name: IsFieldDateUpToToday
af.g:
'Checks that the current Field object's Date value is today's date or earlier.
Dim Value
Dim dNow
Dim locale
Dim sCompare
IsFieldDateUpToToday = False
value = Trim(GetFieldValue())
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
If len(Trim(value))=0 then
Writelog("Field value is empty. Exiting Action.")
Exit Function
End if
'Check Date
If DCGlobalDates.IsDate(Value,locale) then
writelog("Current field value ( " & value & " ) is a valid Date value.")
Else
sReturn = RRState.LoadString("validations","InvalidDate_01","Field '{0}' date value of '{1}' is not a valid date or recognized date format.")
sReturn = replace(sReturn,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sReturn = replace(sReturn,"{1}",CurrentObj.Text)
DCOMessage(sReturn)
Exit Function
End if
Call Writelog(DCGlobalDates.GetLog)
'dNow = cstr(MonthName(month(Now)) & Space(1) & Day(now) & space(1) & Year(now))
'dNow = MetaWord("@DATE(dd/mm/yyyy)")
Dim sDateFormat
Dim sSmartDate
sDateFormat = DCGlobalDates.GetShortDateFormat(locale)
sSmartDate = "@DATE(" & sDateFormat & ")"
writelog( "sSmartDate = " & sSmartDate)
dNow = MetaWord(sSmartDate)
'writelog("value = " & value & ". dNow = " & dNow & ".")
sCompare = DCGlobalDates.CompareDate(Value,dNow,locale)
Select Case sCompare
Case "-1","0"
IsFieldDateUpToToday = True
sMessage= "Field date value is today or earlier"
WriteLog(sMessage)
Case "1"
sMessage=RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldDateUpToToday_01","Field '{0}' date value of '{1}' must be today's date or earlier.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",value)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{2}",dNow)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
WriteLog(sMessage)
Case else
Writelog("Unknown result from Date Compare call. Returned value:'" & sCompare & "'")
End Select
Call Writelog(DCGlobalDates.GetLog)
Call ErrorHandler("Function IsFieldDateUpToToday")

af.name: IsFieldDateWithinXDays
af.g:
'A number <var>n</var> that specifies how many days make up the review period.
'Checks that current Field object's captured Date value is within <var>n</var> days of
'the number entered as a parameter.
On Error Resume Next
Dim XDays, ActualDays
Dim dNow
Dim locale
Dim ValueShortFormat
IsFieldDateWithinXDays = False
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
XDays = Trim(StrParam)
XDays = DCGlobalDates.ReplaceIndicWithWesternDigits(XDays)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(XDays, locale) Or Len(XDays)=0 Then
Writelog("Number of days is not numeric: " & XDays)
Exit Function
end if
value = Trim(GetFieldValue())
value = DCGlobalDates.ReplaceIndicWithWesternDigits(value)
If len(Trim(value))=0 then
Writelog("Field value is empty. Exiting Action")
Exit Function
end if
'Check Date
If DCGlobalDates.IsDate(Value,locale) then
writelog("Current field value ( " & value & " ) is a valid Date value.")
Else
sReturn = RRState.LoadString("validations","InvalidDate_01","Field '{0}' date value of '{1}' is not a valid date or recognized date format.")
sReturn = replace(sReturn,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sReturn = replace(sReturn,"{1}",value)
DCOMessage(sReturn)
Exit Function
End if
dNow = Now
' When dNow is passed directly to SubtractDates, VB re-formats the date when it passes it as a string. For example,
' If the current locale is UK and the date is dd/mm/yyyy, when it passes it to SubtractDates, it first changes it to mm/dd/yyyy
' and so the format is then interpreted incorrectly by subtractDates. By first storing it as a string, then passing the string
' the re-formatting does not happen. So the date is saved in tempString then tempString is passed instead of passing dNow.
Dim tempString
tempString = CStr(dNow)
ValueShortFormat = DCGlobalDates.FormatDateTime(value,"d",locale)
WriteLog("Now=" & tempString & " short=" & ValueShortFormat)
ActualDays = DCGlobalDates.SubtractDates(tempString, ValueShortFormat, 0, locale)
Writelog("[IsFieldDateWithinXDays] Action Limit = " & XDays & " Calculated Days = " & ActualDays)
If ABS(CLng(ActualDays)) <= CLng(XDays) Then
IsFieldDateWithinXDays = True
End If
WriteLog("IsFieldDateWithinXDays returns " & IsFieldDateWithinXDays)
If IsFieldDateWithinXDays = False Then
sMessage=RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldDateWithinXDays","Field '{0}' date value of '{1}' is {3} days from today's date. The date must be within {2} of days of today's date.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",value)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{2}",XDays)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{3}",ABS(CLng(ActualDays)))
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If

af.name: IsFieldDateWithinRange
af.g:
'
' Comma-separated Dates that define the range: Start Date, End Date
' TODAY can represent the current Date.
' Checks that the value assigned to the Text property of the bound object is a valid Date. If so, the action confirms that the Date is within the range specified by the parameters.
Dim sValue
Dim aStrParam
Dim sFromDate
Dim sThruDate
Dim sTempDate
Dim bExit
Dim locale
bExit = False
On Error Resume Next
IsFieldDateWithinRange = False
'Check CurrentObj for Valid Date Value
sValue = Trim(GetFieldValue())
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
'Convert Format
If DCGlobalDates.IsDate(sValue,locale) then
writelog("Current field value (" & sValue & ") is a valid Date value. Locale:(" & DCGlobalDates.FormatDateTime(sValue,"D",locale) & ")")
sValue = DCGlobalDates.FormatDateTime(sValue,"d",locale)
Else
sReturn = RRState.LoadString("validations","InvalidDate_01","Field '{0}' date value of '{1}' is not a valid date or recognized date format.")
sReturn = replace(sReturn,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sReturn = replace(sReturn,"{1}",CurrentObj.Text)
DCOMessage(sReturn)
writelog(sReturn)
writelog(DCGlobalDates.Getlog())
Exit Function
End if
Writelog("-----")
Writelog("Checking Action Parameters...")
'Parse CSV StrParam
aStrParam = split(strParam & ",",",")
sFromDate=Trim(MetaWord(aStrParam(0)))
sThruDate=Trim(MetaWord(aStrParam(1)))
'Checking Parameters for Valid Date Values or Keywords
If instr(ucase(sFromDate),"TODAY") then sFromDate = now
If instr(ucase(sThruDate),"TODAY") then sThruDate = now
If len(sFromDate)=0 then
Writelog(Space(5) & "Action Parameter 1 (From Date) is Empty. Using Current Date '" & now & "'")
sFromDate = now
end if
If len(sThruDate)=0 then
Writelog(Space(5) & "Action Parameter 2 (Thru Date) is Empty. Using Current Date '" & now & "'")
sThruDate = now
end if
'Convert format
If DCGlobalDates.IsDate(sFromDate,locale) then
writelog("FROM Date field value (" & sFromDate & ") is a valid Date value. Locale:(" & DCGlobalDates.FormatDateTime(sFromDate,"D",locale) &")")
sFromDate = DCGlobalDates.FormatDateTime(sFromDate,"d",locale)
'writelog(DCGlobalDates.Getlog)
'writelog("'d' format:" & sFromDate)
Else
writelog(Space(5) & "FROM Date parameter does not have a valid date Format:'" & sFromDate & "'")
writelog(DCGlobalDates.Getlog())
bExit=True
End if
'Convert format
If DCGlobalDates.IsDate(sThruDate,locale) then
writelog("THRU Date field value (" & sThruDate & ") is a valid Date value. Locale:(" & DCGlobalDates.FormatDateTime(sThruDate,"D",locale) & ")")
sThruDate = DCGlobalDates.FormatDateTime(sThruDate,"d",locale)
' writelog(DCGlobalDates.Getlog)
'writelog("'d' format:" & sThruDate)
else
writelog(Space(5) & "Thru-Date parameter does not have a valid date Format:'" & sThruDate & "'")
writelog(DCGlobalDates.Getlog())
bExit=True
End if
'If the parameters failed authenticity then exit the function
If bExit then Exit Function
'Check That FromDate is before ThruDate
If DCGlobalDates.CompareDate(sFromDate,sThruDate,locale)>0 then
Writelog(Space(5) & "Warning: From-date (" + sFromDate + ") is after Thru-date (" + sThruDate + ") : Switching Values.")
writelog(DCGlobalDates.Getlog)
sTempDate=sFromDate
sFromDate=sThruDate
sThruDate=sTempDate
End if
Writelog("-----")
Writelog("Checking Field Value Against Parameter Range...")
'Check Range
If DCGlobalDates.CompareDate(sValue,sFromDate,locale)<0 or DCGlobalDates.CompareDate(sValue,sThruDate,locale)>0 Then
sMessage=RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldDateWithinRange_01","Field '{0}' date value of '{1}' must be between the dates of '{2}' to '{3}'.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",sValue)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{2}",sFromDate)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{3}",sThruDate)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
Writelog(sMessage)
Exit Function
End if
Writelog("Current Date Value '" & cstr(sValue) & "' is within range: '" & cstr(sFromDate) & "' - '" & cstr(sThruDate) & "'")
IsFieldDateWithinRange=True
WriteLog("IsFieldDateWithinRange returns " & IsFieldDateWithinRange)

af.name: IsFieldDateWithReformat
af.g:
'
' The Date format you want to use.
' mm/dd/yy
' dd/mm/yy
' mm.dd.yy, etc.
'
' y yy yyy yyyy "8 08 008 2008" year
' M MM MMM MMMM "3 03 Mar March" month
' d dd ddd dddd "9 09 Sun Sunday" day
' h hh H HH "4 04 16 16" hour 12/24
' m mm "5 05" minute
' s ss "7 07" second
' f ff fff ffff "1 12 123 1230" sec.fraction
' F FF FFF FFFF "1 12 123 123" without zeroes
' t tt "P PM" A.M. or P.M.
' z zz zzz "-6 -06 -06:00" time zone
'
' t ShortTimePattern h:mm tt
' d ShortDatePattern M/d/yyyy
' T LongTimePattern h:mm:ss tt
' D LongDatePattern dddd, MMMM dd, yyyy
' f (combination of D and t) dddd, MMMM dd, yyyy h:mm tt
' F FullDateTimePattern dddd, MMMM dd, yyyy h:mm:ss tt
' g (combination of d and t) M/d/yyyy h:mm tt
' G (combination of d and T) M/d/yyyy h:mm:ss tt
' m, M MonthDayPattern MMMM dd
' y, Y YearMonthPattern MMMM, yyyy
' r, R RFC1123Pattern ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH':'mm':'ss 'GMT' (*)
' s SortableDateTi­mePattern yyyy'-'MM'-'dd'T'HH':'mm':'ss (*)
' u UniversalSorta­bleDateTimePat­tern yyyy'-'MM'-'dd HH':'mm':'ss'Z' (*)
On Error Resume Next
Dim locale
IsFieldDateWithReformat = True
StrParam = Trim(MetaWord(StrParam))
Writelog("IsFieldDateWithReformat argument = '" & StrParam & "' ")
value = Trim(GetFieldValue())
Writelog("Start Field Value:'" & value & "' ")
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
If DCGlobalDates.IsDate(value,locale)=False then
IsFieldDateWithReformat = False
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","InvalidDate_01","Field '{0}' date value of '{1}' is not a valid date or recognized date format.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",value)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End if
'Updates field with reformatted Date value
'Strparam is the pattern to format to
'Value: '*' sets to short date format value
StrParam = Replace(StrParam,"*","d")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"c","y")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"day","dd")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"month","MM")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"year","yyyy")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"ccyy","yyyy")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"julian","y")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"jjj","y")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"j","y")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"yd","yd")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"ym","yM")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"my","My")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"md","Md")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"dy","dy")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"dm","dM")
StrParam = Replace(lcase(StrParam),"m","M")
'default to short date format
If len(trim(StrParam))= 0 then StrParam = "d"
Writelog("Eval String:'" & StrParam & "' ")
CurrentObj.Text = DCGlobalDates.FormatDateTime(value, StrParam,locale)
If Err.Number<>0 then
IsFieldDateWithReformat = False
Writelog("Err:" & err.number & ":" & Err.description)
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldDateWithReformat_01","There was a problem formatting the date value '{1}' in field '{0}' to the pattern '{2}'.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",value)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{2}",StrParam)
Writelog(sMessage)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If
WriteLog("IsFieldDateWithReformat returns " & IsFieldDateWithReformat & ". Date value:'" & CurrentObj.Text & "'")
Set RX = Nothing

af.name: IsFieldCurrency
af.g:
'
' Determines if the current Field object's captured value is 100% Numeric
' and includes a two-digit decimal amount. When determining the Numeric %,
' the action ignores spaces and punctuation such as commas and decimal points.
On Error Resume Next
Dim locale
IsFieldCurrency = False
value = GetFieldValue()
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
IsFieldCurrency = DCGlobalCurrency.IsCurrency(value,locale)
WriteLog("IsFieldCurrency returns " & IsFieldCurrency)
If IsFieldCurrency = False Then
Writelog(DCGlobalCurrency.Getlog())
sMessage=RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldCurrency_01","Field '{0}' value of '{1}' was not recognised as a valid currency format.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",value)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function IsFieldCurrency")

af.name: IsFieldMatching
af.g:
'The value to be checked against the Field object's value.
'Determines if the value entered as the parameter is identical to the captured value of the current Field object.
IsFieldMatching = False
value = GetFieldValue()
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
WriteLog("Checking if field value" & value & " matches " & strParam)
If Trim(value) = Trim(strParam) Then
IsFieldMatching = True
End If
WriteLog("IsFieldMatching returns " & IsFieldMatching)
If IsFieldMatching = False Then
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldMatching_01","Field '{0}' value of '{1}' did not match '{2}'.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",value)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{2}",strParam)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If
Call ErrorHandler("Function IsFieldMatching")

af.name: CopyFieldToField
af.g:
'The name of the target Field object of the Document Hierarchy.
'Copies the captured value of the current Field object to the Field object designated as the action's parameter.
Dim oNewChar, oCurChar
Dim oFld,bRes
Dim nLeft,nTop,nRight,nBottom
Dim nChildren
CopyFieldToField = False
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
Debuglog("GET FIELD " & Ucase(StrParam))
Set oFld = ReturnNamedComponent(StrParam)
If oFld is nothing Then
WriteLog("Cannot locate field '" & StrParam & "'. Exiting Action")
Exit Function
End If
oFld.Text=""
'Append New Characters
nChildren=Currentobj.NumOfChildren
For xChar = 1 to nChildren
'Add Characters
Set oCurChar = CurrentObj.GetChild(xChar-1)
If IsAlive(oCurChar) then
If oCurChar.objecttype=4 Then
Set oNewChar = oFld.AddChild(4,"",-1)
nChar = oNewChar.AddValue(CLng(oCurChar.CharValue(0)), CLng(oCurChar.CharConfidence(0)))
bRes = oCurChar.GetPosition(nLeft,nTop,nRight,nBottom)
bRes = oNewChar.SetPosition(nLeft,nTop,nRight,nBottom)
End if
End if
Next 'xChar
WriteLog("New value for Field " & StrParam & " : '" & oFld.Text & "' ")
CopyFieldToField = True
Set oCurChar = Nothing
Set oNewChar = Nothing
Set oFld = Nothing

af.g:

'Field object specified by the parameter.
Dim oNewChar, oCurChar
Dim oFld,bRes

Dim nAdjust
Dim nChildren
AppendToField= False
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
Debuglog("GET FIELD " & Ucase(StrParam))
Set oFld = ReturnNamedComponent(StrParam)

nChildren=CurrentObj.NumOfChildren
For xChar = 1 to nChildren
Set oCurChar = CurrentObj.GetChild(xChar-1)
If IsAlive(oCurChar) Then
If oCurChar.ObjectType=4 then
'Add Characters
Set oNewChar = oFld.AddChild(4,"",-1)
nChar = oNewChar.AddValue(CLng(oCurChar.CharValue(0)), CLng(oCurChar.CharConfidence(0)))

bRes = oNewChar.SetPosition(nLeft,nTop,nRight,nBottom)

Next 'xChar

af.name: AppendFromField
af.g:
'The name of the Field object whose text value is to be appended to the current field's value.
'
' Appends the captured value of the specified Field object to the
' captured value of the current Field object. You can also apply this
' action at the Page level. A Text page-level variable with the appended
' value will be added to the page's Data file.
Dim oNewChar, oCurChar
Dim oFld,bRes
Dim nLeft,nTop,nRight,nBottom
Dim nAdjust
Dim nChildren
On Error Resume Next
AppendFromField= False
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
Debuglog("GET FIELD " & Ucase(StrParam))
Set oFld = ReturnNamedComponent(StrParam)
If oFld is nothing Then
WriteLog("Cannot locate field '" & StrParam & "'. Exiting Action")
Exit Function
End If
nChildren=oFld.NumOfChildren
For xChar = 1 to nChildren
Set oCurChar = oFld.GetChild(xChar-1)
If IsAlive(oCurChar) then
If oCurChar.ObjectType=4 then
'Add Characters
Set oNewChar = CurrentObj.AddChild(4,"",-1)
nChar = oNewChar.AddValue(CLng(oCurChar.CharValue(0)), CLng(oCurChar.CharConfidence(0)))
bRes = oCurChar.GetPosition(nLeft,nTop,nRight,nBottom)
bRes = oNewChar.SetPosition(nLeft,nTop,nRight,nBottom)
End if
End if
Next 'xChar
WriteLog("New value for Field '" & CurrentObj.Text & "' ")
If CurrentObj.ObjectType<3 then
Writelog("Non-Field Object. Saving as 'Text' variable")
CurrentObj.Variable("Text") = CurrentObj.Variable("Text") & oFld.Text
End if
AppendFromField= True
Set oCurChar = Nothing
Set oNewChar = Nothing
Set oFld = Nothing

af.name: CopyField
af.g:
'The name of the target Field object.
'Assigns the current Field object's captured value to a sibling Field object you specify as the parameter.
Dim aStrParam
Dim oNewChar, oCurChar
Dim oFld, bRes
Dim nLeft,nTop,nRight,nBottom
Dim FieldNm, NewValue
CopyField = False
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
aStrParam = Split(strParam & "," , ",")
FieldNm = aStrParam(0)
NewValue = aStrParam(1)
Writelog("Getting Field '" & FieldNm & "'" )
Set oFld = ReturnNamedComponent(FieldNm)
If oFld is nothing Then
WriteLog("Cannot locate field '" & FieldNm & "'. Exiting Action")
Exit Function
End if
oFld.Text = ""
If len(Trim(NewValue))=0 then
NewValue=CurrentObj.Text
End if
'Append New Characters
For xChar = 1 to len(NewValue)
'Add Characters
Set oNewChar = oFld.AddChild(4,"",-1)
nChar = oNewChar.AddValue(CLng(Ascw( Mid(NewValue,xChar,1))), CLng(9))
bRes = oNewChar.SetPosition(clng(0),clng(0),clng(0),clng(0))
Next 'xChar
WriteLog("New value for Field " & oFld.ID & " is '" & oFld.Text & "'.")
CopyField = True
Set oNewChar = Nothing
Set oFld = Nothing

af.name: IsFieldGreaterOrEqual
af.g:
'The Numeric or Currency value which is the basis for comparison.
'Determines if the captured value of the current Field object is greater than (or equal to) the value entered as a parameter. If the field's value is not Numeric or currency, the action will return a condition.
On Error Resume Next
Dim value
Dim sMessage
Dim locale
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
IsFieldGreaterOrEqual= True
value = GetFieldValue()
sMessage = ""
strParam = MetaWord(strParam)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(strParam, locale, locale) Then
writelog("Action Parameter is not Numeric!")
Writelog(DCGlobalCurrency.Getlog())
IsFieldGreaterOrEqual= False
End if
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(value, locale, locale) Then
WriteLog("Field's value is not numeric!")
Writelog(DCGlobalCurrency.Getlog())
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","NotNumeric_01","Field '{0}' value of '{1}' must be numeric.")
IsFieldGreaterOrEqual= False
End if
If IsFieldGreaterOrEqual= True then
If CDBL(value) >= CDBL(strParam) Then
IsFieldGreaterOrEqual = True
WriteLog(value & " is greater than or equal to " & strParam)
Else
IsFieldGreaterOrEqual = False
WriteLog(value & " is less than " & strParam)
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldGreaterOrEqual_01","Field '{0}' value of '{1}' must be greater than '{2}'.")
End If
End if
WriteLog("IsFieldGreaterOrEqual returns " & IsFieldGreaterOrEqual)
If IsFieldGreaterOrEqual = False then
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",value)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{2}",strParam)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If

af.name: IsFieldLessOrEqual
af.g:
'The Numeric or Currency value you want to compare against.
'
' Determines if the captured value of the current Field object is less than (or equal to)
' the value entered as a parameter. If the field's value is not Numeric or Currency, the
' action will return a condition.
On Error Resume Next
Dim Value
Dim sMessage
Dim locale
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
sMessage = ""
IsFieldLessOrEqual= True
Value = GetFieldValue()
strParam = MetaWord(strParam)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(strParam, locale, locale) Then
Writelog(DCGlobalCurrency.Getlog())
WriteLog("Action Parameter is not Numeric!")
IsFieldLessOrEqual= False
End if
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(value, locale, locale) Then
Writelog(DCGlobalCurrency.Getlog())
WriteLog("Field's value is not numeric!")
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","NotNumeric_01","Field '{0}' value of '{1}' must be numeric.")
IsFieldLessOrEqual= False
End if
If IsFieldLessOrEqual= True then
If CDBL(value) <= CDBL(strParam) Then
IsFieldLessOrEqual = True
WriteLog(value & " is less than or equal to " & strParam)
Else
WriteLog(value & " is greater than " & strParam)
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldLessOrEqual_01","Field '{0}' value of '{1}' must be less than '{2}'.")
IsFieldLessOrEqual= False
End If
end if
WriteLog("IsFieldLessOrEqual returns " & IsFieldLessOrEqual)
If IsFieldLessOrEqual = False then
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",value)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{2}",strParam)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If

af.name: InsertDecimalPoint
af.g:
'A number <var>n</var> indicating the character position at which to place the decimal.
'
' Places a decimal character in the captured value, at the character position specified as a parameter.
' The parameter indicates the position of the decimal point, moving from right to left.
Dim Place
Dim sDecimalSeparator
Dim sGroupSeparator
Dim sDecimalDigits
Dim locale
On Error Resume Next
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
sDecimalDigits = DCGlobalCurrency.CurrencyDecimalDigits(locale)
sGroupSeparator = DCGlobalCurrency.CurrencyGroupSeparator(locale)
sDecimalSeparator = DCGlobalCurrency.CurrencyDecimalSeparator(locale)
strparam = MetaWord(strparam)
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(strparam, locale) or Trim(strparam)="" then
strParam = sDecimalDigits
writelog("Number of decimal places defaulted to " & strparam)
End if
Place = CInt(strParam)-1
InsertDecimalPoint = True
value = GetFieldValue()
Writelog("Start Field value:'" & value & "'")
If InStr(value,sDecimalSeparator) then
writelog("Decimal separator found. Value unchanged. Exiting Action.")
Exit Function
End if
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(value, locale) then
writelog("Non-numeric value found. Value unchanged. Exiting Action.")
Exit Function
End if
If Len(value)<2 then
writelog("Value has less than 2 characters. Value unchanged. Exiting Action.")
Exit Function
End if
If InStr(Right(value,3),sGroupSeparator)>0 Then
WriteLog("Group Separator detected in third position. Value unchanged. Exiting Action.")
Exit Function
End if
value=InsertCharacters(sDecimalSeparator,Cstr(Len(value)-Place),1)
WriteLog("End field value:'" & CurrentObj.Text & "'")

f.name: CalculateFields
f.g:
'
' The equation that is the basis for the calculation.
'
' You can use a Field object's name or numeric values with any arithmetic operator (+,-,*,/,^).
' To use a Field object's name, surround the field name with single quotation marks (').
' A null is treated as a "0".
'
' Calculates the equation entered as a parameter and compares the result to the current Field object's captured value.
Dim nNum
Dim aDecimal
Dim aStrParam
Dim Sobj
Dim Nx
Dim nDecimal
Dim nDecimalDefault
Dim sExpression
Dim nValue
Dim sBasicExpression
Dim oCurParent
Dim oParent
Dim bHasChildren
Dim dictCalcObj
Dim sTempNode
Dim sCResult
Dim bPreserveStatus
Dim nDigits
Dim locale
Dim tNode
Dim bconvertdecimal
On Error Resume Next
Set dictCalcObj = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
CalculateFields = False
Set oCurParent = CurrentObj.Parent()
bHasChildren = CurrentObj.NumOfChildren > Len(CurrentObj.Text)
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(Equation)
bPreserveStatus = FALSE
PreserveStatus=Trim(Ucase(MetaWord(PreserveStatus)))
If PreserveStatus="TRUE" or PreserveStatus="1" then
bPreserveStatus=TRUE
End if
'Set and log number of decimal digits to use for formatting
nDigits = 8 'final eval default to prevent memory error for very small remainders
nDecimal = Trim(MetaWord(DecimalDigits))
Writelog("Decimal digits:'" & nDecimal & "' (Blank if not set, defaults to regional setting)")
if len(nDecimal)>0 then nDigits=nDecimal
sCResult = ""
'Split the array based on the apostrophe character
'surrounding all dco types
aStrParam = Split(strparam & "'", "'")
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
'Get the Group and Decimal Separator regional characters
Dim GroupSeparator
Dim DecimalSeparator
GroupSeparator = DCGlobalCurrency.CurrencyGroupSeparator(locale)
DecimalSeparator = DCGlobalCurrency.CurrencyDecimalSeparator(locale)
bconvertdecimal=true
If ucase(cstr(CurrentObj.Variable("convertdecimal")))="TRUE" then bconvertdecimal=true
Dim elements
elements=Ubound(aStrParam)
'Process each element
For Nx = 1 to Ubound(aStrParam)
aNode = aStrParam(Nx-1)
bNode = False
If Nx>1 then Writelog(vbcrlf)
Writelog("Processing node [" & Nx & "] of [" & elements & "]. Node Value:'" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'")
'Temp var for checking for complex operator
tNode = aNode
'Check for complex operator
tNode = Replace(tNode,"<","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,">","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,"+","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,"=","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,"/","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,"*","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,"-","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,"abs","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,"(","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,")","")
tNode = Replace(tNode,"^","")
tNode = Replace(tNode," ","")
If Trim(tNode) = "" Then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Node " & Nx & " is empty or contains expected mathmatical operator characters.")
bNode = True
End if
'Check if Blank, Numeric or special character
If instr("<>+=/*-abs()^",Trim(aNode))>0 or Trim(aNode) = "" or DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(Trim(aNode),locale)=True Then bNode = True
'Check if self
If aStrParam(Nx-1)= CurrentObj.Type Then
if err.number<>0 then err.clear
If(Trim(CurrentObj.Text) = "") Then
aStrParam(Nx-1) = 0
Else
'Remove the regional Group separator
aStrParam(Nx-1)= Trim(replace(CurrentObj.Text,GroupSeparator,""))
End If
bNode = True
Writelog(Space(3) & CurrentObj.Type & " is Calling Object. Node value is '" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'.")
End If
'Writelog(Space(3) & "Checking point 3 value:'" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'.")
'Check Page/Document of Self
If Not(bNode) And Not(oCurParent Is Nothing) Then
nValue = ""
'If no DCO path is present
If instr(aStrParam(Nx-1),"..\")=0 then
'Search Parent Page, or Document(If called at Page or Document level)
Set oParent = CurrentObj
While (oParent.ObjectType>2 or (oParent.ObjectType>1 And CurrentObj.ObjectType=2)) And oParent.ObjectType<>0 And nValue=""
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
'nValue will return 0+ if children found and "" if no children found.
nValue = u_SumFields(aStrParam(Nx-1),oParent)
'Writelog(Space(3) & "u_SumFields returned:'" & nValue & "'.")
Wend
Set oParent = Nothing
Else
writelog(Space(3) & "DCO path detected. Using fixed path navigation.")
nValue = u_SumFields(aStrParam(Nx-1),CurrentObj)
End if
If nValue <> "" then
'Remove the digits separator (?!)
'aStrParam(Nx-1) = Trim(replace(nValue,GroupSeparator,""))
aStrParam(Nx-1) = Trim(nValue)
bNode = True
'Writelog("Sibling Node(s) found. New Value is " & aStrParam(Nx-1))
For Each fKey in dictTypeVars.keys
If not(dictCalcObj.Exists(fKey)) then Set dictCalcObj(fKey) = dictTypeVars.Item(fKey)
Next
Writelog(Space(3) & "Node value is:'" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'")
End If
End If
'Writelog(Space(3) & "Checking point 4 value:'" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'.")
If bNode = False Then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Node not found as Sibling or Child. Node value is '" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'.")
'Check for complex operators
aNode=replace(aNode,"<","")
aNode=replace(aNode,">","")
aNode=replace(aNode,"+","")
aNode=replace(aNode,"=","")
aNode=replace(aNode,"/","")
aNode=replace(aNode,"*","")
aNode=replace(aNode,"-","")
aNode=replace(aNode,"abs","")
aNode=replace(aNode,"(","")
aNode=replace(aNode,")","")
aNode=replace(aNode,"^","")
aNode=Trim(aNode)
If len(aNode)>0 Then
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(aStrParam(Nx-1), locale) then aStrParam(Nx-1)=0
End if
Else
'Writelog(Space(3) & "Checking point 5 value:'" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'.")
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(aStrParam(Nx-1), locale, locale) And Trim(aNode)<>"" And Len(tNode)>0 Then
dclog = (DCGlobalCurrency.Getlog())
Writelog(Space(3) & "Calculate Fails. Exiting Function")
Writelog(dclog)
CalculateFields = False
Exit Function
End If
'Writelog(Space(3) & "Checking point 6 value:'" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'.")
'Convert Numeric for use with Eval function
If DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(aStrParam(Nx-1), locale, locale) then
'Disabled 09/29/2015 due to update of u_sumfields to adjust according to locale & target (calling obj) locale.
If DecimalSeparator<>"." and bconvertdecimal=true then
aStrParam(Nx-1)=replace(aStrParam(Nx-1),DecimalSeparator,".")
Writelog("converting decimal from '" & DecimalSeparator & "' to '.'")
End if
If nDecimal<>"" Then
aStrParam(Nx-1) = FormatNumber(cdbl(aStrParam(Nx-1)),nDecimal,0,0,0)
Else
aStrParam(Nx-1) = FormatNumber(cdbl(aStrParam(Nx-1)),-1,0,0,0)
End if
Writelog(Space(3) & "Node pre basic expression build value is now '" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'.")
Else
Writelog(Space(3) & "Node did not pass pre basic expression numeric check. '" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'.")
End if
' Writelog(Space(3) & "Checking point 7 value:'" & aStrParam(Nx-1) & "'.")
End If
Next
sExpression = Join(aStrParam,"")
sBasicExpression = sExpression
Writelog("BASIC Expression is: " & sBasicExpression)
On Error Resume Next
'Equalize Expression Decimal Places
If instr(sExpression,"=") Then
aDecimal = Split(sExpression,"=")
For Nx = 0 to Ubound(aDecimal)
sLeft = ""
sRight = ""
'Check for < or > symbols
If Len(aDecimal(Nx))>2 then
If left(aDecimal(Nx),1) = "<" or left(aDecimal(Nx),1) = ">" then
sLeft = left(aDecimal(Nx),1)
aDecimal(Nx) = right(aDecimal(Nx),len(aDecimal(Nx))-1)
End if
If right(aDecimal(Nx),1) = "<" or right(aDecimal(Nx),1) = ">" then
sRight = right(aDecimal(Nx),1)
aDecimal(Nx) = left(aDecimal(Nx),len(aDecimal(Nx))-1)
End if
If DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(aDecimal(Nx), locale, locale) and nDecimal<>"" then
If DecimalSeparator<>"." and instr(aDecimal(Nx),".")>0 and bconvertdecimal=true then aDecimal(Nx)=replace(aDecimal(Nx),".",DecimalSeparator)
writelog("Formatting number[1]: " & aDecimal(Nx))
aDecimal(Nx) = FormatNumber(cdbl(aDecimal(Nx)),nDecimal,0,0,0)
If DecimalSeparator<>"." and bconvertdecimal=true then aDecimal(Nx)=replace(aDecimal(Nx),DecimalSeparator,".")
End if
Elseif DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(aDecimal(Nx), locale, locale) then
If DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(aDecimal(Nx), locale, locale) and nDecimal<>"" then
If DecimalSeparator<>"." and instr(aDecimal(Nx),".")>0 and bconvertdecimal=true then aDecimal(Nx)=replace(aDecimal(Nx),".",DecimalSeparator)
writelog("Formatting number[2]: " & aDecimal(Nx))
aDecimal(Nx) = FormatNumber(cdbl(aDecimal(Nx)),nDecimal,0,0,0)
If DecimalSeparator<>"." and bconvertdecimal=true then aDecimal(Nx)=replace(aDecimal(Nx),DecimalSeparator,".")
End if
End if
'EVAL statement does not interpret numbers not using the decimal characters as the decimal separator
' for the eval ONLY we change the system to use the decimal character.
If DecimalSeparator<>"." and bconvertdecimal=true then aDecimal(Nx)=replace(aDecimal(Nx),DecimalSeparator,".")
'aDecimal(Nx)= "FormatNumber(" & aDecimal(Nx) & "," & nDigits & ",0,0)+0" 'plus zero to compensate for 'negative zero' string evaluation
aDecimal(Nx)= FormatNumber(cdbl(aDecimal(Nx)), nDigits,0,0)+0 'plus zero to compensate for 'negative zero' string evaluation
aDecimal(Nx) = sLeft & aDecimal(Nx) & sRight
Next 'Nx
sExpression = Join(aDecimal,"=")
End if
If instr(sExpression,"<>") Then
aDecimal = Split(sExpression,"<>")
For Nx = 0 to Ubound(aDecimal)
'aDecimal(Nx) = "FormatNumber(" & aDecimal(Nx) & "," & nDigits & ",0,0)+0" 'plus zero to compensate for 'negative zero' string evaluation
aDecimal(Nx) = FormatNumber(cdbl(aDecimal(Nx)), nDigits,0,0)+0 'plus zero to compensate for 'negative zero' string evaluation
Next 'Nx
sExpression = Join(aDecimal,"<>")
End if
Writelog("Formatted Expression: '" & sExpression & "'")
If Instr(sExpression,">")>0 or Instr(sExpression,"<")>0 or Instr(sExpression,"=")>0 then
'sCResult = Eval(Trim(sExpression)) No longer use VBScript version as it does not always evaluate correctly. Use the C# version in Datacap.Global
Dim sCResult2
sCResult2="" ' First setting to empty string to confirm EvaluateExpression is returning something.
'Writelog("BEFORE Call EVAL: " & sExpression)
If not IsAlive(DCGlobalLocale) then
WriteLog("DCGlobalLocale is not instantiated. Cannot evaluate expression. Returning false.")
return false
End if
sCResult2=DCGlobalLocale.EvaluateExpression(Trim(sExpression))
sCResult=sCResult2
writelog("Bool EVAL returns: '" & sCResult & "' ")
Select Case sCResult
Case False
CalculateFields = False
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","CalculateFields_01","Field '{0}' failed Calculation '{1}'.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",sExpression)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"FormatNumber(","")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"," & nDigits & ",0,0)","")
DCOMessage(sMessage)
If bPreserveStatus = FALSE then
For Each fKey in dictCalcObj.keys
Set kObj = dictCalcObj.Item(fKey)
If kObj.Variable("STATUS")<>cstr(nFail) then
writelog("Setting " & kObj.ID & " to STATUS '1'")
kObj.Variable("STATUS")=1
'build message
txtmsg = RRState.LoadString("validations","CalculateFields_03","Field '{0}' failed by Calculate Action on by Field '{1}'.")
txtmsg = replace(txtmsg,"{0}",kObj.ID)
txtmsg = replace(txtmsg,"{1}",CurrentObj.ID)
If Not kObj.AddVariable("MESSAGE",txtmsg) Then
kObj.Variable("MESSAGE") = txtmsg
End If
End if
Next 'fKey
End if
Case True
writelog("Expression returns TRUE")
CalculateFields = True
'Check related field status
If bPreserveStatus = FALSE then
For Each fKey in dictCalcObj.keys
Set kObj = dictCalcObj.Item(fKey)
If trim(kObj.Variable("STATUS"))=cstr(nFail) then
'build message
txtmsg = RRState.LoadString("validations","CalculateFields_03","Field '{0}' failed by Calculate Action on by Field '{1}'.")
txtmsg = replace(txtmsg,"{0}",kObj.ID)
txtmsg = replace(txtmsg,"{1}",CurrentObj.ID)
If instr(kObj.Variable("MESSAGE"),txtmsg)>0 then
'Change Status to pass
kObj.Variable("STATUS")=cstr(nPass)
Call kObj.DeleteVariable("MESSAGE")
End if
End if
Next 'fKey
End if
Case Else
Writelog("Expression returns unexpected result:'" & sCResult & "'.")
CalculateFields = False
End Select
Else ' not a boolean evaluation
sCResult = Eval(Trim(sExpression))
writelog("Calc EVAL returns: '" & sCResult & "' ")
If DCGlobalCurrency.Isnumeric(sCResult, locale) then
If DCGlobalCurrency.Isnumeric(nDecimal, locale) then sCResult = FormatNumber(sCResult, nDecimal,,,0)
Writelog("Expression = " & sCResult)
CurrentObj.Text = sCResult
CalculateFields = True
Else
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","CalculateFields_02","Field '{0}' calling the calculate action has an unexpected result from the expression '{1}'.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{1}",sExpression)
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"FormatNumber(","")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"," & nDigits & ",0,0)","")
DCOMessage(sMessage)
Writelog(sMessage)
CalculateFields = False
End If
End if
dictCalcObj.RemoveAll()
Set dictCalcObj = Nothing
If Err.Number <> 0 Then
If cstr(Err.Number)<>cstr(13) then CalculateFields = False
Err.Clear
End If

af.name: IsFieldEmpty
af.g:
'The Field object's name.
'Checks if the Field object designated as a parameter does not have a captured value.
Dim oFld
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
IsFieldEmpty = False
WriteLog("Checking field " & strParam)
Set oFld = ReturnNamedComponent(strParam)
if oFld is nothing Then
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldEmpty_01","Unable to locate Field '{0}' to check if the field value is empty.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.ID)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
WriteLog(sMessage)
Exit Function
End If
If Len(oFld.Text) = 0 Then
IsFieldEmpty = True
Else
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldEmpty_02","Field '{0}' is not Empty.")
sMessage = replace(sMessage,"{0}", oFld.ID) ' Report the ID of the object that was tested
DCOMessage(sMessage)
Writelog(sMessage)
End If
WriteLog("IsFieldEmpty returns: " & IsFieldEmpty)

af.name: IsFieldFilled
af.g:
'The name of the Field object.
'Determines whether the Field object designated as a parameter contains a captured value or is empty.
Dim oFld
On Error Resume Next
IsFieldFilled = False
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
WriteLog("Checking field " & strParam)
Set oFld = ReturnNamedComponent(strParam)
if oFld is nothing Then
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldFilled_01","Unable to locate Field '{0}' to check if the field has a value.")

af.name: CheckSubFields
af.g:
' An "expression" that specifies which child fields are to be checked for the presence or absence
' of captured values. Within the expression, each child Field object's name needs to be surrounded
' with single quotation marks ('). You can also use parentheses () in your expression.
CheckSubFields=True
Dim aDel()
Dim NumChildren
Dim oSuperField
Dim tNode
Dim aNode
Dim eString
Dim nValue
On Error Resume Next
ReDim Preserve aDel(CurrentObj.NumofChildren + 1)
Set Sobj = Nothing
For i = 0 To CurrentObj.NumOfChildren -1
bNoGood = False
Set oSuperField = CurrentObj.GetChild(i)
If Not (oSuperField Is Nothing) Then
'Check Sub-fields for Data
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
eString = ""
aStrParam = Split(strparam, "'")
For aNode = 0 to ubound(aStrParam)
nValue = Trim(ucase(aStrParam(aNode)))
nValue = replace(nValue,"(","")
nValue = replace(nValue,")","")
nValue = replace(nValue,"OR","")
nValue = replace(nValue,"AND","")
nValue = replace(nValue," ","")
nValue = replace(nValue,"'","")
If Len(nValue)>0 Then
Set Sobj = oSuperField.FindChild(TRIM(aStrParam(aNode)))
If Not(Sobj Is Nothing) Then
If Len(Trim(Sobj.Text))>0 Then
eString = eString & " Cbool(True) "
Else
eString = eString & " Cbool(False) "
End if
Set Sobj = Nothing
End if
Else
eString = eString & aStrParam(aNode) & " "
End If
Next
writelog("Expression: " & eString)
bGood = Eval(eString)
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog("Expression not valid.")
Err.Clear
bGood=False
End if
If not bGood Then
aDel(i) = CStr(i)
Else
aDel(i) = ""
End If
End If
Next 'i
Set Sobj = Nothing
For Fx = (CurrentObj.NumOfChildren - 1) To 0 Step -1
If Not aDel(Fx)="" Then
Call CurrentObj.Deletechild(aDel(fx))
End If
Next 'x
WriteLog("CheckSubFields returns " & CheckSubFields)

af.name: SumFields
af.g:
'String value of a Field object's Type property or the name of a variable.
'Sums captured values of any "child" Field if a child object's Type property is identical to the Type you specify as a parameter.
On Error Resume Next
dictTypeVars.RemoveAll()
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
StrParam = Trim(StrParam)
Call fFindTypeValues(CurrentObj, StrParam,"")
Dim kObj
Dim fKey
Dim nTally
Dim locale
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
nTally = cdbl(0)
For Each fKey in dictTypeVars.keys
Set kObj = dictTypeVars.Item(fKey)
writelog(Space(3) & "Checking '" & fKey & "' ")
if kObj.Type = StrParam then
sVal = kObj.Text
Else
sVal = kObj.Variable(StrParam)
end if
If DCGlobalCurrency.isNumeric(sVal, locale) then
nTally = nTally + cdbl(sVal)
Writelog(Space(3) & "Value '" & cdbl(sVal) & "' is numeric. Total value is '" & nTally & "' ")
Else
Writelog(Space(3) & "Value '" & sVal & "' is not numeric.")
End if
Next 'kObj
If dictTypeVars.Count = 0 then
writelog(Space(3) & "No Fields or Variables of Type '" & StrParam & "' were found.")
end if
CurrentObj.Variable("SumFields_" & StrParam) = nTally
dictTypeVars.RemoveAll()
SumFields = True

af.name: ResetField
af.g:
' This action deletes the selected Field object's captured value, and sets the field's

On Error Resume Next
ResetField = False

Writelog("Not a field object. Exiting Action.")

af.name: ConvertToUpperCase
af.g:
' Converts the lower case characters in a Field object's captured value to Upper Case characters.
' A Validate rule with this action, if applied to a State Field object which accepts only abbreviations,
' would be sure the captured values contain Upper Case letters (AZ, AL, etc.)
Dim sConf
On Error Resume Next
value = GetFieldValue()
If value <> "" Then
Value = Ucase(Value)
sConf = CurrentObj.ConfidenceString
CurrentObj.Text = Value
CurrentObj.ConfidenceString = sConf
If IsObject(LogWindow) then ValueUp.text = Value
WriteLog("Value converted to all caps. New value is: '" & value & "'")
End If
ConvertToUpperCase = True

af.name: ConvertToLowerCase
af.g:
'Converts any Upper Case characters in a Field object's captured value to lower case characters.
'To ensure that the characters in all Product ID's are lower case, a Validate rule that applies to a Document Hierarchy's Item Field object would include this action.
Dim sConf
On Error Resume Next
value = GetFieldValue()
If value <> "" Then
Value = Lcase(Value)
sConf = CurrentObj.ConfidenceString
CurrentObj.Text = Value
CurrentObj.ConfidenceString = sConf
If IsObject(LogWindow) then ValueUp.text = Value
WriteLog("Value converted to all lowercase. New value is: " & Value)
End If
ConvertToLowerCase = True

af.name: SplitFieldValuePreserveEnd
af.g:
'String value of the separating character. SmartParameter Enabled.
'Splits a Field object's captured value at the first instance of the character specified as a parameter.
'The action deletes all characters to the left of the separating character, as well as the separation character. All text to the right of the separating character remains.
'If the object's value is "InvNumber=A1234," this action truncates it to "A1234".
Dim pos
Dim sConf
Dim Fleft,FTop,FBottom,FRight
Dim Cleft,CTop,Cbottom,CRight
Dim sNewParam
Fleft=""
FTop=""
FBottom=""
FTop=""
On Error Resume Next
SplitFieldValuePreserveEnd = False
Value = GetFieldValue()
Writelog("Start value is: '" & Value & "' ")
sNewParam = MetaWord(strParam)
'Only use MetaWord result if it returns a value
If sNewParam<>"" Then strParam=sNewParam
'InstrT is a rrunner.rrx helper function using dcglobal.
pos = InStrT(Value, strParam,0,0)
If pos = 0 then
Writelog("Split value '" & strParam & "' not found in field.")
Exit function
End if
'Character Index begins after any child fields
nFields = (CurrentObj.NumOfChildren - len(CurrentObj.Text))
For Cx = (CurrentObj.NumOfChildren-1) to nFields Step-1
If Cx>=(pos+nFields) then
Set cObj = CurrentObj.GetChild(Cx)
If Not cObj is Nothing then
bRes = cObj.GetPosition(Cleft,Ctop,Cright,Cbottom)
If Not(Cleft=0 and Ctop=0 and Cright=0 and Cbottom=0) Then
If Fleft="" then FLeft=Clng(Cleft)
If Clng(Cleft)<Fleft then FLeft=Clng(Cleft)
If Ftop="" then Ftop=Clng(Ctop)
If Clng(Ctop)<Ftop then Ftop=Clng(Ctop)
If Fright="" then Fright=Clng(Cright)
If Clng(Cright)>Fright then Fright=Clng(Cright)
If Fbottom="" then Fbottom=Clng(Cbottom)
If Clng(Cbottom)>Fbottom then Fbottom=Clng(Cbottom)
End if
End if
Else
'Delete Character Node
If CurrentObj.Deletechild(Cx)=False then
Writelog("Child Index '" & Cx & "' not deleted successfully.")
End if
End if
Next 'x
If Fleft="" then FLeft=Clng(0)
If Ftop="" then Ftop=Clng(0)
If Fright="" then Fright=Clng(0)
If Fbottom="" then Fbottom=Clng(0)
CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = cstr(Fleft) & "," & cstr(Ftop) & "," & cstr(Fright) & "," & cstr(Fbottom)
If IsObject(LogWindow) then ValueUp.text = CurrentObj.Text
WriteLog("Value split at position " & pos & " . New value is: '" & GetFieldValue() & "' , confidence: '" & GetFieldConf() & "'.")
SplitFieldValuePreserveEnd = True

If Ftop="" then Ftop=Clng(Ctop)
If Clng(Ctop)<Ftop then Ftop=Clng(Ctop)

af.name: IsFieldPercentNonNumeric
af.g:
' A number (0-100) indicating the percentage that results in a condition. The default percentage is 100.
' The value must be numeric, without the percent sign.
Dim Value, TrueCount, FalseCount, TFRatio, Cx, Lval
Dim ValueLen
On Error Resume Next
IsFieldPercentNonNumeric = False
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
StrParam = MetaWord(StrParam)
If IsNull(StrParam) Then StrParam = 100
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(StrParam, locale) Then
Writelog("Percentage parameter not numeric. Value defaults to 100 percent.")
StrParam = 100
end if
Writelog("IsFieldPercentNonNumeric percentage parameter set to " & StrParam & " percent.")
TrueCount = 0
FalseCount = 0
Value = Trim(GetFieldValue())
ValueLen = len(Value)
' \p{N} or \p{Number}: any kind of numeric character in any script.
' \p{Nd} or \p{Decimal_Digit_Number}: a digit zero through nine in any script except ideographic scripts.
' \p{Nl} or \p{Letter_Number}: a number that looks like a letter, such as a Roman numeral.
' \p{No} or \p{Other_Number}: a superscript or subscript digit, or a number that is not a digit 0..9 (excluding numbers from ideographic scripts).
For Cx = 1 To Len(value)
sCharacter=Mid(value,Cx,1)
If DCGlobalStrings.RegExIsMatch(sCharacter,"\p{N}") Then
FalseCount = FalseCount + 1
Elseif DCGlobalStrings.RegExIsMatch(sCharacter,"\p{Mn}") Then
ValueLen = ValueLen - 1
Else
TrueCount = TrueCount + 1
End If
Next 'Cx
TFRatio = (StrParam/100)*ValueLen
If TrueCount >= TFRatio and ValueLen>0 Then IsFieldPercentNonNumeric = True
If ValueLen <= 0 Then ValueLen = 1
WriteLog(Space(3) & "Value is " & (TrueCount/ValueLen)*100 & "% non-numeric")
WriteLog("IsFieldPercentNonNumeric returns " & IsFieldPercentNonNumeric)
If IsFieldPercentNonNumeric = False Then
sMessage = RRState.LoadString("validations","IsFieldPercentNonNumeric_01","Field '{0}' value '{1}' contains less than the required percentage of '{2}' non-numeric characters.")
sMessage = Replace(sMessage,"{0}",CurrentObj.id)
sMessage = Replace(sMessage,"{1}",Value)
sMessage = Replace(sMessage,"{2}",StrParam)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If

af.name: IsMaxOMRChecked
af.g:
'An Integer value specifying this maximum.

Dim sValue

Dim locale
On Error Resume Next

'remove unchecked values
sValue = Replace(sValue,"0","")

Else

sMessage = Replace(sMessage,"{2}",StrParam)
WriteLog(sMessage)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End If
WriteLog("IsMaxOMRChecked returns " & IsMaxOMRChecked)

af.name: CompareFields
af.g:
'Five comma-separated values:
'String value of the source field's name. This is the field with a value to be compared.
'String value of the target field's name. This is the field with a value to be compared to.
'String value: Y or Yes; N or No. Alternatively, a Numeric value: 0 = No or 1=Yes.
'"Yes" (or Y or 1) allows the action to carry out a fuzzy rather precise comparison of the fields' values.
' Numeric value of the percentage of required precision. Numbers less than
' "100" permit increasing fuzziness.
Dim SourceField
Dim CompareToField
Dim byWord
Dim bPFuzzy
Dim nFuzzy
Dim aStrParam
Dim SourceValue
Dim CompareToValue
Dim SourceObj
Dim CompareToObj
Dim regEx
Dim Match
Dim Matches
Dim Pattern
Dim StrStart
Dim FirstChar
Dim bFound
Dim nWCount
Dim sWords
Dim locale
On Error Resume Next
CompareFields = False
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
Set SourceObj = Nothing
Set CompareToObj = Nothing
'Added support for smart parameters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
aStrParam = Split(StrParam & ",,,",",")
SourceField = Trim(aStrParam(0))
CompareToField = Trim(aStrParam(1))
bPFuzzy = Trim(aStrParam(2))
nFuzzy = Trim(aStrParam(3))
byWord = ucase(Trim(aStrParam(4)))
If SourceField = "" Then SourceField = CurrentObj.ID
Set SourceObj = ReturnNamedComponent(SourceField)
Set CompareToObj = ReturnNamedComponent(CompareToField)
If (SourceObj is Nothing) or (CompareToObj is Nothing) then
Writelog("Fields not found to compare. Exiting Action.")
Set SourceObj = Nothing
Set CompareToObj = Nothing
Exit Function
End if
SourceValue = SourceObj.Text
CompareToValue = CompareToObj.Text
WriteLog("Comparing " & SourceValue & " to " & CompareToValue)
bPFuzzy = UCase(bPFuzzy)
byWord = UCase(byWord)
If bPFuzzy = "Y" or bPFuzzy = "YES" or bPFuzzy = "1" then
bPFuzzy = True
Else
bPFuzzy = False
End if
If Not DCGlobalCurrency.isnumeric(nFuzzy, locale) then nFuzzy = cint(100)
nFuzzy = cint(nFuzzy)
If byWord = "Y" or byWord = "YES" or byWord = "1" then
byWord = True
Else
byWord = False
End if
sWords=0
If byWord = False Then
If bPFuzzy Then
Writelog("Root search value: '" & Cstr(SourceValue) & "' ")
StrStart = SourceValue
FirstChar = Left(SourceValue,1)
If Len(SourceValue)>1 Then SourceValue = Right(SourceValue, Len(SourceValue)-1)
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue,"[:#]", "[:#]+")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[B8]", "[B8]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[Z2]", "[Z2]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[S5]", "[S5]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[o0O]", "[o0O]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[ilt1I]", "[ilt1I]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "\ +", "[ ]*")
SourceValue = "^?[\b\s\n\r]*" & FirstChar & SourceValue & "[\b\s\$]*"
End if
Writelog("Search value: '" & Cstr(SourceValue) & "' ")
If DCGlobalStrings.RegExIsMatch(CompareToValue,SourceValue,True) Then
Writelog(DCGlobalStrings.GetLog)
sWords = 1
CompareFields = True
End if
'Check for Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & SourceValue & "'")
Err.Clear
CompareFields = False
Exit Function
End if
Else
'Find number of source Words to find in compare to value
aSourceVal = Split(SourceValue & Space(1),Chr(32))
nWords = ubound(aSourceVal)
nWCount = 0
bFound = False
For i = 0 to (nWords-1)
If bPFuzzy Then
Writelog("Root search value: '" & Cstr(aSourceVal(i)) & "' ")
StrStart = aSourceVal(i)
FirstChar = Left(aSourceVal(i),1)
If Len(aSourceVal(i))>1 Then aSourceVal(i) = Right(aSourceVal(i), Len(aSourceVal(i))-1)
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue,"[:#]", "[:#]+")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[B8]", "[B8]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[Z2]", "[Z2]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[S5]", "[S5]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[o0O]", "[o0O]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "[ilt1I]", "[ilt1I]")
SourceValue = DCGlobalStrings.RegExReplace(SourceValue, "\ +", "[ ]*")
aSourceVal(i) = "^?[\b\s\n\r]*" & FirstChar & aSourceVal(i) & "[\b\s\$]*"
End if
If len(aSourceVal(i))>0 Then
Writelog("Search Value: '" & Cstr(aSourceVal(i)) & "' ")
If DCGlobalStrings.RegExIsMatch(CompareToValue,Cstr(aSourceVal(i))) Then
Writelog(DCGlobalStrings.GetLog)
CompareFields = True
bfound=true
End if
'Check for RegEx Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & Cstr(aSourceVal(i)) & "'")
Err.Clear
CompareFields = False
Exit Function
End if
sWords = sWords + 1
If bFound=False then WriteLog(Space(4) & "No value matched.")
End if
If bFound = True then
nWCount = nWCount + 1
bFound = False
End if
Next 'i
'Check % vs nFuzzy value
If sWords <= 0 then sWords = 1
PMatch = cint((nWCount/sWords)*100)
Writelog(PMatch & "% of the 'Compare To' value matched the search words.")
If PMatch >= cint(nFuzzy) And nWCount>0 Then
CompareFields = True
Else
Writelog("Minimum match percentage is set to " & nFuzzy & "%. Not enough words matched, Returning 'Failed'.")
End If
End if
Set SourceObj = Nothing
Set CompareToObj = Nothing

af.name: IsThisFieldEmpty
af.g:
'Confirms if the current field has no captured value.
On Error Resume Next

sMessage = Replace(sMessage,"{1}",CurrentObj.Text)
DCOMessage(sMessage)
End if

af.name: DeleteLCSpaces
af.g:
Dim ReqConf
Dim sTemp
Dim oSetupNode
Dim locale
On Error Resume Next
'Deletes all low confidence spaces from the captured value. Uses ReqConf Setup dco variable as threshold for low confidence values; defaults to 9
ReqConf = 10
locale = DetermineLocale() 'From rrunner.rrx
Set oSetupNode = CurrentObj.SetupNode
If(oSetupNode is Nothing) Then
writelog ("Unable to get setupNode for field " & CurrentObj.ID)
DeleteLCSpaces = False
Exit function
End if
sTemp = Trim(oSetupNode.Variable("ReqConf"))
If len(sTemp)<>0 and DCGlobalCurrency.IsNumeric(sTemp, locale) then ReqConf = sTemp
Writelog("Spaces with confidence below " & ReqConf & " will be removed.")
nNumOfChar = CurrentObj.NumOfChildren
WriteLog("Character ASCII value : Character Confidence")
For i = 1 to nNumOfChar
Writelog CurrentObj.GetChild(nNumOfChar - i).CharValue(0) & ":" & CurrentObj.GetChild(nNumOfChar - i).CharConfidence(0)
If((CurrentObj.GetChild(nNumOfChar - i).CharValue(0) = 32) and (CurrentObj.GetChild(nNumOfChar - i).CharConfidence(0) < (ReqConf-1))) then
CurrentObj.DeleteChild(nNumOfChar - i)
End if
Next
DeleteLCSpaces = true

af.g:

Dim n, i

Dim oChild
On Error Resume Next

Set oChild = Nothing
n = 0
i = 0

'Added support for smart parameters

writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")

For i = 1 to n
Set oChild = CurrentObj.GetChild(i-1)

If oChild.Type = sType Then
HasChildOfType = True

Next 'i
Set oChild = Nothing
sMessage = cstr(n) & space(1) & "children checked. Type not found:" & strparam
Writelog(sMessage)
