method.name: AskForKVPsAndCreateFieldsUsingPageText
method.qi: : A development aid, showing the KVPs a model can find on a page without hints.

p.name: Question
p.qi: The question to ask Watson.

p.name: Format
p.qi: Specifies the format of the page text that is sent to the model.

method.ap:
Question:
The text that is used for searching. If not specified, a
predefined prompt is submitted. If the identifier {{PAGETEXT}} is within the
custom question, it will automatically be replaced with the text for the current page.
See the top-level text to learn how to read the prompt from a text file.
Format:
Identifies the format of the text sent to the model.
0: The page text is provided as plain text. If not specified, this is the default format.
1: The page text is automatically provided to watsonx.ai in HTML format, if a layout file exists along with the CCO.
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
method.h:
By calling this action on a page that has been previously recognized, it will use the LLM to
obtain key-value pairs from the page text and create fields with values based on the returned data.
If the returned JSON contains nested keys, then nested fields are created. No action is taken
if the returned JSON is invalid.
The results from this action can be unpredictable, and all fields are created at runtime,
making it difficult to programmatically act on the results.
This action is intended to help understand what an
LLM can do during the development stage of an application. The randomness of results does not lend
itself to being easily used in a final production version of an application.
Intended as a development tool, the action can help an application developer better understand what KVPs the LLM
can find on its own. It is less useful in production compared to AskForPageValuesUsingKeys
which can use existing fields with user defined key names for lookup.
The action AskForPageValuesUsingKeys is a better choice for final a production application.
Recognition must have been previously performed and a CCO for the page must exist prior to calling this action.
If the format parameter specifies a text format other than plain text, such as HTML,
it is required that a layout file and the CCO exist for the current page.
The layout file will be used to create the page representation provided to the model
and the CCO will be used to locate the response text on the page. Use the action
CreateCCOFromLayout to create the CCO file from the layout file and the action
NormalizeCCO to adjust the text within the CCO, prior to calling this action.
It is recommended that the default question and model are used for this action. The default values
will usually obtain the proper JSON response from the LLM. If the values are changed, it must be assured
that the LLM will only return valid key-value pairs in JSON format. If the LLM does not return
valid JSON, then the action will not be able to parse the results and create the fields.
If a custom question is provided, or if the model is changed, it is required that the results returned
from the LLM are key-value pairs in JSON format, otherwise this action will not function properly.
Because a large number of tokens can be returned from the LLM, it is recommended to increase the amount of tokens
to the maximum allowed for the model by calling the action SetMaximumNewTokens(). If the LLM generates more tokens than the limit, the generated JSON will be
truncated and invalid. No results will be returned from this action when the JSON is not complete and valid.
The returned KVP hierarchy is under the control of the LLM. The LLM may nest particular keys on one page and not nest the
same keys on another. The hierarchy of the returned keys is dependent on the results returned by the LLM.
Likewise, the names of the keys are determined by the LLM and could change from document to document
even though the document types are the same. For example, invoice 1 could have a key called "InvoiceNo" and
invoice 2 could have a key called "InvoiceNumber".
Your application must
handle changing hierarchies and trees as needed.
The action will create new fields on the page based on the names of the keys returned by the LLM.
If any of the keys or subkeys returned have the same name as other keys used on the page, the names
will be adjusted to make them unique. This is a Datacap requirement for the object hierarchy.
This action requires that the model must respond with an answer in JSON, using the following
format:
{
"Key1": "Value1",
"Key2": "Value2",
"Key3": "Value3",
}
AskForKVPsAndCreateFieldsUsingPageText("", "1")
This example would be called on a page node where recognition has been performed and a CCO
already exists for the page. The page text will be used to query the default LLM to get
the KVPs for the page. The result will create and populate new fields for the current page.

method.name: SetEndpointURL
method.qi: : Configures the destination LLM location.

p.name: LLMURL
p.qi: The URL for the LLM.

method.ap:
The URL to use for requests to the watsonx.ai service.
If this action is not called, the URL will default to: https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/v1/text/generation?version=2023-05-29.
method.h:
Set the destination URL to process the query. The action configures the location
but does not test that the location is valid. An invalid URL is reported
when performing a query to the service.
At the time of publishing, the URL format is: '{cluster_url}/ml/v1/text/generation?version=2023-05-02',
where {cluster_url} is to be replaced by the destination service. These are the service URLs at the time of publication and are
provided as an example. The URL must be complete, including the version specification. Version numbers can change
over time, the default version shown here may need to be replaced with an updated version that is appropriate for the
selected model.
• Dallas: https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com
• Frankfurt: https://eu-de.ml.cloud.ibm.com
• London: https://eu-gb.ml.cloud.ibm.com
• Tokyo: https://jp-tok.ml.cloud.ibm.com
The watsonx.ai URL may change over time. Refer to the watsonx.ai documentation to confirm the token URL is correct.
It is also recommended to subscribe to watsonx.ai updates to get notified of changes or deprecation of URLs or models.
The default URL is provided as a mechanism to asist getting an application running quickly. The URL can be changed
as required, or should the default URL become out-of-date.
SetAccessTokenURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm/token")
SetEndpointURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm")
SetProjectID("THIS-IS-MY-PROJECT-ID")
SetAPIKey("THIS-IS-MY-API-KEY")
Sets the URL for the LLM that is used for queries.
The "Set" actions can be in any order as long as they
are called prior to an action that performs the query to the service.
method.see:
Refer to the top-level help of this action library for information regarding this action library.
SetAPIKey.

method.name: SetEnhancedLogging
method.qi: : Enables diagnostic logging.

p.name: Enabled
p.qi: Turns the enhanced logging on or off.

method.ap:
Enabled:
0, the default, disables enhanced logging.
1, Enables enhanced logging.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
When creating an application or debugging a problem, it is desirable to obtain more information
in the log to diagnose the problem. When enabled, additional information from the watsonx.ai actions
is placed into the RRS action log. This setting does not affect any other action library.
This can be turned off during normal production,
to help reduce the size of the log. Whether enhanced logging is enabled or disabled,
RRS action logging will occur based on the standard logging settings.
SetEnhancedLogging("1")
SetMaximumNewTokens("4096")
AskForPageValuesUsingKeys("", "1")
Enables additional logging to help diagnose prompts and the responses.
method.see: Refer to the top-level help of this action library for information regarding this action library.

method.name: SetAccessTokenURL
method.qi: : Configures the token request end point.

p.name: newTokenURL
p.qi: The token request URL for the service.

method.ap:
The URL for the service to obtain a token from the API key.
If this action is not called, the token URL will default to: https://iam.cloud.ibm.com/identity/token.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
The URL used to obtain a "bearer" token from the "API Key".
The bearer token is required to submit prompt requests to the service.
The token URL must be set prior to using any of the actions that
submit a prompt to the service.
The watsonx.ai URL may change over time. Refer to the watsonx.ai documentation to confirm the token URL is correct.
It is also recommended to subscribe to watsonx.ai updates to get notified of changes or deprecation of URLs or models.
SetAccessTokenURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm/token")
SetEndpointURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm")
SetProjectID("THIS-IS-MY-PROJECT-ID")
SetAPIKey("THIS-IS-MY-API-KEY")
The token URL must be set along with the prompt destination URL.
The "Set" actions can be in any order as long as they
are called prior to an action that performs the query to the service.
method.see:
Refer to the top-level help of this action library for information regarding this action library.
SetAPIKey and SetEndpointURL.

method.name: SetAPIKey
method.qi: : Configures the API key that is provided to the LLM.

p.name: APIKey
p.qi: The authentication API key. Smart parameters are supported.

method.ap:
APIKey:
The API key must be set for the "Ask" prompt actions to run successfully.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Set the API key to use for authentication to the LLM service.
The API key must have been created using appropriate method for the target LLM.
This call configures the setting but does not validate that it is correct.
It is required to call this action to set the authentication API Key before using any action that
communicates with the Watsonx service. This action only needs to be called once per task profile.
SetAccessTokenURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm/token")
SetEndpointURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm")
SetAPIKey("THIS-IS-MY-API-KEY")
SetProjectID("THIS-IS-MY-PROJECT-ID")
In this example, the value "THIS-IS-MY-API-KEY" must be replaced with the unique key for your system.
While this example shows the api key hard coded as a parameter, it is for illustration. See the
next example for embedding the api key in the Application Manager.
SetAccessTokenURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm/token")
SetEndpointURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm")
SetAPIKey("@APPVAR(values/adv/watsonkey)")
SetProjectID("THIS-IS-MY-PROJECT-ID")
Typically the api key will not be hardcoded as a parameter, but instead,
placed within the Application Manager with a key name and value. The example shows how to retrieve the
value from the application manager. It assumes that the key has been placed into the
"Advanced values" section of the "Custom values" tab in Application Manger for the application.
The data placed in the advanced values will be encrypted.
Assuming the key created in the Application Manager has the name "wastonkey", the example will retrieve the value from
the application manager at run time instead of hardcoding the value.
method.see:
Refer to the top-level help of this action library for information regarding this action library.
SetAPIKey and SetEndpointURL.

method.name: SetDecodingMethod
method.qi: : Controls the consistency of the returned data.

p.name: DecodingMethod
p.qi: The decoding method for the LLM to use.

method.ap:
DecodingMethod:
Represents the strategy used for picking the tokens during generation of
the output text. Options are "greedy" and "sample".
Value defaults to "greedy" if not specified.
method.h:
The decoding method changes how the model decides upon an answer.
To generate results that are more consistent, use "greedy". To generate results
that are more random, such as generation of text like poetry, use "sample".
Prompts from programmatic tasks usually will use "greedy".
Call this action prior to calling an action to submit a request to change the default value. This can be configured once
per-task, and it will be used on all subsequent requests.
If this action is not called, "greedy" is used as the default.
SetAccessTokenURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm/token")
SetEndpointURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm")
SetAPIKey("THIS-IS-MY-API-KEY")
SetProjectID("THIS-IS-MY-PROJECT-ID")
SetDecodingMethod("greedy")
Configures the LLM to "greedy", which is the best selection to achieve
more consistent results from the query.
method.ret:
True,
if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False.
The action does not test for invalid values. If the value is invalid, an error will
be generated when the query is performed.
method.see:
Refer to the top-level help of this action library for information regarding this action library.
SetAPIKey and SetEndpointURL.

method.name: SetMaximumNewTokens
method.qi: : Controls the number of returned tokens from the LLM.

p.name: MaximumNewTokens
p.qi: The maximum number of tokens.

method.ap:
MaxNewTokens:
The maximum number of new tokens to be generated.
The value must be greater than 0, defaults to 20 if not specified or invalid.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
How the "token" is defined depends on the tokenizer and vocabulary size, which in turn depends on the model.
Often the tokens are a mix of full words and sub-words. A token does not necessarily equal a word.
The result is dependent on the LLM.
The maximum number allowed can vary based on the model. Check the documentation for the model to
find the maximum supported value. This action does not return an error if the value is invalid
for the selected model. It is up to the model to return an error when the requested token size is invalid for the request.
If the maximum tokens is set to a number larger than what the selected LLM allows, an error is usually returned by watsonx.ai.
Call this action prior to calling an action to submit a request. This can be configured once
per-task, and it will be used on all requests.
It is recommended that setting is always configured to the maximum amount allowed by the model.
If a prompt answer is truncated due to the token limit or timeout, the partial returned results
may be considered as invalid and not used by the calling action.
SetAccessTokenURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm/token")
SetEndpointURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm")
SetAPIKey("THIS-IS-MY-API-KEY")
SetProjectID("THIS-IS-MY-PROJECT-ID")
SetMaximumNewTokens("4096")
Configures the number of returned tokens to 4096.
The "Set" actions can be in any order as long as they
are called prior to an action that performs the query to the service.
method.see:
Refer to the top-level help of this action library for information regarding this action library.
SetAPIKey and SetEndpointURL.

method.name: SetModel
method.qi: : Configures the model that will be used for the LLM prompt request.

p.name: Model
p.qi: The model to use as expected by the LLM.

method.ap:
Model:
The model to be used by subsequent prompt request actions.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
Sets the model Large Language Model (LLM) to be used for the query.
This action configures the model name ID but does not test that the model name ID is valid or accepted by the watsonx.ai LLM.
If this action is not called the model defaults to "ibm/granite-3-8b-instruct".
The default model is provided to help simplify setup, providing an example model that works well for many situations.
Use this action to select a different model.
If the model specified in this action does fails on watsonx.ai,
either because the model is not available or because the model ID was entered incorrectly,
watsonx.ai will typically cause a "Bad Request" error, and the response may not specifically state the that the model name ID is invalid.
When setting the model ID it is critical to get the model ID exactly correct. Refer to the following page to get the correct model names.
For example, the granite-3-8b-instruct model name to use in this action is “ibm/granite-3-8b-instruct”.
Check this page to get the current model names (link working at publication time):
https://dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/docs/content/wsj/analyze-data/fm-api-model-ids.html?context=wx#model-ids
You can also generate a live update of all models available by running this curl command. Use the value in the ‘model_id’ tag to set your model in Datacap.
curl --location 'https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/v1/foundation_model_specs?version=2023-05-02'
Important:
New models are regularly added to watsonx.ai and customers are encouraged to test different models to see what works best on your documents.
A model, the default model or a user specified model, can eventually be deprecated or removed by the service provider.
This change is out of the hands of the Datacap product.
It is extremely important to keep up with any notices from the service provider about an up coming model deprecation or removal.
When changing to a new model, comprehensive testing is required to ensure that the model performs
well enough to be processed by the Datacap actions and that the results are acceptable for the application.
If the specified model does not exactly match the name expected by the watsonx service, the request will fail.
The failure reason of "not found" can mean that the specified model is not correct.
Refer to the service documentation for the correct specification of the model name and to confirm that the model is still supported.
It is recommended to review the service documentation as to the purpose of the selected model.
Models that are targeted to responding to programmatic requests will generally work better
in a "zero-shot" approach than a "chat" model, which typically uses a back-and-forth approach to refine an answer.
As the rules are run without interaction, a single request needs to return the desired answer in the desired format.
Models on watsonx.ai can be removed from watsonx.ai over time.
SetAccessTokenURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm/token")
SetEndpointURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm")
SetAPIKey("THIS-IS-MY-API-KEY")
SetProjectID("THIS-IS-MY-PROJECT-ID")
SetModel("ibm/granite-13b-lab-incubation")
The set model will remain in effect for the task until it is changed.
It is allowed to change the model setting between prompt requests.
method.see:
Refer to the top-level help of this action library for information regarding this action library.
SetAPIKey and SetEndpointURL.

method.name: SetProxy
method.qi: : Configures proxy settings, if needed.

p.qi: The port for the proxy server.

p.name: ProxyUsername
p.qi: The proxy server username.

p.name: ProxyPassword
p.qi: The password for the proxy server username.

method.ap:
All parameters support smart parameters.
The password can be encrypted by storing it in the Advanced section of the Custom tab in the Application Manager.
The URL and user name parameters can be stored in the General section of the Datacap Application Manager.
To retrieve the password that is stored in the Advanced section, use a smart parameter for the action's

where proxyPassword is where the password is configured in the Application Manager.
method.h:
Allows configuration of a proxy server for communication to the watsonx.ai endpoint.
This action is required only when the network environment uses a proxy server.
SetProxy("https://the-location-of-the-proxy", 8080, "MyUserID", @APPVAR(values/adv/proxyPassword))
method.see: Refer to the top-level help of this action library for information regarding this action library.

method.name: SetTemperature
method.qi: : Configures the temperature value for the LLM query.

p.name: Temperature
p.qi: The temperature value for the request.

method.ap:
Temperature:
Controls the "randomness" of the query result. Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
A value used to modify the next-token probabilities in sampling mode.
Values less than 1.0 sharpen the probability distribution, resulting in "less random" output.
Values greater than 1.0 flatten the probability distribution, resulting in "more random" output.
A value of 1.0 is the default. The allowed range is 0.0 to 2.0.
When programmatically using the LLM to obtain metadata, generally the temperature should be low
to obtain consistent results. With a higher temperature, the same query will cause
the LLM to return a different answer.
Call this action prior to calling an action to submit a request. This can be configured once
per-task, and it will be used on all requests.
If the provided temperature parameter is invalid, or out of range, this will not be detected until an "Ask" action
is performed.
SetAccessTokenURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm/token")
SetEndpointURL("https://the-location-of-the-llm")
SetAPIKey("THIS-IS-MY-API-KEY")
SetProjectID("THIS-IS-MY-PROJECT-ID")
SetTemperature("0.5")
The temperature is set to "0.5" for subsequent queries to the LLM.

SetAPIKey and SetEndpointURL.

method.name: SetTimeLimit
method.qi: : Controls the maximum amount of time LLM will allow for a response.

p.name: TimeLimit
p.qi: The time limit in seconds.

method.ap:
TimeLimit:
The maximum number of seconds to wait for an answer.
If not set, the value defaults to 0, which is infinite.
Smart parameters are supported.
method.h:
The model will use the timeout as the maximum time allowed to answer to the query.
Call this action prior to calling an action to submit a request. This can be configured once
per-task, and the value will be used for the entire task for all requests. If not called,
the timeout will default to infinite.
If the timeout is too short and truncates the response from the model,
the portion returned may be treated as invalid.

SetTimeLimit("300")
Sets the timeout to 5 minutes.

net.h:
This library of actions facilitates communication with external web services.
You can use these actions to get formatted responses or image files.
The actions can handle both XML and JSON formatted responses, with XML being the expected default.
You will need to know the web service's endpoint, any parameters if applicable and the response type before using these actions.

method.name: WsGetValues

p.name: url
p.qi: Required: the URL of the web service.

p.name: nsprefix
p.qi: Optional: the prefix of the Namespace if you are using tags to obtain results.

p.name: nsuri
p.qi: Optional: the Namespace URI. If a namespace has already been set, you do not need to set the URI.

p.name: source
p.qi: Optional: the xpath or tag to obtain the value. The xpath/tag and target are set separately.

p.name: target
p.qi: Optional: the target DCO. You can set the xpath/tag and target separately, and if no path is set then the entire result set is saved to the target.

p.name: format
p.qi: Optional: the return format type. The default is XML.

p.name: savefile
p.qi: Optional: save the response results to this file for reference.

method.ret:
True
, if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False
.
method.h:
The WsGetValues action returns one or more values from a web service.
The value for the URL should include the end point. This is the only required value if the parameters and target values are set before calling the action.
Smart parameters are supported.
Example 1
uses xpath with a namespace to obtain information from the web service:
WsGetvalues("http://api.worldbank.org/countries?format=xml", "wb", "http://www.worldbank.org", "//wb:countries/wb:country[5]/wb:name", "@B.Country", "", "C:\myfolder\myfile.xml")
Example 2
uses tag value to obtain the information:
WsGetvalues(" http://www.webservicex.net/CurrencyConvertor.asmx/ConversionRate?FromCurrency=USD&ToCurrency=GBP", "", "", "double", "@B.ConversionRate", "", "")
Example 3
shows the syntax for JSON:
WsSetParameter("symbols", "USD", true)
WsSetParameter("symbols", "GBP", true)
WsGetvalues("http://api.fixer.io/latest?", "", "", "", "", "JSON", "@PILOT(BATCHDIR)+/+rates +.json")

method.name: WsIsWindowsAuthenticationEnabled

p.name: IsEnabled
p.qi: Parameter to set if Windows Authentication enabled and used.

method.ret:
True
, if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False
.
method.h:
Use this action if using Windows Authentication for the url to connect.
Set 1 or True to the parameter to set if windows authentication is enabled.
Use this action before WsGetValues action or other action which connects to the webservice url.
Example
Set the parameter if windows authentication is enabled.
WsIsWindowsAuthenticationEnabled(True)
WsGetvalues("http://api.fixer.io/latest?", "", "", "", "", "JSON", "@PILOT(BATCHDIR)+/+rates +.json")

method.name: WsGetFile

p.name: url
p.qi: Required: the URL of the web service. Smart parameters are supported.

p.name: filename
p.qi: Required: the name to use for the downloaded file. Smart parameters are supported.

p.name: timeout
p.qi: Optional: the timeout value in milliseconds before abandoning the request.

method.ret:
True
, if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False
.
method.h:
Downloads a file from a web service using the provided file name.
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
The timeout value specified for this operation will override any timeout value set elsewhere.
The default timeout value is 60000 milliseconds, or one minute.
WsGetfile("http://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/staticmap?center=Costa Mesa,CA&zoom=14&size=400x400&sensor=false", "C:\Test\CMmap.png", 120000)

method.name: WsUploadFile

p.name: url
p.qi: Required: the URI of the resource to receive the file. Smart parameters are supported.

p.name: filename
p.qi: Required: the file to send to the resource. Smart parameters are supported.

p.name: method
p.qi: Optional: the file upload method. By default, 'POST' is used for http and 'STOR' for ftp.

p.name: timeout
p.qi: Optional: the timeout value in milliseconds before abandoning the request. Smart parameters are supported.

method.ret:
True
, if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False
.
method.h:
Uploads a file to a web service.
The timeout value specified for this operation will override any timeout value set elsewhere.
The default timeout value is 60000 milliseconds, or one minute.
If no method is specified, the default is "POST" for http and "STOR" for ftp.
WsUploadFile("http://server/service", "C:\Test\myfile.jpg", "", "120000")

method.name: WsUploadFileEx

p.name: url
p.qi: Required: the URI of the resource to receive the file. Smart parameters are supported.

p.name: filename
p.qi: Required: the file to send to the resource. Smart parameters are supported.

p.name: sessionkeys
p.qi: Optional: comma-separated list of session key names.

p.name: method
p.qi: Optional: the file upload method. By default, 'POST' is used for http and 'STOR' for ftp.

p.name: timeout
p.qi: Optional: the timeout value in milliseconds before abandoning the request. Smart parameters are supported.

method.ret:
True
, if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False
.
method.h:
Uploads a file to a web service.
The timeout value specified for this operation will override any timeout value set elsewhere.
The default timeout value is 60000 milliseconds, or one minute.
If no method is specified, the default is "POST" for http and "STOR" for ftp.
WsSetHeader("http://server/service","Content-Type","application/json","True")
WsSetHeader("http://server/service","accept","*/*","True")
WsUploadFileEx("http://server/service", "C:\Test\myfile.jpg", "Set-Cookie","POST","120000")

method.name: WsUploadData

p.name: url
p.qi: Required: the URL of the web service.

p.name: uploadData
p.qi: Required: the data to upload.

p.name: sessionkeys
p.qi: Optional: comma-separated list of session key names.

p.name: format
p.qi: Optional: return format type. The default is xml.

p.name: responsefile
p.qi: Optional: save the response results to this file for later use.

method.ret:
True
, if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False
.
method.h:
Upload data to a WebService endpoint using a POST request.
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
The example shows how to use wTM endpoints to log on and create a batch:
WsSetHeader("@STRING(Content-Type)", "@STRING(application/xml)", false)
WsUploadData("http://localhost:8010/ServicewTM.svc/Session/Logon",
"
Demo901
admin
1
admin
",
"", "xml", "C:\myfolder\logon.xml")
WsUploadData("http://localhost:8010/ServicewTM.svc/Queue/CreateBatch",
"
Demo901
Demo_SingleTIFFs
",
"Set-Cookie", "", "C:\myfolder\createbatch.xml")

method.name: WsUploadDataEx

p.name: url
p.qi: Required: the URL of the web service.

p.name: uploadData
p.qi: Required: the data to upload.

p.name: sessionkeys
p.qi: Optional: comma-separated list of session key names.

p.name: format
p.qi: Optional: return format type. The default is xml.

p.name: method
p.qi: Optional: the file upload method. By default, 'POST','PUT' is used for http and 'STOR' for ftp.

p.name: responsefile
p.qi: Optional: save the response results to this file for later use.

method.ret:
True
, if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False
.
method.h:
Upload data to a WebService endpoint using a specified method request.
Smart parameters are supported for all parameters.
The example shows how to use wTM endpoints to log on and create a batch:
WsSetHeader("@STRING(Content-Type)", "@STRING(application/xml)", false)
WsUploadDataEx("http://localhost:82/service/Session/LogonEx?loadUserProfile=true",
"
TravelDocs
admin
1
admin
",
"Set-Cookie", "xml", "POST","C:\myfolder\logon.xml")
WsUploadFileEx("http://localhost:82/service/Queue/UploadFile/TravelDocs/+@B.QID+",
"C:\Datacap\TravelDocs\images\car2.tif",
"Set-Cookie", "POST","c:\Datacap\response.txt")
WsUploadDataEx("http://localhost:82/service/Queue/ReleaseBatch/TravelDocs/+@B.QID+/finished","","Set-Cookie", "xml", "PUT","")

method.name: WsSetParameter

p.name: name

p.name: value

p.name: add

WsSetParameter("FromCurrency", "USD", false)

p.qi: The type of encoding to apply. URI or DATA types are supported.

method.ret:
Always
True
.

WsSetParameter("CountryName", "United States", false)
WsSetParameter("CityName", "Newark", false)

method.name: WsClearParameters
method.ret:
True
, if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False
.
method.ap: None.
method.h:
Clear all of the previously set web service parameters.
Call this action if you need to send a new set of parameters for your next call to any web service.
WsSetParameter("FromCurrency", "USD", false)
WsSetParameter("ToCurrency", @APPVAR(values/gen/ToCurrency), false)
WsSetResultItem("double", "@B.ConversionRate")
WsGetvalues(@APPVAR(values/gen/CurrencyConvertor), "", "", "", "", "")
WsClearParameters()
WsClearResultItems()
WsSetParameter("address", "10 Downing Street, London", false)
WsSetParameter("sensor", "false", false)
WsSetResultItem("GeocodeResponse/result/geometry/location/lat", "@B.Latitude")
WsSetResultItem("GeocodeResponse/result/geometry/location/lng", "@B.Longitude")
WsGetvalues("http://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/xml?", "", "", "", "", "")

method.name: WsSetResultItem

p.name: source
p.qi: The xpath or tags to find the value in the result. Smart parameters are supported.

p.name: target
p.qi: Destination item to assign the value.

method.ret:
True
, if the action succeeds. Otherwise,
False
.
method.h:
This action will associate the keys(xpath or tags) to the values from the response to the DCO objects to which you want to assign them.
If the source already exists its corresponding target will be replaced with the new target value.
This action must be set before calling the response.
Use this action if you want to get more than a single value from the response.
Example 1
WsSetParameter("FromCurrency", "USD", false)
WsSetParameter("ToCurrency", "GBP", false)
WsSetResultItem("double", "@B.ConversionRate")
WsGetvalues("http://www.webservicex.net/CurrencyConvertor.asmx/ConversionRate?", "", "", "", "", "")
Example 2
WsSetResultItem("@STRING(rates.USD)", "@B.EUR2USD")
WsSetResultItem("@STRING(rates.GBP)", "@B.EUR2GBP")
WsGetvalues("http://api.fixer.io/latest?", "", "", "", "", "JSON", "")

af.name: PopulateZNField
af.g:
PopulateZNField=DCOFieldFromCCO(CurrentObj, CCO)
writelog("Found Value: '" & CurrentObj.Text & "' ")

af.name: PopulateZNLineItemField
af.g:
PopulateZNLineItemField=False
sPos=CurrentObj.Variable("Position")
If( sPos<>"" and sPos <> "0,0,0,0" ) Then
If Not AdjustPosToParent(CurrentObj,"1") Then Exit Function
PopulateZNLineItemField=DCOFieldFromCCO(CurrentObj, CCO)
Else
PopulateZNLineItemField=true
End If

af.name: ScanDetails
af.g:
On Error Resume Next
ScanDetails=False
Writelog("ScanDetailsEnter")
'Must be a Field Object
If CurrentObj.ObjectType<>3 Then
Writelog("Action must be called from a DCO Field. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
If Not DivideChildsByLines(CurrentObj, CCO, 1)>0 Then Exit Function
CurrentObj.Text=""
nCount=CurrentObj.NumOfChildren()
For i=0 To nCount-1
CurrentObj.GetChild(i).CreateFields()
Next
ScanDetails=True

af.name: ScanDetailsByLines
af.g:
On Error Resume Next
ScanDetailsByLines=False
Writelog("ScanDetailsByLinesEnter")
'Must be a Field Object
If CurrentObj.ObjectType<>3 Then
Writelog("Action must be called from a DCO Field. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
'Added support for smart parameters
sParam=MetaWord(sParam)
writelog("Param: '" & sParam & "'")
If Not DivideChildsByLines(CurrentObj, CCO, CLng(sParam))>0 Then Exit Function
CurrentObj.Text=""
nCount=CurrentObj.NumOfChildren()
For i=0 To nCount-1
CurrentObj.GetChild(i).CreateFields()
Next
ScanDetailsByLines=True

af.name: ScanDetailsByVSpace
af.g:
On Error Resume Next
ScanDetailsByVSpace=False
Writelog("ScanDetailsByVSpace...")
'Must be a Field Object
If CurrentObj.ObjectType<>3 Then
Writelog("Action must be called from a DCO Field. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
'Added support for smart parameters
sParam=MetaWord(sParam)
writelog("Param: '" & sParam & "'")
If Not DivideChildsByVSpace(CurrentObj, CCO, CLng(sParam))>0 Then Exit Function
CurrentObj.Text=""
nCount=CurrentObj.NumOfChildren()
For i=0 To nCount-1
CurrentObj.GetChild(i).CreateFields()
Next
ScanDetailsByVSpace=True

af.name: ScanLineItem
af.g:
On Error Resume Next
Dim newPos
ScanLineItem=False
'Must be a Field Object
If CurrentObj.ObjectType<>3 Then
Writelog("Action must be called from a DCO Field. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
sName=oCurPage.Variable("TemplateID")
Writelog(sName)
CurrentObj.CreateFields()
nCount=CurrentObj.NumOfChildren()
For i=0 To nCount-1
Set oField=CurrentObj.GetChild(i)
Writelog(oField.ID)
If Not oField Is Nothing Then
newPos=Trim(oField.Variable("Pos" & sName))

af.name: ReadZones
af.g:
Dim sName
Dim PosName
Dim sOffSet
Dim aOffSet
Dim nXoffset
Dim nYoffset
Dim oCurPage
Dim bPos
Dim bPM
On Error Resume Next
ReadZones=True
sOffSet = ""
Set oCurPage = CurrentObj
sOffSet=oCurPage.Variable("Image_Offset")
While oCurPage.ObjectType<>2 AND oCurPage.ObjectType>1
Set oCurPage = oCurPage.Parent()
If len(sOffSet)=0 then sOffSet=oCurPage.Variable("Image_Offset")
Wend
sName=oCurPage.Variable("TemplateID")
PosName = "Pos" & sName
Writelog("ReadZones for " & PosName)
aOffSet = Split(sOffSet & ",0" , ",")
nXoffset = (-1*aOffSet(0))
nYoffset = (-1*aOffSet(1))
If Not(Isnumeric(nXoffSet)) or len(trim(nXoffSet))=0 then
nXoffset = 0
writelog("X offset value was not numeric or empty. Setting value to Zero.")
end if
If Not(Isnumeric(nYoffSet)) or len(trim(nYoffSet))=0 then
nYoffset = 0
writelog("Y offset value was not numeric or empty. Setting value to Zero.")
end if
Writelog("Offsets : " & nXoffset & "," & nYoffset)
oSet = 0
xAdj = clng(nXoffSet)
Yadj = clng(nYoffSet)
If CurrentObj.ObjectType < 4 then
sZonePos = CurrentObj.variable(PosName)
'writelog("DCO pos:" & sZonePos)
bPM = Not(CurrentObj.Variable("PatternMatch")="1")
bPos = CurrentObj.Variable("Position")="0,0,0,0" or CurrentObj.Variable("Position")=""
If sZonePos <> "" and sZonePos <> "0,0,0,0" and bPM and bPos then
arZonePos=split(sZonePos,",")
If UBound(arZonePos)=3 Then
arZonePos(0)=arZonePos(0)+Xadj
arZonePos(1)=arZonePos(1)+Yadj
arZonePos(2)=arZonePos(2)+Xadj
arZonePos(3)=arZonePos(3)+Yadj
CurrentObj.Variable("Position")=CStr(arZonePos(0)) & "," & CStr(arZonePos(1)) & "," & CStr(arZonePos(2)) & "," & CStr(arZonePos(3))
writelog("new pos:" & CurrentObj.Variable("Position"))
End if
End if
Set oSetupNode = CurrentObj.SetupNode()
If Not(oSetupNode is Nothing) then
If oSetupNode.variable("RecogType")="4" then
writelog(space(oSet+2) & "OMR recogtype found.")
For nChar = 1 to oSetupNode.NumOfRules
Set oSubRule = oSetupNode.GetRule(nChar-1)
Set oSubChar = CurrentObj.GetChild(nChar-1)
If Not(oSubRule is Nothing) then
If oSubChar is Nothing then
Set oSubChar = CurrentObj.AddChild(4, "", -1)
End if
sZonePos = oSubRule.variable(PosName)
writelog(space(oSet+2) & "Found ZonePos: " & sZonePos)
if sZonePos <> "" and sZonePos <> "0,0,0,0" then
arZonePos=split(sZonePos,",")
If UBound(arZonePos)=3 Then
arZonePos(0)=arZonePos(0)+Xadj
arZonePos(1)=arZonePos(1)+Yadj
arZonePos(2)=arZonePos(2)+Xadj
arZonePos(3)=arZonePos(3)+Yadj
bRes = oSubChar.SetPosition(clng(arZonePos(0)) ,clng(arZonePos(1)),clng(arZonePos(2)),clng(arZonePos(3)))
bRes = oSubChar.GetPosition(clng(arZonePos(0)) ,clng(arZonePos(1)),clng(arZonePos(2)),clng(arZonePos(3)))
'writelog("Saved X Y (" & CStr(arZonePos(2)- arZonePos(0)) & "," & CStr(arZonePos(3)-arZonePos(1)) & ") " & vbcrlf)
end if
end if
End If
Next 'nChar
End If
End If
Set oSetupNode = Nothing
Call ZoneChildren(CurrentObj, PosName, oSet, Xadj, Yadj)
End if

f.name: FindZoneLineItems

'Dev Comments - do not remove this information
'1) If true then create and find lineitem subfields
' If false then only find lineitem
'2) If true (default) then Analyze the area & create block cco

'4) Adjust Search LineItem Area to CCO Line start if start of line within x% difference of line length

Dim pHt
Dim Px
Dim Tobj,zTop
Dim oParent
Dim sPosition
Dim tPosition
Dim sMCCO
Dim sFillType
Dim nGroupValue
Dim arGroup
Dim bLineAdj
Dim nRatio
On Error Resume Next
FindZoneLineItems = False
If zn_IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
'Check for sub field to use as 'Lineitem' - required
If CurrentObj.SetupNode().NumOfRules=0 then
Writelog("Calling Field '" & CurrentObj.ID & "' has no child fields in the Setup DCO. Exiting")
Exit Function
End if
'Parse and Check Parameter Values
'Added support for smart paramters
bCreateFields = ucase(Trim(MetaWord(createSubfields))) ' Parameter 1
bAnalyzeBlock = ucase(Trim(MetaWord(createTempCCO))) ' Parameter 2
sFillType = trim(MetaWord(subfieldFillType)) ' Parameter 3
bLineAdj = ucase(trim(MetaWord(offsetPercent))) ' Parameter 4
nRatio = trim(MetaWord(intersectionRatio)) ' Parameter 5
'PARAMETER 1
If bCreateFields = "" Then bCreateFields = "TRUE"
If bCreateFields="TRUE" Then
Writelog("CreateFields option is 'ON'.")
ElseIf bCreateFields="FALSE" Then
Writelog("CreateFields option is 'OFF'.")
Else
Writelog("Unknown CreateFields Parameter. Using Default of 'ON'.")
bCreateFields="TRUE"
End if
'PARAMETER 2
If bAnalyzeBlock = "" Then bAnalyzeBlock = "TRUE"
If bAnalyzeBlock="TRUE" Then
Writelog("AnalyzeBlock option is 'ON'.")
ElseIf bAnalyzeBlock="FALSE" Then
Writelog("AnalyzeBlock option is 'OFF'.")
Else
Writelog("Unknown bAnalyzeBlock Parameter. Using Default of 'ON'.")
bAnalyzeBlock="TRUE"
End if
'PARAMETER 3
If sFillType = "" Then sFillType = "1:0"
If instr(sFillType,":")>0 Then
aFillType = Split(sFillType,":")
sFillType = aFillType(0)
nGroupvalue = aFillType(1)
If Not isnumeric(Trim(nGroupvalue)) Then
nGroupValue=clng(0)
Else
nGroupvalue=clng(nGroupValue)
End if
Else
nGroupValue = clng(0)
End if
If NOT instr("1,2",sFillType)>0 then
Writelog("Invalid FillType Parameter")
sFillType="1"
End if
'PARAMETER 4
If Not IsNumeric(bLineAdj) then
bLineAdj = "0"
End if
Writelog("offsetPercent = '" & bLineAdj & "'.")
bLineAdj = cint(bLineAdj)
'PARAMETER 5
If Not IsNumeric(nRatio) then
nRatio = ".25"
End if
Writelog("intersectionRatio = '" & nRatio & "'.")
nRatio = cdbl(nRatio)
'Note: The "LineItem" field Defaults to the first child for the calling field.
Set oRootItem = Nothing
Set oRootPage = CurrentObj
Set oCurrLine = Nothing
'look for local offset value before page offset value
sOffSet = oRootPage.Variable("Image_Offset")
While oRootPage.ObjectType > 2 And Not(oRootPage.ObjectType<=1)
Set oRootPage = oRootPage.Parent()
If sOffSet = "" then sOffSet = oRootPage.Variable("Image_Offset")
Wend
'loading current Fingerprint ID
sPosName = "Pos" & oRootPage.Variable("TemplateID")
'Calculate offset string
aOffSet = Split(sOffSet & ",0" , ",")
nXoffset = aOffSet(0)
nYoffset = aOffSet(1)
If Not(IsNumeric(nXoffSet)) Or Len(Trim(nXoffSet))=0 Then
nXoffset = 0
writelog("X offset value was not numeric or empty. Setting value to Zero.")
Else
nXoffset = (-1*nXoffset)
End If
If Not(IsNumeric(nYoffSet)) Or Len(Trim(nYoffSet))=0 Then
nYoffset = 0
writelog("Y offset value was not numeric or empty. Setting value to Zero.")
Else
nYoffset = (-1*nYoffset)
End If
Writelog("Offset Value : " & nXoffset & "," & nYoffset)
nLines=0
'Find Current Position limits
Set oParent=CurrentObj
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
If ubound(arField)<>3 then arField=SplitNumber("0,0,0,0")
While (sPosition="" Or sPosition="0,0,0,0") and oParent.objectType>1
Writelog("Search zone is empty or Zero's (0,0,0,0). Checking parent node for valid zone...")
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
tPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
If tPosition="" or tPosition="0,0,0,0" Then
Writelog("Position info for " & oParent.Id & ":'" & tPosition & "' is empty or Zero's.")
Else
Writelog("Setting search zone to position from " & oParent.Id & ":'" & tPosition & "'.")
sPosition=tPosition
End if
Wend
If sPosition="" or sPosition="0,0,0,0" then
Writelog("A valid search zone (not empty or Zero's) was not found. Exiting.")
Exit Function
end if
Set oParent=Nothing
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
nStarted=0
nLastLine = -1
hdiff = 0
arField(0) = arField(0)-10
arField(1) = arField(1)-10
If arField(2)>0 then arField(2) = arField(2)+10
If arField(3)>0 then arField(3) = arField(3)+10
'Establish Search Limits for ZEROED zone values
If arField(0) <= 0 Then
arField(0) = CCO.Left
End if
If arField(1) <= 0 Then
arField(1) = CCO.Top
If CCO.Count > 0 Then arField(1) = CCO.Item(1).Top
End if
If arField(2) > CCO.Right Or arField(2) <= 0 Then arField(2) = CCO.Right
'Find Lowest zoneCCO Position
If arField(3) > CCO.Bottom Or arField(3) <= 0 Then
If CCO.Count>0 then
arField(3) = CCO.item(CCO.Count).Bottom
Else
arField(3) = CCO.Bottom
End if
End if
If arField(0)>arField(2) Then
writelog("Swapping left and right zone positions")
Dim tval
tval = arField(0)
arField(0) = arField(2)
arField(2) = tval
End If
If arField(1)>arField(3) Then
writelog("Swapping top and bottom zone positions")
tval = arField(1)
arField(1) = arField(3)
arField(3) = tval
End If
If CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = "0,0,0,0" or CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = "" then
CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = cstr(arField(0)) & "," & cstr(arfield(1)) & "," & cstr(arfield(2)) & "," & cstr(arField(3))
End if
iName = oCurPage.Imagename
iName = Left(iName, Len(iName)-4) & "_"
If bAnalyzeBlock = "FALSE" Then
Set ZoneCCO = CCO
ElseIf Not FileMgr.FileExists(iName & CurrentObj.ID & ".CCO") Then
Writelog("Analyzing New BlockCCO...")
Set zoneCCO = CCOCreator.AnalyzeBlock(oRootPage.Imagename,arField(0),arField(1),arField(2),arField(3))
Call GetBlockChars(zoneCCO, arField(0),arField(1),arField(2),arField(3))
Call zoneCCO.Save(iName & CurrentObj.ID & ".CCO")
CurrentObj.Variable("CCOBlock") = iName & CurrentObj.ID & ".CCO"
Else
Dim lbCCOCreator
set lbCCOCreator = CreateObject("CCO._CCOCreator.1")
set zoneCCO = lbCCOCreator.load(iName & CurrentObj.ID & ".CCO")
Writelog("Loading BlockCCO '" & iName & CurrentObj.ID & ".CCO" & "' ")
Set lbCCOCreator = nothing
End if
'Writelog("** FindLineItems v7.5.29 **")
'Create and Init Page Height Dictionary - cumulative height counter by page number
pNm=0
pHt=0
prevHt=0
'Initialize MCCO Page Counter
sMCCO=oCurPage.Variable("CCOBlock")
If sMCCO<>"" Then
sMCCO = FileMgr.GetFileName(sMCCO)
Writelog("MCCO file loaded: " & sMCCO)
sMCCO = sMCCO & "_"
End if
'Function to Find Start Line here!
Dim LookTop
Dim LookLine
Dim LookEnd
LookTop = 1
LookEnd = zoneCCO.Count
LookLine = LookEnd
Call zoneCCO.LocateLines(arField(1),arField(3),LookTop,LookEnd)
Writelog("ZNTop='" & arField(1) & "' ZNBottom='" & arField(3) & "' LineTop=" & LookTop & " LBottom=" & LookEnd)
If LookTop = 0 or LookEnd = 0 or zoneCCO.Count=0 then
Writelog("No Recognition Characters in Search Area.")
Exit Function
End if
For i=LookTop To LookEnd
Set oLine=zoneCCO.Item(i)
arLine(0)=oLine.Left
arLine(1)=oLine.Top
arLine(2)=oLine.Right
arLine(3)=oLine.Bottom
'Cumulative Page Height Counter - for merged CCO's
If oLine.ImageNum>pNm then
pNm = oLine.ImageNum
End if
'Calculate an intersection ratio of oLine to Search Area
IRatio = 1 'IntersectRatio(arField, arLine)
ErrorHandler("FindZoneLineItems Position 100")
If IRatio>0 Then 'CCO line is within the Details Search Area - Line (i) Intersects Detail Area.
Writelog(Space(4) & "Line " & cstr(i) & " Image " & pNm & " '" & oLine.Value & "'")
For j=1 To zoneCCO.Item(i).Count
Set oWord = zoneCCO.Item(i).Item(j)
arWord(0)=oWord.Left
arWord(1)=oWord.Top
arWord(2)=oWord.Right
arWord(3)=oWord.Bottom
'Calculate an intersection ratio of oWord to Search Area
IRatio = IntersectRatio(arField, arWord)
'Calculate GroupWords Area - for SubField Population
arGroup=arWord
If nGroupValue>clng(0) AND oWord.Count>0 Then
'Calculate nPixels
nPixels = nGroupValue * ((oWord.Right-oWord.Left)/oWord.Count)
'Check Word Left
If j>1 then
If (oWord.Left-oLine.Item(j-1).Right)<=nPixels Then
arGroup(0)=oLine.Item(j-1).left
End if
End if
'Check Word Right
If j<oLine.Count then
if (oLine.Item(j+1).Left-oWord.Right)<=nPixels Then
arGroup(2)=oLine.Item(j+1).Right
End if
End if
End if
ErrorHandler("FindZoneLineItems Position 200")
If IRatio>0 Then 'CCO Word is within the Details Search Area - Word (j) Intersects Detail Area.
'Find Next Child to Create (could be the first child)
If nLastLine = -1 Then
If (CurrentObj.NumOfChildren - Len(CurrentObj.Text)) = 0 Then
'No existing sub-fields found - creating first child
CurrentObj.CreateFields()
Else
'Existing sub-fields found - Creating Next child
For Px = 1 To (CurrentObj.NumOfChildren - Len(CurrentObj.Text))
sBaseName = CurrentObj.SetupNode().GetRule(0).Name
Set TObj = CurrentObj.GetChild(Px-1)
sNum = Replace(TObj.Id,sBaseName,"")
If Len(sNum) > 0 And IsNumeric(sNum) Then
If CInt(sNum) > nLines Then
nLines = CInt(sNum)
'writelog(Space(6) & "Next Line number changes to:" & nLines)
End If
End If
Set Tobj=nothing
Next 'P
nLines = nLines + 1
End If
End If
'THIS SECTION CREATES NEW LINES ONLY
If nLines = 0 And i <> nLastLine Then
'ONLY 1ST LINE LOGIC
Set oCurrLine=CurrentObj.GetChild(nLines)
If oCurrLine Is Nothing Then Exit Function
If oCurrLine.variable(sPosName)<>"" Then
arCurrLine = splitnumber(oCurrLine.variable(sPosName))
ElseIf oCurrLine.Variable("Position")<>"" then
arCurrLine = splitnumber(oCurrLine.Variable("Position"))
Else
arCurrLine = splitnumber("0,0,0,0")
End if
'Calculate Zone Height
zTop = arCurrLine(1)
hDiff = arCurrLine(3)-arCurrLine(1)
lDiff = arLine(3)-arLine(1)
'Calculate % difference in height
If hDiff>lDiff Then pDiff = lDiff/hDiff
If lDiff>hDiff Then pDiff = hDiff/lDiff
'Calculate local offset
'Writelog("LOF%:'" & cint(abs(oLine.Left-arCurrLine(0))/(arCurrLine(2)-arCurrLine(0))*100) & "%'")
'Writelog("CurXoff:'" & nXoffset & "' PercentXoff:'" & (oLine.Left-arCurrLine(0))& "'")
If bLineAdj>cint(0) Then
If cint(abs(oLine.Left-arCurrLine(0))/(arCurrLine(2)-arCurrLine(0))*100)<=bLineAdj then
nXoffset = (oLine.Left-arCurrLine(0))
Writelog("Line X offset:'" & nXoffset & "'")
End if
End if
'Adjust Zone Positions
If arCurrLine(2)>arCurrLine(0) Then
arCurrLine(0) = arCurrLine(0) + CLng(nXoffset)
arCurrLine(2) = arCurrLine(2) + CLng(nXoffset)
End if
arCurrLine(1) = arLine(1) 'Set Top of new line to current CCO line
'Need to check zone height restrictions for 1 or 2+ lines-
'i.e. are all subfields on same H plane or check line height vs Zone height as a percentage.
If pDiff<.8 Then
arCurrLine(3) = arCurrLine(1) + CLng(hdiff) 'Set Bottom of new line to current + zone height
Else
arCurrLine(3) = arLine(3)
End If
'Save Adjusted Zone & ID
oCurrLine.Id = oCurrLine.Id & CStr(nLines)
oCurrLine.Variable("Zone") = CStr(arField(0)) & "," & CStr(arLine(1)) & "," & CStr(arField(2)) & "," & CStr(arLine(3))
'Save Adjusted Position
oCurrLine.Variable("Position") = CStr(arCurrLine(0)) & "," & CStr(arCurrLine(1)-clng(pHt)) & "," & CStr(arCurrLine(2)) & "," & CStr(arCurrLine(3)-clng(pHt))
'Check for Page Reference
If pNm>1 then
If Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oCurrLine.Variable("IMAGEFILE")))<>ucase(oCurPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(pNm))) then
If Trim(oCurPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(pNm)))<>"" then
oCurrLine.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oCurPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(pNm))
end if
End if
oCurrLine.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=oLine.ImageHeight
End if
'Create Sub Fields T/F
If bCreateFields = "TRUE" Then Call oCurrLine.CreateFields()
ErrorHandler("FindZoneLineItems Position 300")
For k = 1 To (oCurrLine.NumOfChildren - Len(oCurrLine.text))
Set oSubRootChild = oCurrLine.GetChild(k-1)
If oSubRootChild.Variable(sPosName)<>"" Then
arRoot = splitnumber(oSubRootChild.Variable(sPosName))
Else
arRoot = splitnumber(oSubRootChild.Variable("Position"))
End if
hDiff = arRoot(3)-arRoot(1)
'Adjust Zone Positions
If arRoot(2)>arRoot(0) then
arRoot(0) = arRoot(0) + CLng(nXoffset)
arRoot(2) = arRoot(2) + CLng(nXoffset)
End if
arRoot(1) = arCurrLine(1) + (arRoot(1) - CLng(zTop))
arRoot(3) = arRoot(1) + CLng(hDiff)
If arRoot(0)<clng(0) then arRoot(0)=clng(0)
If arRoot(2)<clng(0) then arRoot(2)=clng(0)
'Save Adjusted Position
oSubRootChild.Variable("Position") = CStr(arRoot(0)) & "," & CStr(arRoot(1)-clng(pHt)) & "," & CStr(arRoot(2)) & "," & CStr(arRoot(3)-clng(pHt))
sPos = CStr(arRoot(0)) & "," & CStr(arWord(1)) & "," & CStr(arRoot(2)) & "," & CStr(arWord(3))
oSubRootChild.Variable("Zone") = sPos
oSubRootChild.Status = 0
If pNm>1 then oSubRootChild.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=oLine.ImageHeight
Next 'k
nLastLine = i
nLines = nLines + 1
Elseif nLines > 0 And i <> nLastLine Then
'2ND LINE+ LOGIC
'Check if word is within the last LineItem's boundries. If yes then bypass creating a new lineitem.
IRatio = IntersectRatio(arCurrLine, arWord)
If IRatio=0 Then
'Get Last Child of same type if oCurrLine is Nothing
If oCurrLine is Nothing then Set oCurrLine = CurrentObj.GetChild(CurrentObj.NumOfChildren - Len(CurrentObj.Text)-1)
'Create Next Line & Index Name
sBaseName = CurrentObj.SetupNode().GetRule(0).Name
Set oNextLine=CurrentObj.AddChild(3, sBaseName & CStr(nLines), -1)
If oNextLine Is Nothing Then Exit For
oNextLine.Type = sBaseName
oNextLine.Status = 0
'Get Zone Position Info
If oNextLine.variable(sPosName)<>"" Then
arCurrLine = splitnumber(oNextLine.variable(sPosName))
ElseIf oNextLine.Variable("Position")<>"" then
arCurrLine = splitnumber(oNextLine.Variable("Position"))
Else
arCurrLine = splitnumber("0,0,0,0")
End if
'Calculate Zone Height
zTop = arCurrLine(1)
hDiff = arCurrLine(3)-arCurrLine(1)
lDiff = arLine(3)-arLine(1)
'Calculate % difference in height
If hDiff>lDiff Then pDiff = lDiff/hDiff
If lDiff>hDiff Then pDiff = hDiff/lDiff
'Calculate local offset
'Writelog("LOF%:'" & cint(abs(oLine.Left-arCurrLine(0))/(arCurrLine(2)-arCurrLine(0))*100) & "%'")
'Writelog("CurXoff:'" & nXoffset & "' PercentXoff:'" & (oLine.Left-arCurrLine(0))& "'")
If bLineAdj>cint(0) Then
If cint(abs(oLine.Left-arCurrLine(0))/(arCurrLine(2)-arCurrLine(0))*100)<=bLineAdj then
nXoffset = (oLine.Left-arCurrLine(0))
Writelog("Line X offset:'" & nXoffset & "'")
End if
End if
'Adjust Zone Positions
If arCurrLine(2)>arCurrLine(0) Then
arCurrLine(0) = arCurrLine(0) + CLng(nXoffset)
arCurrLine(2) = arCurrLine(2) + CLng(nXoffset)
End if
arCurrLine(1) = arLine(1) 'Set Top of new line to current CCO line
'Need to check zone height restrictions for 1 or 2+ lines-
'i.e. are all subfields on same H plane or check line height vs Zone height as a percentage.
If pDiff<.8 Then
arCurrLine(3) = arCurrLine(1) + CLng(hdiff) 'Set Bottom of new line to current + zone height
Else
arCurrLine(3) = arLine(3)
End If
'Save Adjusted Position
oNextLine.Variable("Position") = CStr(arCurrLine(0)) & "," & CStr(arCurrLine(1)-clng(pHt)) & "," & CStr(arCurrLine(2)) & "," & CStr(arCurrLine(3)-clng(pHt))
oNextLine.Variable("Zone") = CStr(arField(0)) & "," & CStr(arLine(1)) & "," & CStr(arField(2)) & "," & CStr(arLine(3))
'Check for Page Reference
If pNm>1 then
If Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oNextLine.Variable("IMAGEFILE")))<>ucase(oCurPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(pNm))) then
If Trim(oCurPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(pNm)))<>"" then
oNextLine.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oCurPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(pNm))
end if
End if
oCurrLine.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=oLine.ImageHeight
End if
If bCreateFields = "TRUE" Then Call oNextLine.CreateFields
ErrorHandler("FindZoneLineItems Position 400")
For k = 1 To (oNextLine.NumOfChildren - Len(oNextLine.text))
If oCurrLine is Nothing Then Exit For
Set oSubChildField = oNextLine.GetChild(k-1)
Set oSubRootChild = oCurrLine.GetChild(k-1)
If oSubRootchild Is Nothing Then Exit For
If oSubRootChild.Variable("Zone")<>"" Then
arRoot = splitNumber(oSubRootChild.Variable("Zone"))
Else
arRoot = splitNumber("0,0,0,0")
End if
sPos = CStr(arRoot(0)) & "," & CStr(arWord(1)) & "," & CStr(arRoot(2)) & "," & CStr(arWord(3))
arSubChildField = splitnumber(oSubChildField.Variable(sPosName))
If ubound(arSubChildField)=3 Then
hDiff = arSubChildField(3)-arSubChildField(1)
Else
arSubChildField = splitnumber("0,0,0,0")
hDiff = 0
End if
'Adjust Zone Positions
If arSubChildField(2)>arSubChildField(0) then
arSubChildField(0) = arSubChildField(0) + CLng(nXoffset)
arSubChildField(2) = arSubChildField(2) + CLng(nXoffset)
End if
arSubChildField(1) = arCurrLine(1) + (arSubChildField(1) - CLng(zTop))
arSubChildField(3) = arSubChildField(1) + CLng(hDiff)
If arSubChildField(0)<clng(0) then arSubChildField(0)=clng(0)
If arSubChildField(2)<clng(0) then arSubChildField(2)=clng(0)
'Save Adjusted Position
oSubChildField.Variable("Position") = CStr(arSubChildField(0)) & "," & CStr(arSubChildField(1)-clng(pHt)) & "," & CStr(arSubChildField(2)) & "," & CStr(arSubChildField(3)-clng(pHt))
oSubChildField.Variable("Zone") = sPos
oSubChildField.Status = 0
If pNm>1 then oSubChildField.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=oLine.ImageHeight
Next 'k
Set oCurrLine = oNextLine
nLastLine = i
nLines = nLines + 1
Else
Writelog(Space(5) & "WORD is in Previous Lineitem Area. Intersection Ratio=" & cint(IRatio*100)& "%")
End If
End If
'END of LINE CREATION SECTION
Call ErrorHandler("FindZoneLineItems Position 500")
'** PLACE CCO VALUE FOR WORD INTO oCurrLine FIELD IF THEY INTERSECT: **
arZone = splitNumber(oCurrLine.Variable("Zone"))
If IntersectRatio(arZone, arWord) > .25 Then
'IF FIELD ALREADY HAS A VALUE MERGE POSITION INFO WITH NEW INTERSECT & SEPARATE VALUE WITH SPACE CHARACTER
If Len(oCurrLine.Text) > 0 Then
Set cObj = oCurrLine.AddChild(4,"",-1)
bRes = cObj.AddValue(CLng(32),CLng(9))
arFieldAdj=splitNumber(oCurrLine.Variable("Position"))
bNew = False
Else
'FIRST VALUE FOR FIELD, POSITION INFO IS CURRENT CCO POSITION
bNEW = True
End If
'ADD CURRENT WORD CHARACTERS TO oCurrLine FIELD
For M = 1 To oWord.Count
Set oChar = oWord.Item(M)
arChar = SplitNumber(oChar.Left & "," & oChar.Top & "," & oChar.Right & "," & oChar.Bottom)
'ADD CHARACTER TO FIELD IF IN ZONE AND FILLTYPE IS BY CHARACTER, OR ADD ALL CHARACTERS IF FILLTYPE IS BY WORD
If (IntersectRatio(arZone, arChar)>.10 AND sFillType="2") or sFillType="1" Then
Set cObj = oCurrLine.AddChild(4,"",-1)
bRes = cObj.AddValue(CLng(Ascw(oWord.Item(M).value)),CLng(oWord.Item(M).Confidence))
bRes = cObj.SetPosition(CLng(oChar.Left),CLng(oChar.Top)-clng(pHt),CLng(oChar.Right),CLng(oChar.Bottom)-clng(pHt))
arCharAdj = SplitNumber(oChar.Left & "," & oChar.Top-pHt & "," & oChar.Right & "," & oChar.Bottom-pHt)
'MERGE EXISTING POSITION INFO WITH NEW CHAR POS
If bNew = True Then arFieldAdj = arCharAdj
arFieldAdj=CombineRect(arCharAdj,arFieldAdj)
oCurrLine.Variable("Position")= Join(arFieldAdj,",")
bNew = False
End If
Next
End If
ErrorHandler("FindZoneLineItems Position 600")
'INSERT CCO TEXT INTO SUBFIELDS ON CURRENT LINE
For k = 1 To (oCurrLine.NumOfChildren - Len(oCurrLine.Text))
Set oChildField = oCurrLine.GetChild(k-1)
If oChildField Is Nothing Then Exit For
arZone = splitNumber(oChildField.Variable("Zone"))
'IF CURRENT SUB FIELD ZONE INTERSECTS THE CURRENT CCO WORD
If IntersectRatio(arZone, arWord) > .25 Then
'IF FIELD HAS A VALUE, MERGE POSITION INFO WITH NEW INTERSECT
If Len(oChildField.Text) > 0 Then
Set cObj = oChildField.AddChild(4,"",-1)
bRes = cObj.AddValue(CLng(32),CLng(9))
arFieldAdj=splitNumber(oChildField.Variable("Position"))
bNew = False
Else
'FIRST VALUE FOR FIELD, POSITION INFO IS CURRENT CCO POSITION
bNEW = True
End If
'ADD CHARACTERS TO CURRENT SUBFIELD
For M = 1 To oWord.Count
'If Err.Number<>0 then writelog("ERR num:" & err.number):Err.clear
Set oChar = oWord.Item(M)
arChar = SplitNumber(oChar.Left & "," & oChar.Top & "," & oChar.Right & "," & oChar.Bottom)
'ADD CHARACTER TO FIELD IF IN ZONE
If (IntersectRatio(arZone, arChar)>.10 AND sFillType="2") or sFillType="1" Then
Set cObj = oChildField.AddChild(4,"",-1)
bRes = cObj.AddValue(CLng(Ascw(oWord.Item(M).value)),CLng(oWord.Item(M).Confidence))
bRes = cObj.SetPosition(CLng(oChar.Left),CLng(oChar.Top)-clng(pHt),CLng(oChar.Right),CLng(oChar.Bottom)-clng(pHt))
arCharAdj = SplitNumber(oChar.Left & "," & oChar.Top-pHt & "," & oChar.Right & "," & oChar.Bottom-pHt)
'MERGE EXISTING POSITION INFO WITH NEW CHAR POS
If bNew = True Then arFieldAdj = arCharAdj
arFieldAdj=CombineRect(arCharAdj,arFieldAdj)
oChildField.Variable("Position")= Join(arFieldAdj,",")
bNew = False
End If
Next
ErrorHandler("FindZoneLineItems Position 700")
Else
Writelog("IntersectionRatio was " & cstr(IntersectRatio(arZone, arWord)) & " for field " & ochildfield.id)
End If
Next 'k
End If
Next 'j
End If
Next
Set oSubField = Nothing
Set oSubchildField = Nothing

af.name: AnchorPage
af.g:
Dim sName
Dim nChildren
Dim RegExStr
Dim nL, nW
Dim ZoneCCO
Dim arField
Dim znField
Dim znWidth
Dim znHeight
Dim sPosName
On Error Resume Next
AnchorPage = False
If zn_IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
sName=CurrentObj.Variable("TemplateID")
WriteLog("AnchorPage " & sName)
nChildren = CurrentObj.NumOfChildren
For nChild = 0 to nChildren -1
Set oField = CurrentObj.GetChild(nChild)
Do While Not oField is Nothing
If oField Is Nothing Then Exit Do
If Not left(oField.ID & Space(6),6) = "Anchor" Then Exit Do
sWord=oField.Variable("Word" & sName)
If sWord="" Then Exit Do
Writelog("Anchor Word value : " & sWord)
sPosName = "Pos" & sName
arField=SplitNumber(oField.Variable(sPosName))
If UBound(arField)<3 Then Exit Do
znField=arField
znWidth = znField(2)-znField(0)
znHeight = znField(3)-znField(1)
'Search area left position
znField(0) = znField(0)-(2*znWidth)
If znField(0) < 0 then znField(0) = 0
'Search area right position
znField(2) = znField(2)+(2*znWidth)
if znField(2) > CCO.Right then znField(2) = CCO.Right
'Search area top position
znField(1) = znField(1)-(4*znHeight)
if znField(1) < 0 then znField(1) = 0
'Search area bottom position
znField(3) = znField(3)+(4*znHeight)
if znField(3) > CCO.Bottom then znField(3) = CCO.Bottom
Set zoneCCO = CCOCreator.AnalyzeBlock(oCurPage.Imagename,znField(0),znField(1),znField(2),znField(3))
Call GetBlockChars(zoneCCO, znField(0),znField(1),znField(2),znField(3))
RegExStr = RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, sWord)
If not FindKey(bInter, bDebug, RegExStr) then Exit Do
nL=0
nW=0
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(nL, nW)
Writelog("sName")
Set oWord=CCO.Item(nL).Item(nW)
If oWord Is Nothing Then Exit Do
nXOffset=oWord.Left-arField(0)
nYOffset=oWord.Top-arField(1)
nCount=CurrentObj.NumOfChildren()
writelog("X offset - " & CStr(nXOffset))
writelog("Y offset - " & CStr(nYOffset))
Call ZoneChildren(CurrentObj, sPosName,0,nXOffset,nYOffset)
AnchorPage = True
Exit Function
loop
Next 'nChild
writelog("Anchor Value not found...loading raw Zone positions. (non adjusted)")
Call ZoneChildren(CurrentObj, sPosName,0,0,0)

Dim nChildren

If Not FindKey(bInter, bDebug, sWord) Then
Dim tmpStr

end if
nL=0
nW=0

'nXOffset=oWord.Left-arField(0)

'arField(0)=arField(0)+nXOffset

arField(3)=arField(3)+nYOffset

End If
Next
Exit Function
loop
Next 'nChild

af.name: ZoneImage_SaveAs
af.g:
'
' Rule Manager Example: (Called on 'DETAILS' field)
' ZoneImage_SaveAs("SAMMY"+@TYPE+@DATE+JJJ) --> "..\SAMMYDETAILS243.tif"
Dim oParentPage
Dim oDCImage
Dim aCurrPos
Dim lx, ly, lw, lh
Dim sPosition
Dim iType,Wx,Hx,Bx
Dim cType, sExtn
'iType
' 0 : TIFF Uncompressed
' 1 : BMP Uncompressed
' 7 : TIFF CCITT3 FAX
' 8 : TIFF CCITT4 FAX
' 9 : TIFF LZW
'10 : TIFF CCITT6
'13 : JPEG (works)
'16 : TIFF_PACK
'40 : TIFF JPEG -> QUALITY ISSUES DO NOT USE
'73 : TIFF_JPEG7
Set oDCImage= Nothing
ZoneImage_SaveAs = False
On Error Resume Next
Set oParentPage = CurrentObj
While oParentPage.ObjectType > 2 AND oParentPage.ObjectType>1
Set oParentPage= oParentPage.Parent()
Wend
If oParentPage.ImageName <> "" then
Set oDCImage= CreateObject("DCIMAGE.DCImageCtrl.1")
If oDCImage is Nothing then
Writelog("Unable to Create DCImage Object!")
Exit Function
End if
oDCImage.FileName = oParentPage.ImageName
'Added support for smart parameters
StrFileName=MetaWord(StrFileName)
writelog("Param: '" & StrFileName & "'")
If SetZoneImageName(bInter, bDebug, StrFileName) = False then Exit Function
sPosition = CurrentObj.Variable("Position")
Writelog("Zone Positions found: '" & sPosition & "' ")
if sPosition = "" or sPosition = "0,0,0,0" or not(isnumeric(replace(sPosition,",",""))) then
Writelog("No Zone Position Information Found for Component '" & CurrentObj.ID & "', no area to save.")
Set oDCImage= Nothing
Exit Function
End if
aCurrPos = splitnumber(sPosition)
lx = clng(aCurrPos(0))
ly = clng(aCurrPos(1))
lw = clng(aCurrPos(2)-aCurrPos(0))
lh = clng(aCurrPos(3)-aCurrPos(1))
iType=10
Call oDCImage.GetImageInfo(Wx,Hx,Bx)
'For colored images the compression set to LZW
If Bx>1 then
iType=9
cType = CurrentObj.Variable("SaveAs_Compression")
if cType<>"" then iType=cType
End if
sExtn = "tif"
If (13 = iType) then ' If JPEG is the selected format, then adjust the extention
sExtn = "jpg"
elseif (1 = iType) then
sExtn = "bmp"
End if
eType = CurrentObj.Variable("SaveAs_Extension") ' The user can still override the extension.
if eType<>"" then sExtn=eType
g_ZoneImageName = g_ZoneImageName & "." & sExtn
If Not FileMgr.FolderExists(g_ZoneImageName) then
Writelog("Parent folder Not found. Saving Image to Batch Directory.")
g_ZoneImageName = Pilot.BatchDir & "\" & g_ZoneImageName
Writelog("New full Path:'" & g_ZoneImageName & "'.")
End if
writelog("Saving X:" & lx & " Y:" & ly & " Width:" & lw & " Height:" & lh & " Compression: " & iType & " ImageName:" & g_ZoneImageName)
ZoneImage_SaveAs = oDCImage.SaveZone(lx,ly,lw,lh,g_ZoneImageName,CInt(iType)) ' Type must be passed as an integer
End If
Set oDCImage= Nothing
