af.name: FindDataBlocks
af.g:
Dim modStrParam
Dim sValue
Dim Match
Dim tMatches
Dim bMatches
Dim bFound
Dim oValueTop
Dim oValueBtm
Dim nLine, nWord, pLine
Dim index, tindex, bindex
Dim MatchCount
Dim ileft
Dim iRight
Dim iTop
Dim iBottom
Dim oPage
Dim sBasename
Dim osubfield
Dim iName
Dim aStrParam
Dim sLine, sWord, sLine2, sWord2
Dim xM, bM, cM
Dim tLineAdj, bLineAdj
Dim sMCCO
Dim nPage
Dim oParent
Dim arField
Dim tval
Dim nHeight
Dim tLine,tWord
Dim prevLine
On Error Resume Next
FindDataBlocks = FALSE
Set regEx = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp")
regEx.IgnoreCase = True
regEx.Global = True
If zn_IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
'Set Extremes
iTop = clng(CCO.Bottom)
iLeft = clng(CCO.Right)
iRight = clng(CCO.Left)
iBottom = clng(CCO.Top)
'Find CCO Limits
For cM = 1 to CCO.Count
If iTop > clng(CCO.Item(cM).Top) Then iTop = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Top)
If iLeft > clng(CCO.Item(cM).Left) Then iLeft = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Left)
If iRight < clng(CCO.Item(cM).Right) Then iRight = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Right)
If iBottom < clng(CCO.Item(cM).Bottom) Then iBottom = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Bottom)
Next 'cM
'Get Child Base Name
sBaseName = CurrentObj.SetupNode().GetRule(0).Name
Set oPage = CurrentObj
While oPage.ObjectType>2 And Not(oPage.ObjectType<=1)
Set oPage = oPage.Parent()
Wend
'Find Current Position limits
Set oParent=CurrentObj
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
If ubound(arField)<>3 then sPosition="0,0,0,0"
While (sPosition="" Or sPosition="0,0,0,0") and oParent.objectType>1
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
if sPosition="" then sPosition="0,0,0,0"
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
Wend
Set oParent=Nothing
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
If ubound(arField)=3 then
arField(0) = clng(arField(0))
arField(1) = clng(arField(1))
arField(2) = clng(arField(2))
arField(3) = clng(arField(3))
arField(0) = arField(0)-clng(10)
arField(1) = arField(1)-clng(10)
If arField(2)>clng(0) then arField(2) = clng(arField(2))+clng(10)
If arField(3)>clng(0) then arField(3) = clng(arField(3))+clng(10)
'Establish Search Limits for ZEROED zone values
If arField(0) <= clng(0) Then
arField(0) = clng(iLeft)
End if
If arField(1) <= clng(0) Then arField(1) = iTop
If arField(2) > iRight Or arField(2) <= 0 Then arField(2) = iRight
'Find Lowest zoneCCO Position
If arField(3) > iBottom Or arField(3) <= clng(0) Then arField(3) = iBottom
If arField(0)>arField(2) Then
writelog("Swapping left and right zone positions")
tval = arField(0)
arField(0) = arField(2)
arField(2) = tval
End If
If arField(1)>arField(3) Then
writelog("Swapping top and bottom zone positions")
tval = arField(1)
arField(1) = arField(3)
arField(3) = tval
End If
iLeft = arField(0)
iTop = arField(1)
iRight = arField(2)
iBottom = arField(3)
Else
arField=SplitNumber(cstr(iLeft & "," & iTop & "," & iRight & "," & iBottom))
End if
'Find Search Zone Text & Start Index
'Setup Start CCO Position.
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(sLine, sWord, sLine2, sWord2)
If sLine=0 then sLine=1
If sWord=0 then sWord=1
If sLine2=0 then sLine2=1
If sWord2=0 then sWord2=1
If sLine2>=sLine then
sLine=sLine2
sWord=sWord2
End if
Writelog("Start CCO Position: Line='" & sLine & "' Word='" & sWord & "'")
Call CCO.LocateLines(arField(1),arField(3),LTop,LBottom)
If LTop = 0 or LBottom = 0 then
Writelog("No Recognition Characters in Search Area.")
Exit Function
End if
'Adjust Search Area to Start CCO Position
If sLine>LTop and sLine<LBottom Then
LTop = sLine
If CCO.item(LTop).Count > sWord Then
sWord = sWord + 1
Else
sLine = sLine + 1
sWord = 1
End if
End if
If sWord=0 then sWord=1
'GET START INDEX
StartIndex = CCO.LocateCharIndex(LTop,sWord)
Writelog("Ascending Search from Line:'" & Ltop & "' Word:'" & sWord & "' to Line:'" & LBottom & "' Word:'" & CCO.Item(LBottom).count & "'")
'adjust search text for mid line word location
If sWord>1 and LTop<LBottom Then
For y = sWord to CCO.Item(LTop).Count
str = str & CCO.Item(LTop).Item(y).Value & Space(1)
Next 'y
str = Trim(str) & vbcrlf
LTop = LTop + 1
sValue = sValue & str
End if
For x = LTop to LBottom
'str = Trim(CCO.Item(x).Value)
If CCO.item(x).count > 0 then str = CCO.Item(x).Value
If x<CCO.Count then str = str & vbcrlf
sValue = sValue & str
Next 'x
'Initialize MCCO Page Counter
sMCCO=oPage.Variable("CCOBlock")
If sMCCO<>"" Then
sMCCO = FileMgr.GetFileName(sMCCO)
Writelog("MCCO file loaded: " & sMCCO)
sMCCO = sMCCO & "_"
End if
aStrParam = Split(MetaWord(StrParam),",")
oValueTop = Trim(aStrParam(0))
If ubound(aStrParam)>=1 Then oValueBtm = Trim(MetaWord(aStrParam(1)))
'Find Line Adjustments
If ubound(aStrParam)>=2 Then tLineAdj = Trim(MetaWord(aStrParam(2)))
If ubound(aStrParam)>=3 Then bLineAdj = Trim(MetaWord(aStrParam(3)))
'Remove Plus sign (its a positive number anyway...)
tLineAdj = replace(tLineAdj,"+","")
bLineAdj = replace(bLineAdj,"+","")
'Check for numeric value
If Not Isnumeric(tLineAdj) Then tLineadj = 0
If Not Isnumeric(bLineAdj) Then bLineadj = 0
tLineadj = clng(tLineadj)
bLineAdj = clng(bLineadj)
MatchCount = 1
FindDataBlocks = False
modStrParamT = ""
modStrParamB = ""
bFound = False
WriteLog("Find Values: '" & oValueTop & "' to '" & oValueBtm & "'. ")
If len(oValueTop)>0 And len(oValueBtm)>0 Then
'We have a top & bottom value to search for
'Note build RegEx 'OR' string implicitly here...
amodStrParamT = Split(oValueTop&"|","|")
amodStrParamB = Split(oValueBtm&"|","|")
Writelog("Argorithm 1")
For T = 0 to ubound(amodStrParamT)-1
modStrParamT = modStrParamT & RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, amodStrParamT(T))
If T < ubound(amodStrParamT)-1 then modStrParamT = modStrParamT & "|"
Next 'T
For B = 0 to ubound(amodStrParamB)-1
modStrParamB = modStrParamB & RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, amodStrParamB(B))
If B < ubound(amodStrParamB)-1 then modStrParamB = modStrParamB & "|"
Next 'B
'adding space here compensates for RegEx indexing being Zero based vs. CCO one based.
regEx.Pattern = modStrParamT
Set tMatches = regEx.Execute(space(1) & sValue)
'Check for RegEx Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & sDeleteString & "'")
Err.Clear
Exit Function
End if
'adding space here compensates for RegEx indexing being Zero based vs. CCO one based.
regEx.Pattern = modStrParamB
Set bMatches = regEx.Execute(space(1) & sValue)
'Check for RegEx Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & sDeleteString & "'")
Err.Clear
Exit Function
End if
writelog(" Top Matches Count is :" & tMatches.Count)
writelog("Bottom Matches Count is :" & bMatches.Count)
'Set iBottom to 0
iBottom = clng(0)
For xM = 1 to (tMatches.Count)
Set tMatch = tMatches(xM-1)
WriteLog("Matched Value: '" & cstr(MatchedTextValue(tMatch.value)) & "' ")
Index = tMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If CCO.LocateChar(Index, nLine, nWord) Then
iTop = CCO.Item(nline).Top
nPage = CCO.Item(nLine).ImageNum
nHeight = CCO.Item(nLine).ImageHeight
If tLineAdj<>clng(0) Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + tLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line Top up/down by " & tLineAdj & ". ")
iTop = CCO.Item(nline+ tLineAdj).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine+ tLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine+ tLineAdj).ImageHeight
End if
End if
'check that iTop is Below (>) last calculated iBottom.
If iTop>iBottom Then
'iBottom = CCO.Item(CCO.Count).Bottom
'iBottom = arField(3)
'tIndex = len(sValue) + StartIndex
tIndex = CCO.LocateCharIndex(CCO.Count,CCO.Item(CCO.Count).Count)
'CCO Line before Next Top Becomes default Bottom
If xM < tMatches.Count then
Set tMatch = tMatches(xM)
tIndex = tMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If CCO.LocateChar(tIndex, nLine, nWord) Then iBottom = CCO.Item(nline-1).Bottom
End if
'Look For Bottom Word match between Top word spans
For bM = 1 to (bMatches.Count)
Set bMatch = bMatches(bM-1)
bIndex = bMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If (bIndex >= Index) And (bIndex <= tIndex) then
If CCO.LocateChar(bIndex, nLine, nWord) Then
'Word Between span found
iBottom = CCO.Item(nline).Bottom
WriteLog("Bottom Matched Value: '" & cstr(MatchedTextValue(bMatch.value)) & "' ")
If bLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + bLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line bottom up/down by " & bLineAdj & ". ")
iBottom = CCO.Item(nline + bLineAdj).Bottom
End if
End if
Exit For
End if
End if
Next 'bM
if arField(1)<=itop and arField(3)>=itop then
Set oSubField=CurrentObj.AddChild(3,"",-1)
If oSubField is Nothing then
Writelog("No SubField Created for Match " & xM & ". ")
Exit for
End if
oSubField.ID = sBaseName & CStr(MatchCount)
oSubField.Type = sBaseName
oSubField.Status = 0
oSubField.Variable("Position") = cstr(iLeft) & "," & cstr(iTop) & "," & cstr(iRight) & "," & cstr(iBottom)
Writelog("Position:" & oSubField.Variable("Position"))
'Check for Page Reference
If nPage>1 then
If Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")))<>ucase(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))) then
If Trim(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage)))<>"" then
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))
end if
End if
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=nHeight
End if
Call oSubField.CreateFields
Set oSubField = Nothing
End if
MatchCount = MatchCount + 1
bFound = True
End if
End If
Next
ElseIf len(oValueTop)>0 And len(oValueBtm)=0 Then
'We have a top value to search for
'modStrParamT = RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, oValueTop)
'Note build RegEx or string implicitly here...
Writelog("Argorithm 2.1")
amodStrParamT = Split(oValueTop&"|","|")
For T = 0 to ubound(amodStrParamT)-1
modStrParamT = modStrParamT & RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, amodStrParamT(T))
If T < ubound(amodStrParamT)-1 then modStrParamT = modStrParamT & "|"
Next 'T
regEx.Pattern = modStrParamT
Set tMatches = regEx.Execute(space(1) & sValue)
'Check for RegEx Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & sDeleteString & "'")
Err.Clear
Exit Function
End if
writelog("Top Matches Count is :" & tMatches.Count)
For xM = 1 to (tMatches.Count)
Set tMatch = tMatches(xM-1)
WriteLog("Matched Value: '" & cstr(MatchedTextValue(tMatch.value)) & "' ")
Index = tMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If CCO.LocateChar(Index, nLine, nWord) Then
iTop = CCO.Item(nline).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine).ImageHeight
If tLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + tLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line Top up/down by " & tLineAdj & ". ")
iTop = CCO.Item(nline+ tLineAdj).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine+ tLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine+ tLineAdj).ImageHeight
End if
End if
'iBottom = CCO.Item(CCO.Count).Bottom
iBottom = arField(3)
'CCO Line before next match becomes bottom, cannot be same line or above
Do While xM < tMatches.Count
Set tMatch = tMatches(xM)
Index = tMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If CCO.LocateChar(Index, nLineb, nWord) Then
iBottom = CCO.Item(nlineb-1).Bottom
If bLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLineb - 1 + bLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line bottom up/down by " & bLineAdj & ". ")
iBottom = CCO.Item(nlineb - 1 + bLineAdj).Bottom
End if
End if
If iBottom>iTop And nLineb>nLine Then Exit Do
End if
xM = xM + 1
iBottom = arField(3)
'iBottom = CCO.Item(CCO.Count).Bottom
loop
'Wend
if arField(1)<=itop and arField(3)>=itop then
Set oSubField=CurrentObj.AddChild(3,"",-1)
If oSubField is Nothing then
Writelog("No SubField Created for Match " & xM & ". ")
Exit for
End if
oSubField.ID = sBaseName & CStr(MatchCount)
oSubField.Type = sBaseName
oSubField.Status = 0
oSubField.Variable("Position") = cstr(iLeft) & "," & cstr(iTop) & "," & cstr(iRight) & "," & cstr(iBottom)
Writelog("Position:" & oSubField.Variable("Position"))
'Check for Page Reference
If nPage>1 then
If Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")))<>ucase(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))) then
If Trim(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage)))<>"" then
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))
End if
End if
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=nHeight
End if
Call oSubField.CreateFields
Set oSubField = Nothing
End if
End If
MatchCount = MatchCount + 1
bFound = True
Next
ElseIf len(oValueTop)=0 And len(oValueBtm)>0 Then
'We have a bottom value to search for
'modStrParamB = RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, oValueBtm)
'Note build RegEx or string implicitly here...
Writelog("Argorithm 3")
amodStrParamB = Split(oValueBtm&"|","|")
Writelog("setup pattern")
For B = 0 to ubound(amodStrParamB)-1
modStrParamB = modStrParamB & RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, amodStrParamB(B))
If B < ubound(amodStrParamB)-1 then modStrParamB = modStrParamB & "|"
Next 'B
Writelog("set pattern")
regEx.Pattern = modStrParamB
Writelog("get matches")
Set bMatches = regEx.Execute(space(1) & sValue)
'Check for RegEx Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & sDeleteString & "'")
Err.Clear
Exit Function
End if
writelog("Bottom Matches Count is :" & bMatches.Count)
'Start position is the Top of the current CCO Pointer location's Next Line - default is current line bottom
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(tLine, tWord)
If tLine<=1 and tWord<=1 then
iTop = CCO.Item(sLine).top
Else
iTop = CCO.Item(sLine).bottom
End if
nPage= CCO.Item(sLine).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(sLine).ImageHeight
If CCO.Count>=sLine+1 and Not(tLine<=1 and tWord<=1) then
iTop = CCO.Item(sLine+1).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(sLine+1).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(sLine+1).ImageHeight
End if
For xM = 1 to (bMatches.Count)
Set bMatch = bMatches(xM-1)
WriteLog("Matched Value: '" & cstr(MatchedTextValue(bMatch.value)) & "' ")
Index = bMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
PrevLine=0
If CCO.LocateChar(Index, nLine, nWord) Then
If PrevLine<nLine Then
iBottom = CCO.Item(nline).Bottom
If bLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + bLineAdj) and (nline + bLineAdj>0) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line bottom up/down by " & bLineAdj & ". ")
iBottom = CCO.Item(nline + bLineAdj).Bottom
End if
End if
if arField(1)<=itop and arField(3)>=itop then
Set oSubField=CurrentObj.AddChild(3,"",-1)
If oSubField is Nothing then
Writelog("No SubField Created for Match " & xM & ". ")
Exit for
End if
oSubField.ID = sBaseName & CStr(MatchCount)
oSubField.Type = sBaseName
oSubField.Status = 0
oSubField.Variable("Position") = cstr(iLeft) & "," & cstr(iTop) & "," & cstr(iRight) & "," & cstr(iBottom)
Writelog("Position:" & oSubField.Variable("Position"))
'Check for Page Reference
If nPage>1 then
If Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")))<>ucase(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))) then
If Trim(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage)))<>"" then
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))
end if
End if
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=nHeight
End if
Call oSubField.CreateFields
Set oSubField = Nothing
End if
'Next Line Top after Last Bottom Line becomes next Top - default is current bottom
iTop = iBottom
If nLine+bLineAdj>CCO.Count Then nLine=CCO.Count-bLineAdj
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine+ bLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine + bLineAdj).ImageHeight
If (CCO.Count>=(nline+1+ bLineAdj)) Then
iTop = CCO.Item(nline + 1 + bLineAdj).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine + 1 + bLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine + 1 + bLineAdj).ImageHeight
If tLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + 1 + tLineAdj + bLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line Top up/down by " & tLineAdj & ". ")
iTop = CCO.Item(nline + 1 + tLineAdj + bLineAdj).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nline + 1 + tLineAdj + bLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine + 1 + tLineAdj + bLineAdj).ImageHeight
End if
End if
End if
End If
MatchCount = MatchCount + 1
end if
PrevLine=nLine
bFound = True
Next
End if
If bFound = True Then
If Not(Pilot is Nothing) And Not IsAlive(LogWindow) then Pilot.ChildrenChanged(CurrentObj)
FindDataBlocks = True
Else
Writelog("No Matches Found")
End If
Set oPage = Nothing
Set regEx = Nothing
Set bMatch = Nothing
Set tMatch = Nothing
Set bMatches = Nothing
Set tMatches = Nothing
Set oSubField = Nothing
Set ZoneCCO = Nothing

af.name: FindRegExBlocks
af.g:
Dim modStrParam
Dim sValue
Dim Match
Dim tMatches
Dim bMatches
Dim bFound
Dim oValueTop
Dim oValueBtm
Dim nLine, nWord, pLine
Dim index, tindex, bindex
Dim MatchCount
Dim ileft
Dim iRight
Dim iTop
Dim iBottom
Dim oPage
Dim sBasename
Dim osubfield
Dim iName
Dim aStrParam
Dim sLine, sWord, sLine2, sWord2
Dim xM, bM, cM
Dim tLineAdj, bLineAdj
Dim sMCCO
Dim nPage
Dim oParent
Dim arField
Dim tval
Dim nHeight
Dim tLine,tWord
On Error Resume Next
FindRegExBlocks=FALSE
Set regEx = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp")
regEx.IgnoreCase = True
regEx.Global = True
If zn_IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
'Set Extremes
iTop = clng(CCO.Bottom)
iLeft = clng(CCO.Right)
iRight = clng(CCO.Left)
iBottom = clng(CCO.Top)
'Find CCO Limits
For cM = 1 to CCO.Count
If iTop > clng(CCO.Item(cM).Top) Then iTop = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Top)
If iLeft > clng(CCO.Item(cM).Left) Then iLeft = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Left)
If iRight < clng(CCO.Item(cM).Right) Then iRight = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Right)
If iBottom < clng(CCO.Item(cM).Bottom) Then iBottom = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Bottom)
Next 'cM
'Get Child Base Name
sBaseName = CurrentObj.SetupNode().GetRule(0).Name
Set oPage = CurrentObj
While oPage.ObjectType>2 And Not(oPage.ObjectType<=1)
Set oPage = oPage.Parent()
Wend
'Find Current Position limits
Set oParent=CurrentObj
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
If ubound(arField)<>3 then sPosition="0,0,0,0"
While (sPosition="" Or sPosition="0,0,0,0") and oParent.objectType>1
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
if sPosition="" then sPosition="0,0,0,0"
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
Wend
Set oParent=Nothing
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
If ubound(arField)=3 then
arField(0) = clng(arField(0))
arField(1) = clng(arField(1))
arField(2) = clng(arField(2))
arField(3) = clng(arField(3))
arField(0) = arField(0)-clng(10)
arField(1) = arField(1)-clng(10)
If arField(2)>clng(0) then arField(2) = clng(arField(2))+clng(10)
If arField(3)>clng(0) then arField(3) = clng(arField(3))+clng(10)
'Establish Search Limits for ZEROED zone values
If arField(0) <= clng(0) Then
arField(0) = clng(iLeft)
End if
If arField(1) <= clng(0) Then arField(1) = iTop
If arField(2) > iRight Or arField(2) <= 0 Then arField(2) = iRight
'Find Lowest zoneCCO Position
If arField(3) > iBottom Or arField(3) <= clng(0) Then arField(3) = iBottom
If arField(0)>arField(2) Then
writelog("Swapping left and right zone positions")
tval = arField(0)
arField(0) = arField(2)
arField(2) = tval
End If
If arField(1)>arField(3) Then
writelog("Swapping top and bottom zone positions")
tval = arField(1)
arField(1) = arField(3)
arField(3) = tval
End If
iLeft = arField(0)
iTop = arField(1)
iRight = arField(2)
iBottom = arField(3)
Else
arField=SplitNumber(cstr(iLeft & "," & iTop & "," & iRight & "," & iBottom))
End if
'Find Search Zone Text & Start Index
'Setup Start CCO Position.
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(sLine, sWord, sLine2, sWord2)
If sLine=0 then sLine=1
If sWord=0 then sWord=1
If sLine2=0 then sLine2=1
If sWord2=0 then sWord2=1
If sLine2>=sLine then
sLine=sLine2
sWord=sWord2
End if
Writelog("Start CCO Position: Line='" & sLine & "' Word='" & sWord & "'")
Call CCO.LocateLines(arField(1),arField(3),LTop,LBottom)
If LTop = 0 or LBottom = 0 then
Writelog("No Recognition Characters in Search Area.")
Exit Function
End if
'Adjust Search Area to Start CCO Position
If sLine>LTop and sLine<LBottom Then
LTop = sLine
If CCO.item(LTop).Count > sWord Then
sWord = sWord + 1
Else
sLine = sLine + 1
sWord = 1
End if
End if
If sWord=0 then sWord=1
'GET START INDEX
StartIndex = CCO.LocateCharIndex(LTop,sWord)
Writelog("Ascending Search from Line:'" & Ltop & "' Word:'" & sWord & "' to Line:'" & LBottom & "' Word:'" & CCO.Item(LBottom).count & "'")
'adjust search text for mid line word location
If sWord>1 and LTop<LBottom Then
For y = sWord to CCO.Item(LTop).Count
str = str & CCO.Item(LTop).Item(y).Value & Space(1)
Next 'y
str = Trim(str) & vbcrlf
LTop = LTop + 1
sValue = sValue & str
End if
For x = LTop to LBottom
str = Trim(CCO.Item(x).Value)
If x<CCO.Count then str = str & vbcrlf
sValue = sValue & str
Next 'x
'Initialize MCCO Page Counter
sMCCO=oPage.Variable("CCOBlock")
If sMCCO<>"" Then
sMCCO = FileMgr.GetFileName(sMCCO)
Writelog("MCCO file loaded: " & sMCCO)
sMCCO = sMCCO & "_"
End if
aStrParam = Split(MetaWord(StrParam),",")
oValueTop = Trim(aStrParam(0))
If ubound(aStrParam)>=1 Then oValueBtm = Trim(MetaWord(aStrParam(1)))
'Find Line Adjustments
If ubound(aStrParam)>=2 Then tLineAdj = Trim(MetaWord(aStrParam(2)))
If ubound(aStrParam)>=3 Then bLineAdj = Trim(MetaWord(aStrParam(3)))
'Remove Plus sign (its a positive number anyway...)
tLineAdj = replace(tLineAdj,"+","")
bLineAdj = replace(bLineAdj,"+","")
'Check for numeric value
If Not Isnumeric(tLineAdj) Then tLineadj = 0
If Not Isnumeric(bLineAdj) Then bLineadj = 0
tLineadj = clng(tLineadj)
bLineAdj = clng(bLineadj)
MatchCount = 1
FindRegExblocks = False
modStrParamT = ""
modStrParamB = ""
bFound = False
WriteLog("Find Values: '" & oValueTop & "' to '" & oValueBtm & "'. ")
If len(oValueTop)>0 And len(oValueBtm)>0 Then
'We have a top & bottom value to search for
Writelog("Argorithm 1")
regEx.Pattern = oValueTop
Set tMatches = regEx.Execute(space(1) & sValue)
'Check for RegEx Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & sDeleteString & "'")
Err.Clear
Exit Function
End if
regEx.Pattern = oValueBtm
Set bMatches = regEx.Execute(space(1) & sValue)
'Check for RegEx Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & sDeleteString & "'")
Err.Clear
Exit Function
End if
writelog("Top Matches Count is :" & tMatches.Count)
writelog("Bottom Matches Count is :" & bMatches.Count)
'Set iBottom to 0
iBottom = clng(0)
For xM = 1 to (tMatches.Count)
Set tMatch = tMatches(xM-1)
WriteLog("Matched Value: '" & cstr(MatchedTextValue(tMatch.value)) & "' ")
Index = tMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If CCO.LocateChar(Index, nLine, nWord) Then
iTop = CCO.Item(nline).Top
nPage = CCO.Item(nLine).ImageNum
nHeight = CCO.Item(nLine).ImageHeight
If tLineAdj<>clng(0) Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + tLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line Top up/down by " & tLineAdj & ". ")
iTop = CCO.Item(nline+ tLineAdj).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine+ tLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine+ tLineAdj).ImageHeight
End if
End if
'check that iTop is Below (>) last calculated iBottom.
If iTop>iBottom Then
tIndex = CCO.LocateCharIndex(CCO.count,CCO.Item(CCO.Count).Count)
'CCO Line before Next Top Becomes default Bottom
If xM < tMatches.Count then
Set tMatch = tMatches(xM)
tIndex = tMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If CCO.LocateChar(tIndex, nLine, nWord) Then iBottom = CCO.Item(nline-1).Bottom
End if
'Look For Bottom Word match between Top word spans
For bM = 1 to (bMatches.Count)
Set bMatch = bMatches(bM-1)
bIndex = bMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If (bIndex >= Index) And (bIndex <= tIndex) then
If CCO.LocateChar(bIndex, nLine, nWord) Then
'Word Between span found
iBottom = CCO.Item(nline).Bottom
WriteLog("Bottom Matched Value: '" & cstr(MatchedTextValue(bMatch.value)) & "' ")
If bLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + bLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line bottom up/down by " & bLineAdj & ". ")
iBottom = CCO.Item(nline + bLineAdj).Bottom
End if
End if
Exit For
End if
End if
Next 'bM
if arField(1)<=itop and arField(3)>=itop then
Set oSubField=CurrentObj.AddChild(3,"",-1)
If oSubField is Nothing then
Writelog("No SubField Created for Match " & xM & ". ")
Exit for
End if
oSubField.ID = sBaseName & CStr(MatchCount)
oSubField.Type = sBaseName
oSubField.Status = 0
oSubField.Variable("Position") = cstr(iLeft) & "," & cstr(iTop) & "," & cstr(iRight) & "," & cstr(iBottom)
Writelog("Position:" & oSubField.Variable("Position"))
'Check for Page Reference
If nPage>1 then
If Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")))<>ucase(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))) then
If Trim(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage)))<>"" then
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))
end if
End if
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=nHeight
End if
Call oSubField.CreateFields
Set oSubField = Nothing
End if
MatchCount = MatchCount + 1
bFound = True
End if
End If
Next
ElseIf len(oValueTop)>0 And len(oValueBtm)=0 Then
'We have a top value to search for
'modStrParamT = RegExBuild(bInteractive, bDebug, oValueTop)
Writelog("Argorithm 2.1")
regEx.Pattern = oValueTop
Set tMatches = regEx.Execute(space(1) & sValue)
'Check for RegEx Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & sDeleteString & "'")
Err.Clear
Exit Function
End if
writelog("Top Matches Count is :" & tMatches.Count)
For xM = 1 to (tMatches.Count)
Set tMatch = tMatches(xM-1)
WriteLog("Matched Value: '" & cstr(MatchedTextValue(tMatch.value)) & "' ")
Index = tMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If CCO.LocateChar(Index, nLine, nWord) Then
iTop = CCO.Item(nline).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine).ImageHeight
If tLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + tLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line Top up/down by " & tLineAdj & ". ")
iTop = CCO.Item(nline+ tLineAdj).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine+ tLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine+ tLineAdj).ImageHeight
End if
End if
'iBottom = CCO.Item(CCO.Count).Bottom
iBottom = arField(3)
'CCO Line before next match becomes bottom, cannot be same line or above
Do While xM < tMatches.Count
Set tMatch = tMatches(xM)
Index = tMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If CCO.LocateChar(Index, nLineb, nWord) Then
iBottom = CCO.Item(nlineb-1).Bottom
If bLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLineb - 1 + bLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line bottom up/down by " & bLineAdj & ". ")
iBottom = CCO.Item(nlineb - 1 + bLineAdj).Bottom
End if
End if
If iBottom>iTop And nLineb>nLine Then Exit Do
End if
xM = xM + 1
'iBottom = CCO.Item(CCO.Count).Bottom
iBottom = arField(3)
loop
'Wend
if arField(1)<=itop and arField(3)>=itop then
Set oSubField=CurrentObj.AddChild(3,"",-1)
If oSubField is Nothing then
Writelog("No SubField Created for Match " & xM & ". ")
Exit for
End if
oSubField.ID = sBaseName & CStr(MatchCount)
oSubField.Type = sBaseName
oSubField.Status = 0
oSubField.Variable("Position") = cstr(iLeft) & "," & cstr(iTop) & "," & cstr(iRight) & "," & cstr(iBottom)
Writelog("Position:" & oSubField.Variable("Position"))
'Check for Page Reference
If nPage>1 then
If Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")))<>ucase(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))) then
If Trim(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage)))<>"" then
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))
end if
End if
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=nHeight
End if
Call oSubField.CreateFields
Set oSubField = Nothing
End if
End If
MatchCount = MatchCount + 1
bFound = True
Next
ElseIf len(oValueTop)=0 And len(oValueBtm)>0 Then
'We have a bottom value to search for
Writelog("Argorithm 3")
regEx.Pattern = oValueBtm
Writelog("get matches")
Set bMatches = regEx.Execute(Space(1) & sValue)
'Check for RegEx Error - usually due to invalid Pattern syntax
If Err.number<>0 then
Writelog(Space(3) & "Invalid Pattern '" & sDeleteString & "'")
Err.Clear
Exit Function
End if
writelog("Bottom Matches Count is :" & bMatches.Count)
'Start position is the Top of the current CCO Pointer location's Next Line - default is current line bottom
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(tLine, tWord)
If tLine<=1 and tWord<=1 then
iTop = CCO.Item(sLine).top
Else
iTop = CCO.Item(sLine).bottom
End if
pLine=0
nPage= CCO.Item(sLine).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(sLine).ImageHeight
If CCO.Count>=sLine+1 and Not(tLine<=1 and tWord<=1) then
iTop = CCO.Item(sLine+1).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(sLine+1).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(sLine+1).ImageHeight
End if
For xM = 1 to (bMatches.Count)
Set bMatch = bMatches(xM-1)
Index = bMatch.FirstIndex + StartIndex
If CCO.LocateChar(Index-1, nLine, nWord) Then
iBottom = CCO.Item(nline).Bottom
If bLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + bLineAdj) and (nLine+bLineAdj>0) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line bottom up/down by " & bLineAdj & ". ")
iBottom = CCO.Item(nline + bLineAdj).Bottom
End if
End if
if arField(1)<=itop and arField(3)>=itop and pLine<nLine then
WriteLog("Matched Value: '" & cstr(MatchedTextValue(bMatch.value)) & "' ")
Set oSubField=CurrentObj.AddChild(3,"",-1)
If oSubField is Nothing then
Writelog("No SubField Created for Match " & xM & ". ")
Exit for
End if
oSubField.ID = sBaseName & CStr(MatchCount)
oSubField.Type = sBaseName
oSubField.Status = 0
oSubField.Variable("Position") = cstr(iLeft) & "," & cstr(iTop) & "," & cstr(iRight) & "," & cstr(iBottom)
Writelog("Position:" & oSubField.Variable("Position"))
'Check for Page Reference
If nPage>1 then
If Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")))<>ucase(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))) then
If Trim(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage)))<>"" then
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))
end if
End if
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=nHeight
End if
Call oSubField.CreateFields
Set oSubField = Nothing
End if
'Next Line Top after Last Bottom Line becomes next Top - default is current bottom
pLine=nLine
iTop = iBottom
If nLine+bLineAdj>CCO.Count Then nLine=CCO.Count-bLineAdj
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine+ bLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine + bLineAdj).ImageHeight
If (CCO.Count>=(nline+1+ bLineAdj)) Then
iTop = CCO.Item(nline + 1 + bLineAdj).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nLine + 1 + bLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine + 1 + bLineAdj).ImageHeight
If tLineAdj<>0 Then
If CCO.Count >= (nLine + 1 + tLineAdj + bLineAdj) Then
Writelog("Adjusting line Top up/down by " & tLineAdj & ". ")
iTop = CCO.Item(nline + 1 + tLineAdj + bLineAdj).Top
nPage= CCO.Item(nline + 1 + tLineAdj + bLineAdj).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(nLine + 1 + tLineAdj + bLineAdj).ImageHeight
End if
End if
End if
End If
MatchCount = MatchCount + 1
bFound = True
Next
End if
If bFound = True Then
If Not(Pilot is Nothing) And Not IsAlive(LogWindow) then Pilot.ChildrenChanged(CurrentObj)
FindRegExblocks = True
Else
Writelog("No Matches Found")
End If
Set oPage = Nothing
Set regEx = Nothing
Set bMatch = Nothing
Set tMatch = Nothing
Set bMatches = Nothing
Set tMatches = Nothing
Set oSubField = Nothing
Set ZoneCCO = Nothing

af.name: CalculateLocalOffset
af.g:
Dim sName
Dim sPosName
Dim sOffSet
Dim aOffSet
Dim nXoffset
Dim nYoffset
Dim oPage
On Error Resume Next
CalculateLocalOffset=False
sOffSet = ""
Set oPage = CurrentObj
While oPage.ObjectType>2 And Not(oPage.ObjectType<=1)
Set oPage = oPage.Parent()
Wend
sName=oPage.Variable("TemplateID")
If len(sName)=0 then Writelog("No fingerprint ID for this Image found. SetupDCO zone information will not be loaded.")
sPosName = "Pos" & sName
Writelog("ReadZones for " & sPosName)
Set oPage = Nothing
'Find Setup zone position
sZonePos=CurrentObj.Variable(sPosName)
If sZonePos = "" or sZonePos = "0,0,0,0" or not(isnumeric(replace(sZonePos,",",""))) then
Writelog("No Setup Zone Position Information Found.")
Exit Function
End if
aZonePos = splitnumber(sZonePos)
Zx = clng(aZonePos(0))
Zy = clng(aZonePos(1))
'Find current component position
sPosition=CurrentObj.Variable("Position")
If sPosition = "" or sPosition = "0,0,0,0" or not(isnumeric(replace(sPosition,",",""))) then
Writelog("No Committed Component Position Information Found. Checking CCO Position.")
Exit Function
End if
aCurrPos = splitnumber(sPosition)
Cx = clng(aCurrPos(0))
Cy = clng(aCurrPos(1))
'Calculate Local Offset(s)
nXoffSet = -1*(Cx-Zx)
nYoffSet = -1*(Cy-Zy)
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
If Instr(ucase(StrParam),"X")=0 Then nXoffSet = clng(0)
If Instr(ucase(StrParam),"Y")=0 Then nYoffSet = clng(0)
If Not(Isnumeric(nXoffSet)) or len(trim(nXoffSet))=0 then
nXoffset = 0
writelog("X offset value was not numeric or empty. Setting value to Zero.")
end if
If Not(Isnumeric(nYoffSet)) or len(trim(nYoffSet))=0 then
nYoffset = 0
writelog("Y offset value was not numeric or empty. Setting value to Zero.")
end if
Writelog("Offset(s) : " & nXoffset & "," & nYoffset)
CurrentObj.Parent.Variable("Image_Offset") = cstr(nXoffSet) & "," & cstr(nYoffSet)
CalculateLocalOffset=True

af.name: InheritParentPosition
af.g:
Dim oParent
Dim arField
Dim sPosition
Dim sType
InheritParentPosition=False
Set oParent=CurrentObj
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Current Position of Field '" & oParent.Id & "' = '" & sPosition & "'.")
'Added support for smart parmeters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
'Search for specified Parent
StrParam=Trim(StrParam)
Writelog("Looking for parent node '" & StrParam & "'....")
While (oParent.Type<>StrParam or oParent.ID<>StrParam) and oParent.objectType>1
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
Wend
If oParent.Type=StrParam or oParent.ID=StrParam then
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
If ubound(arField)=3 then
CurrentObj.Variable("Position")=sPosition
If oParent.Variable("IMAGEFILE")<>CurrentObj.Variable("IMAGEFILE") then
If Trim(oParent.Variable("IMAGEFILE"))<>"" then
CurrentObj.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oParent.Variable("IMAGEFILE")
end if
End if
InheritParentPosition=true
Else
Writelog("Invalid Position information found.")
End if
Else
Writelog("Node of Type or ID '" & StrParam & "' was not found as a Parent of the calling Node. Exiting.")
End if
Set oParent=Nothing

af.name: CreateBlockCCO
af.g:
Dim oRootPage
Dim arField
Dim sPosition
Dim zoneCCO
Dim iName
Dim oPage
On Error Resume Next
CreateBlockCCO = False
Set oRootPage = CurrentObj
While oRootPage.ObjectType > 2 And Not(oRootPage.ObjectType<=1)
Set oRootPage = oRootPage.Parent()
Wend
sPosition = currentObj.variable("Position")
Writelog("Analyzing zone '" & sPosition & "'.")
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
Set zoneCCO = CCOCreator.AnalyzeBlock(oRootPage.Imagename,arField(0),arField(1),arField(2),arField(3))
Call GetBlockChars(zoneCCO, arField(0),arField(1),arField(2),arField(3))
'**** SAVE BLOCK CCO ****
Set oPage = CurrentObj
While oPage.ObjectType>2 And Not(oPage.ObjectType<=1)
Set oPage = oPage.Parent()
Wend
iName = oPage.Imagename
iName = Left(iName, Len(iName)-4) & "_"
sfileName = iName & CurrentObj.ID & ".CCO"
Writelog("Saving BlockCCO file '" & sfileName & "'.")
Call zoneCCO.Save(sfileName)
CurrentObj.Variable("CCOBlock") = sfileName
Set CCO = zoneCCO
If Err.Number=0 then CreateBlockCCO = True

af.name: FindBlocks_WhiteSpace
af.g:
Dim modStrParam
Dim sValue
Dim Match
Dim tMatches
Dim bMatches
Dim bFound
Dim oValueTop
Dim oValueBtm
Dim nLine, nWord, pLine
Dim index, tindex, bindex
Dim MatchCount
Dim ileft
Dim iRight
Dim iTop
Dim iBottom
Dim oPage
Dim sBasename
Dim osubfield
Dim iName
Dim aStrParam
Dim sLine, sWord, sLine2, sWord2
Dim xM, bM, cM
Dim tLineAdj, bLineAdj
Dim sMCCO
Dim nPage
Dim oParent
Dim arField
Dim tval
Dim nHeight
Dim tLine,tWord
Dim prevLine
Dim oSetupNode
On Error Resume Next
FindBlocks_WhiteSpace = FALSE
If zn_IsCCOEmpty Then Exit Function
'Set Extremes
iTop = clng(CCO.Bottom)
iLeft = clng(CCO.Right)
iRight = clng(CCO.Left)
iBottom = clng(CCO.Top)
'Find CCO Limits
For cM = 1 to CCO.Count
If iTop > clng(CCO.Item(cM).Top) Then iTop = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Top)
If iLeft > clng(CCO.Item(cM).Left) Then iLeft = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Left)
If iRight < clng(CCO.Item(cM).Right) Then iRight = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Right)
If iBottom < clng(CCO.Item(cM).Bottom) Then iBottom = clng(CCO.Item(cM).Bottom)
Next 'cM
'Get Child Base Name
Set oSetupNode = CurrentObj.SetupNode()
If oSetupNode is Nothing then
Writelog("Field Setup Node not found. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
If oSetupNode.NumOfRules<>1 then
Writelog("No Subfields exists in the setup DCO for this field. Action requires a Parent/Child field relationship. Exiting.")
Exit Function
End if
sBaseName = oSetupNode.GetRule(0).Name
Set oSetupNode = Nothing
Set oPage = CurrentObj
While oPage.ObjectType>2 And Not(oPage.ObjectType<=1)
Set oPage = oPage.Parent()
Wend
'Find Current Position limits
Set oParent=CurrentObj
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
If ubound(arField)<>3 then sPosition="0,0,0,0"
While (sPosition="" Or sPosition="0,0,0,0") and oParent.objectType>1
Set oParent = oParent.Parent()
sPosition=trim(oParent.Variable("Position"))
if sPosition="" then sPosition="0,0,0,0"
Writelog("Position of " & oParent.Id & " = " & sPosition)
Wend
Set oParent=Nothing
arField=SplitNumber(sPosition)
If ubound(arField)=3 then
arField(0) = clng(arField(0))
arField(1) = clng(arField(1))
arField(2) = clng(arField(2))
arField(3) = clng(arField(3))
arField(0) = arField(0)-clng(10)
arField(1) = arField(1)-clng(10)
If arField(2)>clng(0) then arField(2) = clng(arField(2))+clng(10)
If arField(3)>clng(0) then arField(3) = clng(arField(3))+clng(10)
'Establish Search Limits for ZEROED zone values
If arField(0) <= clng(0) Then
arField(0) = clng(iLeft)
End if
If arField(1) <= clng(0) Then arField(1) = iTop
If arField(2) > iRight Or arField(2) <= 0 Then arField(2) = iRight
'Find Lowest zoneCCO Position
If arField(3) > iBottom Or arField(3) <= clng(0) Then arField(3) = iBottom
If arField(0)>arField(2) Then
writelog("Swapping left and right zone positions")
tval = arField(0)
arField(0) = arField(2)
arField(2) = tval
End If
If arField(1)>arField(3) Then
writelog("Swapping top and bottom zone positions")
tval = arField(1)
arField(1) = arField(3)
arField(3) = tval
End If
iLeft = arField(0)
iTop = arField(1)
iRight = arField(2)
iBottom = arField(3)
Else
arField=SplitNumber(cstr(iLeft & "," & iTop & "," & iRight & "," & iBottom))
End if
'Find Search Zone Text & Start Index
'Setup Start CCO Position.
Call CCO.GetCurrentPosition(sLine, sWord, sLine2, sWord2)
If sLine=0 then sLine=1
If sWord=0 then sWord=1
If sLine2=0 then sLine2=1
If sWord2=0 then sWord2=1
If sLine2>=sLine then
sLine=sLine2
sWord=sWord2
End if
Writelog("Start CCO Position: Line='" & sLine & "' Word='" & sWord & "'")
Call CCO.LocateLines(arField(1),arField(3),LTop,LBottom)
If LTop = 0 or LBottom = 0 then
Writelog("No Recognition Characters in Search Area.")
Exit Function
End if
'Adjust Search Area to Start CCO Position
If sLine>LTop and sLine<LBottom Then
LTop = sLine
If CCO.item(LTop).Count > sWord Then
sWord = sWord + 1
Else
sLine = sLine + 1
sWord = 1
End if
End if
If sWord=0 then sWord=1
Writelog("Ascending Search from Line:'" & Ltop & "' Word:'" & sWord & "' to Line:'" & LBottom & "' Word:'" & CCO.Item(LBottom).count & "'")
'Initialize MCCO Page Counter
sMCCO=oPage.Variable("CCOBlock")
If sMCCO<>"" Then
sMCCO = FileMgr.GetFileName(sMCCO)
Writelog("MCCO file loaded: " & sMCCO)
sMCCO = sMCCO & "_"
End if
'Added support for smart parmaters
StrParam=MetaWord(StrParam)
writelog("Param: '" & StrParam & "'")
'Check Parameter
nWhiteSpace = Trim(StrParam)
If Not isnumeric(nWhiteSpace) or len(nWhiteSpace)=0 then
Writelog("Parameter must be a Number.")
Exit Function
End if
MatchCount = 1
bFound = False
WriteLog("Divide by Whitespace '" & nWhiteSpace & "' pixels.")
Dim Blocktop
Dim BlockBottom
Dim bBlock
dim nAvg
Dim nCount
BlockTop=0
BlockBottom=0
bBlock=False
nAvg=0
ncount=0
For nLine = Ltop to LBottom
iThisTop = CCO.Item(nline).Top
iThisBottom = CCO.Item(nLine).Bottom
If nLine = CCO.Count then
iNextTop = CCO.Bottom
Else
iNextTop = CCO.Item(nline+1).Top
iNextBottom = CCO.Item(nLine+1).Bottom
End if
'Calc Avg Line Height (only if below param of MAX height)
If clng(iThisBottom-iThisTop)<=clng(nWhiteSpace) then
nAvg = clng(nAvg) + clng(iThisBottom-iThisTop)
ncount=ncount+1
Else
If clng(nAvg)=clng(0) and clng(nWhiteSpace)>clng(0) then
nAvg=Clng(nWhiteSpace)
nCount=1
End if
End if
cAvg = clng(nAvg/ncount)
Writelog(cstr(nLine) & " to " & nLine+1 & " : " & cstr(iNextTop-iThisBottom) & " Avg h '" & cstr(cAvg) & "'")
If clng(iNextTop-iThisBottom)>=clng(nWhitespace) Then
'WhiteSpaceFound!
If BlockTop=0 then
BlockTop=nLine+1
Writelog("First Top Set to line " & BlockTop)
Else
BlockBottom=nLine
Writelog("Creating Block Line " & BlockTop & " to " & BlockBottom)
nPage= CCO.Item(BlockTop).ImageNum
nHeight= CCO.Item(BlockTop).ImageHeight
'CREATE BLOCK
Set oSubField=CurrentObj.AddChild(3,"",-1)
If oSubField is Nothing then
Writelog("No SubField Created for Match " & xM & ". ")
Exit for
End if
oSubField.ID = sBaseName & CStr(MatchCount)
oSubField.Type = sBaseName
oSubField.Status = 0
oSubField.Variable("Position") = cstr(iLeft) & "," & cstr(CCO.Item(BlockTop).Top) & "," & cstr(iRight) & "," & cstr(CCO.Item(BlockBottom).Bottom)
Writelog("Position:" & oSubField.Variable("Position"))
'Check for Page Reference
If nPage>1 then
If Ucase(FileMgr.GetFileName(oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")))<>ucase(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))) then
If Trim(oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage)))<>"" then
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEFILE")=oPage.Variable(sMCCO & cstr(nPage))
End if
End if
oSubField.Variable("IMAGEHEIGHT")=nHeight
End if
Call oSubField.CreateFields
Set oSubField = Nothing
MatchCount = MatchCount + 1
BlockTop=BlockBottom+1
Writelog("Top Of Next Block is " & BlockTop)
bFound = True
End if
End if
Next 'CCO line
If bFound = True Then
If Not(Pilot is Nothing) And Not IsAlive(LogWindow) then Pilot.ChildrenChanged(CurrentObj)
FindBlocks_WhiteSpace = True
Else
Writelog("No Matches Found")
End If
Set oPage = Nothing
Set oSubField = Nothing
Set ZoneCCO = Nothing

f.name: MergeZones
f.g:
Dim sRect
Dim arField
Dim bZero
Dim aParams
Dim posCurObj
Dim oNode
Dim arMerged
Dim sCurRect
On Error Resume Next
MergeZones=TRUE
'Array of SmartParameters
aParams=Split(Trim(SmartParameters)&",", ",")
'Check for Valid Calling Position
sCurRect=Trim(CurrentObj.Variable("Position"))
If len(sCurRect)=0 then sCurRect="0,0,0,0"
arMerged=SplitNumber(sCurRect)
arMergedZone=arMerged
If zn_ValidatePosition(arMerged,False) = False then
Writelog("Calling object has invalid position value:'" & sCurRect & "'")
MergeZones=False
Exit Function
End if
Writelog("Start Position='" & sCurRect )
For i = 0 to (ubound(aParams)-1)
bZero=True
Set oNode=DCONav(aParams(i))
If Not IsAlive(oNode) then
Writelog("SmartParameter:'" & aParams(i) & "' could not find the requested node. The Position for this node will not be Merged.")
Else
'Check for Valid Position
sRect=oNode.Variable("Position")
Writelog("Position:'" & sRect & "'")
arField=SplitNumber(sRect)
If UBound(arField)=3 Then
If arField(0)>0 or arField(1)>0 or arField(2)=0 or arField(3)=0 Then
bZero=False
End if
End if
If bZero=True then
Writelog("Position for node '" & oNode.ID & "' is not complete or ZERO (0,0,0,0). The Position for this node will not be Merged.")
Else
If sCurRect="0,0,0,0" Then
'If calling field is zero then set zone to first 'merged' zone
sCurRect=sRect
arMergedZone=arField
Else
'merge zone
arMergedzone = CombineRect(arMergedzone,arField)
End if
End if
End if
Next 'i
CurrentObj.variable("Position")=arMergedzone(0)& "," & arMergedzone(1) & "," & arMergedzone(2) & "," & arMergedzone(3)
Writelog("New Position='" & CurrentObj.variable("Position"))
Call ErrorHandler("Function MergeZones")

f.name: PadZone
f.g:
Dim aParams
Dim L,T,R,B
Dim arPaddedRect
Dim arRect
Dim sRect
Dim nParams
Dim sPrimaryParse
On Error Resume Next
PadZone=TRUE
'Check for Valid Calling Position
sRect=Trim(CurrentObj.Variable("Position"))
If len(sRect)=0 then sRect="0,0,0,0"
arRect=SplitNumber(sRect)
arPaddedRect=arRect
If zn_ValidatePosition(arRect,False) = False then
Writelog("Calling object has invalid position value:'" & sCurRect & "'")
PadZone=False
Exit Function
End if
If len(Trim(SmartParameters))=0 then
Writelog("No parameters value found. Exiting.")
PadZone=False
Exit Function
End if
Writelog("Start Position='" & sRect )
sPrimaryParse = Trim(MetaWord(SmartParameters))
If len(sPrimaryParse)>0 then SmartParameters = sPrimaryParse
'Array of Parameters
aParams=Split(Trim(SmartParameters) & "," , ",")
nParams=cstr((Ubound(aParams)))
Select Case nParams
Case "1"
'One parameter - pad all LTRB by this value (i.e. expand if positive)
L=MetaWord(aParams(0))
T=L
R=L
B=L
Writelog("Number of Parameters '1'.")
Case "2"
'Two parameters - pad as X,Y (X: apply to L & R, Y: apply to T & B)
L=MetaWord(aParams(0))
T=MetaWord(aParams(1))
R=L
B=T
Writelog("Number of Parameters '2'.")
Case "3","4"
'Multi parameter - pad as L,T,R,B : missing values will be treated as zero.
L=MetaWord(aParams(0))
T=MetaWord(aParams(1))
R=MetaWord(aParams(2))
B=MetaWord(aParams(3))
Writelog("Number of Parameters '3'.")
Case Else
'More than 4 parameters
Writelog("Invalid Number of Parameters:'" & nParams & "'. Expecting 1-4")
PadZone=False
Exit Function
End Select
If len(Trim(L))=0 then L=0
If len(Trim(T))=0 then T=0
If len(Trim(R))=0 then R=0
If len(Trim(B))=0 then B=0
If Not(IsNumeric(L)) or Not(IsNumeric(T)) or Not(IsNumeric(R)) or Not(IsNumeric(B)) then
Writelog("Non Numeric Pad Value. Exiting")
PadZone=False
Exit Function
End if
arPaddedRect = PadRect(arRect,L,T,R,B)
CurrentObj.variable("Position")=arPaddedRect(0)& "," & arPaddedRect(1) & "," & arPaddedRect(2) & "," & arPaddedRect(3)
Writelog("New Position='" & CurrentObj.variable("Position"))
Call ErrorHandler("Function PadZone")

af.name: ResetField
af.g:
' This action deletes the selected Field object's captured value, and sets the field's
' attribute to 0,0,0,0.
On Error Resume Next
ResetField = False
If CurrentObj.ObjectType<> 3 Then
Writelog("Not a field object. Exiting Action.")
Exit Function
End if
CurrentObj.Variable("Position") = "0,0,0,0"
CurrentObj.Text=""
If isObject(Logwindow) then
ValueUP.Text = ""
end if
ResetField = True
Writelog("Current captured value and field position attributes reset.")

1. True or False
True if the action is to create Line-item fields and their sub-fields.
False if the action is to create Line-item fields only.
2. True or False (OPTIONAL: defaults to True)
True if the action is to Analyze the calling zone and analyze word and line relationships based on the zone contents only for the search.
False if the action is to use the existing word and line relationships (CCO for image).
3. 1 or 2 (OPTIONAL: Fill Sub fields option - defaults to 1)
1 - fill by CCO word; if the CCO words overlap by a certain intersection value then fill sub field with its value. Also has sub setting of a colon followed by a group words value. i.e. "1:1.5" (treat words 1.5 character spaces apart or closer as one word)
2 - fill by CCO character; if the CCO characters overlap by a certain intersection value then fill sub field with the character value.
4. 0 to 100 (OPTIONAL: Percent offset adjustment - defaults to 0)
Moderates the flexibility for the left offset based on the overall length of the line. Use larger values for shorter line items.
5. .01 to .99 (OPTIONAL: Intersection Ratio - defaults to .25)
Changes the intersection ratio of Words and Lines used to determine creation and value of Lineitems and their subfields.

It does not support the page-level multi-page functionality.
Saves the current Objects Zone area of an image as a separate Image file. The Zone Image file is always placed in the Batches directory; saving to the current page will create a multi-page TIFF file with the additional image as its zone.
When the image segment is saved, 1 bit black and white images will be saved as a TIFF with CCITT 6 format. If the image is a 24 bit or 8 bit image then the image will be saved as a TIFF with LZW format.
The compression used for color images can be changed by setting the DCO variable "SaveAs_Compression" before calling ZoneImage_SaveAs. These are the values that can be used for "SaveAs_Compression"
0 : TIFF uncompressed
1 : Bitmap uncompressed
7 : TIFF with CCITT 3 compression
8 : TIFF with CCITT 4 compression
9 : TIFF with LZW
10 : TIFF with CCITT 6 compression
13 : JPEG
16 : TIFF with packed bits compression
73 : TIFF with JPEG compression
If the saved image will be used for recognition, then it is recommended to use a lossless compression. A lossy compression, such as JPEG, will degrade text characters, reducing the quality of recognition.
If necessary the extension of the newly created file can be controlled by setting the DCO variable "SaveAs_Extension" prior to calling ZoneImage_SaveAs.
ZoneImage_SaveAs("@P.ID+-+@TYPE")
As part of a rule bound to the Field object of the Document Hierarchy, the action produces this Image File Name: "TM000001-Field1.tif"
rrSet("0","@X.SaveAs_Compression")
ZoneImage_SaveAs("@P.ID+-+@TYPE")
This example first changes the compression to an uncompressed TIF prior to saving the image segment.

Pads calling field's position with each value passed. Number of passed values varies padding vector as follows:
1) Pads Left, Top, Right, and Bottom by this value (i.e. expand if positive)
2) Pads as X,Y (X: pad to Left and Right, Y: pad to Top and Bottom)
3) Pads as Left, Top, Right, and Bottom. (missing values will be treated as zero). 4) Pads as Left, Top, Right, and Bottom.
PadZone("15") Pads 15 pixels to the Left, Right, Top and Bottom position.
PadZone("5,10") Pads 5 pixels to the Left and Right position, and 10 to the Top and Bottom position.
PadZone("-5,0,12,25") Pads -5 pixels to the Left, 0 to the Right, 12 to the Top and 25 to the Bottom position.
